en: The shopkeeper calculated the total using an abacus.
Learning to use an abacus can help improve mental calculation skills.
The abacus is one of the earliest known calculating devices.
cn: 店主用算盘计算了总额。
学习使用算盘有助于提高心算能力。
算盘是已知最古老的计算装置之一。

definitions.definition: 降低（地位、身份、尊严）；使谦卑

en: He would not abase himself by showing fear in front of his enemies.
The king's decree was meant to abase the power of the noble families.
She felt abased by the constant criticism from her supervisor.
cn: 他不会在敌人面前因显露恐惧而自贬身份。
国王的法令意在削弱贵族家族的权力。
她因主管不断的批评而感到尊严受损。

en: The storm abated by dawn.
The court ordered the noise to be abated immediately.
His anger abated when he heard the explanation.
cn: 暴风雨在黎明前减弱了。
法院命令立即减少噪音。
听到解释后，他的怒气消退了。

en: Please abbreviate " Avenue " to " Ave. " in the address.
cn: 请在地址中将 "Avenue" 缩写为 "Ave."。

en: "IT" is a common abbreviation for "Information Technology".
Please avoid using abbreviations in formal academic writing.
The abbreviation "e.g." stands for the Latin phrase "exempli gratia".
cn: “IT”是“Information Technology”（信息技术）的一个常见缩写。
请在正式的学术写作中避免使用缩写词。
缩写“e.g.”代表拉丁短语“exempli gratia”（例如）。

definitions.definition: 正式放弃（权力、责任或职位）

en: The king was forced to abdicate the throne after the revolution.
She abdicated her role as CEO to focus on family.
Leaders who abdicate responsibility lose public trust.
cn: 革命后，国王被迫退位。
她辞去CEO职务以专注家庭。
放弃责任的领导者会失去公众信任。

en: The doctor examined her abdominal pain carefully.
Core exercises strengthen the abdominal muscles.
The scan revealed an abnormality in the abdominal cavity.
cn: 医生仔细检查了她的腹痛。
核心训练能增强腹部肌肉。
扫描显示腹腔内有一处异常。

en: The criminals planned to abduct the billionaire's son for ransom.
The doctor explained how this muscle helps to abduct the arm.
In the novel, the protagonist was abducted by aliens.
cn: 犯罪分子计划绑架亿万富翁的儿子以索取赎金。
医生解释了这块肌肉如何帮助手臂外展。
小说中，主人公被外星人劫持。

definitions.definition: 偏离正常的；反常的；异常的（尤指行为或观念）

en: The biologist took notes on the aberrant growth pattern observed in the plant sample.
His aberrant behavior at the meeting raised concerns among his colleagues.
In statistics, an aberrant value is one that significantly differs from the rest of the data set.
cn: 生物学家记录了在植物样本中观察到的异常生长模式。
他在会议上的反常行为引起了同事们的担忧。
在统计学中，异常值是指与数据集中其他值显著不同的值。

en: She abhors violence in any form.
The philosopher abhorred hypocrisy and empty rhetoric.
His strict upbringing caused him to abhor laziness.
cn: 她憎恶任何形式的暴力。
这位哲学家厌恶虚伪与空洞的言辞。
严格的成长环境使他对懒惰深恶痛绝。

en: You must abide by the rules of the game.
She cannot abide his rude behavior.
The memory of that day will abide forever.
cn: 你必须遵守比赛规则。
她无法容忍他的粗鲁行为。
那一天的记忆将永远留存。

en: She has an abiding love for classical music.
The agreement has no abiding legal force.
His abiding faith in humanity inspired many.
cn: 她对古典音乐有着持久的热爱。
该协议不具备永久法律效力。
他对人性坚定不移的信念激励了许多人。

definitions.definition: 奴颜婢膝的；低声下气的

en: They live in abject poverty, without access to clean water.
His abject apology failed to convince the angry crowd.
The prisoner's abject surrender shocked the guards.
cn: 他们生活在赤贫中，连干净的水都用不上。
他低声下气的道歉未能平息愤怒的人群。
囚犯卑躬屈膝的投降让警卫震惊。

en: The forest was set ablaze by lightning.
Her eyes were ablaze with excitement.
The protesters' speeches left the crowd ablaze with anger.
cn: 森林被闪电点燃，燃起大火。
她的双眼因兴奋而闪闪发光。
抗议者的演讲让群情激愤。

en: She ably demonstrated the complex procedure to the new interns.
The manager ably handled the customer's complaint, turning a negative situation into a positive one.
Despite the short notice, the team ably completed the project ahead of schedule.
cn: 她向新实习生巧妙地演示了复杂的程序。
经理能干地处理了客户的投诉，将负面局面转化为积极的一面。
尽管通知得很仓促，团队还是有效地提前完成了项目。

en: The test results showed a genetic abnormality.
Such behavior is considered an abnormality in this culture.
The doctor studied the abnormality in the X-ray carefully.
cn: 检测结果显示基因异常。
此类行为在该文化中被视为反常。
医生仔细研究了X光片中的异常部位。

en: He has no fixed abode and moves from place to place.
The old manor was a peaceful abode surrounded by nature.
They abode in the small village for many years.
cn: 他没有固定住所，从一个地方搬到另一个地方。
那座古老的庄园是一座被自然环绕的宁静住所。
他们在这个小村庄里居住了多年。

definitions.definition: 令人憎恶的；可恶的；糟糕透顶的

en: The abominable treatment of prisoners sparked international outrage.
We had abominable weather throughout the entire vacation.
The dictator's abominable crimes against humanity will never be forgotten.
cn: 对囚犯骇人听闻的待遇引发了国际社会的愤慨。
我们整个假期期间的天气都糟透了。
这位独裁者反人类的滔天罪行永远不会被遗忘。

en: The mission had to abort due to technical failure.
She decided to abort the pregnancy after careful consideration.
The rocket’s launch was aborted at the last second.
cn: 任务因技术故障被迫中止。
经过慎重考虑，她决定终止妊娠。
火箭发射在最后一秒被取消。

definitions.definition: 光明正大的，公开透明的

en: All their business dealings have been completely aboveboard.
She insisted that everything was done aboveboard.
The negotiations need to be conducted aboveboard to avoid suspicion.
cn: 他们的所有商业往来都完全公开透明。
她坚称一切操作都是光明正大的。
谈判需公开进行以避免猜疑。

definitions.definition: 研磨的；粗糙的（指物理特性）
伤人感情的；生硬粗暴的（指行为或言语）

en: The abrasive surface of the sandpaper quickly smoothed the wood.
His abrasive comments during the meeting offended several colleagues.
Avoid using abrasive cleaners on delicate glassware.
cn: 砂纸粗糙的表面迅速磨平了木头。
他在会议中生硬的言论冒犯了几位同事。
避免在精致玻璃器皿上使用研磨性清洁剂。

definitions.definition: 并列，并排（尤指行进或保持同步）
了解最新情况（常与 of 连用）

en: The soldiers marched four abreast down the narrow street.
She keeps abreast of the latest scientific developments.
The cyclists rode abreast, chatting as they pedaled.
cn: 士兵们四人一排沿着狭窄的街道行进。
她始终紧跟最新的科学发展动态。
骑行者们并排骑行，一边蹬车一边交谈。

definitions.definition: （尤指长期或习惯性）缺席者（如学生、选民等）

en: The school tracks absentees to improve attendance rates.
Absentee ballots allow voters to participate remotely.
The factory faced labor shortages due to high absenteeism.
cn: 学校记录缺席者以提高出勤率。
缺席选票让选民可远程参与投票。
该工厂因高缺勤率面临劳动力短缺。

definitions.definition: 戒除；节制（尤指自愿避免某事，如饮酒、投票等）

en: He decided to abstain from alcohol for health reasons.
Several members abstained during the controversial vote.
Monks abstain from worldly pleasures as a spiritual practice.
cn: 他因健康原因决定戒酒。
数名成员在争议性投票中弃权。
僧侣通过禁绝世俗享乐进行灵修。

en: The resolution was passed due to the abstention of two key members.
His abstention from alcohol has significantly improved his health.
Abstention is often interpreted as a silent form of protest in diplomatic meetings.
cn: 由于两名关键成员的弃权，该决议得以通过。
他戒酒后健康状况显著改善。
在外交会议上，弃权常被解读为一种沉默的抗议形式。

definitions.definition: 节制（尤指对享乐或欲望的克制，如饮食、酒精等）
禁欲（宗教或道德层面的自我约束）

en: His doctor recommended abstinence from alcohol to improve his liver health.
Monks practice abstinence as part of their spiritual discipline.
Temporary abstinence from social media can reduce stress.
cn: 医生建议他戒酒以改善肝脏健康。
僧侣将禁欲作为修行的一部分。
暂时远离社交媒体可以减轻压力。

en: He was fired for using abusive language to his colleagues.
The report exposed the abusive practices in some factories.
Abusive relationships often leave deep psychological scars.
cn: 他因对同事使用辱骂性语言而被解雇。
这份报告揭露了一些工厂的虐待行为。
虐待性关系通常会留下深刻的心理创伤。

definitions.definition: 深渊；无底洞（字面或比喻）

en: The submarine explored the dark abyss of the ocean trench.
Her grief felt like an endless abyss.
Ancient myths often depict the abyss as a realm of chaos.
cn: 潜艇探索了海沟的黑暗深渊。
她的悲伤如同无尽的深渊。
古代神话常将深渊描绘为混沌之境。

definitions.definition: 院士；学会会员（尤指科学院或艺术院成员）

en: She was elected as an academician of the National Academy of Sciences.
The academician delivered a groundbreaking lecture on quantum physics.
Only distinguished scholars can become academicians in this prestigious institution.
cn: 她当选为国家科学院院士。
这位院士发表了一场关于量子物理的突破性演讲。
只有杰出学者才能成为这一知名机构的院士。

definitions.definition: 同意，应允（尤指最初反对后）

en: The president finally acceded to the protesters' demands.
He acceded to the throne after his father's death.
The committee acceded to our proposal with minor revisions.
cn: 总统最终同意了抗议者的要求。
他在父亲去世后继任王位。
委员会稍作修改后通过了我们的提案。

en: The dark frame accentuates the brightness of the painting.
She wore a red belt to accentuate her waistline.
The report accentuates the need for immediate action.
cn: 深色画框凸显了画作的明亮部分。
她系了一条红色腰带以突出腰线。
报告强调了立即采取行动的必要性。

en: The museum is accessible to wheelchair users.
Her writing style makes complex ideas accessible.
The report is now accessible online.
cn: 这座博物馆对轮椅使用者开放。
她的写作风格使复杂思想易于理解。
该报告现在可在线获取。

definitions.definition: 加入；就职；正式接纳（如加入国际组织）
（财产、权力的）获得；新增藏品（博物馆等）
正式登记（新增物品或权利）

en: The country's accession to the EU took five years of negotiations.
The museum announced the accession of a rare Picasso painting.
Her accession to the throne marked a new era.
cn: 该国加入欧盟经历了五年的谈判。
博物馆宣布新增一幅毕加索罕见画作。
她的登基标志着一个新时代的开始。

en: The audience acclaimed the performer with a standing ovation.
Her research was acclaimed as a breakthrough in science.
The book received critical acclaim upon its release.
cn: 观众起立鼓掌，向表演者喝彩。
她的研究被称赞为科学界的突破。
这本书一经出版便获得评论界的高度赞扬。

definitions.definition: 伴奏者（尤指为独奏或独唱者进行钢琴伴奏的人）

en: The pianist worked as an accompanist for the opera singer for over a decade.
A skilled accompanist must listen carefully to adapt to the soloist's tempo and expression.
She hired a professional accompanist to practice her violin concerto before the competition.
cn: 这位钢琴家为歌剧演唱家担任伴奏者已超过十年。
一名熟练的伴奏者必须仔细聆听，以适应独奏者的节奏和表情。
她在比赛前聘请了一位专业伴奏者来练习她的小提琴协奏曲。

en: The police arrested him and his accomplice after the robbery.
Without an accomplice, the thief couldn’t have stolen the jewels.
She was unaware that her friend had become an accomplice in the fraud.
cn: 抢劫后，警方逮捕了他和他的同伙。
若没有共犯，小偷不可能盗走珠宝。
她未意识到朋友已成了诈骗案的共犯。

definitions.definition: 负有责任的（需对行为或决定作出解释）
可解释的（符合逻辑或事实的）

en: Public officials should be accountable for their decisions.
The lack of accountable data made the research unreliable.
A good leader creates an accountable team culture.
cn: 公职人员应对自己的决策负责。
缺乏可验证的数据导致研究不可靠。
优秀的领导者会建立一种团队问责文化。

en: She decided to pursue a career in accountancy after graduating.
A strong understanding of economics is beneficial for those in accountancy.
The firm offers services in auditing, tax advice, and accountancy.
cn: 她决定毕业后从事会计职业。
扎实的经济学知识对从事会计工作的人有益。
这家公司提供审计、税务咨询和会计服务。

en: The university is accredited by the Ministry of Education.
She accredited her success to hard work and perseverance.
The journalist was accredited to cover the presidential election.
cn: 这所大学获得了教育部的官方认证。
她将成功归因于努力和坚持。
这名记者获授权报道总统选举。

definitions.definition: （利息、收益等）自然积累；逐渐增加

en: Interest will accrue on the savings account monthly.
Over time, her experience accrued into valuable expertise.
The company accrued significant debts during the expansion.
cn: 储蓄账户的利息将按月累积。
随着时间的推移，她的经验逐渐积累成宝贵的专业知识。
该公司在扩张期间累积了巨额债务。

en: She reluctantly acquiesced to their demands.
The government acquiesced in the protest after days of negotiation.
He nodded quietly, acquiescing without a word.
cn: 她勉强默许了他们的要求。
经过数日谈判，政府默许了抗议活动。
他安静地点头，一言不发地默认了。

en: The jury acquitted the defendant due to lack of evidence.
She acquitted herself admirably in the leadership role.
The soldier acquitted his duty with courage.
cn: 陪审团因证据不足宣判被告无罪。
她在领导角色中表现出色，完美履行了职责。
这名士兵勇敢地完成了他的使命。

en: The jury's verdict resulted in his acquittal.
Acquittal in this case sets a controversial precedent.
Her lawyer fought tirelessly to secure an acquittal.
cn: 陪审团的裁决使他无罪释放。
本案的无罪判决开创了争议性先例。
她的律师不懈努力以争取无罪判决。

definitions.definition: （言语、态度或争执的）尖刻，刻薄，激烈

en: The debate was filled with acrimony, leaving both sides resentful.
Despite their divorce, they managed to part without acrimony.
His criticism was not offered in acrimony but as constructive advice.
cn: 辩论充满了尖酸刻薄，让双方都心怀怨恨。
尽管离婚了，他们还是成功地好聚好散，没有互相攻讦。
他的批评并非出于刻薄，而是作为建设性的建议。

en: The documentary captures the harsh actuality of life in the war zone.
In philosophy, potentiality and actuality are fundamental concepts.
His dreams finally became an actuality after years of effort.
cn: 这部纪录片记录了战区生活的残酷现实。
在哲学中，潜在性与现实性是基本概念。
经过多年努力，他的梦想终于成为现实。

en: Her business acumen saved the company from bankruptcy.
The professor's intellectual acumen impressed all his students.
Political acumen is essential for a successful diplomat.
cn: 她的商业敏锐力使公司免于破产。
教授的学术洞察力令所有学生叹服。
政治敏锐力是成功外交官的必备素质。

definitions.definition: （古）坚硬的物质（如钻石或磁石）

en: She was adamant about refusing the offer.
The diamond’s adamant surface resisted all scratches.
His adamant stance on the issue surprised everyone.
cn: 她坚决拒绝了这个提议。
钻石坚硬的表面抗住了所有刮痕。
他在这个问题上的固执立场让所有人惊讶。

en: Social media can be highly addictive.
The game's design is intentionally addictive.
Sugar has an addictive effect on the brain.
cn: 社交媒体可能极具成瘾性。
这款游戏的设计刻意追求让人上瘾。
糖会对大脑产生成瘾性影响。

en: This food contains no artificial additives.
The additive effect of these medications can be dangerous.
Color additives must be approved by the FDA.
cn: 这种食品不含人工添加剂。
这些药物的叠加效应可能很危险。
着色剂必须通过美国食品药品监督管理局认证。

definitions.definition: 附加物；附加组件；扩展功能

en: This software supports various add-ons to enhance its functionality.
The flight booking includes an add-on for extra luggage.
You can install this browser add-on to block advertisements.
cn: 该软件支持多种附加组件以增强其功能。
机票预订包含额外行李的附加服务。
你可以安装这个浏览器扩展来屏蔽广告。

en: She is adept at solving complex problems under pressure.
The workshop was led by an adept in traditional woodworking.
His adept handling of the crisis earned him a promotion.
cn: 她擅长在压力下解决复杂问题。
该研讨会由一位传统木工技艺的专家主持。
他对危机的娴熟处理为他赢得了晋升。

en: The adhesive tape stuck firmly to the surface.
This glue is highly adhesive even on wet materials.
She used an adhesive to repair the broken vase.
cn: 胶带牢牢粘在表面上。
这种胶水即使在潮湿材料上也有强黏性。
她用黏合剂修复了破碎的花瓶。

en: She saw an ad for the job online.
The company placed an ad in the local newspaper.
Click the ad to learn more about the product.
cn: 她在网上看到了这份工作的广告。
该公司在本地报纸上刊登了一则广告。
点击广告以了解更多产品信息。

en: The two gardens adjoin at the hedge.
Our office adjoins the train station.
The theory adjoins several disciplines.
cn: 两座花园在树篱处相连。
我们的办公室紧邻火车站。
这一理论与多个学科领域相关联。

definitions.definition: /vi. 休会；延期；推迟（会议或活动）

en: The committee decided to adjourn the meeting until next week.
Court will adjourn at 4:30 PM today.
Let’s adjourn for lunch and reconvene in an hour.
cn: 委员会决定休会，下周继续。
法庭将于今天下午4:30休庭。
我们暂停会议去用餐，一小时后继续。

definitions.definition: 判决；裁定（法律或正式场合）

en: The court will adjudicate the dispute between the two companies.
As a teacher, she often has to adjudicate disagreements among students.
The committee was formed to adjudicate on ethical violations.
cn: 法院将裁决这两家公司之间的纠纷。
作为教师，她经常需要仲裁学生间的分歧。
该委员会成立以裁定违反道德的行为。

definitions.definition: 附属物；附加物；辅助人员（如兼职教师）

en: The professor works as an adjunct at three different universities.
The smartphone’s camera is a useful adjunct to its primary functions.
The rules are adjunct to the main contract and must be followed.
cn: 这位教授在三所大学担任兼职教师。
这款智能手机的摄像头是其核心功能的有用补充。
这些条款是主合同的附属部分，必须遵守。

definitions.definition: （证据或论点）可接受的；可采纳的
（人或事物）有资格加入的；准予进入的

en: The judge ruled that the evidence was admissible in court.
Only applicants with admissible qualifications will be considered for the position.
Her excuse for being late was not admissible.
cn: 法官裁定该证据在法庭上可被采纳。
只有拥有合格资质的申请者才会被考虑该职位。
她迟到的借口是不可接受的。

definitions.definition: 告诫，劝告（温和或正式地批评）

en: The teacher admonished the students for neglecting their homework.
She admonished him to drive carefully in the storm.
His tone was more sad than angry when he admonished his friend.
cn: 老师因学生忽视作业而告诫他们。
她提醒他在暴风雨中小心驾驶。
他告诫朋友时，语气中的悲伤多过愤怒。

en: Without further ado, let us begin the ceremony.
She always makes much ado about trivial matters.
The meeting proceeded without any ado.
cn: 事不宜迟，让我们开始仪式吧。
她总是为琐事大惊小怪。
会议顺利进行，没有出现任何纷扰。

en: She adorned her hair with fresh flowers.
The walls were adorned with paintings by local artists.
His speech was adorned with witty anecdotes.
cn: 她用鲜花装饰头发。
墙上装饰着当地艺术家的画作。
他的演讲因风趣的轶事而增色。

definitions.definition: /adv. 漂浮的（地）；随波逐流的（地）
/adv. 无目标的（地）；脱离常规的（地）

en: The boat was left adrift after the storm.
His career seemed adrift without clear goals.
She felt emotionally adrift after the breakup.
cn: 风暴过后，小船随波漂流。
他的职业生涯缺乏明确目标，显得漫无方向。
分手后，她在情感上感到无所适从。

en: She is adroit at handling difficult situations.
The adroit negotiator secured a favorable deal for his client.
His adroit fingers quickly repaired the delicate mechanism.
cn: 她善于处理棘手的情况。
这位精明的谈判者为他的客户争取到了有利的交易。
他灵巧的手指迅速修好了那个精密的机械装置。

definitions.definition: 掺假的；通奸的（古义/罕用）

en: It is illegal to adulterate food with harmful substances.
The spice was adulterated with cheap fillers to increase profit.
Historically, merchants would adulterate wine with water to sell more.
cn: 在食品中掺入有害物质是违法的。
这种香料被掺入廉价的填充物以增加利润。
历史上，商人会往酒里掺水以扩大销量。

definitions.definition: 通奸（自愿发生的婚外性行为）

en: In some cultures, adultery was historically punishable by death.
cn: 在某些文化中，通奸曾是可判处死刑的罪行。

definitions.definition: （重要事件、时期或人物的）到来，出现

en: The advent of the internet revolutionized communication.
Advent calendars count down the days until Christmas.
Scientists anticipate the advent of clean energy solutions.
cn: 互联网的出现彻底改变了通讯方式。
降临节日历用来倒数圣诞前的天数。
科学家们期待清洁能源解决方案的到来。

en: The chess champion faced his toughest adversary yet.
In debate, she skillfully countered every argument of her adversary.
The two companies became direct adversaries in the market.
cn: 这位国际象棋冠军遇到了迄今为止最强的对手。
辩论中，她巧妙地反驳了对手的每一个论点。
这两家公司成了市场上的直接竞争对手。

en: The expedition faced adverse weather conditions.
His adverse reaction to the medicine surprised the doctor.
The policy had an adverse impact on small businesses.
cn: 探险队遭遇了恶劣天气。
他对药物的不良反应让医生感到意外。
该政策对小企业产生了负面影响。

en: She showed remarkable resilience in the face of adversity.
Historical figures often achieve greatness by overcoming adversity.
Financial adversity forced him to rethink his career path.
cn: 她在逆境中展现出非凡的韧性。
历史人物常通过战胜苦难成就伟大。
经济困境迫使他重新规划职业道路。

definitions.definition: （对观点、政策或群体的）支持，拥护
（法律或专业领域的）辩护，代言

en: Her advocacy for environmental protection inspired many.
The lawyer’s advocacy skills won the case.
Youth advocacy groups are pushing for policy changes.
cn: 她对环保的倡导激励了许多人。
律师的辩护技巧赢得了案件。
青年倡议团体正在推动政策变革。

definitions.definition: 特技飞行；特技飞行表演

en: The pilot performed incredible aerobatics at the air show.
Mastering aerobatics requires extensive training and precision.
The crowd gasped as the aircraft spun during the aerobatics display.
cn: 这名飞行员在航展上表演了令人难以置信的特技飞行动作。
掌握特技飞行需要大量的训练和精准的操作。
当飞机在特技飞行表演中旋转时，人群发出了惊叹声。

definitions.definition: 有氧运动（一种通过持续动作增强心肺功能的锻炼方式）

en: She attends aerobics classes three times a week to stay fit.
Aerobics became popular in the 1980s as a fun way to exercise.
Doctors recommend aerobics for improving cardiovascular health.
cn: 她每周参加三次有氧运动课程以保持健康。
有氧运动在1980年代因其趣味性而流行。
医生推荐有氧运动以改善心血管健康。

definitions.definition: 空气动力学，研究空气或其他气体运动及其与物体相互作用的科学

en: The design of the new aircraft was optimized using principles of aerodynamics.
Aerodynamics plays a crucial role in the performance of racing cars.
She is studying aerodynamics to better understand fluid motion.
cn: 新飞行器的设计运用空气动力学原理进行了优化。
空气动力学对赛车的性能起着至关重要的作用。
她正在学习空气动力学，以更好地理解流体运动。

definitions.definition: 气溶胶（悬浮在气体中的微小固体或液体颗粒）
喷雾剂（加压容器中喷出的气溶胶制剂）

en: The volcano ejected an aerosol of ash and sulfur dioxide into the stratosphere.
She used an aerosol spray to paint the metal surface evenly.
Aerosol particles can affect climate by scattering sunlight.
cn: 火山向平流层喷出含火山灰和二氧化硫的气溶胶。
她使用喷雾剂均匀喷涂金属表面。
气溶胶颗粒能通过散射阳光影响气候。

definitions.definition: 航空航天空间（指地球大气层及其以外的宇宙空间）

en: The aerospace industry is developing faster than ever.
NASA conducts research in aerospace engineering.
The museum exhibits historic aerospace vehicles.
cn: 航空航天产业的发展速度前所未有。
美国宇航局从事航空航天工程研究。
博物馆展出了历史上的航空航天器。

en: The professor was known for his affable manner, always greeting students with a smile.
Despite his high status, the CEO remained affable and approachable.
Her affable personality made her a favorite among colleagues.
cn: 这位教授以和蔼著称，总是微笑着问候学生。
尽管地位显赫，这位CEO依然保持平易近人的态度。
她友善的性格使她深受同事喜爱。

en: The university is affiliated with several research institutes.
She works as an affiliate marketer for global brands.
The two companies decided to affiliate to expand their market share.
cn: 这所大学与多家研究机构有隶属关系。
她为国际品牌从事联盟营销工作。
两家公司决定联合以扩大市场份额。

definitions.definition: 密切关系；吸引力（如化学、生物学或人际间的天然联系）
相似性；共鸣（指事物间的内在相似或适配性）

en: The enzyme shows a strong affinity for certain proteins.
Their shared love of music created an instant affinity between them.
There’s a clear affinity between the two artists’ styles.
cn: 这种酶对特定蛋白质表现出强亲和力。
对音乐的共同热爱使他们迅速产生共鸣。
两位艺术家的风格有明显相似性。

en: The region is afflicted by drought every summer.
She was afflicted with guilt after the accident.
Diseases that afflict the elderly require specialized care.
cn: 该地区每年夏季都遭受干旱的折磨。
事故后她深陷内疚的痛苦中。
折磨老年人的疾病需要专业护理。

en: His refusal to apologize was a direct affront to her dignity.
The graffiti on the monument affronted the entire community.
She took his criticism as a personal affront.
cn: 他的拒绝道歉是对她尊严的公然侮辱。
纪念碑上的涂鸦冒犯了整个社区。
她将他的批评视为对个人的侮辱。

en: The botanists went afield to collect rare plant specimens.
His comments strayed afield from the main topic.
Soldiers were sent afield to guard the borders.
cn: 植物学家们去野外采集稀有植物标本。
他的评论偏离了主题。
士兵被派往边境驻守。

definitions.definition: 漂浮的；在水面（或空中）不沉的

en: The boat stayed afloat despite the storm.
With careful budgeting, the company remained afloat.
Leaves were afloat on the pond's surface.
cn: 小船在风暴中仍保持漂浮。
通过精打细算，公司得以维持运营。
树叶漂浮在池塘水面上。

en: Rumors of a merger are afoot in the company.
The detective sensed trouble afoot and stayed alert.
They traveled afoot through the mountains for days.
cn: 公司里流传着合并的传闻。
侦探察觉到有麻烦在酝酿，保持警惕。
他们徒步穿越山区数日。

en: After the failure, they decided to start afresh with a new strategy.
The wall was painted white afresh to cover the old stains.
She wiped the slate afresh and began writing again.
cn: 失败后，他们决定采用新策略重新开始。
墙被重新刷白以遮盖旧污渍。
她擦干净石板重新开始书写。

definitions.definition: 使恶化；加重（问题、疾病等）

en: Smoking can aggravate respiratory conditions.
His sarcastic remarks only aggravated the tension in the room.
Don't aggravate your mother by leaving your clothes on the floor.
cn: 吸烟会加重呼吸系统疾病。
他的讽刺言论只会加剧房间里的紧张气氛。
别把衣服扔地上，这会惹恼你妈妈。

en: The aggregate score of the team was impressive.
We need to aggregate data from multiple sources.
Sand is an aggregate of small rock particles.
cn: 球队的总分令人印象深刻。
我们需要汇总来自多个来源的数据。
沙子是小岩石颗粒的集合体。

definitions.definition: 感到委屈的；愤愤不平的

en: She was aggrieved by the unfair treatment.
The aggrieved tenant filed a lawsuit against the landlord.
His aggrieved tone revealed deep disappointment.
cn: 她因不公平的待遇感到愤愤不平。
权益受侵害的租户对房东提起了诉讼。
他委屈的语气透露出深深的失望。

en: The agile gymnast flipped effortlessly between the parallel bars.
An agile mind is essential for solving complex problems.
Startups need agile strategies to adapt to market changes.
cn: 这位敏捷的体操运动员在双杠间轻松翻转。
机敏的头脑对解决复杂问题至关重要。
初创企业需要灵活的策略以适应市场变化。

definitions.definition: 使激动；使焦虑；搅动（液体）

en: The wind agitated the surface of the lake.
His speech agitated the crowd into protest.
She felt agitated before the interview.
cn: 风搅动了湖面。
他的演讲煽动人群发起抗议。
面试前她感到焦躁不安。

en: The agitation of the crowd grew as the speech continued.
She stirred the soup with slow agitation to avoid splashing.
Political agitation often leads to social change.
cn: 人群随着演讲的继续变得越来越激动。
她缓慢搅动汤以避免溅出。
政治鼓动常引发社会变革。

definitions.definition: 不可知论者（认为上帝或任何超自然事物是否存在不可知的人）
不可知论的；未知的；不可知的

en: As an agnostic, he remained open-minded about the existence of a higher power but demanded empirical evidence.
The agnostic viewpoint often serves as a middle ground between fervent belief and outright atheism.
Her agnostic approach to the new theory meant she neither accepted nor rejected it without further data.
cn: 作为一名不可知论者，他对更高力量的存在持开放态度，但要求经验证据。
不可知论观点常常是狂热信仰和彻底无神论之间的中间立场。
她对这个新理论持不可知的态度，意味着在没有进一步数据的情况下，她既不接受也不拒绝它。

definitions.definition: 令人极度痛苦的；折磨人的
(agonize的现在分词) 使痛苦；挣扎

en: The agonizing wait for the test results made her sleepless.
He spent an agonizing hour trying to make the decision.
The soldier's agonizing scream echoed across the battlefield.
cn: 等待考试结果的煎熬让她彻夜难眠。
他花了一小时痛苦地做决定。
士兵痛苦的惨叫在战场上回荡。

en: The tanker ran aground during the storm, causing a major oil spill.
Sailors must check charts carefully to avoid going aground in shallow waters.
The rescue team worked for days to refloat the ship that was aground near the harbor.
cn: 油轮在风暴中搁浅，导致了严重的原油泄漏。
船员必须仔细查看海图，避免在浅水区搁浅。
救援团队连日工作，试图使搁浅在港口附近的船只重新浮起。

definitions.definition: 艾滋病（获得性免疫缺陷综合征）

en: Scientists are working tirelessly to find a cure for AIDS.
Public awareness campaigns have reduced AIDS transmission rates.
Early diagnosis is crucial for managing AIDS effectively.
cn: 科学家们正不懈努力寻找艾滋病的治愈方法。
公众宣传活动降低了艾滋病传播率。
早期诊断对有效控制艾滋病至关重要。

definitions.definition: 生病的；健康状况不佳的

en: The ailing patient needs immediate medical attention.
The government introduced policies to rescue the ailing economy.
Her ailing grandmother still manages to tend the garden.
cn: 这位病情加重的患者需要立即就医。
政府出台政策以挽救低迷的经济。
她体弱的祖母仍坚持打理花园。

en: She complained of a minor ailment that kept her in bed all day.
Herbal teas are often used to relieve common ailments.
The doctor assured him it was just a temporary ailment.
cn: 她因小病卧床一整天。
花草茶常用来缓解常见不适。
医生向他保证这只是暂时的小毛病。

en: The virus can become airborne and spread rapidly.
Airborne troops were deployed behind enemy lines.
The drone delivers airborne packages to remote areas.
cn: 病毒可通过空气传播并快速扩散。
空降部队被部署到敌后战线。
无人机将空运包裹送达偏远地区。

definitions.definition: 轻松地；快活地；漫不经心地

en: She waved her hand airily and walked away, not seeming to care about the consequences.
The dancer moved airily across the stage, as if floating on a cloud.
He answered the serious question airily, with a laugh that surprised everyone.
cn: 她漫不经心地挥了挥手就走开了，似乎对后果毫不在意。
舞者在舞台上轻盈地移动，仿佛在云端漂浮。
他以一种轻松的方式回答了这个严肃的问题，笑声让所有人都感到惊讶。

definitions.definition: 空运；空运行动；空运物资

en: The government organized an emergency airlift to deliver supplies to the flood-stricken area.
During the blockade, the city survived on a constant airlift of food and medicine.
The rescue team was airlifted to the mountaintop by helicopter.
cn: 政府组织了一次紧急空运，向洪灾地区运送物资。
在封锁期间，这座城市依靠持续的空运食物和药品得以维持。
救援队由直升机空运至山顶。

definitions.definition: 简易机场（通常为未铺装的狭长跑道，供小型飞机起降）

en: The bush pilot landed smoothly on the remote airstrip.
During the war, makeshift airstrips were built in jungles.
The airstrip was too short for commercial jets.
cn: 这位丛林飞行员平稳降落在偏远的简易跑道上。
战争期间，丛林里搭建了临时简易机场。
这条跑道太短，无法起降商用喷气机。

en: The room felt light and airy with its large windows.
She danced with an airy grace, as if floating on air.
His promises were just airy dreams with no real plan.
cn: 大窗户让房间明亮通风。
她舞步轻盈优雅，宛如凌空飘浮。
他的承诺只是不切实际的空想，毫无具体计划。

en: The door was left ajar, allowing a sliver of light to enter.
She peeked through the ajar window to see who was outside.
The cat nudged the ajar cabinet door open with its paw.
cn: 门半掩着，透进一缕光线。
她从微开的窗户窥视外面是谁。
猫用爪子推开了半开的橱柜门。

definitions.definition: 炼金术（中世纪化学与哲学的结合，试图将普通金属转化为黄金）
（引申义）神秘或难以理解的变化过程

en: Medieval alchemy laid the foundation for modern chemistry.
The transformation of her ideas into a masterpiece seemed like alchemy.
His approach to business is a strange alchemy of intuition and logic.
cn: 中世纪的炼金术为现代化学奠定了基础。
她的想法蜕变为杰作的过程宛如炼金术。
他的商业策略是直觉与逻辑的奇妙结合。

en: His alcoholism destroyed both his career and family relationships.
Early intervention is crucial in treating alcoholism.
The documentary explores the genetic factors behind alcoholism.
cn: 他的酗酒问题毁掉了他的事业和家庭关系。
早期干预对治疗酒精中毒至关重要。
这部纪录片探讨了酗酒背后的遗传因素。

en: The hacker operated under an alias to avoid detection.
The document was signed by John Smith, alias "Jack Frost".
The suspect had multiple aliases in different countries.
cn: 这名黑客使用化名活动以躲避追踪。
文件由约翰·史密斯签署，又名“杰克·弗罗斯特”。
该嫌疑人在不同国家使用多个别名。

en: The suspect provided a solid alibi for the night of the crime.
She always has an alibi for not finishing her homework.
His alibi was verified by security camera footage.
cn: 嫌疑人为案发当晚提供了确凿的不在场证明。
她总能为未完成作业找借口。
他的不在场证明被监控录像证实。

en: The bird alighted on a branch.
Passengers must not alight while the train is moving.
Her face was alight with joy.
cn: 鸟儿轻落在树枝上。
列车行驶时乘客禁止下车。
她的脸庞因喜悦而容光焕发。

definitions.definition: 使成一直线；对准；使一致

en: The carpenter aligned the boards perfectly before nailing them.
Our goals must align with the company's mission.
The planets will align in a rare celestial event next month.
cn: 木匠将木板完全对齐后再钉牢。
我们的目标必须与公司使命一致。
下月行星将排成一线，形成罕见天象。

definitions.definition: （离婚或分居后一方付给另一方的）赡养费，生活费

en: The court ordered him to pay monthly alimony to his ex-wife.
She sought alimony to support herself after the divorce.
The amount of alimony is determined by the couple's standard of living during the marriage.
cn: 法院命令他每月向前妻支付赡养费。
离婚后，她寻求赡养费以维持生计。
赡养费的数额由夫妻在婚姻期间的生活水平决定。

en: The soil in this region has a high alkali content.
Sodium hydroxide is a strong alkali used in many industrial processes.
Farmers sometimes add sulfur to counteract the effects of alkali in the soil.
cn: 该地区的土壤碱含量很高。
氢氧化钠是一种用于许多工业过程的强碱。
农民有时会添加硫来中和土壤中碱的影响。

definitions.definition: 减轻（痛苦、恐惧等）；缓解；平息

en: The doctor gave her medicine to allay the pain.
His calm words allayed their fears about the storm.
The government took measures to allay public concerns.
cn: 医生给她开了药以缓解疼痛。
他平静的话语平息了他们对风暴的恐惧。
政府采取措施以减轻公众的担忧。

definitions.definition: （对统治者、国家、团体或信念的）忠诚，效忠

en: The knights swore allegiance to their king.
Her allegiance to the cause never wavered.
Dual allegiance is forbidden in some countries.
cn: 骑士们宣誓效忠国王。
她对事业的忠诚从未动摇。
某些国家禁止双重效忠。

definitions.definition: 寓言；讽喻（通过人物或事件象征抽象概念的故事）
象征性表达（广义的隐喻性描述）

en: "Animal Farm" is a political allegory about Soviet communism.
The film uses allegory to critique modern consumerism.
Her paintings are rich in religious allegories.
cn: 《动物农场》是一部关于苏联共产主义的政治寓言。
这部电影用讽喻手法批判现代消费主义。
她的画作充满宗教象征意义。

en: She is allergic to peanuts.
He seems allergic to any form of exercise.
The patient developed an allergic rash.
cn: 她对花生过敏。
他好像对任何运动都反感。
患者出现了过敏性皮疹。

definitions.definition: 过敏（对特定物质的异常免疫反应）

en: She developed an allergy to peanuts after childhood.
His allergy to bureaucracy makes him avoid government jobs.
Pollen allergies are common in spring.
cn: 她童年后对花生产生了过敏。
他对官僚主义的反感使他避开政府工作。
花粉过敏在春季很常见。

en: The medicine helped to alleviate her chronic pain.
Planting trees can alleviate air pollution in urban areas.
His humorous remarks alleviated the tension in the room.
cn: 药物帮助缓解了她的慢性疼痛。
植树可以减轻城市地区的空气污染。
他的幽默发言缓和了房间里的紧张气氛。

en: She alluded to his past mistakes without naming them.
The poem alludes to Greek mythology in its opening lines.
His speech alluded to upcoming changes in the company.
cn: 她隐晦地提及了他过去的错误，但未具体说明。
这首诗的开篇影射了希腊神话。
他的讲话暗示了公司即将到来的变革。

en: The allure of the unknown drives many explorers.
Her voice had a mysterious allure that captivated everyone.
The company uses bright packaging to allure customers.
cn: 未知的诱惑驱使许多探险家前行。
她的嗓音有一种迷人的神秘感，令所有人着迷。
该公司用鲜艳的包装吸引顾客。

en: Her speech contained an allusion to a famous Shakespearean tragedy.
The novel's title is an allusion to Greek mythology.
He made an allusion to his past mistakes without elaborating.
cn: 她的演讲暗指了一部莎士比亚的著名悲剧。
这部小说的书名影射了希腊神话。
他隐约提及了自己过去的错误，但未详细说明。

en: The farmer consulted his almanac to predict the best time for planting.
This almanac is filled with fascinating statistics about the past year.
For centuries, sailors relied on nautical almanacs for navigation.
cn: 这位农民查阅了他的历书，以预测最佳的种植时间。
这本年鉴充满了关于过去一年的迷人统计数据。
几个世纪以来，水手们依靠航海历书进行导航。

definitions.definition: 施舍物（指金钱、食物等给予穷人或需要帮助的人的物品）

en: The beggar gratefully received alms from the passing monk.
In medieval times, giving alms was considered a sacred duty.
She distributed alms to the refugees every Friday.
cn: 乞丐感激地接受了路过僧侣的施舍。
在中世纪，施舍被视为一项神圣的义务。
她每周五向难民分发救济品。

definitions.definition: 合并，混合（尤指组织、公司或物质）

en: The two companies decided to amalgamate their resources to compete with larger firms.
In dentistry, mercury is used to amalgamate with other metals to create fillings.
Cultural traditions often amalgamate over time through migration and exchange.
cn: 两家公司决定合并资源以与更大企业竞争。
牙科中，汞与其他金属混合制成填充材料。
文化传统常通过迁移与交流随时间逐渐融合。

en: He managed to amass a fortune through wise investments.
Squirrels amass nuts for the winter.
The museum amassed a collection of rare artifacts over decades.
cn: 他通过明智的投资积累了财富。
松鼠为冬天囤积坚果。
博物馆用数十年时间汇集了一批稀有文物。

definitions.definition: 环境氛围（指特定场所的独特气氛或情调）

en: The soft lighting and jazz music created a cozy ambience in the café.
The restaurant’s ambience reflects its Mediterranean theme.
She designs spaces with attention to both functionality and ambience.
cn: 柔和的灯光和爵士乐为咖啡馆营造出舒适的氛围。
餐厅的环境氛围呼应了其地中海主题。
她设计空间时兼顾功能性与氛围感。

definitions.definition: 矛盾情感的（同时存在两种对立情绪或态度）

en: She felt ambivalent about accepting the job offer—excited yet anxious.
His ambivalent attitude toward climate change reflects societal divisions.
The film’s ending left audiences ambivalent, neither fully satisfied nor disappointed.
cn: 她对是否接受这份工作感到矛盾，既兴奋又焦虑。
他对气候变化的矛盾态度反映了社会分歧。
电影的结局让观众矛盾，既不完全满意也不失望。

en: The soldiers lay in ambush for the enemy convoy.
The tiger ambushed its prey from the dense bushes.
They were ambushed by rebels on the mountain path.
cn: 士兵们埋伏等待敌军车队。
老虎从密林中伏击了猎物。
他们在山路上遭到叛军伏击。

definitions.definition: 便利设施（如公园、商店等）

en: The hotel offers amenities like a swimming pool and free Wi-Fi.
Green spaces are essential urban amenities.
The amenity of the coastal town attracts many retirees.
cn: 这家酒店提供游泳池和免费Wi-Fi等便利设施。
绿地是城市重要的舒适性设施。
这座海滨小镇的宜人环境吸引了许多退休者。

en: She has an amiable personality that puts everyone at ease.
The amiable waiter remembered our usual orders.
Despite the tension, he kept an amiable tone during the debate.
cn: 她性格友善，能让每个人都感到放松。
那位和蔼的服务员记得我们常点的菜。
尽管气氛紧张，他在辩论中始终保持友善的语气。

en: The two nations reached an amicable agreement on the border dispute.
Despite their divorce, they maintained an amicable relationship for their children.
The meeting ended in an amicable atmosphere, with both sides smiling.
cn: 两国就边境争端达成了友好协议。
尽管离婚，他们为了孩子仍保持和睦关系。
会议在友好的氛围中结束，双方都面带笑容。

definitions.definition: 在…中间；在…之中（= amid，更古旧或诗意的变体）

en: The castle stood amidst the swirling fog.
She found peace amidst the chaos of the city.
A single flower grew amidst the cracks of the pavement.
cn: 城堡矗立在缭绕的雾气中。
她在城市的喧嚣中寻得宁静。
一朵孤花从铺路石的缝隙中生长而出。

en: The accident left him with temporary amnesia.
Retrograde amnesia affects memories formed before the injury.
Her amnesia made her forget even her own name.
cn: 事故导致他暂时性失忆。
逆行性遗忘症影响受伤前形成的记忆。
她的健忘症严重到连自己的名字都记不起。

en: The government declared amnesty for political prisoners.
Thousands of refugees were amnestied and granted citizenship.
The new law includes an amnesty clause for minor tax offenses.
cn: 政府宣布对政治犯实行大赦。
数千名难民被赦免并授予公民身份。
新法律包含对轻微税务犯罪的赦免条款。

definitions.definition: 不属于道德范畴的；与道德无关的
无道德观念的；不遵守道德标准的

en: The study of nature is amoral; it describes what is, not what ought to be.
He viewed business decisions as amoral, focusing solely on profit and efficiency.
The character is an amoral force of chaos, acting on impulse without guilt.
cn: 对自然的研究是非道德性的；它描述的是“是什么”，而不是“应该是什么”。
他将商业决策视为与道德无关，只关注利润和效率。
这个角色是一股无视道德的混乱力量，凭冲动行事且毫无愧疚。

en: Frogs are typical amphibians that live both in water and on land.
The new amphibian vehicle can travel across rivers and rough terrain.
Amphibian species are highly sensitive to environmental pollution.
cn: 青蛙是典型的两栖动物，既栖息于水中也生活在陆地。
这款新型水陆两用车可穿越河流与崎岖地形。
两栖动物对环境污染物极为敏感。

definitions.definition: 两栖的（能在水陆两种环境中生存或活动）
具有双重性质的（比喻意义）

en: Frogs are typical amphibious animals.
The Marines conducted an amphibious assault at dawn.
Her amphibious career spans both academia and industry.
cn: 青蛙是典型的两栖动物。
海军陆战队在黎明时分发起了一场两栖进攻。
她的职业跨越学术界和工业界，具有双重性质。

en: The patient presented with fatigue and pallor, classic symptoms of anaemia.
Iron deficiency is a common cause of anaemia worldwide.
The veterinarian diagnosed the dog with anaemia after a blood test.
cn: 病人表现出疲劳和面色苍白，这些都是贫血的典型症状。
缺铁是全世界范围内贫血的一个常见原因。
兽医在验血后诊断这只狗患有贫血症。

en: The patient was under general anaesthesia during the surgery.
Local anaesthesia is often used for minor dental procedures.
The anaesthesia wore off several hours after the operation.
cn: 手术期间病人处于全身麻醉状态。
局部麻醉常用于小型牙科手术。
手术几小时后，麻醉效果逐渐消退。

en: The dentist administered a local anaesthetic before starting the procedure.
She was under general anaesthetic during the surgery and felt no pain.
The development of effective anaesthetics revolutionized modern surgery.
cn: 牙医在开始操作前注射了局部麻醉剂。
手术期间她处于全身麻醉状态，没有任何疼痛感。
有效麻醉剂的发展彻底改变了现代外科学。

definitions.definition: 变位词，变义词（由颠倒字母顺序而构成的词或短语）

en: The word "listen" is an anagram of "silent".
She enjoys solving anagram puzzles in the newspaper.
The title of the novel is an anagram of the author's name.
cn: 单词 “listen” 是 “silent” 的变位词。
她喜欢解答报纸上的变位词谜题。
这部小说的书名是作者名字的一个变位词。

definitions.definition: （非正式）过分拘泥细节的；吹毛求疵的

en: The doctor examined the patient for anal discomfort.
cn: 医生检查了患者的肛门不适症状。

definitions.definition: 类似物；相似体；模拟设备

en: The vinyl record is an analogue form of music storage.
Many classic watches feature an analogue display with hands.
Scientists created a chemical analogue to study the reaction without using the rare compound.
cn: 黑胶唱片是一种模拟形式的音乐存储介质。
许多经典手表采用带指针的模拟式表盘。
科学家们制造了一种化学类似物，以便在不使用这种稀有化合物的情况下研究该反应。

definitions.definition: 无政府状态的；混乱无序的

en: The party had an anarchic, energetic atmosphere that was both exciting and a little overwhelming.
The film is an anarchic comedy that satirizes the political establishment.
His anarchic approach to management often led to creative breakthroughs but also to organizational chaos.
cn: 这场派对有一种混乱而又充满活力的气氛，既令人兴奋又有点让人不知所措。
这部电影是一部讽刺政治体制的无序喜剧。
他那种无序的管理方式常常带来创造性的突破，但也导致了组织上的混乱。

definitions.definition: 无政府主义者（主张废除政府或权威的人）
扰乱秩序的人；反抗权威者

en: The anarchist group protested against all forms of government control.
He was labeled an anarchist for challenging corporate hierarchies.
Early 20th-century anarchists believed in voluntary cooperation.
cn: 无政府主义团体抗议一切形式的政府管控。
他因挑战企业等级制度而被贴上无政府主义者的标签。
20世纪初的无政府主义者信奉自愿合作。

en: The country fell into anarchy after the revolution.
Critics argue that the policy would lead to economic anarchy.
The artist embraced the creative anarchy of the avant-garde movement.
cn: 革命后，该国陷入无政府状态。
批评者认为该政策将导致经济混乱。
这位艺术家拥抱前卫运动的创造性无序。

en: After the failure, he decided to start anew.
The artist painted the canvas anew with vibrant colors.
Spring makes nature bloom anew each year.
cn: 失败后，他决定重新开始。
艺术家用鲜艳的色彩重新绘制了画布。
春天让大自然每年焕然一新。

en: She cried out in anguish when she heard the tragic news.
The soldier's face reflected the anguish of war.
He was anguished by the guilt of his past mistakes.
cn: 听到噩耗时，她痛苦地哭喊起来。
士兵的脸上映照着战争的折磨。
过往错误的愧疚使他备受煎熬。

en: The artist used motion to animate the clay figures.
Her lively eyes made her face peculiarly animate.
The professor's speech animated the audience.
cn: 艺术家用动作让黏土人偶活灵活现。
她灵动的双眼让脸庞格外生动。
教授的演讲激发了听众的热情。

en: The animation industry has revolutionized storytelling.
Her face was full of animation as she described the trip.
Stop-motion animation requires immense patience.
cn: 动画产业彻底改变了叙事方式。
她描述旅程时脸上充满活力。
定格动画需要极大的耐心。

en: The animosity between the two rivals was palpable during the debate.
Historical conflicts have left deep animosity among the communities.
She sensed no animosity in his tone, only weary resignation.
cn: 辩论中，两位对手间的敌意显而易见。
历史冲突在这些群体间留下了深刻的仇恨。
她从他语气中感受不到敌意，只有疲惫的妥协。

en: The earthquake annihilated the entire village.
Their team was annihilated in the debate competition.
The new evidence annihilated his previous argument.
cn: 地震彻底摧毁了整个村庄。
他们的队伍在辩论赛中一败涂地。
新证据彻底推翻了他之前的论点。

definitions.definition: 年金（定期支付的固定金额）

en: She receives a monthly annuity from her retirement plan.
The annuity provides a steady income for life.
Calculating the present value of an annuity requires financial expertise.
cn: 她从退休计划中按月领取年金。
这份年金保险提供终身稳定收入。
计算年金的现值需要金融专业知识。

en: The sudden temperature drop was an anomaly in this region.
Scientists studied the genetic anomaly in the lab.
The algorithm flags any financial transaction anomaly for review.
cn: 此次气温骤降是该地区的异常现象。
科学家在实验室研究了这种基因异常。
算法会标记所有金融交易异常以供审查。

en: The whistleblower demanded anonymity for safety reasons.
Online forums often provide a sense of anonymity.
The author published the letter under anonymity.
cn: 举报者出于安全考虑要求匿名。
网络论坛常提供一种匿名感。
作者以匿名方式发表了这封信。

en: His rude comments antagonized the entire team.
Avoid using language that might antagonize your audience.
The policy antagonized voters instead of winning their support.
cn: 他的粗鲁言论激怒了整个团队。
避免使用可能引起听众反感的语言。
这一政策未能赢得选民支持，反而激起了对立情绪。

definitions.definition: 羚羊（泛指牛科中多种敏捷的草食性动物）

en: The antelope leaped gracefully across the savannah.
Antelopes are known for their incredible speed and agility.
We spotted a herd of antelopes near the waterhole.
cn: 羚羊优雅地跃过非洲草原。
羚羊以惊人的速度和敏捷性闻名。
我们在水坑附近发现了一群羚羊。

definitions.definition: 选集（尤指文学作品或诗歌的汇编）

en: This anthology features the best short stories of the 20th century.
She contributed a poem to the school's literary anthology.
The anthology provides a comprehensive overview of modern African poetry.
cn: 这本选集收录了20世纪最优秀的短篇小说。
她为学校的文学选集投了一首诗。
该选集全面展现了现代非洲诗歌的概貌。

definitions.definition: 人类学（研究人类及其文化、社会、生物演化的学科）

en: She majored in anthropology to study indigenous cultures.
Biological anthropology explores human evolution.
His fieldwork in anthropology took him to remote tribes.
cn: 她主修人类学以研究原住民文化。
生物人类学探究人类演化。
他的人类学田野调查将他带到了偏远部落。

definitions.definition: 抗体（一种免疫系统产生的蛋白质，用于识别和中和病原体）

en: Vaccines stimulate the body to produce antibodies against specific viruses.
Antibodies play a crucial role in immune system defense.
The test detects COVID-19 antibodies in blood samples.
cn: 疫苗刺激身体产生针对特定病毒的抗体。
抗体在免疫系统防御中起关键作用。
该检测可识别血液样本中的新冠病毒抗体。

definitions.definition: 解药（用于中和毒药或抵消有害物质）
对抗负面事物的方法或手段（比喻义）

en: Honey is a natural antidote to certain types of food poisoning.
Laughter can be an effective antidote to stress.
The doctor administered the antidote within minutes of the snakebite.
cn: 蜂蜜是某些食物中毒的天然解药。
欢笑是缓解压力的有效良方。
医生在蛇咬伤后几分钟内注射了解毒剂。

en: She felt an instant antipathy toward his arrogant demeanor.
Cultural differences sometimes lead to mutual antipathy.
His antipathy for bureaucracy made him reject the job.
cn: 她对他的傲慢态度立刻产生了反感。
文化差异有时会导致彼此间的厌恶。
他对官僚主义的反感使他拒绝了这份工作。

definitions.definition: 鹿角（雄性鹿科动物头部分叉的骨质角，周期性脱落）

en: The stag polished his antlers against the tree bark.
Antlers are shed and regrown annually in a cycle controlled by hormones.
The fossilized antler provided clues about prehistoric deer species.
cn: 雄鹿在树皮上磨砺它的鹿角。
鹿角受荷尔蒙调控，每年周期性脱落再生。
这块鹿角化石为研究史前鹿种提供了线索。

en: The function of the anus is to expel feces from the body.
The doctor examined the patient's anus for any signs of abnormality.
Certain muscles control the opening and closing of the anus.
cn: 肛门的功能是将粪便排出体外。
医生检查了病人的肛门，寻找任何异常迹象。
某些肌肉控制着肛门的开合。

en: The company is growing apace, expanding into new markets every quarter.
Rumors about the merger spread apace through the office.
She worked apace to finish the report before the deadline.
cn: 公司正在飞速发展，每个季度都在拓展新市场。
关于合并的谣言在办公室里迅速传开。
她飞快地工作，以便在截止日期前完成报告。

definitions.definition: （南非历史上的）种族隔离制度

en: Nelson Mandela fought tirelessly to end apartheid in South Africa.
The apartheid system enforced strict racial segregation.
International sanctions helped dismantle apartheid.
cn: 纳尔逊·曼德拉为终结南非种族隔离制度不懈奋斗。
种族隔离制度强制实行严格的种族分隔。
国际制裁助力瓦解了种族隔离制度。

definitions.definition: 冷漠，无兴趣；缺乏情感或热情

en: His apathy toward social issues disappointed his friends.
The team's apathy led to their defeat in the competition.
She misinterpreted his quietness as apathy.
cn: 他对社会问题的冷漠让朋友们失望。
团队的消极态度导致他们在比赛中失败。
她将他的沉默误解为冷漠。

en: The eagle circled at the apex of the mountain.
Her career reached its apex when she won the Nobel Prize.
The pyramid's apex was covered in gold.
cn: 鹰在山顶盘旋。
当她获得诺贝尔奖时，职业生涯达到了顶峰。
金字塔的顶端覆盖着黄金。

en: The tickets cost ten dollars apiece.
She handed out the candies, one apiece to the children.
The team members received a medal apiece for their efforts.
cn: 门票每张十美元。
她分发糖果，每个孩子各一颗。
团队成员每人获得一枚奖章以表彰其努力。

en: In the past, apoplexy was a term often used to describe what we now call a stroke.
cn: 在过去，apoplexy（中风）一词常被用来描述我们现在称之为脑卒中的疾病。

definitions.definition: 服装，服饰（尤指特定场合或职业的衣着）

en: The store specializes in high-end athletic apparel.
She was appareled in a traditional silk gown for the ceremony.
The brand’s eco-friendly apparel appeals to conscious consumers.
cn: 这家店专营高端运动服装。
她身着传统丝绸长袍出席典礼。
该品牌的环保服饰吸引了有环保意识的消费者。

en: The government tried to appease the protesters by promising reforms.
A small snack may appease your hunger temporarily.
His apology did little to appease her anger.
cn: 政府承诺改革以安抚抗议者。
少量零食可暂时缓解饥饿感。
他的道歉几乎未能平息她的怒火。

en: Please append your signature at the bottom of the document.
The author decided to append a glossary to the textbook.
You can append multiple files to a single email.
cn: 请在文件末尾附加您的签名。
作者决定为教科书添加一个术语表。
你可以将多个文件附加到一封邮件中。

en: The patient was rushed to the hospital with severe abdominal pain, which was later diagnosed as acute appendicitis.
If left untreated, appendicitis can lead to a rupture of the appendix, which is a serious medical emergency.
The classic symptom of appendicitis is pain that begins around the navel and then moves to the lower right abdomen.
cn: 病人因剧烈腹痛被紧急送往医院，后被诊断为急性阑尾炎。
若不予治疗，阑尾炎可能导致阑尾破裂，这是一种严重的医疗急症。
阑尾炎的典型症状是疼痛始于肚脐周围，然后转移到右下腹。

en: The book includes an appendix with detailed references.
He had to undergo surgery to remove his inflamed appendix.
Check the appendix for additional data tables.
cn: 这本书附有详细参考文献的附录。
他不得不接受手术切除发炎的阑尾。
查看附录中的附加数据表。

en: The speaker made several apposite remarks about the current economic climate.
His comments were not only amusing but also apposite to the discussion.
She found an apposite quote from Shakespeare to illustrate her point.
cn: 演讲者对当前经济形势发表了若干恰如其分的评论。
他的评论不仅有趣，而且与讨论的内容十分贴切。
她从莎士比亚的作品中找到了一个贴切的引文来阐明她的观点。

definitions.definition: 评估，估价（尤指对价值或质量的正式评定）

en: The bank requires an appraisal of the property before approving the loan.
Her annual performance appraisal highlighted exceptional leadership skills.
The antique dealer’s appraisal confirmed the vase was a Ming dynasty original.
cn: 银行要求对房产进行评估后才批准贷款。
她的年度绩效评估突出了卓越的领导能力。
古董商的鉴定证实这只花瓶是明代真品。

en: The jeweler will appraise the diamond ring for insurance purposes.
Managers must appraise employees' performance objectively.
The antique was appraised at $10,000 by an expert.
cn: 珠宝商将为钻戒估价以便投保。
管理者必须客观评估员工表现。
这件古董经专家鉴定价值1万美元。

en: The police apprehended the suspect near the border.
It took me a while to apprehend the complexity of the theory.
cn: 警方在边境附近逮捕了嫌疑人。
我花了一些时间才理解这个理论的复杂性。

en: She felt a growing apprehension about the upcoming exam.
His quick apprehension of complex concepts impressed the professor.
The police made an apprehension of the suspect at midnight.
cn: 她对即将到来的考试感到越来越忧虑。
他对复杂概念的快速理解令教授印象深刻。
警方于午夜逮捕了嫌疑人。

definitions.definition: 水族馆（饲养展示水生生物的设施）
玻璃水族箱（家庭或实验室用的小型容器）

en: The children were fascinated by the colorful fish in the aquarium.
She maintains a small aquarium with tropical plants at home.
The aquarium's conservation program protects endangered marine species.
cn: 孩子们被水族馆里五彩斑斓的鱼迷住了。
她在家养了一个种植热带植物的小型水族箱。
该水族馆的保护项目致力于拯救濒危海洋物种。

definitions.definition: （时尚、风格等领域的）权威人物

en: The judge acted as an arbiter in the labor dispute.
She is widely regarded as the arbiter of modern fashion.
The treaty established the UN as the final arbiter of border conflicts.
cn: 法官在这场劳资纠纷中担任仲裁者。
她被公认为现代时尚的权威裁决者。
该条约将联合国确立为边境争端的最终仲裁方。

en: The UN was asked to arbitrate the dispute between the two nations.
Lawyers arbitrate disagreements to avoid costly court battles.
He has the authority to arbitrate in labor management conflicts.
cn: 联合国被请求仲裁两国间的争端。
律师通过仲裁解决分歧，以避免昂贵的法庭斗争。
他有权在劳资冲突中进行仲裁。

definitions.definition: 拱廊（两侧带拱门的走廊或通道）
电子游戏厅（因早期游戏厅多设于拱廊建筑内得名）

en: The shopping street features a beautiful 19th-century arcade.
We spent hours playing games at the arcade near the pier.
Renaissance architects often used arcades to create shaded walkways.
cn: 这条商业街有一座精美的19世纪拱廊。
我们在码头附近的游戏厅玩了好几个小时。
文艺复兴时期的建筑师常用拱廊打造荫凉步道。

definitions.definition: 古老的，过时的（指语言、习俗等）

en: The text contained several archaic words no longer in common use.
Archaeologists found archaic tools dating back to the Bronze Age.
His archaic views on gender roles were met with criticism.
cn: 这段文本包含几个已不再常用的古旧词汇。
考古学家发现了可追溯至青铜时代的原始工具。
他对性别角色的陈旧观点遭到了批评。

en: The archer drew the bowstring with practiced precision.
In medieval times, an archer was a vital part of any army.
She trained for years to become an Olympic archer.
cn: 弓箭手以熟练的精准度拉紧了弓弦。
中世纪时，弓箭手是军队中至关重要的角色。
她经过多年训练，成为奥运射箭选手。

definitions.definition: 原型（原始模型或典型代表）
（心理学）集体无意识中的原始意象

en: The hero's journey is an archetype found in myths worldwide.
The novel's villain follows the archetype of the tragic fallen angel.
Jung believed archetypes shape our subconscious behaviors.
cn: 英雄之旅是世界各地神话中常见的原型。
小说中的反派遵循了堕落天使的悲剧原型。
荣格认为原型塑造了我们的潜意识行为。

definitions.definition: 群岛（地理学术语，指一组密集分布的岛屿）

en: The Greek archipelago is famous for its stunning sunsets.
Scientists studied the biodiversity of the Indonesian archipelago.
The word "archipelago" originally referred only to the Aegean Sea.
cn: 希腊群岛以其壮丽的日落闻名。
科学家研究了印度尼西亚群岛的生物多样性。
“archipelago”一词最初仅指爱琴海。

en: The historian spent months studying the national archive.
Please archive these documents for future reference.
Digital archives have revolutionized data preservation.
cn: 这位历史学家花了数月研究国家档案馆。
请将这些文件归档以备将来查阅。
数字档案彻底改变了数据保存方式。

definitions.definition: 炽热的（古义或文学用法）

en: She is an ardent supporter of environmental protection.
His ardent speech inspired the crowd.
The ardent sun beat down on the desert.
cn: 她是环境保护的热心支持者。
他热情的演讲鼓舞了人群。
炽热的阳光灼烤着沙漠。

en: The climbers faced an arduous journey to the summit.
Completing the project was an arduous task due to limited resources.
She trained for years to prepare for the arduous marathon.
cn: 登山者们面临着登顶的艰难旅程。
由于资源有限，完成该项目是一项艰巨的任务。
她为备战艰苦的马拉松训练了多年。

definitions.definition: 方舟（《圣经》中诺亚建造的大船）
避难所；保护性容器（引申义）

en: Noah built the ark to survive the great flood.
The library became an ark of knowledge during the war.
The seed bank acts as an ark for plant biodiversity.
cn: 诺亚建造方舟以在大洪水中幸存。
战时，图书馆成了知识的庇护所。
种子库是植物多样性的“方舟”。

definitions.definition: 舰队，尤指大型海军舰队

en: The Spanish Armada was defeated by the English navy in 1588.
The country is building a modern armada to protect its maritime interests.
The documentary featured the impressive armada of aircraft carriers.
cn: 1588年，西班牙无敌舰队被英国海军击败。
该国正在打造一支现代舰队以保护其海洋利益。
这部纪录片展示了那支令人印象深刻的航空母舰舰队。

definitions.definition: 芳香，香气（尤指食物、饮料或植物的愉悦气味）

en: The aroma of freshly baked bread filled the kitchen.
This coffee has a rich aroma with hints of chocolate.
The aroma therapy uses essential oils to promote relaxation.
cn: 新鲜出炉的面包香气弥漫了整个厨房。
这款咖啡带有浓郁的香气，夹杂着巧克力的气息。
芳香疗法利用精油来帮助放松。

en: The garden was filled with aromatic herbs like lavender and rosemary.
Aromatic compounds are essential in perfumery and flavor industries.
She lit an aromatic candle to create a relaxing atmosphere.
cn: 花园里种满了薰衣草和迷迭香等芳香草本植物。
芳香化合物是香水与调味品行业的关键成分。
她点燃了一支香薰蜡烛以营造放松的氛围。

en: The city's arsenal was heavily guarded during the war.
Her mind is an arsenal of creative ideas.
The museum displayed weapons from the medieval arsenal.
cn: 战争期间，该市的军火库戒备森严。
她的头脑是创意灵感的宝库。
博物馆展出了中世纪兵工厂的武器。

en: The historic church was destroyed by arson.
He was convicted of arson after setting fire to his own business.
Investigators found evidence of arson at the warehouse.
cn: 这座历史悠久的教堂毁于纵火。
他因对自己的店铺放火而被判纵火罪。
调查人员在仓库发现了纵火的证据。

definitions.definition: 巧妙的，技艺精湛的（中性或褒义）

en: The thief gave an artful excuse to avoid suspicion.
Her artful use of colors made the painting unforgettable.
He was artful enough to turn the situation to his advantage.
cn: 小偷编了个狡猾的借口以避开怀疑。
她对色彩的巧妙运用使这幅画令人难忘。
他机灵地将局面转为对自己有利。

en: Chronic arthritis can severely limit joint mobility.
Rheumatoid arthritis is an autoimmune disorder.
Doctors recommend exercise to alleviate arthritis pain.
cn: 慢性关节炎会严重限制关节活动能力。
类风湿性关节炎是一种自身免疫性疾病。
医生建议通过运动缓解关节炎疼痛。

definitions.definition: 表达清晰的；能说会道的
清晰地表达；用关节连接

en: She is highly articulate in debates.
The robot’s arms articulate at multiple points.
He struggled to articulate his emotions.
cn: 她在辩论中表达非常清晰。
机器人的手臂在多个关节处连接。
他难以清晰地表达自己的情感。

definitions.definition: 人工制品（尤指具有历史或文化价值的工具、装饰品等）
（科学实验中因操作失误导致的）伪影

en: The museum displayed ancient artifacts from the Mayan civilization.
The strange line in the MRI scan was later identified as an artifact.
Digital artifacts often occur when compressing low-resolution images.
cn: 博物馆展出了玛雅文明的古代手工艺品。
核磁共振扫描中的异常线条后来被确认为伪影。
压缩低分辨率图像时常会产生数字伪影。

en: The magician’s artifice left the audience in awe.
She used every artifice to win the negotiation.
The clock’s mechanism was a marvel of 18th-century artifice.
cn: 魔术师的巧妙手法让观众惊叹不已。
她使尽浑身解数赢得谈判。
这座钟表的机械结构是18世纪人工技艺的杰作。

definitions.definition: 工匠，手艺人（尤指传统手工行业的熟练制作者）

en: The artisan carved the wooden statue with incredible precision.
Local artisans keep traditional pottery techniques alive.
She apprenticed under a master artisan for five years.
cn: 这位工匠以惊人的精度雕刻了木像。
当地手艺人使传统陶艺得以延续。
她师从一位工匠大师学习了五年。

definitions.definition: 上升的；占优势的；有影响力的

en: The ascendant heat from the valley created shimmering mirages.
His political party is now in the ascendant and controls the parliament.
With her confidence ascendant, she delivered a powerful speech that captivated the audience.
cn: 山谷中上升的热气形成了闪烁的海市蜃楼。
他的政党现在占优势地位并控制了议会。
带着与日俱增的自信，她发表了一场吸引全场观众的强有力的演讲。

en: The detective worked hard to ascertain the truth.
We need to ascertain whether the data is accurate.
The study aims to ascertain the effects of climate change.
cn: 侦探努力查明了真相。
我们需要确定数据是否准确。
该研究旨在确定气候变化的影响。

en: The ascetic monk lived in a cave with only a wooden bowl.
Her ascetic lifestyle excluded all luxuries, even a warm blanket.
Philosophers often praise the ascetic pursuit of wisdom over material wealth.
cn: 这位苦行僧仅靠一只木碗生活在洞穴中。
她禁欲的生活方式排斥一切奢侈品，甚至一条温暖的毯子。
哲学家常赞颂为追求智慧而摒弃物质财富的苦行精神。

en: Historians often ascribe the fall of Rome to internal corruption.
She ascribed her success to hard work and luck.
The poem was wrongly ascribed to an unknown medieval author.
cn: 历史学家常将罗马的衰落归因于内部腐败。
她将自己的成功归因于努力和运气。
这首诗被错误地归于一位不知名的中世纪作者。

definitions.definition: 渴望；抱负（强烈追求的目标）

en: Her aspiration to become a doctor motivated her to study hard.
The patient’s aspiration was monitored during surgery.
His lifelong aspiration was to promote peace in the region.
cn: 她成为医生的抱负激励她努力学习。
手术中监测了患者的吸气情况。
他毕生的愿望是推动该地区的和平。

en: She aspires to become a renowned scientist.
Many young artists aspire to exhibit their work in this gallery.
He never aspired to wealth, only to knowledge.
cn: 她渴望成为一位著名科学家。
许多年轻艺术家渴望在此画廊展出作品。
他从不追求财富，只追求知识。

en: The army was ready to assail the fortress at dawn.
She felt assailed by doubts after the interview.
Protesters assailed the politician with angry questions.
cn: 军队准备在黎明时猛攻要塞。
面试后，她被疑虑困扰。
抗议者用愤怒的质问猛烈抨击那位政客。

en: The police quickly apprehended the assailant.
She identified her assailant in the courtroom.
The victim suffered minor injuries from the assailant.
cn: 警方迅速逮捕了袭击者。
她在法庭上指认了攻击她的人。
受害者因袭击者受了轻伤。

en: The committee gave their assent to the proposal.
She nodded in assent without saying a word.
Silence does not necessarily imply assent.
cn: 委员会同意了这项提案。
她一言不发地点头表示赞同。
沉默不一定意味着同意。

en: She gave an assertive response during the negotiation.
His assertive personality helps him lead the team effectively.
Being assertive doesn’t mean being aggressive.
cn: 她在谈判中给出了果断的回应。
他自信的性格有助于高效领导团队。
自信果断并不意味着咄咄逼人。

en: She was assiduous in her research, checking every detail meticulously.
His assiduous efforts finally led to the completion of the project.
The nurse’s assiduous care helped the patient recover quickly.
cn: 她研究非常勤奋，一丝不苟地核对每个细节。
他坚持不懈的努力最终促成了项目的完成。
护士细致周到的照料帮助病人迅速康复。

en: Children assimilate new languages faster than adults.
The community gradually assimilated the immigrants.
Some cultures resist being assimilated into mainstream society.
cn: 儿童比成人更快掌握新语言。
这个社区逐渐接纳了移民。
某些文化抗拒被主流社会同化。

en: The box contained assorted chocolates.
She wore an assorted collection of bracelets.
The assorted sizes made it hard to choose.
cn: 盒子里装着各式各样的巧克力。
她戴着一堆五花八门的手镯。
尺寸混杂让人难以选择。

definitions.definition: 分类；混合物；各类物品的集合

en: The store offers a wide assortment of chocolates from around the world.
Her wardrobe contains an eclectic assortment of vintage and modern clothing.
The box held a curious assortment of buttons, ribbons, and broken jewelry.
cn: 这家商店提供来自世界各地的多种巧克力。
她的衣橱里混杂着复古与现代风格的服装。
盒子里装着一堆奇怪的纽扣、丝带和破损首饰。

en: Please mark the optional items with an asterisk.
The footnote is indicated by a red asterisk.
She asterisked the names of participants who needed follow-up.
cn: 请用星号标注可选项目。
脚注通过红色星号标示。
她用星号标出需要跟进的联系人姓名。

definitions.definition: 哮喘（一种呼吸系统疾病，特征为气道狭窄和呼吸困难）

en: Pollen can trigger severe asthma attacks in sensitive individuals.
The doctor prescribed an inhaler to manage her chronic asthma.
Urban air pollution exacerbates childhood asthma rates.
cn: 花粉可能引发敏感人群的严重哮喘发作。
医生开了吸入器以控制她的慢性哮喘。
城市空气污染加剧了儿童哮喘的发病率。

en: The telescope revealed the astral bodies in stunning detail.
Some belief systems involve the concept of astral projection.
The ancient map was decorated with astral symbols.
cn: 望远镜揭示了天体的惊人细节。
一些信仰体系涉及星体投射的概念。
这张古老的地图上装饰着星形符号。

en: The hikers went astray in the dense forest.
His advice led me astray from my original goal.
Without clear guidelines, the project could easily go astray.
cn: 徒步者在茂密的森林中迷了路。
他的建议让我偏离了最初的目标。
若缺乏明确指导，项目很容易走入歧途。

definitions.definition: 占星学；占星术（通过天体的位置和运动来预测人间事件的一种体系）

en: In medieval times, astrology was considered a scholarly tradition and was common in academic circles.
She checks her horoscope every day, although she doesn't fully believe in astrology.
The practice of astrology has evolved over thousands of years in different cultures.
cn: 在中世纪，占星学被视为一种学术传统，在学术界很普遍。
她每天都查看她的星座运势，尽管她并不完全相信占星学。
占星术的实践在不同文化中已经演变了数千年。

definitions.definition: 天体物理学，天文学的一个分支，应用物理学的定律和理论来研究天体的性质和宇宙现象

en: She decided to major in astrophysics to study black holes and the expansion of the universe.
Modern astrophysics relies heavily on data collected by space telescopes.
The conference brought together experts in astrophysics from around the globe.
cn: 她决定主修天体物理学，以研究黑洞和宇宙膨胀。
现代天体物理学极大地依赖于太空望远镜收集的数据。
这次会议汇聚了来自全球的天体物理学专家。

definitions.definition: 庇护所（尤指政治避难或精神病人收容机构）

en: The journalist sought asylum in a foreign embassy after receiving threats.
The old asylum was converted into luxury apartments.
International law guarantees the right to asylum for refugees.
cn: 这名记者受到威胁后向外国大使馆寻求庇护。
这座旧精神病院被改造成了豪华公寓。
国际法保障难民的避难权。

definitions.definition: 不对称的；非对称的（指形状、排列或数量上不相等或不平衡）

en: The butterfly’s wings had an asymmetric pattern, with one side larger than the other.
Asymmetric encryption is widely used in modern cybersecurity protocols.
The artist deliberately created an asymmetric design to evoke a sense of dynamic tension.
cn: 蝴蝶翅膀的图案不对称，一侧比另一侧更大。
非对称加密技术广泛应用于现代网络安全协议。
艺术家刻意设计不对称造型，以营造动态张力感。

en: The dictator was known for his atrocious acts against humanity.
The weather was atrocious throughout the entire holiday.
She committed an atrocious error in the final calculation.
cn: 这位独裁者因其反人类的暴行而臭名昭著。
整个假期期间的天气都糟糕透了。
她在最终计算中犯了一个严重的错误。

definitions.definition: 恶劣的行径；令人震惊的行为

en: The documentary exposed the atrocities committed during the war.
It's an atrocity to destroy cultural heritage deliberately.
Survivors testified about the atrocities they witnessed.
cn: 这部纪录片揭露了战争期间犯下的暴行。
故意破坏文化遗产是一种恶劣行径。
幸存者为他们目睹的暴行作证。

definitions.definition: 证明，证实（真实性或有效性）

en: The signature attests the authenticity of the document.
Archaeologists attested the artifact's age through carbon dating.
Her tears attested to the emotional impact of the story.
cn: 签名证实了文件的真实性。
考古学家通过碳测年法验证了文物的年代。
她的泪水证明了故事的情感冲击力。

en: Patience is an essential attribute for a teacher.
She attributes her success to hard work and luck.
The sculpture is attributed to an unknown artist.
cn: 耐心是教师必备的特质。
她将成功归因于努力和运气。
这件雕塑被归于一位匿名艺术家之手。

definitions.definition: 磨损；消耗（尤指长期逐步的减少）
（员工）自然减员（如退休、辞职等非裁员导致的减少）

en: The constant attrition of waves shaped the coastal cliffs.
The company reduced staff through natural attrition rather than layoffs.
War of attrition exhausted both sides' resources.
cn: 海浪的持续侵蚀塑造了海岸悬崖。
公司通过自然减员而非裁员来减少员工。
消耗战拖垮了双方的资源。

en: The auctioneer skillfully drove the bidding to a record price.
She decided to auctioneer the charity event to raise more funds.
The auctioneer's hammer fell, marking the end of the sale.
cn: 拍卖师娴熟地将竞拍推至创纪录价格。
她决定主持这场慈善拍卖以筹集更多资金。
拍卖槌落下，标志着交易完成。

en: His audacious plan to cross the desert alone amazed everyone.
The startup's audacious approach revolutionized the industry.
She was audacious enough to challenge the professor's theory.
cn: 他独自穿越沙漠的大胆计划让所有人惊叹。
这家初创公司的大胆方法彻底改变了行业。
她大胆到敢于挑战教授的理论。

en: The speaker's voice was barely audible over the noise.
Ultrasonic waves are not audible to the human ear.
She turned up the volume to make the recording audible.
cn: 在噪音中，演讲者的声音几乎听不见。
超声波是人耳无法听见的。
她调高音量，使录音能够被听见。

en: She prepared a monologue for the audition.
The director auditioned over 100 actors for the role.
His audition impressed the judges with its emotional depth.
cn: 她为试镜准备了一段独白。
导演为这个角色试镜了100多名演员。
他的试演以情感深度打动了评委。

definitions.definition: 增加量，扩增部分（较少用）

en: The company plans to augment its workforce by hiring 50 new employees.
Virtual reality can augment the learning experience in classrooms.
The surgeon used a graft to augment the patient's jawbone.
cn: 公司计划通过招聘50名新员工来扩充劳动力。
虚拟现实可以增强课堂中的学习体验。
外科医生用移植物增厚了患者的下颌骨。

en: The ceremony was held in an august hall filled with dignitaries.
August is often the hottest month in this region.
His august presence commanded respect from everyone.
cn: 仪式在座无虚席的庄严大厅中举行。
八月通常是该地区最热的月份。
他威严的气场令所有人肃然起敬。

definitions.definition: 氛围；气质（一种独特的无形氛围或特质）
（医学）先兆（癫痫等发作前的感知异常）

en: The old castle had an aura of mystery.
She always carries an aura of confidence.
He experienced a visual aura before the migraine attack.
cn: 这座古堡笼罩着神秘的氛围。
她总带着自信的气质。
偏头痛发作前，他出现了视觉先兆。

definitions.definition: 吉利的，吉祥的；有前途的，有希望的

en: The clear blue sky was taken as an auspicious sign for the start of their journey.
The project had an auspicious beginning, with full funding secured in the first week.
It is considered auspicious to get married during the spring festival in many cultures.
cn: 晴朗的蓝天被视为他们旅程开始的一个吉祥征兆。
这个项目有一个吉祥的开始，在第一周就获得了全部资金。
在许多文化中，在春节期间结婚被认为是吉祥的。

en: The monk lived in an austere cell with only a wooden bed.
Her writing style is austere but powerful.
The school’s austere rules forbade any form of entertainment.
cn: 这位僧人住在只有一张木床的简朴小屋里。
她的写作风格简洁而有力。
学校严格的规章制度禁止任何形式的娱乐活动。

en: The government implemented austerity measures to reduce the national debt.
His life was marked by simplicity and austerity.
The austerity of the desert landscape left a deep impression on her.
cn: 政府实施紧缩政策以减少国债。
他的生活以简朴和清苦为特点。
沙漠景观的荒凉给她留下了深刻印象。

en: The authoritarian regime suppressed all opposition.
His parenting style is often criticized as authoritarian.
Authoritarian leaders rarely tolerate dissent.
cn: 威权主义政权镇压了一切反对声音。
他的育儿方式常被批评为专制型。
威权主义领导者极少容忍异议。

en: The emperor ruled as an autocrat, with no need to consult any council.
In the corporate world, he was known as an autocrat who made all decisions alone.
History has shown that autocrats rarely retain power peacefully.
cn: 这位皇帝作为独裁者统治，无需咨询任何议会。
在企业界，他以独自做出所有决定的独裁者而闻名。
历史表明，独裁者很少能和平地保留权力。

en: The autocratic leader made decisions without consulting his advisors.
Her autocratic management style stifled creativity in the team.
Historically, autocratic regimes often suppressed free speech.
cn: 这位独裁的领导者未经咨询顾问就做出了决定。
她专制的管理风格扼杀了团队的创造力。
历史上，专制政权常压制言论自由。

en: She asked the author to autograph her copy of the novel.
The museum displayed Beethoven’s original autograph.
Fans lined up to get the star’s autograph after the concert.
cn: 她请作者在小说上亲笔签名。
博物馆展出了贝多芬的手稿真迹。
演唱会结束后，粉丝们排队索取明星的签名。

en: The coroner performed an autopsy to determine the cause of death.
Modern autopsies rely on both macroscopic and microscopic analysis.
Without an autopsy, the exact manner of death remains unclear.
cn: 法医进行尸检以确定死因。
现代尸检依赖宏观和微观分析。
若不进行尸检，死亡的具体方式仍无法明确。

en: No amount of effort could avail against the storm.
She availed herself of every opportunity to learn.
His advice was of little avail in the crisis.
cn: 任何努力都无法抵御这场风暴。
她利用一切机会学习。
他的建议在危机中收效甚微。

en: She has a strong aversion to public speaking.
His aversion to risk makes him a cautious investor.
The smell of fish is an aversion she developed after childhood.
cn: 她对公开演讲有强烈的厌恶感。
他对风险的回避使他成为谨慎的投资者。
对鱼腥味的反感是她童年后才产生的。

en: She averted her eyes from the gruesome scene.
The quick response averted a potential disaster.
He tried to avert suspicion by acting normally.
cn: 她移开视线，不去看那可怕的场景。
快速反应避免了一场潜在的灾难。
他试图通过正常举止来避开怀疑。

en: She is an avid reader of science fiction.
His avid curiosity drove him to explore remote places.
The team showed avid interest in the new project.
cn: 她是科幻小说的狂热读者。
他强烈的好奇心驱使他探索偏远之地。
团队对新项目表现出极大的兴趣。

en: The view from the mountaintop was truly awesome.
She has an awesome talent for playing the piano.
The thunderstorm was awesome in its power.
cn: 山顶的景色令人叹为观止。
她拥有惊人的钢琴演奏天赋。
这场雷暴的威力令人敬畏。

definitions.definition: 含糊不清地说；喋喋不休

en: The baby babbled happily in her crib.
The stream babbled over the smooth stones.
Ignore his drunken babble—he makes no sense.
cn: 婴儿在婴儿床上开心地咿呀作声。
溪水流过光滑的石头，发出潺潺声。
别理他醉后的胡言乱语——毫无逻辑。

en: The office was rife with gossip and backbiting.
She couldn't tolerate the backbiting comments about her colleague.
His reputation was damaged by constant backbiting.
cn: 办公室里充满了流言蜚语和背后中伤。
她无法容忍那些针对她同事的诽谤性言论。
他的声誉因持续的背后诽谤而受损。

definitions.definition: 将日期追溯到比实际更早的时间；使（文件、协议等）自过去某日起生效

en: They had to backdate the contract to the beginning of the fiscal year.
The pay increase will be backdated to January.
It is illegal to backdate an insurance claim.
cn: 他们不得不将合同日期追溯到财政年度开始时生效。
这次加薪将从一月份开始补发。
倒签保险索赔日期是违法的。

definitions.definition: 背景幕布（剧院或摄影用）

en: The photographer used a painted backdrop for the portrait.
The economic crisis formed a grim backdrop to the election.
Mountains served as a natural backdrop for the open-air concert.
cn: 摄影师用一幅绘制的背景幕布拍摄人像。
经济危机为选举蒙上了阴郁的背景。
群山为露天音乐会提供了天然背景。

definitions.definition: （计划、行动）产生反效果；事与愿违

en: His attempt to discredit the report backfired when new evidence surfaced.
The old truck's engine backfired loudly on the hill.
Strict censorship may backfire by fueling public curiosity.
cn: 他试图抹黑报告的行为因新证据出现而适得其反。
那辆旧卡车的引擎在上坡时剧烈回火。
严格的审查可能适得其反，激起公众的好奇心。

definitions.definition: （网球等）反手击球；反手；向左倾斜的书法

en: She has a very powerful backhand in tennis.
He answered the criticism with a backhanded compliment.
The player backhanded the ball cross-court for a winner.
cn: 她的网球反手击球非常有力。
他用一句暗含讽刺的恭维来回应批评。
这名球员反手将球打到对角线上，制胜得分。

en: He slipped and landed hard on his backside.
The backside of the painting was signed by the artist.
They entered through the backside of the building.
cn: 他滑了一跤，重重摔在了屁股上。
画作的背面有艺术家的签名。
他们从建筑物的后侧进入。

definitions.definition: 回水；滞水（指河流中因障碍物或支流形成的静止水域）
闭塞落后的地方（比喻与主流隔绝、发展停滞的地区）

en: The small village was a cultural backwater, untouched by modern technology.
We paddled our canoe into a quiet backwater of the river.
The town’s economy became a backwater after the factory closed.
cn: 这个小村庄是文化闭塞之地，未受现代科技影响。
我们将独木舟划入河流一处宁静的回水区。
工厂关闭后，该镇经济陷入停滞。

en: The badger dug a deep burrow in the forest.
Stop badgering me about the homework!
Badgers are nocturnal animals with distinctive black-and-white faces.
cn: 獾在森林里挖了一个很深的洞。
别再为作业的事烦我了！
獾是夜行性动物，面部有独特的黑白条纹。

definitions.definition: 挡板，隔板（用于控制流体或声音）

en: The math problem completely baffled the students.
The soundproof walls baffle noise from the highway.
She installed a baffle in the chimney to control the draft.
cn: 这道数学题彻底难住了学生们。
隔音墙阻隔了高速公路的噪音。
她在烟囱里装了挡板以控制气流。

definitions.definition: 阴郁的，不祥的（如表情、氛围）

en: The dragon cast a baleful glance at the intruders.
Her baleful influence corrupted the entire organization.
The sky darkened with baleful clouds before the storm.
cn: 巨龙向入侵者投去不祥的一瞥。
她的有害影响腐蚀了整个组织。
暴风雨前，阴郁的乌云使天空暗沉。

definitions.definition: 犹豫；突然停止（尤指马匹拒绝前进）

en: The horse balked at jumping the fence.
Don't balk at the opportunity to learn something new.
They placed a balk of timber across the road as a barricade.
cn: 马在跳跃围栏时突然止步。
不要回避学习新事物的机会。
他们将一根横木放在路上作为路障。

definitions.definition: 民谣，叙事歌谣（一种简短的故事性诗歌或歌曲）
情歌，抒情慢歌（现代流行音乐中的慢节奏歌曲）

en: The musician composed a ballad about a lost love.
Medieval ballads often told tales of knights and dragons.
Her latest single is a powerful ballad with haunting melodies.
cn: 这位音乐家创作了一首关于逝去爱情的民谣。
中世纪的叙事歌谣常讲述骑士与龙的故事。
她的最新单曲是一首旋律萦绕的动人抒情曲。

definitions.definition: 压载物（如船舶或气球中用于稳定重量的沙石等）

en: The ship took on ballast to steady itself in rough seas.
Workers replaced the old ballast on the railway tracks.
Hot-air balloons use sandbags as ballast to control altitude.
cn: 船只装载压舱物以在汹涌的海面上保持稳定。
工人们更换了铁轨上的旧道砟。
热气球用沙袋作为压载物来控制高度。

definitions.definition: 芭蕾舞女演员（尤指主角）

en: The young ballerina performed a flawless solo in Swan Lake.
She trained for decades to become a prima ballerina.
The documentary captures the daily struggles of a ballerina’s life.
cn: 这位年轻的芭蕾舞女演员在《天鹅湖》中完成了无瑕的独舞。
她经过数十年训练成为首席芭蕾舞演员。
这部纪录片记录了芭蕾舞演员日常的艰辛。

definitions.definition: 弹道学，研究抛射物（如子弹、炮弹）在飞行中受力与运动的科学

en: The expert in ballistics confirmed the bullet was fired from a distance of over 100 meters.
The ballistics of the new rifle design are exceptionally accurate.
He studied ballistics to understand how gravity and air resistance affect a projectile's path.
cn: 弹道学专家确认该子弹是从超过100米的距离发射的。
这款新式步枪的弹道特性异常精准。
他学习弹道学是为了理解重力和空气阻力如何影响抛射物的路径。

en: She applied a balm to soothe the sunburn.
His kind words were a balm to her troubled heart.
The balm of evening dew refreshed the flowers.
cn: 她涂抹药膏以缓解晒伤。
他善意的话语抚慰了她不安的心。
夜晚的露珠如香膏般滋润了花朵。

definitions.definition: 芳香的，温和的（指气候或空气）

en: The balmy breeze carried the scent of jasmine.
She laughed at his balmy ideas about time travel.
We enjoyed a balmy evening by the lake.
cn: 温和的微风带着茉莉的香气。
她嘲笑他关于时间旅行的荒唐想法。
我们在湖边度过了一个宜人的夜晚。

en: We leaned against the marble balustrade, gazing out at the city lights.
The intricate carvings on the wooden balustrade were a testament to the craftsman's skill.
The staircase featured a wrought iron balustrade that curved elegantly to the floor below.
cn: 我们倚靠着大理石栏杆，凝望着城市的灯火。
木扶手上精美的雕刻是工匠技艺的证明。
楼梯的特色是一个锻铁扶手，优雅地弯曲通向下层。

en: The movie's plot was so banal that I predicted every twist.
She dismissed his compliments as banal and insincere.
The hotel room was decorated in a banal style, lacking any personality.
cn: 这部电影的情节老套到我能猜到每一个转折。
她认为他的赞美陈腐且虚伪。
酒店房间的装修风格平庸，毫无特色。

definitions.definition: （游行中载乐队的）彩车；潮流，时尚

en: Politicians often jump on the bandwagon of popular opinion.
The new tech trend became a bandwagon everyone wanted to join.
Circus bandwagons were brightly painted to draw crowds.
cn: 政客们常迎合大众舆论，随波逐流。
这项新科技趋势成了人人追捧的潮流。
马戏团的乐队彩车被漆得鲜艳夺目以吸引人群。

definitions.definition: 祸根；毁灭的原因；死亡的原因

en: The invasive species became the bane of the local ecosystem.
In old ballads, dragons were often called a bane to knights.
The constant noise was the bane of his existence.
cn: 这种入侵物种成了当地生态系统的祸根。
在古老的民谣中，龙常被称为骑士的克星。
持续的噪音是他生活中的一大困扰。

definitions.definition: 流放，驱逐（尤指法律或官方命令）

en: The king decided to banish the traitor from the kingdom.
She tried to banish all negative thoughts before the exam.
The law was used to banish political dissidents in the 18th century.
cn: 国王决定将叛国者驱逐出境。
考试前，她试图摒弃所有消极想法。
18世纪时，这项法律曾被用来流放政治异见者。

definitions.definition: 班卓琴（一种拨弦乐器，琴身圆形，琴颈长，常用于民间音乐）

en: He played a lively tune on his banjo.
The bluegrass band features a banjo as the lead instrument.
She learned to strum the banjo during her summer in Appalachia.
cn: 他用班卓琴弹奏了一首欢快的曲子。
这支蓝草乐队以班卓琴为主奏乐器。
她在阿巴拉契亚山区度夏时学会了弹奏班卓琴。

en: The colleagues exchanged good-natured banter during the lunch break.
She bantered with the audience to lighten the mood.
Their banter was a sign of deep friendship.
cn: 午餐休息时，同事们互相开着善意的玩笑。
她与观众打趣以活跃气氛。
他们的戏谑是深厚友谊的体现。

definitions.definition: 男中音乐器（如萨克斯管、号等）

en: He is a celebrated baritone in the opera world.
The baritone saxophone adds depth to jazz ensembles.
Her voice has a rich, almost baritone quality.
cn: 他是歌剧界著名的男中音歌唱家。
上低音萨克斯为爵士乐团增添了深度。
她的嗓音浑厚，几乎带有男中音的特质。

definitions.definition: 巴洛克风格的（17-18世纪欧洲艺术风格，以华丽、复杂为特征）
过分装饰的；繁复的（引申义）

en: The church is famous for its baroque architecture with elaborate gold decorations.
cn: 这座教堂以其饰有繁复金箔的巴洛克建筑风格闻名。

definitions.definition: 2. 连续猛击；大量倾泻（如问题、批评等）
以密集火力攻击；连珠炮似地提问

en: The soldiers laid down a barrage of gunfire to cover their retreat.
She faced a barrage of questions from journalists.
The dam created a barrage to control flooding.
cn: 士兵们以密集火力掩护撤退。
她面对记者连珠炮般的提问。
水坝筑起拦河堰以控制洪水。

en: The protesters built a barricade across the road.
Soldiers barricaded the entrance to the palace.
The old door served as a makeshift barricade.
cn: 抗议者在路上筑起路障。
士兵封锁了宫殿入口。
旧门被临时用作障碍物。

definitions.definition: （英国及一些英联邦国家的）出庭律师，大律师

en: She qualified as a barrister after completing her pupillage.
The barrister presented a compelling argument to the jury.
In the UK, a barrister is often instructed by a solicitor to represent a client in court.
cn: 她在完成实习大律师培训后获得了出庭律师资格。
这位大律师向陪审团陈述了极具说服力的论点。
在英国，事务律师通常委托出庭律师在法庭上代表客户。

en: The gardener loaded the soil onto the barrow and wheeled it across the lawn.
Archaeologists discovered a Bronze Age barrow on the outskirts of the village.
In some rural dialects, a barrow refers to a castrated male pig.
cn: 园丁将泥土装上手推车，推着它穿过草坪。
考古学家在村庄外围发现了一座青铜时代的古坟。
在一些乡村方言中，“barrow”指被阉割的公猪。

en: Villagers bartered grain for tools.
The economy relied heavily on barter during the crisis.
They bartered their skills to survive.
cn: 村民用谷物换取工具。
危机期间经济严重依赖以物易物。
他们通过交换技能谋生。

en: He accidentally bashed his knee against the table.
The film was bashed by critics for its weak plot.
We threw a huge bash for her birthday.
cn: 他不小心把膝盖撞到了桌子上。
这部电影因剧情薄弱遭到影评人猛批。
我们为她举办了一场盛大的生日派对。

en: The bashful child hid behind her mother when strangers approached.
He gave a bashful smile when complimented on his performance.
Despite being bashful, she forced herself to speak at the meeting.
cn: 那个害羞的孩子见到陌生人就躲到母亲身后。
当别人夸赞他的表演时，他腼腆地笑了笑。
尽管腼腆，她还是强迫自己在会议上发了言。

definitions.definition: 舒适地晒太阳；沉浸于（温暖或愉悦的事物中）

en: The cat basks in the sunlight by the window.
She basked in the praise from her colleagues.
Tourists basked on the beach all afternoon.
cn: 那只猫在窗边晒太阳。
她沉浸在同事的赞美中。
游客们在海滩上晒了一下午太阳。

en: The ancient bastion withstood countless attacks.
Universities should be bastions of free thought.
The coral reef acts as a natural bastion against ocean storms.
cn: 这座古老堡垒抵御了无数次进攻。
大学应是自由思想的捍卫者。
珊瑚礁是抵御海洋风暴的天然屏障。

en: The conductor raised his baton to begin the symphony.
She passed the baton to the next runner smoothly.
The officer carried a baton as part of his uniform.
cn: 指挥举起指挥棒，交响乐开始演奏。
她将接力棒顺利传给下一位选手。
警员佩戴警棍作为制服的一部分。

en: The battalion was deployed to the front line at dawn.
A battalion of volunteers cleaned up the park.
His research required a battalion of assistants.
cn: 该营于黎明时分被部署到前线。
一大队志愿者清理了公园。
他的研究需要大批助手。

en: The baby bawled all night, keeping the neighbors awake.
"Get out!" he bawled, slamming the door.
Street vendors bawled their prices to attract customers.
cn: 婴儿整晚嚎哭，吵得邻居无法入睡。
“滚出去！”他摔门大吼。
街头小贩高声吆喝价格以招揽顾客。

en: The ship anchored in the sheltered bay.
She placed the books in the bay of the library shelf.
The hounds bayed at the moon all night.
cn: 船只停泊在避风的海湾。
她把书放在图书馆书架的凹槽里。
猎犬整夜对着月亮吠叫。

definitions.definition: 刺刀（装在步枪前端的短刀）

en: The soldier fixed his bayonet before charging.
Historical accounts describe how troops bayoneted the enemy at close range.
Modern bayonets often double as utility knives.
cn: 士兵在冲锋前装上了刺刀。
历史记载描述了军队如何近距离用刺刀刺杀敌人。
现代刺刀常兼作多功能刀具。

definitions.definition: 集市（尤指中东或南亚的露天市场）
义卖市场（慈善或社区活动中的临时集市）

en: The spice merchants in the bazaar filled the air with exotic aromas.
Our school is hosting a Christmas bazaar to raise funds for charity.
She bought a handwoven carpet at the Istanbul bazaar.
cn: 集市里的香料商人让空气中充满异域香气。
学校正在举办圣诞义卖，为慈善筹款。
她在伊斯坦布尔的集市买了一条手工编织地毯。

en: The ball bearings reduce friction in the machine.
She maintained a calm bearing during the crisis.
The hiker lost his bearing in the dense forest.
cn: 球轴承减少了机器中的摩擦。
她在危机中保持了冷静的举止。
徒步者在密林中迷失了方向。

definitions.definition: 野兽般的；残忍的；令人不快的

en: He was fired for his beastly behavior towards his subordinates.
The weather was beastly hot and humid.
It was beastly of him to cancel the plan at the last minute.
cn: 他因对下属的野蛮行为而被解雇。
天气极其炎热和潮湿。
他在最后一刻取消计划，真是太讨厌了。

en: The rhythmic beating of the drum echoed through the valley.
Her heart was beating fast after the sprint.
The team suffered a brutal beating in the finals.
cn: 鼓的节奏性敲击声在山谷中回荡。
冲刺后她的心跳得很快。
这支队伍在决赛中遭遇惨败。

en: They planted flowers to beautify the entrance of the community.
The new software can beautify your photos with just one click.
Many cities have programs to beautify urban spaces with public art.
cn: 他们种植了花卉来美化社区入口。
这款新软件只需点击一下就能美化你的照片。
许多城市都有通过公共艺术来美化城市空间的计划。

definitions.definition: 示意，召唤（用手势或点头）

en: She beckoned to me from across the street.
The smell of fresh bread beckoned him into the bakery.
The teacher beckoned the student to come forward.
cn: 她在街对面向我招手示意。
新鲜面包的香气吸引他走进面包店。
老师示意学生上前。

definitions.definition: 对（某人的成就或财富）感到不满；忌妒

en: She didn't begrudge the money spent on her children's education.
cn: 她不会吝惜花在孩子们教育上的钱。

en: He used his charm to beguile investors into funding the project.
The storyteller's voice beguiled the children, holding them spellbound.
Don't let their friendly smiles beguile you; they have hidden motives.
cn: 他用自己的魅力诱骗投资者为项目提供资金。
故事讲述者的声音迷住了孩子们，让他们听得入神。
不要被他们友好的微笑所欺骗；他们别有用心。

definitions.definition: 哀叹；惋惜；表达悲伤或不满

en: She would often bemoan the lack of funding for education.
The villagers bemoaned the destruction of their ancient temple.
Critics bemoan the decline of traditional craftsmanship.
cn: 她常为教育资金不足而叹息。
村民们为古庙被毁而哀叹。
评论家们惋惜传统工艺的衰落。

definitions.definition: 困惑的，茫然的（尤指因复杂或矛盾的事物）

en: The professor's bemused expression suggested he hadn't understood the question.
She sat bemused, staring at the abstract painting for hours.
His bemused laughter confused the audience further.
cn: 教授困惑的表情表明他没听懂问题。
她出神地坐着，盯着那幅抽象画看了几个小时。
他茫然的笑容让观众更加迷惑。

definitions.definition: 以…为基准；对…进行基准测试

en: The new software was tested against industry benchmarks.
We need to benchmark our progress monthly.
The lake’s water level serves as a natural benchmark.
cn: 这款新软件以行业基准进行了测试。
我们需要每月对标进度。
湖泊水位是天然的测量基准。

en: The priest offered a benediction at the end of the service.
She received the benediction of her family before embarking on her journey.
The poem is a benediction to the beauty of the natural world.
cn: 仪式结束时，牧师进行了赐福祈祷。
在开始旅程之前，她得到了家人的祝福。
这首诗是对自然世界之美的一种礼赞。

definitions.definition: 受益人（法律或财务关系中接受利益的人）
受惠者（广义上因某事物获益的人或组织）

en: She was named the sole beneficiary of her uncle's will.
Farmers are direct beneficiaries of the new irrigation project.
The charity acts as a beneficiary for donations to support education.
cn: 她是她叔叔遗嘱的唯一受益人。
农民是新灌溉项目的直接受惠者。
该慈善机构作为受赠方，接收支持教育的捐款。

en: His benevolence toward the poor was widely admired.
The foundation operates through pure benevolence, not profit.
Ancient rulers often displayed benevolence to gain public support.
cn: 他对穷人的仁慈广受赞誉。
该基金会纯粹出于善心运作，而非盈利。
古代统治者常通过施恩来赢得民心。

en: The benevolent old man donated his entire fortune to the orphanage.
The company is known for its benevolent policies toward employees.
Her benevolent smile made the children feel at ease.
cn: 这位仁慈的老人将全部财产捐给了孤儿院。
这家公司以对员工的友善政策闻名。
她和善的微笑让孩子们感到安心。

en: The tumor was found to be benign after further tests.
His benign smile put the children at ease.
The climate here is benign, perfect for growing grapes.
cn: 进一步检查后，肿瘤被确认为良性。
他和善的微笑让孩子们放松下来。
这里气候温和，非常适合种植葡萄。

definitions.definition: 将（知识、传统等）传给后代

en: She bequeathed her entire estate to a wildlife foundation.
Ancient philosophers bequeathed us timeless wisdom.
The artist bequeathed his paintings to the local museum.
cn: 她将全部遗产遗赠给一家野生动物基金会。
古代哲学家为我们留下了永恒的智慧。
这位艺术家将画作遗赠给当地博物馆。

definitions.definition: 遗赠（法律术语，指通过遗嘱赠与的财产或物品）
传统或文化的传承（比喻义）

en: The museum received a valuable bequest of antique paintings.
His work is a bequest to future generations of scientists.
The will included a bequest of $10,000 to her alma mater.
cn: 博物馆获得了一批珍贵古董画的遗赠。
他的成果是留给后世科学家的遗产。
遗嘱中包含向母校捐赠1万美元的条款。

definitions.definition: 丧失亲友的；痛失亲人的
丧失亲友者（通常用复数形式 the bereaved）

en: The bereaved family received condolences from the entire community.
She spoke with quiet dignity to the bereaved at the funeral.
Counseling services are available to help the bereaved cope with grief.
cn: 痛失亲人的家庭收到了来自整个社区的慰问。
她在葬礼上以平静的尊严与逝者家属交谈。
心理咨询服务可帮助丧失亲友者应对哀伤。

en: The explorers were beset by sudden storms.
Self-doubt began to beset her as the deadline approached.
The crown was beset with rubies and emeralds.
cn: 探险者们遭遇暴风雨的围困。
随着截止日期临近，自我怀疑开始困扰她。
王冠上镶嵌着红宝石和绿宝石。

en: The fairy used a spell to bewitch the forest creatures.
Her brilliant performance bewitched the entire audience.
The ancient legend tells of a witch who could bewitch people with a single glance.
cn: 仙女用咒语使森林生物着魔。
她精彩的表演令全场观众陶醉。
古老传说中，有一位女巫能用一瞥蛊惑人心。

en: The siblings bickered over who got to sit in the front seat.
