Political debates often devolve into petty bickering.
The stream bickered down the rocks, a soothing background noise.
cn: 兄妹俩为谁坐前排吵个不停。
政治辩论常沦为无谓的口角。
溪水潺潺流过岩石，成为舒缓的背景音。

en: My grandfather wears bifocals so he can read and see at a distance without switching glasses.
The invention of bifocals was a significant advancement for people with presbyopia.
The line across the lens is barely noticeable in his new pair of bifocals.
cn: 我祖父戴着双光眼镜，这样他就不用更换眼镜既能阅读又能看远处。
双光眼镜的发明对老花眼患者来说是一个重大的进步。
在他那副新的双光眼镜上，镜片中间的分隔线几乎看不出来。

definitions.definition: 偏执的人；顽固者（尤指宗教、种族或政治上的盲目信仰者）

en: He was labeled a bigot for refusing to accept any cultural differences.
cn: 他被指责为偏执者，因拒绝接受任何文化差异。

en: The liver secretes bile to aid in digestion.
His criticism was full of bile.
Medieval doctors believed excess bile caused melancholy.
cn: 肝脏分泌胆汁以辅助消化。
他的批评充满敌意。
中世纪医生认为过量胆汁会导致忧郁。

definitions.definition: 台球（一种在长方形桌面上用球杆击球的室内游戏）

en: He spends every weekend playing billiards at the local club.
The bar has a vintage billiards table from the 1920s.
Learning billiards requires patience and precise hand-eye coordination.
cn: 他每周都在当地俱乐部打台球。
这家酒吧有一张20世纪20年代的古董台球桌。
学习台球需要耐心和精准的手眼协调能力。

definitions.definition: 巨浪；翻滚的云团或烟雾

en: The sails billowed in the strong wind.
Dark billows of smoke rose from the burning factory.
Her dress billowed as she ran down the hill.
cn: 船帆在强风中鼓胀翻腾。
滚滚黑烟从燃烧的工厂升起。
她跑下山时，裙子如浪般翻飞。

definitions.definition: 狂欢；放纵（尤指暴饮暴食或疯狂消费）

en: She went on a shopping binge and maxed out her credit card.
Binge-watching TV shows can disrupt your sleep schedule.
After the exam, he binged on pizza and ice cream.
cn: 她疯狂购物，刷爆了信用卡。
狂刷剧集会打乱你的睡眠规律。
考试结束后，他暴食披萨和冰淇淋。

definitions.definition: 宾果游戏（一种数字匹配游戏）；突然的成功或发现
表示惊喜或突然的成功（口语）

en: She shouted "Bingo!" when she matched all the numbers on her card.
cn: 当她卡片上的数字全部匹配时，她大喊"宾果！"。

definitions.definition: 两党的；代表两党的；得到两党支持的

en: The bill received bipartisan support in Congress.
Bipartisan cooperation is essential for passing major reforms.
The committee was composed of bipartisan members.
cn: 这项法案在国会获得了跨党派支持。
两党合作对通过重大改革至关重要。
该委员会由两党成员共同组成。

en: The architect used a compass to bisect the angle accurately.
The new highway will bisect the forest, raising concerns among environmentalists.
To find the center of a line segment, you simply bisect it.
cn: 建筑师用圆规精确地将角平分为两部分。
新高速公路将把森林一分为二，引发了环保人士的担忧。
要找到线段的中点，你只需将它对半平分。

definitions.definition: 母狗；贬义指刻薄或强势的女性

en: The farmer's bitch gave birth to six puppies.
She called her boss a controlling bitch.
Stop bitching about the workload and just do it.
cn: 农夫的母狗生了六只小狗。
她骂老板是个控制欲强的泼妇。
别抱怨工作量了，赶紧干活。

en: The artist's bizarre paintings left the audience both confused and fascinated.
She wore a bizarre costume to the party, resembling a giant pineapple.
The plot of the movie was so bizarre that no one could predict the ending.
cn: 这位艺术家怪异的画作让观众既困惑又着迷。
她穿了一套古怪的服装参加派对，看起来像一只巨型菠萝。
这部电影的情节离奇到无人能猜到结局。

en: He was arrested for blackmailing a politician with stolen documents.
Emotional blackmail can damage relationships.
The mob used blackmail to silence witnesses.
cn: 他因用窃取的文件敲诈一名政治家而被捕。
情感胁迫会破坏人际关系。
黑帮通过勒索迫使证人沉默。

definitions.definition: （因酒精或药物导致的）暂时性记忆丧失

en: The city experienced a blackout due to a power grid failure.
He had a blackout after drinking too much and couldn't remember anything.
The government imposed a media blackout during the crisis.
cn: 因电网故障，该市遭遇断电。
他饮酒过量后出现短暂失忆，完全想不起发生了什么。
危机期间，政府实施了新闻封锁。

definitions.definition: （通过沸水或阳光）使变白；使苍白

en: She blanched the almonds by soaking them in boiling water.
His face blanched when he heard the terrible news.
The gardener blanched the celery to reduce its bitterness.
cn: 她将杏仁浸泡在沸水中焯白。
听到噩耗时，他的脸色变得苍白。
园丁将芹菜焯水以减轻苦味。

definitions.definition: 发出响亮刺耳的声音；高声宣布

en: The trumpets blared as the king entered.
She turned down the radio to escape the blare of advertisements.
Headlines blared the news of the scandal.
cn: 国王入场时，喇叭高声齐鸣。
她调低收音机音量以躲避广告的刺耳声响。
头条新闻大肆宣扬这桩丑闻。

definitions.definition: 明目张胆的；公然的（尤指负面行为）
喧闹的；刺耳的（古义，现较少用）

en: The politician’s blatant corruption shocked the public.
She told a blatant lie without hesitation.
The old recording had a blatant, almost mechanical sound.
cn: 这位政客的公然腐败震惊了公众。
她毫不犹豫地撒了一个明目张胆的谎。
这段古老的录音有一种刺耳的、近乎机械的声音。

definitions.definition: 短促的高音信号；（代替脏话的）哔哔声
（用哔哔声）盖过（粗话）；发出哔哔声

en: The microwave will let out a bleep when your food is ready.
The station had to bleep out the profanity in the live interview.
I heard a bleep from my phone, indicating a new message.
cn: 你的食物加热好后，微波炉会发出“哔”的一声。
电视台不得不把直播采访中的脏话用“哔”声盖掉。
我听到手机发出“哔”的一声，提示有一条新消息。

en: The vase had a small blemish near the base.
Scandal blemished his political career.
She used concealer to cover the blemish on her cheek.
cn: 花瓶底部附近有一处小瑕疵。
丑闻玷污了他的政治生涯。
她用遮瑕膏盖住了脸颊上的斑点。

en: The birth of her child brought her unimaginable bliss.
Sitting by the lake at dawn, he felt a moment of pure bliss.
Ignorance is bliss, but knowledge is power.
cn: 孩子的诞生带给她难以想象的幸福。
黎明时分坐在湖边，他感受到片刻纯粹的极乐。
无知是福，但知识才是力量。

definitions.definition: 以闪电战攻击；快速处理

en: The company launched a marketing blitz to promote its new product.
During the war, the city suffered heavily from enemy blitzes.
She decided to blitz through her emails before the meeting.
cn: 公司发起了一场营销闪电战来推广新产品。
战争期间，这座城市遭受了敌军的猛烈空袭。
她决定在会议前快速处理完所有邮件。

definitions.definition: （比喻）大量密集的事物（如信息、问题等）

en: The blizzard shut down highways for two days.
She faced a blizzard of paperwork after the meeting.
Pioneers feared blizzards more than any other winter hazard.
cn: 暴风雪导致公路封闭两天。
会议后，她面对堆积如山的文件。
拓荒者最畏惧的冬季灾害莫过于暴风雪。

definitions.definition: 一滴，一团（无定形的液体或软质物质）
（计算机）二进制大对象（Binary Large Object 的缩写）

en: A blob of paint dripped onto the canvas.
The scientist observed a strange blob under the microscope.
The database stores images as blobs.
cn: 一滴颜料滴落在画布上。
科学家在显微镜下观察到一个奇怪的团状物。
数据库将图像存储为二进制大对象。

definitions.definition: （警局的）逮捕记录簿，临时记录册

en: He signed the letter and quickly placed it under the blotter to dry.
The sergeant entered the suspect's name into the police blotter.
I jotted down the phone number on my blotter before I lost it.
cn: 他在信上签了名，然后迅速把它压在吸墨纸下晾干。
警官将嫌疑人的名字登记在了警局逮捕记录簿上。
我把电话号码草草记在我的临时记事本上，以免忘记。

en: The diplomat's blunder caused an international scandal.
She blundered through the dark room, knocking over a vase.
Forgetting the client's name was a blunder he couldn't recover from.
cn: 这位外交官的愚蠢错误引发了国际丑闻。
她在黑暗的房间里跌跌撞撞，打翻了一个花瓶。
忘记客户的名字是他无法挽回的大错。

en: The rain blurred the windshield, making it hard to see.
Her memories of the event were just a blur.
The artist intentionally blurred the lines between reality and fantasy.
cn: 雨水使挡风玻璃变得模糊，难以看清。
她对那件事的记忆只是一片模糊。
艺术家刻意模糊了现实与幻想的界限。

definitions.definition: （书籍封面的）简介或推荐语；夸张的宣传广告

en: The book's blurb claimed it would "change your life forever."
Don't judge a novel by its blurb; the actual content might surprise you.
The movie poster had a blurb from a famous critic calling it "a masterpiece."
cn: 这本书的简介宣称它将“永远改变你的人生”。
别通过封面推荐语评判一本书，实际内容可能让你惊讶。
电影海报上印着某知名影评人的宣传语，称其为“杰作”。

definitions.definition: 脱口而出（未经过思考地说出）

en: He blurted out the secret before realizing his mistake.
The child blurted an awkward question during the meeting.
Don't blurt answers—think first.
cn: 他一时口快说出了秘密，随后才意识到错误。
孩子在会议上冒出一个尴尬的问题。
别脱口而出答案，先思考。

en: The hikers accidentally stepped into a bog and sank to their knees.
Heavy rain turned the field into a bog.
The project got bogged down in bureaucratic delays.
cn: 徒步者不慎踩进沼泽，泥浆没至膝盖。
大雨将田地变成了泥潭。
项目因官僚拖延而陷入停滞。

definitions.definition: （因震惊、恐惧或困惑而）犹豫，踌躇；不知所措
使困惑，使难以想象；搞糟

en: The mind boggles at the sheer complexity of the universe.
Don't boggle at the cost; just get the job done right.
The sudden change in plans boggled the entire team.
cn: 宇宙的极度复杂令人难以想象。
不要对成本犹豫不决，把工作做好就行了。
计划的突然变动让整个团队都不知所措。

en: The website sells bogus diplomas that look surprisingly real.
His apology sounded completely bogus after the scandal.
The police uncovered a bogus charity scam.
cn: 这家网站出售看起来逼真的假文凭。
丑闻后，他的道歉听起来极其虚伪。
警方破获了一起假冒慈善骗局。

definitions.definition: 喧闹的，狂暴的（形容人或行为）
猛烈的，汹涌的（形容自然现象）

en: The boisterous children made it impossible to concentrate.
A boisterous wind tore through the coastal town.
His boisterous laughter echoed across the room.
cn: 吵闹的孩子们让人无法集中注意力。
狂风席卷了这座海滨小镇。
他爽朗的笑声在房间里回荡。

definitions.definition: 1. 连续轰炸；2. 大量提问/攻击（比喻义）

en: The army bombarded the enemy positions for hours.
Reporters bombarded the celebrity with personal questions.
The 14th-century bombard was a primitive but powerful weapon.
cn: 军队对敌军阵地进行了数小时轰炸。
记者们连珠炮般向名人抛出私人问题。
14世纪的早期火炮虽简陋但威力巨大。

definitions.definition: 炸弹；爆炸性事件（比喻令人震惊的消息或人物）
性感尤物（俚语，强调极具吸引力的人）

en: The scandal was a political bombshell.
She became a bombshell after her iconic movie role.
The lab handled the bombshell with extreme caution.
cn: 这桩丑闻是一枚政治炸弹。
她因标志性电影角色成为性感偶像。
实验室极其谨慎地处理这枚炸弹弹壳。

definitions.definition: 篝火；营火（尤指户外庆祝或仪式中点燃的大型火堆）

en: We gathered around the bonfire to sing and tell stories.
The annual festival ends with a giant bonfire on the beach.
In ancient times, a bonfire was believed to ward off evil spirits.
cn: 我们围坐在篝火旁唱歌、讲故事。
年度庆典以海滩上的巨型篝火收尾。
古人认为篝火能驱散恶灵。

definitions.definition: （汽车引擎的）引擎盖（英式英语）

en: She tied the ribbons of her bonnet under her chin.
The mechanic lifted the bonnet to check the engine.
The baby’s knitted bonnet kept her warm in winter.
cn: 她将帽带系在下巴下方。
机械师掀开引擎盖检查发动机。
婴儿的针织帽让她在冬天保持温暖。

definitions.definition: 嘘声（表示不满或惊吓的声音）

en: The audience started to boo when the performer missed the note.
"Boo!" she shouted, jumping out from behind the door.
The politician was met with boos during his controversial speech.
cn: 观众在表演者唱错音时开始喝倒彩。
"嘘！"她从门后跳出来喊道。
这位政治家在有争议的演讲中遭遇嘘声。

en: He felt like a complete booby for forgetting his own birthday.
The blue-footed booby is a seabird known for its clumsy mating dance.
The comedian's joke was full of childish booby humor.
cn: 他觉得自己像个十足的傻瓜，竟然忘记了自己的生日。
蓝脚鲣鸟是一种以其笨拙求偶舞蹈而闻名的海鸟。
那位喜剧演员的笑话充满了幼稚的傻气幽默。

en: The new software proved to be a boon for small businesses.
Clean energy is a boon to environmental protection.
His timely advice was an unexpected boon.
cn: 这款新软件被证明是小企业的福音。
清洁能源是环境保护的一大助力。
他及时的建议成了意外的收获。

en: The new policy will boost local employment.
She gave me a boost to reach the high shelf.
Coffee can provide an energy boost in the morning.
cn: 新政策将促进当地就业。
她托了我一把，让我够到高架子。
咖啡能在早晨提供能量提升。

definitions.definition: 私货；走私货；非法制造或贩卖的物品
非法制造或贩卖的；盗版的

en: The police seized a large quantity of bootleg alcohol.
He was arrested for selling bootleg DVDs.
In the 1920s, many people made a living by bootlegging.
cn: 警方查获了大量私酿酒精。
他因贩卖盗版DVD而被逮捕。
在20世纪20年代，许多人以走私私酒为生。

en: He stocked the fridge with booze for the party.
They boozed all night at the pub.
Avoid cheap booze if you don't want a headache.
cn: 他为派对在冰箱里囤满了酒。
他们在酒吧豪饮整夜。
如果不想头疼，就别喝廉价烈酒。

en: The bountiful harvest ensured no one went hungry that winter.
She was known for her bountiful heart, always helping those in need.
The garden was bountiful with ripe tomatoes and fragrant herbs.
cn: 丰收的粮食确保了那年冬天无人挨饿。
她以慷慨闻名，总是帮助有需要的人。
花园里满是成熟的番茄和芬芳的香草。

en: The king was known for his bounty to the poor.
The government offered a bounty for capturing the pirate.
The ocean’s bounty provides food for millions.
cn: 国王以对穷人的慷慨著称。
政府悬赏捉拿海盗。
海洋的丰饶养活了数百万人。

definitions.definition: 一段（时间或活动）；一次发作（如疾病）

en: She had a bout of flu last winter.
The boxer won the bout in the third round.
He goes through bouts of intense creativity.
cn: 她去年冬天患了一次流感。
拳击手在第三回合赢得了比赛。
他会经历一阵阵强烈的创作期。

definitions.definition: 精品店（销售独特或高端商品的小型零售店）
（某领域的）特色服务或产品（如 boutique hotel 精品酒店）

en: She bought a handcrafted necklace from a boutique in Paris.
The city is known for its boutique coffee shops offering rare beans.
They stayed at a boutique hotel with only ten uniquely designed rooms.
cn: 她在巴黎一家精品店买了一条手工项链。
这座城市以提供稀有咖啡豆的特色咖啡馆闻名。
他们入住了一家仅有十间独特设计客房的精品酒店。

en: The wall was reinforced with steel braces.
She braced herself for the impact.
His teeth were straightened with braces.
cn: 这面墙用钢支架加固了。
她绷紧身体准备迎接冲击。
他的牙齿用牙箍矫正了。

en: She learned to braid her hair in a French style.
The rug was made with colorful braids of wool.
He braided the ropes together to make them stronger.
cn: 她学会了法式编发。
这块地毯用彩色羊毛编织而成。
他把绳子编在一起以增加强度。

definitions.definition: 盲文（一种供盲人使用的触觉文字系统）

en: The book is available in braille for visually impaired readers.
She learned to read braille at the age of six.
Braille signage ensures accessibility in public spaces.
cn: 这本书有盲文版，供视障读者阅读。
她六岁时学会了阅读盲文。
盲文标识确保了公共场所的无障碍性。

definitions.definition: 洗脑；通过系统性心理操控使人改变信念或行为

en: The cult used isolation to brainwash its members.
Some advertisements subtly brainwash consumers into brand loyalty.
Totalitarian regimes often brainwash citizens through propaganda.
cn: 邪教通过孤立手段对成员进行洗脑。
某些广告潜移默化地“洗脑”消费者形成品牌忠诚。
极权政权常通过宣传机器给民众洗脑。

definitions.definition: 刺眼的；俗丽的（如颜色或装饰）
碎冰；残枝（地质/植物学术语）

en: His brash decision cost the company a major client.
She wore a brash orange dress to the formal event.
The glacier left behind piles of brash ice.
cn: 他鲁莽的决定让公司失去了一个重要客户。
她在正式场合穿了一条俗丽的橙色连衣裙。
冰川留下了成堆的碎冰。

definitions.definition: 虚张声势；故作勇敢的行为

en: His bravado disappeared when he faced the real danger.
She laughed with forced bravado, hiding her fear.
The gangster's bravado was just a mask for insecurity.
cn: 面对真正的危险时，他的虚张声势消失了。
她强装勇敢地大笑，掩饰内心的恐惧。
那个黑帮分子的逞强只是缺乏安全感的面具。

en: The brevity of his speech was appreciated by the audience.
The brevity of human life is a common theme in poetry.
I admire the brevity and clarity of her writing style.
cn: 他演讲的简洁受到了听众的赞赏。
人生的短暂是诗歌中一个常见的主题。
我欣赏她写作风格的简洁和清晰。

en: She wore a stunning bridal gown at the ceremony.
The hotel specializes in bridal packages for weddings.
Old paintings often depict bridal processions with torches.
cn: 她在仪式上穿了一件惊艳的新娘礼服。
这家酒店专营婚礼套餐服务。
古画常描绘持火炬的婚礼游行队伍。

en: She adjusted the horse's bridle before the race.
He struggled to bridle his anger during the debate.
The mare bridled at the unfamiliar rider.
cn: 比赛前，她调整了马的笼头。
辩论中，他竭力抑制怒火。
母马对陌生的骑手昂头抗拒。

definitions.definition: 不列颠人（尤指古代或现代英国的凯尔特原住民）
（现代用法）英国人（非正式，略带古风或诗意）

en: The ancient Britons resisted Roman invasion for decades.
As a Briton, he takes pride in his country's multicultural heritage.
The poem depicts a Briton standing atop the white cliffs of Dover.
cn: 古代不列颠人抵抗罗马入侵长达数十年。
作为英国人，他为祖国的多元文化传统感到自豪。
这首诗描绘了一位不列颠人伫立在多佛白崖上的身影。

en: The brittle branches snapped under the weight of the snow.
Her laughter was brittle, masking nervousness.
Old photographs become brittle with age.
cn: 脆弱的树枝在积雪重压下断裂。
她的笑声尖利，掩饰着紧张。
老照片随时间变得脆弱易损。

definitions.definition: 西兰花（一种绿色蔬菜，属十字花科）

en: Steam the broccoli for five minutes to retain its nutrients.
She added fresh broccoli to the stir-fry for extra crunch.
Broccoli is rich in vitamin C and dietary fiber.
cn: 蒸西兰花五分钟以保留其营养。
她在炒菜中加入新鲜西兰花以增添爽脆口感。
西兰花富含维生素C和膳食纤维。

en: After his business failed, he was completely broke.
She accidentally broke the vase while cleaning.
Many young artists start out broke but full of passion.
cn: 他的生意失败后，他彻底破产了。
她在打扫时不小心打碎了花瓶。
许多年轻艺术家起初身无分文，但充满热情。

definitions.definition: 作为中间人安排（交易、协议等）

en: He works as a real estate broker in New York.
The deal was brokered by an international agency.
Stock brokers must be licensed to operate.
cn: 他在纽约做房地产经纪人。
这笔交易由一家国际机构居中协调。
股票经纪人必须持证上岗。

en: She works in a brokerage firm specializing in real estate.
The brokerage fee for the transaction was 2% of the total amount.
Online brokerages have made stock trading more accessible.
cn: 她在一家专营房地产的经纪公司工作。
这笔交易的佣金是总金额的2%。
在线经纪业务使股票交易更加便利。

en: Smoking can significantly increase the risk of developing chronic bronchitis.
The patient was diagnosed with acute bronchitis and prescribed antibiotics.
His persistent cough turned out to be a symptom of bronchitis.
cn: 吸烟会显著增加患慢性支气管炎的风险。
该患者被诊断为急性支气管炎，并开了抗生素。
他持续的咳嗽原来是支气管炎的一个症状。

en: The city shut down the illegal brothel last week.
Historical records mention brothels near the ancient port.
He described the place as a filthy brothel.
cn: 上周该市查封了非法妓院。
历史记载提到古港口附近的妓院。
他将那地方描述为肮脏的妓院。

definitions.definition: 浏览器（用于访问互联网的软件）
浏览者（翻阅书籍或资料的人）

en: Chrome is a popular web browser.
She was a casual browser of antique shops.
The browser automatically blocks pop-up ads.
cn: 谷歌浏览器是一款流行的网页浏览器。
她是个随意逛古董店的浏览者。
该浏览器自动拦截弹窗广告。

en: She is a stunning brunette with green eyes.
The brunette wood of the table matched the vintage decor.
Many actors dye their hair brunette for certain roles.
cn: 她是一位绿眼睛的深褐色头发美女。
桌子的深褐色木材与复古装饰相配。
许多演员为特定角色将头发染成深褐色。

definitions.definition: 冲击的主要部分；最严重的压力或影响

en: The small island bore the brunt of the hurricane.
Frontline workers faced the brunt of the pandemic.
The company took the brunt of the financial loss.
cn: 这个小岛首当其冲地遭受了飓风的袭击。
一线工作者承受了疫情最严重的冲击。
公司承担了经济损失的主要部分。

en: His brusque manner sometimes offends people.
She was very brusque with her reply.
The manager’s brusque decision ended the discussion.
cn: 他唐突的举止有时会冒犯到别人。
她的回答非常简短生硬。
经理粗暴的决定终止了讨论。

en: He was condemned for his brutish behavior.
The dictator's brutish regime ignored basic human rights.
He felt a brutish anger that he could not control.
cn: 他的野蛮行为受到了谴责。
那个独裁者野蛮的政权无视基本人权。
他感到一种无法控制的、野兽般的愤怒。

en: He's been my buddy since kindergarten.
Can you buddy up with the new student?
"Hey buddy, need a hand?" called the stranger.
cn: 他是我的幼儿园同窗好友。
你能和新同学组队吗？
“嘿兄弟，要帮忙吗？”陌生人喊道。

definitions.definition: 使稍微移动；勉强改变（立场）

en: The heavy stone didn't budge an inch despite our efforts.
She refused to budge from her decision.
The government finally budged after weeks of protests.
cn: 尽管我们努力，那块巨石纹丝不动。
她拒绝改变自己的决定。
经过数周抗议，政府终于让步。

definitions.definition: 浅黄色软皮革；爱好者，狂热者（尤指电影、游戏等领域的）
浅黄色的；健美的，肌肉发达的

en: He wore a jacket made of buff leather.
She's a real film buff and watches three movies a day.
He buffed the car until it shone.
cn: 他穿了一件浅黄色皮革夹克。
她是个真正的电影迷，每天看三部电影。
他把车擦得锃亮。

en: The software uses a memory buffer to store temporary data.
Trees act as a buffer against strong winds.
She buffered the news with gentle words.
cn: 该软件使用内存缓冲区存储临时数据。
树木起到减缓强风的作用。
她用温和的言辞缓和了这一消息的冲击。

definitions.definition: 多虫的；故障频出的（尤指计算机系统）

en: The software is still buggy and crashes frequently.
She pushed the baby in a buggy through the park.
The old barn was buggy, with insects crawling everywhere.
cn: 该软件仍故障频出，经常崩溃。
她推着婴儿车穿过公园。
旧谷仓里虫满为患，到处是爬虫。

en: The frog's throat bulged as it croaked loudly.
Her backpack had a noticeable bulge from the heavy books.
The population bulge after the war caused housing shortages.
cn: 青蛙鸣叫时喉咙鼓胀起来。
她的背包因厚重的书本明显鼓出一块。
战后人口激增导致住房短缺。

en: The bulk of the work was completed in just two days.
Buying in bulk can save you a lot of money.
The mountain bulked large against the evening sky.
cn: 这项工作的大部分在两天内就完成了。
批量购买能省不少钱。
暮色中，山峦显得格外巍峨。

definitions.definition: （因体积大而）难以移动或处理的

en: The bulky package barely fit through the door.
She struggled to carry the bulky furniture upstairs.
Despite its bulky appearance, the machine is highly efficient.
cn: 这个笨重的包裹几乎无法通过门。
她费力地把笨重的家具搬上楼。
尽管外观庞大，这台机器效率极高。

definitions.definition: 1. 流浪汉；无业游民 2. （非正式）屁股

en: He's been a bum since he lost his job.
Stop bumming around and do something productive!
This bum knee keeps me from running.
cn: 他失业后一直是个无业游民。
别闲荡了，做点有意义的事！
这该死的膝盖让我没法跑步。

definitions.definition: 保险杠；缓冲器；丰盛之物（如丰收）

en: The car's bumper was dented in the accident.
This year's harvest was a bumper crop.
They served a bumper portion of fries at the diner.
cn: 事故中汽车的保险杠凹了进去。
今年迎来了大丰收。
这家小餐馆提供了超大份薯条。

definitions.definition: 床铺（尤指狭窄的或叠层的）

en: The soldiers slept in narrow bunks during the voyage.
Don't talk bunk—we need factual evidence.
He had to bunk with his brother when guests visited.
cn: 士兵们在航行期间睡在狭窄的铺位上。
别胡说八道，我们需要事实证据。
客人来访时，他不得不和弟弟挤一张床。

definitions.definition: 掩体；地堡；沙坑（高尔夫球场障碍区）
将…藏入掩体；使陷入困境

en: Soldiers took shelter in the underground bunker during the air raid.
The golfer's ball landed in a deep bunker near the green.
The company bunkered extra fuel before the storm hit.
cn: 空袭期间，士兵们躲在地下掩体中。
高尔夫球手的球落入了果岭附近的深沙坑。
公司在风暴来临前储备了额外燃料。

definitions.definition: 浮力；物体在液体中上浮的趋势或能力
（经济、市场等的）上涨趋势，繁荣
（情绪、态度等的）轻松愉快，乐观

en: The buoyancy of the life jacket kept him afloat in the water.
The buoyancy of the stock market has attracted many new investors.
Despite the setbacks, she faced the challenges with remarkable buoyancy.
cn: 这件救生衣的浮力使他在水中保持漂浮。
股市的上涨趋势吸引了许多新投资者。
尽管遭遇挫折，她仍以非凡的乐观态度面对挑战。

en: The rabbit disappeared into its burrow.
She burrowed under the blankets to keep warm.
The archaeologists burrowed through layers of sediment.
cn: 兔子钻进了地洞。
她钻进毯子里保暖。
考古学家们层层挖掘沉积物。

en: The market bustled with shoppers on weekends.
She bustled around the kitchen, preparing dinner.
The city's bustle never seems to fade, even at night.
cn: 周末的市场挤满了忙碌的顾客。
她在厨房里忙前忙后准备晚餐。
即使夜晚，城市的喧嚣也从未消退。

definitions.definition: 嗡嗡声；活跃的讨论；电话
发出嗡嗡声；忙碌；充满活力

en: The bees buzzed around the flowers.
There's been a lot of buzz about the new movie.
My phone buzzed twice during the meeting.
cn: 蜜蜂在花丛间嗡嗡飞舞。
关于这部新电影有很多热议。
会议期间我的手机震动了两次。

definitions.definition: 旁路；绕行道路；分流术（医学）

en: The construction forced drivers to take a bypass around the city.
The surgeon performed a coronary bypass to restore blood flow.
She bypassed the traditional publishing route by self-publishing her book.
cn: 施工迫使司机绕行城市的旁路。
外科医生进行了冠状动脉搭桥手术以恢复血流。
她通过自助出版绕过了传统出版流程。

definitions.definition: 卡巴莱（一种结合歌舞表演的餐厅或夜总会）
卡巴莱表演（小型娱乐节目）

en: The dimly lit cabaret featured a jazz singer and a small dance floor.
She performed a satirical monologue at the underground cabaret.
Parisian cabarets in the 1920s were hubs of artistic innovation.
cn: 昏暗的卡巴莱里有一位爵士歌手和小舞池。
她在地下卡巴莱表演了一段讽刺独白。
1920年代的巴黎卡巴莱是艺术创新的中心。

definitions.definition: 隐藏的储备物；计算机缓存

en: The hikers found a cache of supplies left by previous campers.
Modern browsers automatically cache website data to improve loading speed.
The spy hid the documents in a secret cache behind the bookshelf.
cn: 徒步者发现了之前露营者留下的物资储备。
现代浏览器会自动缓存网站数据以提高加载速度。
间谍将文件藏在书架后的秘密隔层里。

definitions.definition: （尤指禽类）咯咯叫；（人）高声尖笑

en: The hens cackled loudly after laying eggs.
Her cackle echoed through the room, making everyone turn their heads.
The witch’s cackle sent shivers down the children’s spines.
cn: 母鸡下蛋后咯咯大叫。
她刺耳的笑声在房间里回荡，引得所有人转头。
女巫的尖笑让孩子们脊背发凉。

definitions.definition: 无赖；卑鄙的男人；行为不端的男子

en: He was widely regarded as a cad for abandoning his family.
In Victorian novels, the cad often meets a bad end.
Don't be such a cad; return the money you found.
cn: 他被普遍认为是个抛弃家庭的卑鄙小人。
在维多利亚时代的小说中，无赖通常没有好下场。
别这么无耻；把你捡到的钱还回去。

en: She managed to cajole him into lending her the car.
Parents often cajole children with promises of treats.
The salesman cajoled the customer with flattery.
cn: 她成功哄骗他把车借给了她。
父母常用奖励哄劝孩子。
销售员用奉承话劝诱顾客。

en: The earthquake was a calamity that destroyed the entire village.
Losing his job during the pandemic felt like a personal calamity.
The flood brought calamity to the region, leaving thousands homeless.
cn: 这场地震是一场毁灭整个村庄的灾难。
疫情期间失业对他而言如同个人灾难。
洪水给该地区带来灾难，导致数千人无家可归。

definitions.definition: 精于算计的；工于心计的

en: She gave him a calculating look, weighing his proposal against potential risks.
He is too calculating to be trusted in matters of friendship.
The calculating businessman always prioritized profit over personal relationships.
cn: 她投给他一个精明的眼神，权衡着他的提议与潜在风险。
他太工于心计，在友情方面不值得信任。
这位精于算计的商人总是把利润置于人际关系之上。

definitions.definition: 冷酷无情的；麻木不仁的

en: His callous disregard for the suffering of others shocked everyone.
Years of manual labor left her hands callous and rough.
The villain's callous laughter echoed through the room.
cn: 他对他人痛苦的冷漠无视令所有人震惊。
多年的体力劳动让她的双手布满老茧、粗糙不堪。
反派的冷酷笑声在房间里回荡。

definitions.definition: 稚嫩的，不成熟的（尤指年轻人缺乏经验）

en: He was a callow youth when he first joined the company, but he has grown into a capable manager.
cn: 他刚加入公司时还是个毛头小子，但如今已成长为一位能干的经理。

definitions.definition: 1. 浮雕宝石（尤指侧面人像）

en: She wore a delicate gold ring with a tiny cameo of a goddess.
cn: 她戴着一枚镶有女神浮雕的金戒指。

en: The chameleon's camouflage helps it blend into its surroundings.
Soldiers used leaves and branches to camouflage their position.
Her cheerful manner was just a camouflage for sadness.
cn: 变色龙的伪装帮助它融入环境。
士兵用树叶和树枝伪装他们的位置。
她开朗的举止只是悲伤的掩饰。

definitions.definition: 自然的，未经摆拍的（如照片）

en: She gave a candid answer about her mistakes.
The documentary shows candid moments of the actor’s daily life.
His candid feedback helped improve the project.
cn: 她坦率地回答了自己的错误。
这部纪录片展现了演员日常生活的自然瞬间。
他直言不讳的反馈帮助改进了项目。

definitions.definition: 食人者；同类相食的动物

en: The explorers feared encountering cannibals in the uncharted jungle.
Some animal species exhibit cannibal behavior under extreme stress.
The legend describes a tribe of cannibals living deep in the mountains.
cn: 探险者害怕在未知丛林中遭遇食人族。
某些动物在极端压力下会表现出同类相食行为。
传说描述了一群生活在深山中的食人部落。

en: She's a canny investor who always spots undervalued stocks.
His canny negotiation skills saved the company millions.
The old man gave a canny smile, as if he knew more than he let on.
cn: 她是一位精明的投资者，总能发现被低估的股票。
他精明的谈判技巧为公司节省了数百万。
老人露出狡黠的微笑，仿佛知道的比表现出来的更多。

definitions.definition: 独木舟（一种狭长的轻便小船，通常用单根树干挖空制成）

en: They paddled the canoe across the lake at dawn.
The indigenous people carved canoes from giant tree trunks.
Canoeing is a popular summer activity in this region.
cn: 他们在黎明时分划独木舟穿过湖泊。
原住民用巨大的树干雕刻独木舟。
划独木舟是该地区夏季的热门活动。

definitions.definition: 教规；标准；经典（尤指宗教或文学领域的权威文本）

en: The canon of Shakespeare's works has influenced generations of writers.
The church canon prohibits clergy from marrying.
Bach's "Canon in D" showcases intricate melodic imitation.
cn: 莎士比亚的作品经典影响了几代作家。
教会教规禁止神职人员结婚。
巴赫的《D大调卡农》展现了精妙的旋律模仿。

en: The bride walked under a floral canopy.
The rainforest canopy shelters countless species.
The jet’s ejection canopy saved the pilot’s life.
cn: 新娘走在鲜花搭成的天篷下。
雨林树冠为无数物种提供庇护。
喷气机的弹射舱盖救了飞行员的命。

en: The horse broke into a smooth canter across the field.
We cantered along the beach as the sun was setting.
She cantered her pony around the ring to warm up.
cn: 马匹迈着平稳的慢跑穿过田野。
我们骑着马在沙滩上慢跑，此时夕阳西下。
她让她的矮种马在场地里慢跑以进行热身。

definitions.definition: /vi. 游说拉票；征求意见；详细讨论

en: Volunteers will canvass the neighborhood to promote the new policy.
The team held a meeting to canvass all possible solutions.
Early canvass results suggest a close election race.
cn: 志愿者将走访社区游说宣传新政策。
团队召开会议以详细讨论所有可能的解决方案。
早期民意调查结果显示选举竞争激烈。

definitions.definition: 海角，岬（伸入海中的陆地）

en: The lighthouse stands on the rocky cape.
She wore a red velvet cape to the gala.
Cape Horn is notorious for its rough seas.
cn: 灯塔矗立在多石的海角上。
她穿着红色天鹅绒斗篷参加晚宴。
合恩角因汹涌的海浪而闻名。

en: Oxygen passes through the thin walls of capillaries into the bloodstream.
Capillary action allows water to rise in narrow tubes against gravity.
The scientist observed the capillary network under a microscope.
cn: 氧气通过毛细血管的薄壁进入血液。
毛细作用使水能在细管中逆重力上升。
科学家在显微镜下观察了毛细血管网络。

en: The rebels were forced to capitulate after months of siege.
He refused to capitulate to the unreasonable demands.
The software company capitulated to user pressure and restored the old feature.
cn: 叛军在数月围困后被迫投降。
他拒绝屈服于无理要求。
软件公司迫于用户压力恢复了旧功能。

definitions.definition: 反复无常；任性；心血来潮
随想曲；变幻莫测的乐曲

en: He resigned out of mere caprice.
The composer's caprice is full of unexpected turns.
The weather in spring is often a caprice.
cn: 他辞职完全是一时心血来潮。
作曲家的这首随想曲充满了意想不到的转折。
春天的天气常常变幻莫测。

en: The capricious weather made planning the picnic impossible.
Her capricious moods kept everyone on edge.
The stock market is often driven by capricious investor sentiment.
cn: 反复无常的天气让野餐计划无法落实。
她任性的情绪让所有人都紧张不安。
股市常受投资者反复无常的情绪驱动。

en: The sudden squall caused the small boat to capsize.
Be careful not to capsize the canoe when you stand up.
The ferry capsized in the storm, resulting in a tragic loss of life.
cn: 突如其来的暴风使小船倾覆了。
站起来时小心别把独木舟弄翻了。
渡轮在风暴中倾覆，造成了悲惨的生命损失。

en: Her performance captivated the entire audience.
The novel's plot captivates readers with its unexpected twists.
cn: 她的表演迷住了全场观众。
小说情节以出人意料的转折吸引读者。

en: The prisoners endured years of captivity in harsh conditions.
Zoos aim to provide humane care for animals in captivity.
Her memoir describes the psychological effects of captivity.
cn: 囚犯们在恶劣条件下忍受了多年的监禁。
动物园旨在为圈养动物提供人道照料。
她的回忆录描述了囚禁对心理的影响。

definitions.definition: 克拉（宝石重量单位，等于200毫克）
开（黄金纯度单位，纯金为24开）

en: The diamond in her engagement ring is over two carats.
This ring is made of 18-carat gold, meaning it contains 75% pure gold.
The value of a gemstone increases significantly per additional carat.
cn: 她订婚戒指上的钻石超过两克拉。
这枚戒指是18K金制成的，意味着它含有75%的纯金。
宝石的价值会随着每增加一克拉而显著上升。

definitions.definition: 碳水化合物（由碳、氢、氧组成的有机化合物，如糖类、淀粉等）

en: Whole grains are rich in complex carbohydrates.
Athletes often consume carbohydrates for energy.
This lab test measures your carbohydrate metabolism.
cn: 全谷物富含复合碳水化合物。
运动员常摄入碳水化合物以补充能量。
此项实验检测你的碳水化合物代谢情况。

en: The patient suffered a cardiac arrest during surgery.
Cardiac muscles are involuntary and found only in the heart.
The doctor prescribed a cardiac to strengthen his heartbeat.
cn: 患者在手术过程中突发心脏骤停。
心肌是不随意肌，仅存在于心脏中。
医生开了强心剂以增强他的心跳。

en: She gave the kitten a gentle caress.
His words were a caress to her wounded heart.
The breeze caressed the surface of the lake.
cn: 她轻轻抚摸着小猫。
他的话抚慰了她受伤的心。
微风轻拂过湖面。

definitions.definition: 漫画；讽刺画；夸张的模仿
用漫画表现；夸张地模仿

en: The politician was portrayed as a clown in the newspaper's caricature.
Her performance caricatured the mannerisms of famous celebrities.
Caricatures often exaggerate physical features for humorous effect.
cn: 报纸的漫画将这位政客描绘成小丑。
她的表演夸张模仿了名人的举止。
漫画常通过夸大外貌特征达到幽默效果。

en: The battle left behind a scene of utter carnage.
Documentary footage revealed the carnage of the civil war.
Wildlife carnage caused by deforestation is often overlooked.
cn: 战斗留下了彻底的大屠杀现场。
纪录片镜头展现了内战的血腥场面。
森林砍伐导致的野生动物屠杀常被忽视。

definitions.definition: 世俗的（与精神或神圣相对）

en: His poetry often explores the conflict between carnal desires and spiritual aspirations.
The monk renounced all carnal pleasures to pursue enlightenment.
The film was criticized for its excessive focus on carnal themes.
cn: 他的诗歌常探讨肉体欲望与精神追求之间的冲突。
这位僧侣放弃了所有世俗享乐以追求觉悟。
这部电影因过度聚焦情欲主题而受到批评。

en: She wore a white dress with a pink carnation pinned to her lapel.
In Renaissance art, carnation symbolized divine love.
The dye was a perfect match for the carnation hue of the petals.
cn: 她穿着白色连衣裙，衣领上别着一朵粉色康乃馨。
文艺复兴艺术中，康乃馨象征神圣之爱。
这种染料与花瓣的肉粉色完全吻合。

en: Lions are obligate carnivores, relying solely on meat for survival.
The Venus flytrap is a rare example of a carnivorous plant.
His critics called him a corporate carnivore for aggressively acquiring smaller companies.
cn: 狮子是专性食肉动物，完全依赖肉类生存。
捕蝇草是罕见的食肉植物代表。
批评者称他为“企业掠夺者”，因其激进收购小公司。

en: The pond was stocked with carp and goldfish.
She always carps about minor details in our reports.
Ancient Chinese poets often used carp as a symbol of perseverance.
cn: 池塘里放养了鲤鱼和金鱼。
她总是对我们报告中的细枝末节吹毛求疵。
中国古代诗人常以鲤鱼象征坚韧。

definitions.definition: 弹药筒；墨盒；暗盒（相机或录音设备）

en: He loaded a fresh cartridge into the rifle.
The printer needs a new ink cartridge.
Old cameras used film cartridges.
cn: 他将一枚新弹药筒装入步枪。
打印机需要更换新墨盒。
老式相机使用胶卷暗盒。

definitions.definition: 小瀑布；连续的多阶段过程
像瀑布般落下；连续传递

en: The hikers admired the crystal-clear water of the mountain cascade.
The news triggered a cascade of protests across the country.
Data errors can cascade through the system if not caught early.
cn: 徒步者赞叹着山间小瀑布清澈的水流。
这则新闻引发了全国范围内的连锁抗议。
若未及时发现，数据错误会在系统中逐级传递。

definitions.definition: 羊绒（特指克什米尔山羊的细软绒毛）
羊绒织物（如围巾、毛衣等）

en: She wrapped herself in a soft cashmere shawl.
Authentic cashmere is expensive due to its rarity.
The sweater is made of 100% pure cashmere.
cn: 她裹着一条柔软的羊绒披肩。
真正的羊绒因稀缺而价格昂贵。
这件毛衣由100%纯羊绒制成。

definitions.definition: 种姓（印度社会的世袭阶级制度）
严格的社会等级或阶层

en: The caste system in India has influenced social structure for centuries.
Discrimination based on caste is illegal in many countries.
Some argue that corporate hierarchies resemble a modern caste system.
cn: 印度的种姓制度已影响社会结构数百年。
许多国家禁止基于种姓的歧视。
有人认为企业层级制度类似现代的种姓体系。

definitions.definition: 催化剂（化学中加速反应但不被消耗的物质）
促进因素（引发变化的人或事物）

en: Enzymes act as catalysts in metabolic reactions.
The protest became a catalyst for political reform.
Her speech was the catalyst that inspired the team to innovate.
cn: 酶在代谢反应中充当催化剂。
这次抗议成为政治改革的催化剂。
她的演讲是激发团队创新的推动力。

definitions.definition: （表示反对或嘲笑的）尖利口哨声；嘘声
对…发嘘声；用尖利的口哨声嘲弄

en: The comedian was met with catcalls when his jokes fell flat.
It is disrespectful to catcall performers during a show.
He blew a loud catcall from the back of the auditorium.
cn: 当喜剧演员的笑话冷场时，他遭遇了一片嘘声。
在演出中对表演者发出嘘声是不尊重的行为。
他从礼堂后面吹出一声响亮而刺耳的口哨。

definitions.definition: （政治口号或广告中的）流行语，标语
（词典页眉处标注首尾单词的）导词
（戏剧中提示演员接词的）尾白

en: "Sustainability" became the catchword of the corporate campaign.
In old dictionaries, catchwords helped readers locate entries quickly.
The actor missed his catchword, causing a pause in the performance.
cn: “可持续性”成了企业宣传活动的流行语。
在旧词典中，导词帮助读者快速定位词条。
那位演员错过了他的尾白，导致演出出现了停顿。

definitions.definition: 朗朗上口的（指音乐或短语）

en: The song has a catchy chorus that sticks in your head.
His presentation was full of catchy slogans.
Avoid writing overly catchy headlines that mislead readers.
cn: 这首歌的副歌朗朗上口，让人过耳不忘。
他的演讲充满了吸引人的口号。
避免使用过于噱头但误导读者的标题。

definitions.definition: 绝对的；无条件的（如 categorical statement）
分类的；范畴的（如 categorical data）

en: She gave a categorical denial to all accusations.
The survey results are divided into categorical variables.
His refusal was categorical—no room for negotiation.
cn: 她对所有指控断然否认。
调查结果被分为分类变量。
他的拒绝毫无余地，没有协商空间。

en: In a battery, electrons flow from the anode to the cathode.
The cathode ray tube was once widely used in television sets.
Scientists developed a new material to improve cathode efficiency in lithium-ion batteries.
cn: 电池中电子从阳极流向阴极。
阴极射线管曾广泛应用于电视机。
科学家开发了一种新材料以提高锂离子电池阴极的效率。

definitions.definition: 天主教（基督教分支，以罗马教廷为中心）
普世性；广泛性（古义，现较少用）

en: Catholicism is one of the largest branches of Christianity.
The spread of Catholicism in Latin America began in the 16th century.
His writings reflect a blend of Catholicism and humanist thought.
cn: 天主教是基督教最大的分支之一。
天主教在拉丁美洲的传播始于16世纪。
他的著作融合了天主教思想与人文主义。

en: The model gracefully strutted down the catwalk in a dazzling gown.
Workers crossed the steel catwalk high above the construction site.
The fire escape served as an improvised catwalk for the underground fashion show.
cn: 模特身着耀眼礼服，优雅地走在T台上。
工人们在工地高空的钢制步道上穿行。
消防通道被临时用作地下时装秀的T台。

en: The study focuses on the causal relationship between smoking and lung cancer.
Philosophers often debate whether free will is compatible with causal determinism.
The report omitted any discussion of causal factors behind the economic crisis.
cn: 这项研究聚焦于吸烟与肺癌之间的因果关系。
哲学家常争论自由意志是否与因果决定论相容。
报告未提及经济危机背后的任何因果因素。

definitions.definition: 洞穴（尤指大型或幽深的）

en: The explorers lit torches to illuminate the dark cavern.
Stalactites hung from the ceiling of the limestone cavern.
The cavern echoed with the sound of dripping water.
cn: 探险者们点燃火把，照亮漆黑的洞穴。
钟乳石从石灰岩洞穴的顶部垂挂下来。
洞穴中回荡着滴水的声音。

definitions.definition: 鱼子酱（尤指鲟鱼卵制成的珍馐）

en: She served toast with caviar at the elegant party.
Authentic Russian caviar is prized for its delicate flavor.
The price of caviar reflects its status as a luxury item.
cn: 她在豪华派对上提供了配鱼子酱的吐司。
正宗的俄罗斯鱼子酱因其细腻风味而备受推崇。
鱼子酱的价格反映了其作为奢侈品的地位。

definitions.definition: 空洞，腔（如牙齿龋洞、体腔）

en: The dentist found a small cavity in my molar.
Lava tubes form natural cavities in volcanic regions.
The ultrasound revealed a cavity in the lung tissue.
cn: 牙医发现我的磨牙上有个小龋洞。
熔岩管在火山区域形成天然洞穴。
超声检查显示肺组织中有一个空洞。

definitions.definition: 雪松（一种常绿乔木，木材芳香耐用）

en: The cabin was built from fragrant cedar.
Cedar oil is often used in aromatherapy.
Ancient Egyptians used cedar wood for shipbuilding.
cn: 这座小屋是用芳香的雪松木建造的。
雪松精油常用于芳香疗法。
古埃及人用雪松木造船。

definitions.definition: 让步，屈服（常与介词 to 连用）

en: The defeated nation was forced to cede the territory.
He refused to cede control of the project.
The government ceded to public pressure and canceled the policy.
cn: 战败国被迫割让领土。
他拒绝放弃对项目的控制权。
政府迫于公众压力让步，取消了该政策。

definitions.definition: 天空的；天上的（与天体或天堂相关）

en: The telescope revealed celestial bodies invisible to the naked eye.
Her voice had a celestial quality, pure and ethereal.
Ancient cultures worshipped celestial phenomena as divine signs.
cn: 望远镜揭示了肉眼不可见的天体。
她的嗓音如天籁般纯净空灵。
古文明将天象奉为神谕。

definitions.definition: （书籍、电影等的）审查员；监察官

en: The film was heavily censored before release.
Ancient Roman censors had the power to remove senators for misconduct.
Social media platforms often censor hate speech.
cn: 这部电影在上映前被大幅删改。
古罗马监察官有权因行为不端罢免元老院成员。
社交媒体平台常审查仇恨言论。

en: She gave a censorious account of the committee's work.
He is censorious of any behaviour that does not meet his own high standards.
The review was censorious in its critique of the film's direction.
cn: 她对委员会的工作进行了一番吹毛求疵的描述。
他对任何达不到自己高标准的行为都会加以苛责。
这篇评论对这部电影的导演工作提出了苛刻的批评。

definitions.definition: 审查制度（对媒体、言论等的官方管控）
审查行为（具体的检查或删改动作）

en: The government imposed strict censorship on social media during the crisis.
Many artists protested against the censorship of their works.
Historical records show how censorship shaped public opinion in wartime.
cn: 危机期间，政府对社交媒体实施了严格的审查制度。
许多艺术家抗议对其作品的审查行为。
历史记录揭示了审查制度如何影响战时的公众舆论。

en: The senator faced censure for violating ethics rules.
His harsh censure of the policy shocked the committee.
The media’s censure influenced public opinion.
cn: 这位参议员因违反道德准则而受到公开谴责。
他对政策的严厉批评令委员会震惊。
媒体的指责影响了公众舆论。

definitions.definition: 一百周年；一百周年纪念
一百年的；一百周年纪念的

en: The university is celebrating its centenary this year.
A series of centenary events are planned throughout the year.
The book was published to mark the centenary of the author's birth.
cn: 该大学今年正在庆祝其一百周年校庆。
一系列百年纪念活动计划在整个年度展开。
这本书的出版是为了纪念作者诞辰一百周年。

en: The government plans to centralise healthcare services under a single authority.
Modern technology allows companies to centralise their data storage efficiently.
Critics argue that centralising power may reduce local autonomy.
cn: 政府计划将医疗服务集中到一个单一机构管理。
现代技术使企业能高效集中数据存储。
批评者认为权力集中可能削弱地方自主权。

definitions.definition: 中间派，温和主义者（政治或社会观点中立的人）

en: The party needs more centrists to bridge the gap between left and right.
As a centrist, she often mediates conflicts within the committee.
Centrists argue that pragmatic policies yield better results than ideological extremes.
cn: 该党需要更多中间派来弥合左右翼的分歧。
作为温和派，她常调解委员会内的冲突。
中间派认为务实政策比意识形态极端更有效。

en: The stroke caused damage to his cerebral cortex.
She has a cerebral approach to problem-solving.
The film is too cerebral for casual viewers.
cn: 中风对他的大脑皮层造成了损伤。
她解决问题的方式非常理性。
这部电影对普通观众来说过于深奥。

definitions.definition: 礼节性的，拘泥于虚礼的

en: The host gave a ceremonious welcome to all the distinguished guests.
His ceremonious manner of speaking made the simple conversation feel very formal.
They exchanged ceremonious bows before the match began.
cn: 主人对所有尊贵的来宾致以了隆重的欢迎。
他那种拘泥于礼节的说话方式，让简单的对话显得非常正式。
在比赛开始前，他们相互进行了礼节性的鞠躬。

definitions.definition: 证明，证实（某事的真实性或准确性）

en: The doctor must certify the cause of death before the burial.
This program is certified by the international quality standard.
She certified the document with her official seal.
cn: 医生必须在埋葬前证明死亡原因。
该项目已通过国际质量标准认证。
她用公章证明了文件的真实性。

en: He spoke with absolute certitude about the outcome.
In a world of doubt, she held onto her certitude.
There's a difference between confidence and arrogant certitude.
cn: 他对结果抱有绝对的确定性。
在一个充满怀疑的世界里，她坚守着自己的信念。
自信和傲慢的确信之间是有区别的。

definitions.definition: （阿尔卑斯山的）木屋，小农舍；山间小屋；（仿瑞士农舍风格的）度假屋

en: They rented a charming wooden chalet in the Alps for their skiing holiday.
The resort features several luxury chalets with stunning mountain views.
The architecture of the house was inspired by a traditional Swiss chalet.
cn: 他们在阿尔卑斯山租了一间迷人的小木屋来度滑雪假。
该度假村拥有数间可欣赏壮丽山景的豪华小屋。
这所房子的建筑灵感来自于传统的瑞士农舍。

definitions.definition: 圣歌；吟诵；重复的节奏性呼喊

en: The monks began their morning chant in the chapel.
Protesters chanted slogans outside the government building.
The football fans' chant echoed through the stadium.
cn: 僧侣们在小教堂里开始了晨祷吟唱。
抗议者在政府大楼外反复呼喊着口号。
球迷们的助威声回荡在整个体育场。

definitions.definition: （医院、军队、监狱等的）牧师；随军神职人员

en: The hospital chaplain offered comfort to grieving families.
During the war, the chaplain held services for soldiers at the front.
She trained to become a prison chaplain to support inmates spiritually.
cn: 医院牧师为悲伤的家庭提供慰藉。
战争期间，随军牧师在前线为士兵主持礼拜。
她受训成为监狱牧师，为囚犯提供精神支持。

definitions.definition: 魅力，感召力（尤指领袖或名人的非凡吸引力）

en: The politician’s charisma won him a loyal following.
Her natural charisma makes her a brilliant public speaker.
In early Christianity, charisma referred to spiritual gifts like healing.
cn: 这位政治家的魅力为他赢得了大批忠实追随者。
她天生的感召力使其成为出色的演说家。
在早期基督教中，“charisma”指治愈等神赐能力。

definitions.definition: 有魅力的；具有领袖气质的

en: His charismatic speech inspired the crowd.
She has a charismatic personality that draws people in.
The movement was led by a charismatic preacher.
cn: 他富有魅力的演讲鼓舞了人群。
她的个性极具魅力，吸引着周围的人。
这场运动由一位具有神赐魅力的传教士领导。

definitions.definition: 贞洁的，纯洁的（指行为或品德）
朴素的，简洁的（指风格或设计）

en: In the classic novel, the protagonist is portrayed as a chaste and virtuous woman.
The architect preferred a chaste design, free from unnecessary ornamentation.
His poetry is known for its chaste and elegant style.
cn: 在这部经典小说中，女主角被描绘成一位贞洁贤德的女子。
这位建筑师偏爱一种朴素的设计，摒弃了不必要的装饰。
他的诗歌以其简洁优雅的风格而闻名。

en: Medieval knights swore vows of chastity as part of their code.
The novel explores the tension between chastity and desire.
Some cultures value chastity as a moral virtue.
cn: 中世纪骑士以贞洁誓言作为守则的一部分。
这部小说探讨了贞洁与欲望之间的张力。
某些文化将贞洁视为道德美德。

definitions.definition: 沙文主义；盲目的爱国主义；对本群体（如性别）的极端或好战的忠诚

en: His blatant male chauvinism made him unpopular with his female colleagues.
The government's policy was criticized as a form of economic chauvinism.
National chauvinism can blind people to the value of international cooperation.
cn: 他露骨的大男子主义使他在女同事中很不受欢迎。
该政府的政策被批评为一种经济沙文主义。
民族沙文主义会让人看不到国际合作的价值。

definitions.definition: 将死（国际象棋中无法防御的攻击）

en: With a swift move of his queen, he declared, "Checkmate!"
The new evidence was a checkmate to the prosecution's case.
Their innovative strategy completely checkmated the competition.
cn: 他用皇后迅速走了一步，宣布：“将死！”
这项新证据使得控方的案件被彻底推翻。
他们创新的战略彻底击败了竞争对手。

en: She wore a chic black dress to the party.
The apartment has a minimalist chic.
His writing style is both witty and chic.
cn: 她穿了一条别致的黑色连衣裙参加派对。
这间公寓有一种极简主义的优雅风格。
他的写作风格既机智又雅致。

definitions.definition: 首领，酋长（尤指部落或氏族领袖）
（历史语境中）军事领袖或头目

en: The chieftain led his tribe through the harsh winter.
In medieval Scotland, a chieftain commanded both respect and loyalty.
The rebel chieftain negotiated a truce with the royal army.
cn: 酋长带领部落度过了严冬。
在中世纪的苏格兰，氏族首领既受人尊敬，又拥有绝对忠诚。
叛军首领与皇家军队谈判达成了休战协议。

definitions.definition: 钟声；和谐的声音；一套钟
用钟声报时；使和谐一致

en: The church bells chimed at midnight.
Her ideas chimed perfectly with the team’s vision.
The wind chimes tinkled in the breeze.
cn: 午夜时分，教堂钟声响起。
她的想法与团队的愿景完全契合。
风铃在微风中叮当作响。

definitions.definition: 黑猩猩（非洲灵长类动物，与人类基因高度相似）

en: Chimpanzees use tools to crack nuts in the wild.
The chimpanzee's DNA is 98% identical to humans.
Researchers observed complex social behaviors among chimpanzees.
cn: 野生黑猩猩会使用工具敲开坚果。
黑猩猩的DNA与人类98%相同。
研究人员观察到黑猩猩群体中的复杂社会行为。

definitions.definition: （鸟或昆虫的）啁啾声，短促尖叫声
发出啁啾声（或短促尖叫声）

en: The sparrows chirped loudly at dawn.
A single chirp from the cricket broke the silence.
Her voice chirped with excitement.
cn: 麻雀在黎明时分高声啁啾。
蟋蟀的一声鸣叫打破了寂静。
她兴奋得声音尖细轻快。

definitions.definition: 凿子（一种用于雕刻或切割的工具）
用凿子雕刻；凿刻；<非正式>欺诈（钱财）

en: The sculptor used a chisel to shape the marble.
He carefully chiseled his initials into the wood.
They were caught trying to chisel money from elderly investors.
cn: 雕塑家用凿子雕刻大理石。
他小心地将姓名首字母凿刻在木头上。
他们试图诈骗老年投资者的钱财时被抓获。

definitions.definition: （中世纪的）骑士精神，骑士制度
（尤指男性对女性的）彬彬有礼，绅士风度

en: The knight was a true example of chivalry and honor.
He held the door open for her out of sheer chivalry.
Modern chivalry is less about combat and more about everyday courtesy.
cn: 这位骑士是骑士精神与荣誉的真正典范。
他纯粹是出于绅士风度为她拉着门。
现代的骑士精神更侧重于日常的礼节，而非战斗。

definitions.definition: 叶绿素（植物中负责光合作用的绿色色素）

en: Chlorophyll absorbs sunlight to convert carbon dioxide into energy.
The green colour of leaves comes from chlorophyll.
Plants without sufficient chlorophyll may appear yellow and struggle to grow.
cn: 叶绿素吸收阳光，将二氧化碳转化为能量。
叶子的绿色源于叶绿素。
缺乏足够叶绿素的植物可能发黄且难以生长。

definitions.definition: 叶绿体（植物细胞中进行光合作用的细胞器）

en: Chloroplasts are responsible for photosynthesis in plant cells.
The green color of leaves comes from chlorophyll within chloroplasts.
Scientists study chloroplast DNA to understand plant evolution.
cn: 叶绿体负责植物细胞的光合作用。
叶子的绿色来自于叶绿体内的叶绿素。
科学家研究叶绿体DNA以理解植物进化。

definitions.definition: 霍乱（一种急性肠道传染病）

en: Cholera outbreaks often occur in areas with poor sanitation.
The rapid spread of cholera was linked to contaminated water.
Vaccination can help prevent cholera in high-risk regions.
cn: 霍乱爆发常见于卫生条件较差的地区。
霍乱的快速传播与受污染的水源有关。
疫苗接种有助于在高风险地区预防霍乱。

definitions.definition: 胆固醇（一种脂类物质，存在于动物细胞中，过高会导致心血管疾病）

en: High cholesterol can lead to heart disease.
Eggs contain dietary cholesterol but are nutritious.
Doctors recommend checking cholesterol levels annually.
cn: 高胆固醇可能导致心脏病。
鸡蛋含膳食胆固醇但营养丰富。
医生建议每年检查胆固醇水平。

definitions.definition: （动作或节奏）不连贯的，断断续续的

en: The boat struggled in the choppy waters.
His speech was choppy, with frequent pauses.
The film's editing felt choppy and disjointed.
cn: 小船在波涛汹涌的水域中艰难前行。
他的演讲断断续续，频繁停顿。
这部电影的剪辑显得零碎而不连贯。

en: The choral performance moved the audience to tears.
She joined a choral society to improve her singing skills.
The cathedral is famous for its choral traditions.
cn: 合唱表演让观众感动落泪。
她加入合唱团以提高歌唱技巧。
这座大教堂以其合唱传统闻名。

en: The choreography of this ballet blends classical and modern styles.
Her choreography for the Olympic opening ceremony was breathtaking.
The protest's success relied on careful choreography of media coverage.
cn: 这支芭蕾舞的编舞融合了古典与现代风格。
她为奥运会开幕式设计的舞蹈编排令人叹为观止。
抗议活动的成功依赖于对媒体报道的精心策划。

en: The baby was christened in the local church.
They christened the new ship "Voyager".
Let's christen this bottle of champagne!
cn: 婴儿在当地教堂接受了洗礼。
他们将新船命名为“旅行者号”。
我们来开这瓶香槟庆祝吧！

en: The car's bumper was coated with shiny chrome.
Chrome is widely used in stainless steel production.
She loved the vintage look of chrome-plated furniture.
cn: 汽车的保险杠镀了一层闪亮的铬。
铬被广泛应用于不锈钢制造。
她喜欢镀铬家具的复古感。

definitions.definition: 染色体（细胞中携带遗传物质的结构）

en: Each human cell normally contains 23 pairs of chromosomes.
Abnormalities in chromosome structure can cause genetic disorders.
The Y chromosome determines male sex characteristics.
cn: 每个人类细胞通常含有23对染色体。
染色体结构异常可能导致遗传疾病。
Y染色体决定雄性性别特征。

definitions.definition: 年代学；按时间顺序排列的事件记录

en: The book provides a detailed chronology of the Civil War.
Archaeologists use tree rings to establish the chronology of ancient settlements.
Her presentation included a chronology of key scientific discoveries.
cn: 这本书详细记录了美国内战的时间线。
考古学家通过年轮确定古代聚落的年代顺序。
她的演示中包含了重大科学发现的时间轴。

definitions.definition: 圆胖的，丰满的（尤指脸或身体）

en: The baby has chubby cheeks that everyone loves to pinch.
She held out her chubby hands to catch the falling leaves.
The puppy’s chubby belly waddled as it ran.
cn: 这个宝宝的胖嘟嘟脸颊让人总想捏一捏。
她伸出圆润的双手去接飘落的树叶。
小狗跑动时，圆鼓鼓的肚子一摇一摆。

definitions.definition: 卡盘（机械装置）；亲昵称呼（如 "Hey chuck!"）
（非正式）放弃；终止（如 "chuck it all"）

en: He chucked the ball to his dog.
The lathe chuck needs adjustment.
She decided to chuck her job and travel.
cn: 他将球轻抛给小狗。
车床卡盘需要调整。
她决定辞职去旅行。

definitions.definition: 成为好朋友（常与 "up" 连用）

en: He's been my chum since primary school.
They chummed up during the camping trip.
Bring your chums to the party!
cn: 他是我的小学同学，至今仍是死党。
他们在露营期间成了好朋友。
带上你的哥们儿来参加派对！

definitions.definition: 粗鲁的；脾气坏的；无礼的

en: It was churlish of him to refuse such a generous offer.
She apologized for her churlish behavior at the meeting.
Despite his churlish exterior, he had a kind heart.
cn: 他拒绝如此慷慨的提议，实在无礼。
她为自己在会议上的粗鲁行为道歉。
尽管他外表脾气暴躁，内心却很善良。

definitions.definition: 搅乳器；剧烈搅动；客户流失
剧烈搅拌；使（客户）频繁更换

en: She used a wooden churn to make butter.
The ocean churned violently during the storm.
High fees can cause customers to churn to competitors.
cn: 她用木制搅乳器制作黄油。
暴风雨中海水剧烈翻腾。
高费用会导致客户转向竞争对手。

en: The fireplace was full of cold cinders after the fire died out.
Volcanic cinders covered the slopes of the mountain.
She swept the cinders from the hearth every morning.
cn: 火焰熄灭后，壁炉里堆满了冰冷的余烬。
火山渣覆盖了山坡。
她每天早晨都会清扫炉床的煤渣。

definitions.definition: 与特定环境相关的；详细的

en: The case relied heavily on circumstantial evidence.
She gave a circumstantial account of the incident.
His alibi was weak and purely circumstantial.
cn: 该案件高度依赖间接证据。
她对事件进行了详尽的描述。
他的不在场证明薄弱且完全基于间接推断。

en: The hacker circumvented the firewall by exploiting a loophole.
Diplomats often circumvent sensitive issues through careful wording.
The new law aims to prevent companies from circumventing tax regulations.
cn: 黑客利用漏洞绕过了防火墙。
外交官常通过谨慎措辞规避敏感问题。
新法律旨在阻止企业规避税收法规。

en: The mountain peaks are clad in snow all year round.
She clad herself in a traditional silk dress for the ceremony.
The building was clad with shiny metal panels.
cn: 山峰终年积雪覆盖。
她为典礼穿上了传统的丝绸礼服。
这座建筑覆有闪亮的金属板。

definitions.definition: 索赔人；申请人（法律或正式场合中提出权利主张的人）

en: The claimant submitted evidence to support her case.
As the rightful claimant, he inherited the property.
The court dismissed the claimant's appeal due to lack of proof.
cn: 这位索赔人提交了证据以支持她的诉求。
作为合法申请人，他继承了这笔财产。
法院因证据不足驳回了申请人的上诉。

definitions.definition: 攀爬（尤指手脚并用费力地爬）

en: The children clambered over the rocks to reach the cave.
She clambered up the steep slope, her hands covered in dirt.
Tourists clamber aboard the ancient train for a scenic ride.
cn: 孩子们手脚并用地爬过岩石，抵达洞穴。
她爬上陡坡，双手沾满泥土。
游客们费力地登上老式火车，准备欣赏风景。

definitions.definition: 秘密的、暗中的（尤指非法或不道德的活动）

en: The group held clandestine meetings in abandoned warehouses.
She discovered his clandestine affair through a text message.
Journalists often rely on clandestine sources to expose corruption.
cn: 该组织在废弃仓库举行秘密会议。
她通过一条短信发现了他秘密的婚外情。
记者常依赖秘密消息来源揭露腐败。

definitions.definition: 连续而清脆的撞击声（如金属、硬物碰撞）
发出连续清脆的撞击声

en: The dishes fell with a loud clatter.
The train clattered over the old iron bridge.
Her heels clattered on the marble floor.
cn: 盘子哗啦一声摔碎了。
火车哐当哐当地驶过老铁桥。
她的鞋跟在大理石地面上咔嗒作响。

definitions.definition: 幽闭恐惧症（对狭小或封闭空间的极端或非理性恐惧）

en: His claustrophobia prevents him from using elevators.
The narrow, windowless tunnel triggered her claustrophobia.
MRI scans can be challenging for patients suffering from claustrophobia.
cn: 他的幽闭恐惧症使他无法乘坐电梯。
那狭窄无窗的隧道引发了她的幽闭恐惧症。
对于患有幽闭恐惧症的病人来说，核磁共振成像扫描可能颇具挑战。

definitions.definition: 彻底清洁；净化（尤指身体或精神）
清除（有害物质或不良影响）

en: The ritual is meant to cleanse the spirit of negative energy.
She used a special toner to cleanse her face every night.
The city launched a campaign to cleanse the polluted river.
cn: 这个仪式旨在净化心灵中的负能量。
她每晚用一款特殊爽肤水彻底清洁面部。
该市发起了一项净化受污染河流的运动。

definitions.definition: 裂缝，分裂（地质学/生物学）

en: The geologist studied the rock cleavage to understand tectonic movements.
Her dress accentuated her cleavage, drawing discreet glances.
Embryonic cleavage is a critical stage in early development.
cn: 地质学家研究岩石裂隙以理解板块运动。
她的裙子凸显了乳沟，引来克制的目光。
胚胎分裂是早期发育的关键阶段。

en: The lumberjack used his axe to cleave the log in two.
The wet shirt cleaved to his skin.
They vowed to cleave to their principles no matter the pressure.
cn: 樵夫用斧头将圆木劈成两半。
湿衬衫紧贴在他的皮肤上。
他们发誓无论压力多大，都将坚守自己的原则。

definitions.definition: 陈词滥调；老套的表达或想法

en: His speech was full of tired clichés about teamwork.
The movie's plot felt clichéd and predictable.
Avoid using clichés in your writing to sound more original.
cn: 他的演讲充斥着关于团队合作的老生常谈。
这部电影的情节显得陈腐且可预测。
写作中避免使用陈词滥调，以显得更有原创性。

en: The climactic scene of the movie left the audience breathless.
His speech reached its climactic moment with a call to action.
The symphony's climactic finale was met with thunderous applause.
cn: 电影的高潮场景让观众屏息凝神。
他的演讲以行动号召达到高潮。
交响乐高潮迭起的终章赢得了雷鸣般的掌声。

definitions.definition: 敲弯（钉子等以固定）；最终确定（协议、胜利等）

en: The carpenter clinched the nails to secure the wooden planks.
The team clinched the championship with a last-minute goal.
The boxers were clinching to avoid punches.
cn: 木匠敲弯钉子以固定木板。
球队凭借最后一分钟的进球锁定冠军。
拳击手扭抱在一起以躲避攻击。

en: She wore traditional wooden clogs in the Dutch countryside.
Leaves clogged the drain after the storm.
The printer keeps clogging due to cheap ink.
cn: 她在荷兰乡村穿着传统木屐。
暴风雨后树叶堵塞了排水管。
由于使用廉价墨水，打印机不断卡住。

en: A blood clot can block the flow of oxygen to the brain.
The sauce will clot if you leave it uncovered.
Stir the mixture constantly to prevent clotting.
cn: 血凝块可能阻断氧气输送到大脑。
酱汁暴露在空气中会凝结成块。
持续搅拌混合物以防止结块。

en: She tripped over a clump of grass.
The workers clumped the soil into mounds.
We heard him clumping up the stairs.
cn: 她被一簇草绊倒了。
工人们把土堆成块状。
我们听见他咚咚地走上楼梯。

definitions.definition: 杂乱，混乱（尤指散乱的物品）

en: The desk was covered in a clutter of papers and pens.
Don’t clutter your mind with unnecessary details.
She quickly cleared the clutter from the room before guests arrived.
cn: 桌上堆满了杂乱的文件和笔。
别让无关细节扰乱你的思绪。
客人到来前，她迅速清理了房间的杂物。

definitions.definition: 用温和的方式劝说；诱哄

en: She managed to coax the cat down from the tree with treats.
It took hours to coax the old printer back to life.
His voice was soft, coaxing her to share the secret.
cn: 她用零食成功哄猫咪从树上下来。
花了数小时才调试好这台老打印机。
他声音轻柔，诱哄她说出秘密。

definitions.definition: 1. 粗略地修补；2. 用圆石铺路

en: The street was cobbled with smooth stones.
He cobbled together a makeshift shelter from scrap wood.
Her shoes clattered on the wet cobbles.
cn: 这条街用光滑的石头铺成。
他用废木料草草搭了个临时避难所。
她的鞋子在潮湿的鹅卵石上咔嗒作响。

en: The cobra raised its head and spread its hood.
The mongoose is known for its ability to fight and kill cobras.
He was fascinated by the hypnotic movement of the cobra.
cn: 眼镜蛇抬起头，张开了它的颈兜。
獴以能够与眼镜蛇搏斗并杀死它们而闻名。
他被眼镜蛇那令人催眠的动作迷住了。

definitions.definition: 可卡因（一种从古柯叶中提取的兴奋剂药物）

en: Cocaine was originally used as a local anesthetic in medical procedures.
The leaves of the coca plant are the natural source of cocaine.
Illegal cocaine trafficking remains a global issue.
cn: 可卡因最初被用作医疗手术中的局部麻醉剂。
古柯植物的叶子是可卡因的天然来源。
非法可卡因贩运仍是全球性问题。

definitions.definition: 傲慢的，自大的（尤指过分自信或炫耀）

en: He became cocky after winning the first round.
Her cocky attitude annoyed the interviewers.
Don’t get cocky—this is just the beginning.
cn: 他在第一轮获胜后变得趾高气扬。
她傲慢的态度让面试官感到不悦。
别得意忘形，这只是个开始。

definitions.definition: 溺爱，娇惯（尤指过度呵护）

en: She coddles her son so much that he can't even tie his own shoes.
The chef coddled the eggs to perfection in a water bath.
Stop coddling the new interns—they need to learn from mistakes.
cn: 她过度溺爱儿子，他甚至不会自己系鞋带。
厨师用水浴法将鸡蛋慢煮至完美状态。
别再娇惯新实习生了，他们需要从错误中学习。

definitions.definition: （数学、物理中的）系数；协同因素

en: The coefficient of friction between the tires and the road affects braking distance.
In the equation y=2x+1, the number 2 is the coefficient of x.
Higher education is a significant coefficient in economic growth.
cn: 轮胎与路面间的摩擦系数影响刹车距离。
在方程 y=2x+1 中，数字 2 是 x 的系数。
高等教育是经济增长的重要协同因素。

definitions.definition: 强迫，胁迫（通过武力或压力迫使某人做某事）

en: The government was accused of coercing citizens into voting for the regime.
Peer pressure can coerce teenagers into making poor decisions.
The contract prohibits any attempt to coerce employees through threats.
cn: 政府被指控胁迫公民为政权投票。
同龄人压力可能迫使青少年做出糟糕的决定。
合同禁止任何通过威胁胁迫员工的企图。

en: The dictator ruled by coercion rather than consent.
Psychological coercion can be as damaging as physical force.
The law prohibits coercion in contractual agreements.
cn: 独裁者通过胁迫而非民意进行统治。
心理胁迫可能与身体暴力同样有害。
法律禁止合同协议中的强制行为。

definitions.definition: 共存；同时存在；和平共处

en: Multiple species can coexist in a balanced ecosystem.
The two religions have coexisted peacefully in the region for centuries.
It is challenging for traditional values to coexist with modern ideologies.
cn: 多种物种可以在一个平衡的生态系统中共存。
这两种宗教在该地区和平共处了几个世纪。
传统价值观与现代意识形态要共存是具有挑战性的。

definitions.definition: 齿轮的轮齿；嵌齿；无足轻重的人或物

en: The mechanic replaced a broken cog in the engine.
He felt like a mere cog in the corporate machine.
The clock’s cogs were meticulously cleaned.
cn: 机械师更换了发动机中损坏的齿轮。
他觉得自己只是公司机器中的一个小齿轮。
钟表的齿轮被精心清洁过。

definitions.definition: 认知的；与认识过程相关的

en: Cognitive abilities decline with age if not exercised regularly.
The study focuses on cognitive development in early childhood.
Sleep is essential for cognitive function and memory consolidation.
cn: 认知能力若不经常锻炼，会随着年龄增长而衰退。
该研究聚焦于儿童早期的认知发展。
睡眠对认知功能和记忆巩固至关重要。

definitions.definition: 连贯的，一致的（指逻辑或表达清晰）
黏附的，紧密结合的（物理或化学性质）

en: Her argument was coherent and easy to follow.
The laser produces coherent light waves.
The team lacked a coherent strategy.
cn: 她的论点连贯且易于理解。
激光产生相干的光波。
团队缺乏一致的策略。

en: The team lacked cohesive leadership, resulting in disorganized efforts.
This adhesive forms a cohesive bond even under extreme temperatures.
Her essay was praised for its cohesive argument and clear structure.
cn: 团队缺乏有凝聚力的领导，导致行动散乱。
这种粘合剂即使在极端温度下也能形成牢固的结合。
她的论文因论点连贯、结构清晰而受到好评。

en: Please collate the reports before the meeting.
The software can automatically collate data from multiple sources.
She spent hours collating research notes for her thesis.
cn: 请在会议前整理好报告。
该软件能自动汇总多来源的数据。
她花了数小时整理论文的研究笔记。

en: The two companies were found to collude on pricing, which is illegal.
He would never collude with anyone to cheat the system.
There was no evidence to suggest that the players had colluded to lose the match.
cn: 这两家公司被发现在定价上串通，这是非法的。
他绝不会与任何人勾结来欺诈体制。
没有证据表明球员们串通故意输掉比赛。

definitions.definition: 共谋，勾结（秘密合作以达成非法或欺骗性目的）

en: The companies were accused of collusion to fix prices.
Political collusion undermines public trust in democracy.
The investigation revealed collusion between officials and smugglers.
cn: 这些公司被指控合谋操纵价格。
政治勾结会削弱公众对民主的信任。
调查揭露了官员与走私者之间的勾结。

en: Use a colon to introduce a list.
The surgeon removed part of his colon.
Greek physicians studied the function of the colon.
cn: 用冒号引出列表。
外科医生切除了他的一部分结肠。
古希腊医师研究过结肠的功能。

definitions.definition: 在（某地）建立殖民地；殖民化

en: The British began to colonize Australia in the late 18th century.
Certain bacteria can colonize the human gut within hours.
The novel critiques how powerful nations colonize both land and culture.
cn: 英国于18世纪末开始殖民澳大利亚。
某些细菌能在数小时内定植于人类肠道。
这部小说批判了强国如何殖民土地与文化。

en: The project required a colossal amount of resources.
The dinosaur skeleton was a colossal sight in the museum.
She made a colossal mistake by ignoring the warnings.
cn: 这项工程需要耗费巨大的资源。
恐龙骨架在博物馆中呈现震撼的景象。
她因忽视警告而犯下大错。

definitions.definition: 巨型雕像；庞然大物；巨人

en: The ancient Colossus of Rhodes was a statue of the Greek sun god Helios.
The new skyscraper is a colossus that dominates the city skyline.
He was a colossus in the field of theoretical physics.
cn: 罗德岛的古太阳神巨像是希腊太阳神赫利俄斯的雕像。
这座新的摩天大楼是一个庞然大物，主宰着城市的天际线。
他是理论物理学领域的一位巨人。

definitions.definition: （非正式）新手，缺乏经验的年轻人

en: The farmer trained the colt to carry a rider.
As a colt in the industry, he made several rookie mistakes.
Her painting style still has the energy of a colt—wild but promising.
cn: 农夫训练小马驹驮骑手。
作为行业新手，他犯了些初级错误。
她的画风仍带着稚气——狂野但充满潜力。

en: Gasoline is highly combustible and must be handled with care.
The comedian's combustible temper was well-known among his colleagues.
Wood and coal are common combustibles.
cn: 汽油高度易燃，必须小心处理。
这位喜剧演员易怒的脾气在他的同事中是出了名的。
木材和煤是常见的可燃物。

definitions.definition: 指挥官；司令官；（尤指军事院校的）校长

en: The commandant issued orders to fortify the base.
He was appointed as the new commandant of the military academy.
All personnel must report to the commandant immediately.
cn: 指挥官下令加固基地。
他被任命为这所军事学院的新校长。
所有人员必须立即向司令官报到。

en: The punishment should be commensurate with the crime.
Her salary is commensurate with her experience.
The project’s budget is not commensurate to its scale.
cn: 惩罚应与罪行相称。
她的薪水与资历相匹配。
该项目的预算与其规模不成比例。

definitions.definition: （信息、思想）可传达的，可交流的

en: Measles is a highly communicable disease.
The news was not communicable in a simple sentence.
He has the skill to make complex ideas communicable to a general audience.
cn: 麻疹是一种高度传染的疾病。
这个消息无法用一句简单的话来表达。
他拥有将复杂思想传达给普通听众的技巧。

definitions.definition: 共享；交流（思想或情感的深层联结）

en: The team felt a deep communion after overcoming the challenge together.
cn: 团队在共同克服挑战后感受到深刻的凝聚力。

definitions.definition: 官方公报；正式声明（通常由政府或组织发布）

en: The government issued a communique detailing the peace agreement.
The embassy's communique was broadcast on national television.
The communique emphasized the need for international cooperation.
cn: 政府发布了一份公报，详述和平协议内容。
大使馆的正式声明在国家电视台播出。
公报强调了国际合作的必要性。

definitions.definition: （观点、方法等）相容的，不矛盾的

en: The software is compatible with both Windows and Mac.
Their personalities are highly compatible.
The theory must be compatible with experimental data.
cn: 该软件兼容Windows和Mac系统。
他们的性格非常合得来。
理论必须与实验数据相符。

en: During the Olympics, athletes feel a strong bond with their compatriots.
The writer found inspiration in the stories of her compatriots abroad.
Though from rival companies, they recognized each other as compatriots in the tech industry.
cn: 奥运会期间，运动员们与同胞们紧密相连。
这位作家从海外同胞的故事中汲取灵感。
尽管来自竞争公司，他们仍视彼此为科技行业的同路人。

en: The two theories are complementary rather than contradictory.
Blue and orange are complementary colors on the color wheel.
The angles are complementary, adding up to 90 degrees.
cn: 这两种理论是互补而非对立的。
蓝色和橙色在色轮上是互补色。
这些角互为余角，总和为90度。

en: Her fair complexion burned easily in the sun.
The political complexion of the country has shifted dramatically.
A healthy diet can improve your complexion.
cn: 她白皙的皮肤在阳光下很容易晒伤。
该国的政治格局已发生巨变。
健康饮食能改善肤色。

en: The sculpture is made of a composite material.
This alloy is a composite of three metals.
Her style is a composite of classical and modern influences.
cn: 这座雕塑由复合材料制成。
这种合金是三种金属的合成物。
她的风格融合了古典与现代元素。

en: She maintained her composure despite the shocking news.
His composure under pressure impressed the interviewers.
The speaker lost composure when the audience laughed unexpectedly.
cn: 尽管消息令人震惊，她仍保持镇定。
他在压力下的沉着给面试官留下深刻印象。
听众突然大笑时，演讲者失去了冷静。

definitions.definition: 强迫；冲动（难以抗拒的行为或心理压力）

en: She felt a sudden compulsion to tell the truth.
His cleaning rituals are driven by OCD compulsion.
The law operates through compulsion, not persuasion.
cn: 她突然有种难以抑制的冲动想说出真相。
他的清洁仪式是强迫症驱使的行为。
法律通过强制而非说服运作。

en: She felt no compunction about taking back what was rightfully hers.
The CEO showed no compunction while laying off hundreds of employees.
After yelling at his friend, he was filled with compunction and immediately apologized.
cn: 她对于拿回本就属于她的东西毫无愧疚。
这位首席执行官在裁掉数百名员工时没有表现出丝毫愧疚。
对朋友大吼大叫后，他内心充满了懊悔，并立即道了歉。

en: She was arrested for running a con on elderly investors.
He had to con the lyrics before the performance.
The debate listed pros and cons clearly.
cn: 她因诈骗老年投资者被捕。
他不得不在演出前死记硬背歌词。
辩论清晰地列出了正反论点。

definitions.definition: 让步，退让（尤指在争论或竞争中）

en: After hours of debate, he finally conceded the point.
The team conceded defeat when their star player was injured.
She conceded gracefully, allowing her opponent to take the lead.
cn: 经过数小时辩论，他终于承认了这一点。
球队在主力队员受伤后认输了。
她优雅地让步，让对手取得领先。

en: The tree rings form concentric circles around the core.
The castle had concentric walls for better defense.
Their goals were concentric, though their methods differed.
cn: 树木的年轮围绕核心形成同心圆。
城堡的同心围墙设计增强了防御能力。
他们的目标一致，尽管方法不同。

definitions.definition: 协奏曲（一种由独奏乐器与管弦乐队协同演奏的古典音乐形式）

en: Mozart's Piano Concerto No. 21 is renowned for its lyrical second movement.
The violinist performed a Baroque concerto with exquisite phrasing.
This concerto highlights the dialogue between soloist and orchestra.
cn: 莫扎特第21号钢琴协奏曲以其如歌的第二乐章闻名。
小提琴家以精妙的乐句处理演绎了一首巴洛克协奏曲。
这首协奏曲凸显了独奏者与乐队的对话性。

definitions.definition: 安抚；劝慰；赢得（好感或支持）

en: The government tried to conciliate the protesters by offering reforms.
Her calm manner helped to conciliate the angry customer.
He made efforts to conciliate between the two opposing parties.
cn: 政府通过提出改革方案试图安抚抗议者。
她冷静的态度帮助平息了愤怒的顾客。
他努力调解对立双方之间的分歧。

en: The two nations signed a treaty of concord and cooperation.
The couple lived in concord for over fifty years.
The concord among team members was crucial for the project's success.
cn: 两国签署了和睦与合作条约。
这对夫妇和谐地生活了五十多年。
团队成员间的和谐对于项目的成功至关重要。

en: The jury members concurred on the verdict.
Heavy rain and strong winds concurred during the storm.
Historians rarely concur about the causes of the war.
cn: 陪审团成员对裁决达成一致。
暴雨和狂风在风暴中同时发生。
历史学家很少对战争原因持相同看法。

definitions.definition: 屈尊；俯就；带着优越感对待他人

en: He would not condescend to acknowledge his former friends.
The manager condescended to have lunch with the interns.
Her tone was condescending, as if she were explaining something to a child.
cn: 他不会屈尊去承认他以前的朋友。
经理屈尊与实习生们共进了午餐。
她的语气带着居高临下的优越感，仿佛在向一个孩子解释事情。

en: Always use a condom to prevent sexually transmitted infections.
The clinic provides free condoms to promote safe sex.
Condoms are essential for both contraception and protection.
cn: 使用安全套以预防性传播感染。
该诊所提供免费避孕套以倡导安全性行为。
安全套对避孕和防护都至关重要。

definitions.definition: 甜食，糖果；精工制作的物品（尤指服装或艺术品）

en: The bakery specializes in French confections like macarons and éclairs.
Her wedding dress was a confection of lace and silk.
Medieval apothecaries prepared medical confections from herbs and honey.
cn: 这家面包店专做法式甜点，如马卡龙和闪电泡芙。
她的婚纱是一件蕾丝与丝绸的精工之作。
中世纪的药剂师用草药和蜂蜜调配药剂。

definitions.definition: 联盟；邦联；同盟（尤指国家或州之间的政治联盟）
共谋；结党营私（用于贬义）

en: The Southern Confederacy was formed in 1861 by states that seceded from the United States.
The tribes formed a confederacy to resist the invaders.
They were accused of a confederacy to manipulate the election results.
cn: 南部邦联于1861年由脱离美国的州组成。
这些部落组成了一个联盟来抵抗入侵者。
他们被指控共谋操纵选举结果。

en: Several tribes formed a confederate alliance to resist the invasion.
cn: 几个部落组成了一个同盟来抵抗入侵。

en: The university will confer an honorary degree upon the scientist.
The team needs to confer before making a final decision.
She conferred with her lawyer about the contract details.
cn: 大学将授予这位科学家荣誉学位。
团队需商讨后再作最终决定。
她就合同细节与律师交换了意见。

definitions.definition: （婚礼、庆典中抛撒的）五彩纸屑

en: The bride and groom were showered with confetti as they left the church.
The children eagerly gathered the colorful confetti from the parade route.
For the party decorations, we cut up old magazines to make homemade confetti.
cn: 新娘和新郎离开教堂时，身上洒满了五彩纸屑。
孩子们急切地从游行路线上收集起五彩缤纷的纸屑。
为了布置派对，我们把旧杂志剪碎，自制了五彩纸屑。

definitions.definition: 密友，知己（尤指可倾诉秘密的人）

en: She has been my confidant since childhood.
The CEO’s confidant often handles sensitive negotiations.
A true confidant never betrays your trust.
cn: 她是我从小到大的知己。
这位CEO的心腹常处理敏感谈判。
真正的密友永不背叛你的信任。

definitions.definition: 信任（常与 in 连用）

en: She confided her fears to her best friend.
He confides in his journal when feeling overwhelmed.
The spy confided the documents to a trusted courier.
cn: 她向挚友吐露了自己的恐惧。
感到压力时，他信任地向日记倾诉。
间谍将机密文件托付给可信的信使。

definitions.definition: 配置（系统或设备的排列方式）
结构（事物的整体布局或形态）

en: The software allows users to customize the system configuration.
The configuration of stars in this constellation resembles a lion.
Changing the network configuration requires administrator access.
cn: 该软件允许用户自定义系统配置。
这个星座的星群结构形似狮子。
更改网络配置需管理员权限。

en: The prisoner endured years of solitary confinement.
During her confinement, she read books to pass the time.
The pandemic led to the confinement of millions in their homes.
cn: 这名囚犯忍受了多年的单独监禁。
她在待产期间通过读书消磨时间。
疫情导致数百万人被限制在家中。

definitions.definition: 合并，混合（信息、观点或文本）

en: The report conflates data from several different studies, making it difficult to discern individual findings.
It's a common error to conflate correlation with causation.
The editor decided to conflate the two chapters into one for a more streamlined narrative.
cn: 这份报告合并了多项不同研究的数据，使人难以辨别各自的研究结果。
将相关性混同为因果关系是一个常见的错误。
编辑决定将两个章节合并为一个，使叙述更流畅。

definitions.definition: 意气相投的；性格相似的
宜人的；适合的（指环境或氛围）

en: She found the small town's atmosphere congenial to her creative work.
They were congenial colleagues who often shared ideas over coffee.
The garden's congenial layout made it perfect for outdoor gatherings.
cn: 她发现小镇的氛围很适合她的创作。
他们是志趣相投的同事，常边喝咖啡边交流想法。
花园宜人的布局使其成为户外聚会的理想场所。

definitions.definition: 与生俱来的（常指负面特质）

en: The baby was born with a congenital heart defect.
His congenital optimism helped him overcome difficulties.
Some congenital traits can be influenced by environmental factors.
cn: 这个婴儿患有先天性心脏缺陷。
他与生俱来的乐观帮助他克服了困难。
某些先天特征可能受环境影响。

definitions.definition: 拥挤的；堵塞的（尤指交通或身体器官）

en: The streets were heavily congested during rush hour.
Her nose became congested due to allergies.
The airport is often congested with tourists in summer.
cn: 高峰时段街道严重拥堵。
她的鼻子因过敏而充血堵塞。
夏季机场常因游客拥挤不堪。

en: The boreal forest is primarily composed of coniferous trees like spruce and pine.
Coniferous forests are an important habitat for many species of wildlife.
The wood from coniferous trees is often used in construction and paper manufacturing.
cn: 北方森林主要由云杉和松树等针叶树组成。
针叶林是许多野生动植物的重要栖息地。
针叶树的木材常用于建筑和造纸。

definitions.definition: 推测，猜想（基于不完整信息的推断）
推测，猜测（提出未经证实的观点）

en: His theory about the ancient ruins was pure conjecture.
Scientists can only conjecture about the origins of the universe.
She conjectured that the letter was written in code.
cn: 他对古遗址的理论纯属猜测。
科学家们只能推测宇宙的起源。
她推测这封信是用密码写的。

en: The magician conjured a dove from his empty hat.
The smell of cinnamon conjured memories of her grandmother's kitchen.
Shakespeare's words conjure vivid images in the reader's mind.
cn: 魔术师从空帽子里变出一只鸽子。
肉桂的气味唤起了她对祖母厨房的回忆。
莎士比亚的文字在读者脑海中唤起生动的画面。

definitions.definition: 鉴赏家（尤指艺术、美食等领域的专家）
行家（对某领域有深刻理解的人）

en: She is a connoisseur of fine wines, able to identify rare vintages by taste.
The museum hired him as a connoisseur to authenticate the Renaissance paintings.
True connoisseurs appreciate both the technique and emotion behind a masterpiece.
cn: 她是葡萄酒鉴赏家，能通过品尝辨别稀有年份。
博物馆聘请他作为鉴定专家，验证文艺复兴画作的真伪。
真正的行家既欣赏杰作的技巧，也理解其背后的情感。

definitions.definition: 隐含意义（词语或事物引发的联想或情感色彩）
语言学中的附加意义（区别于字面意义）

en: The word "home" carries connotations of warmth and safety.
Politicians often use words with positive connotations.
The connotation of "snake" varies across cultures.
cn: “家”一词隐含着温暖与安全的联想。
政客常使用具有积极隐含意义的词汇。
“蛇”的隐含意义因文化而异。

definitions.definition: 隐含，暗示（除字面意义外的联想或情感）
逻辑学中表示“内涵意义”

en: The word "home" often connotes warmth and safety.
In semantics, denotation and connotation are equally important.
His tone connotes disapproval, though he says nothing.
cn: “家”一词常隐含温暖与安全的意味。
在语义学中，外延与内涵同样重要。
他的语气暗示着不满，尽管他什么都没说。

en: During the war, the government conscripted young men into the army.
He was a conscript who had no choice but to serve.
The conscript system was abolished in many countries after peacetime.
cn: 战争期间，政府征召年轻男性入伍。
他是一名被迫服役的应征士兵。
和平时期后，许多国家废除了征兵制。

definitions.definition: 使神圣化；奉献给神；祝圣

en: The archbishop will consecrate the new cathedral next week.
They consecrated their lives to helping the poor.
The treaty consecrated the border between the two nations as inviolable.
cn: 大主教将于下周为新主教座堂举行祝圣仪式。
他们毕生致力于帮助穷人。
这条约使两国边界成为不可侵犯的。

en: The committee reached a consensus after hours of debate.
Scientific consensus on climate change is overwhelming.
There was no consensus among the participants.
cn: 委员会经过数小时辩论后达成共识。
关于气候变化的科学共识具有压倒性。
参与者之间未能达成一致意见。

definitions.definition: 打发，遣送（至某地或某种状态）

en: The documents were consigned to the archives for safekeeping.
The unsold goods were consigned to a discount warehouse.
She felt consigned to a life of monotony after the move.
cn: 文件被移交至档案馆保管。
未售出的货物被发往折扣仓库处理。
搬家后，她觉得自己注定要过单调的生活。

en: The shop sells furniture on consignment.
The latest consignment of goods has just arrived at the dock.
He was responsible for the consignment of the valuable artifacts to the museum.
cn: 这家商店以寄售方式销售家具。
最新的一批托付货物刚刚抵达码头。
他负责将这些珍贵的文物委托给博物馆。

definitions.definition: 控制台，操纵台（如电子设备或仪器的操作面板）

en: She tried to console her friend after the loss.
The game console connects seamlessly to the TV.
The priest’s words consoled the grieving family.
cn: 她在朋友遭遇损失后尽力安慰对方。
这款游戏机可无缝连接电视。
神父的话语抚慰了悲伤的家人。

definitions.definition: 财团；联合企业（为共同目标临时组成的团体）
协会；联盟（尤指学术或商业领域的合作组织）

en: Five universities formed a consortium to share research resources.
The banking consortium agreed to finance the infrastructure project.
This international consortium promotes sustainable energy development.
cn: 五所大学组成联盟以共享研究资源。
银行财团同意为基建项目提供资金。
该国际协会致力于推动可持续能源发展。

definitions.definition: 密谋，阴谋（秘密策划非法或有害的行为）
共谋（多人共同参与的秘密计划）

en: The politicians were accused of a conspiracy to overthrow the government.
The conspiracy theory about moon landing has been widely debunked.
Their conspiracy to monopolize the market was uncovered by investigators.
cn: 这些政客被指控密谋推翻政府。
关于登月的阴谋论已被广泛证伪。
他们垄断市场的共谋被调查人员揭露。

en: The rebels conspired to overthrow the government.
His enemies conspired against him behind closed doors.
Events conspired to ruin our carefully laid plans.
cn: 叛乱者密谋推翻政府。
他的敌人在背地里联手陷害他。
诸多事件阴差阳错地毁掉了我们精心制定的计划。

en: Her constancy in supporting the team through difficult times was admirable.
The constancy of the northern star made it a vital navigation tool for sailors.
He valued constancy in relationships more than fleeting passion.
cn: 她在困难时期始终支持团队，这种坚定不移令人钦佩。
北极星的恒定不变使其成为水手重要的导航工具。
他看重感情中的忠贞，而非短暂的激情。

en: The chemical constituents of the solution were analyzed in the lab.
As a constituent of this district, I demand better public services.
Hydrogen and oxygen are constituent elements of water.
cn: 溶液的化学成分在实验室中被分析。
作为本选区的选民，我要求更好的公共服务。
氢和氧是水的组成元素。

definitions.definition: 强迫，限制（通过规则或外力）

en: The tight deadlines constrained their creativity.
She felt constrained by social expectations.
The law constrains companies from polluting.
cn: 紧迫的截止日期限制了他们的创造力。
她感到被社会期望束缚。
法律强制企业不得污染环境。

en: The design must comply with budget constraints.
She felt a constraint in his presence.
Legal constraints prevent further expansion.
cn: 设计必须符合预算限制。
她在他在场时感到拘束。
法律约束阻碍了进一步扩张。

definitions.definition: 完成（婚姻、协议等）；使圆满

en: She is a consummate professional in her field.
The treaty was consummated after months of negotiation.
His performance displayed consummate skill and grace.
cn: 她是该领域技艺精湛的专业人士。
经过数月谈判，条约最终达成。
他的表演展现出无与伦比的技巧与优雅。

en: She sat quietly to contemplate the meaning of life.
He stood on the hill, contemplating the distant mountains.
Before making a decision, take time to contemplate all options.
cn: 她静坐沉思生命的意义。
他站在山丘上，凝视着远方的群山。
做决定前，花时间权衡所有选项。

en: Athletes contend for gold medals in the Olympics.
The lawyer contended that the evidence was insufficient.
They must contend with strong winds during the climb.
cn: 运动员在奥运会上争夺金牌。
律师主张证据不足。
他们攀登时必须应对强风。

definitions.definition: 应急计划； contingency plan（固定搭配）

en: We must prepare for all possible contingencies during the expedition.
The contract includes a contingency clause in case of delays.
Her quick thinking turned a potential disaster into a manageable contingency.
cn: 探险期间，我们必须为所有可能的意外情况做好准备。
合同中包含针对延误的应急条款。
她的敏捷思维将潜在的灾难转化为可控的意外事件。

en: Our travel plans are contingent on weather conditions.
A contingent of soldiers was sent to the border.
Success is contingent upon hard work and opportunity.
cn: 我们的旅行计划取决于天气状况。
一支分遣队被派往边境。
成功离不开努力和机遇。

definitions.definition: 连续体；连续统（数学、物理中指无限可分或紧密连接的整体）

en: The spectrum of light forms a continuum from red to violet.
In calculus, we treat time as a smooth continuum.
Cultural changes exist on a continuum rather than as discrete stages.
cn: 光的频谱形成了从红色到紫色的连续体。
在微积分中，我们将时间视为平滑的连续统。
文化变迁存在于一个连续统上，而非离散的阶段中。

en: His face contorted in pain as he lifted the heavy box.
The metal frame contorted under extreme heat.
She contorted the truth to fit her narrative.
cn: 他抬起重箱时，脸因疼痛而扭曲。
金属框架在高温下变形。
她歪曲事实以迎合自己的说法。

definitions.definition: 勾勒轮廓；沿等高线修筑

en: The artist carefully traced the contour of the model's face.
The map shows contour lines at 10-meter intervals.
They contoured the road to follow the natural slope of the hill.
cn: 艺术家仔细勾勒了模特面部的轮廓。
地图上标注了间隔10米的等高线。
他们沿山体的自然坡度修筑了这条盘山路。

en: She decided to use contraceptives to avoid unintended pregnancy.
The clinic provides free contraceptive advice to teenagers.
Some religions oppose contraceptive methods on ethical grounds.
cn: 她决定使用避孕药以避免意外怀孕。
这家诊所向青少年提供免费的避孕建议。
一些宗教基于伦理理由反对避孕措施。

definitions.definition: 设计；发明（尤指巧妙或非常规的方式）

en: She contrived a clever excuse to leave early.
The prisoners contrived an escape plan using hidden tools.
His smile seemed contrived, not genuine.
cn: 她巧妙编了个提早离开的借口。
囚犯们用藏匿的工具策划了一场越狱。
他的笑容显得刻意而不自然。

en: The committee will convene next Monday to discuss the budget.
The president has the authority to convene an emergency session.
Birds convened on the lakeshore as winter approached.
cn: 委员会将于下周一召开会议讨论预算。
总统有权召集紧急会议。
冬季临近时，鸟儿们聚集到湖岸边。

en: The railway lines converge at the central station.
Their opinions gradually converged after the debate.
The lens converges light rays to a focal point.
cn: 铁路轨道在中央车站交汇。
辩论后他们的观点逐渐趋同。
透镜将光线汇聚到焦点。

en: She is conversant with modern European literature.
The team needs members who are conversant in multiple programming languages.
To be conversant in the local customs, he spent months living in the community.
cn: 她精通现代欧洲文学。
团队需要熟悉多种编程语言的成员。
为了熟悉当地风俗，他在社区里生活了数月。

en: The sofa is convertible into a bed.
He drove a red convertible along the coast.
These bonds are convertible to company shares.
cn: 这张沙发可变为床。
他开着红色敞篷车沿海岸行驶。
这些债券可转换为公司股票。

en: The supply trucks traveled under military convoy.
Warships were sent to convoy the merchant vessels.
The humanitarian aid arrived with a UN convoy.
cn: 补给卡车在军队护送下行驶。
军舰被派去为商船护航。
人道主义援助物资随联合国车队抵达。

en: The patient's body began to convulse violently during the seizure.
The entire region was convulsed by a massive earthquake.
His hilarious story convulsed the entire audience with laughter.
cn: 在癫痫发作期间，病人的身体开始剧烈抽搐。
整个地区被一场大地震剧烈震动。
他滑稽的故事让全场观众笑得前仰后合。

definitions.definition: 将（家禽）关入笼中；限制自由

en: The chickens were kept in a wooden coop.
She felt cooped up in her tiny apartment.
The farmer built a new coop for the ducks.
cn: 鸡被关在一个木制笼子里。
她觉得自己被困在狭小的公寓里。
农夫为鸭子建了一个新笼子。

en: The musician played a lively solo on the cornet.
She enjoyed an ice cream served in a crispy cornet.
The cornet was responsible for carrying the troop's standard in the ceremony.
cn: 音乐家用短号演奏了一段欢快的独奏。
她享用了一份盛在酥脆蛋卷里的冰淇淋。
这位掌旗官在仪式中负责携带部队的军旗。

en: The rise in unemployment is a corollary of the economic recession.
In geometry, the corollary followed directly from the theorem.
His conclusion was a corollary of the initial hypothesis.
cn: 失业率上升是经济衰退的必然结果。
在几何学中，这条系定理直接由原定理推导而出。
他的结论是初始假设的自然推论。

definitions.definition: 加冕典礼（君主正式戴上王冠的仪式）

en: The coronation of the new king was attended by leaders from around the world.
Medieval coronations often included religious rituals.
The crown used in the coronation is over 300 years old.
cn: 新任国王的加冕典礼吸引了各国领导人出席。
中世纪的加冕典礼常包含宗教仪式。
加冕典礼使用的王冠已有300多年历史。

definitions.definition: 验尸官（负责调查死因的官员）

en: The coroner concluded that the death was accidental.
A coroner's report is often crucial in criminal investigations.
The family awaited the coroner's verdict anxiously.
cn: 验尸官判定死亡为意外事故。
验尸官的报告在刑事调查中至关重要。
家属焦急等待验尸官的结论。

en: He served in the Marine Corps for ten years.
The press corps waited outside the conference hall.
The diplomatic corps attended the state banquet.
cn: 他在海军陆战队服役了十年。
记者团在会议厅外等候。
外交使团出席了国宴。

en: His once athletic frame had become increasingly corpulent in his later years.
The corpulent man struggled to fit into the narrow seat.
The doctor advised the corpulent patient to adopt a healthier diet and exercise regimen.
cn: 他曾经运动员般的体格在晚年变得日益肥胖。
那位肥胖的男子艰难地挤进狭窄的座位。
医生建议那位肥胖的病人采取更健康的饮食和锻炼计划。

definitions.definition: （书面或文字的）全集，文集；身体，躯体（专业术语）

en: The linguist analyzed a corpus of medieval manuscripts.
The human corpus contains trillions of cells.
This dictionary is based on a large digital corpus.
cn: 语言学家分析了一部中世纪手稿文集。
人体由数万亿细胞组成。
这部词典基于一个大型数字语料库。

en: The study found that diet and exercise correlate strongly with longevity.
It's difficult to correlate these two sets of data without more context.
Happiness doesn't always correlate with wealth.
cn: 研究发现饮食和运动与长寿高度相关。
缺乏更多背景信息时，这两组数据难以建立关联。
幸福未必与财富相关。

en: The new evidence corroborated the witness's testimony.
Multiple studies corroborate the theory of climate change.
Her alibi was corroborated by security footage.
cn: 新证据证实了证人的证词。
多项研究强化了气候变化理论的可信度。
监控录像证实了她的不在场证明。

en: Acid rain can corrode metal structures over time.
The old pipes had corroded, causing water leaks.
Jealousy can corrode even the strongest relationships.
cn: 酸雨会逐渐腐蚀金属结构。
老化的管道被腐蚀，导致漏水。
嫉妒会侵蚀最牢固的关系。

definitions.definition: 腐蚀；侵蚀（化学或自然作用导致的物质逐渐破坏）

en: The iron gate showed signs of corrosion after years of exposure to rain.
Corruption is the corrosion of moral values in society.
Saltwater accelerates the corrosion of metal surfaces.
cn: 铁门因多年雨淋已出现腐蚀痕迹。
腐败是社会道德观念的侵蚀。
盐水会加速金属表面的腐蚀。

definitions.definition: 使起皱（corrugate 的过去分词形式）

en: The roof was made of corrugated iron sheets.
Her brow corrugated in concentration.
Corrugated cardboard provides better cushioning.
cn: 屋顶由波纹铁皮制成。
她眉头紧锁，全神贯注。
瓦楞纸板能提供更好的缓冲。

en: His calm countenance hid the turmoil within.
The school will not countenance cheating on exams.
She gave a nod of countenance to the proposal.
cn: 他平静的面容掩盖了内心的动荡。
学校不会容忍考试作弊行为。
她对提案点头表示支持。

en: The drug helps to counteract the effects of the poison.
