Planting more trees can counteract carbon emissions.
His kindness counteracted her initial distrust.
cn: 这种药物有助于抵消毒素的影响。
种植更多树木可以对抗碳排放。
他的善意化解了她最初的不信任。

en: The weight acts as a counterbalance to the door’s movement.
Her calm demeanor counterbalanced his impulsive decisions.
The committee serves as a counterbalance to executive power.
cn: 这个重物起到了抵消门运动的作用。
她冷静的举止平衡了他冲动的决定。
该委员会是行政权力的制衡力量。

en: The museum discovered the painting was a counterfeit.
He was arrested for counterfeiting money.
Her counterfeit smile hid the sadness inside.
cn: 博物馆发现这幅画是赝品。
他因伪造货币被捕。
她强颜欢笑，掩饰内心的悲伤。

definitions.definition: 成功的行动或策略（比喻义）

en: The military staged a coup and overthrew the government.
Her promotion was a real coup for the team.
The marketing campaign was a coup, doubling sales in a month.
cn: 军方发动政变，推翻了政府。
她的晋升是团队的一次重大成功。
这次营销活动大获成功，一个月内销售额翻倍。

en: The courier delivered the package before noon.
She works as a bicycle courier in the city center.
Documents were couriered to the client overnight.
cn: 快递员在中午前送达了包裹。
她在市中心担任自行车快递员。
文件通过快递连夜送交客户。

en: Their courtship lasted three years before they married.
The bird’s courtship dance attracts potential mates.
In Victorian era, courtship rituals were highly formalized.
cn: 他们的恋爱持续了三年才结婚。
这种鸟通过求偶舞蹈吸引配偶。
维多利亚时代的求爱仪式非常正式。

en: The two nations signed a covenant to promote peace.
They covenanted to share the profits equally.
The ancient covenant was carved on stone tablets.
cn: 两国签署了促进和平的盟约。
他们立约承诺平分利润。
这份古老的契约刻在石板上。

definitions.definition: 覆盖范围（如媒体、保险、信号等）

en: The news channel provides global coverage of major events.
Check your insurance policy for coverage details before traveling.
The WiFi coverage in this building is excellent.
cn: 该新闻频道对重大事件进行全球报道。
出行前请核对保险条款的保障范围。
这栋楼的无线网络覆盖非常好。

en: The spy carried out covert operations in enemy territory.
Rabbits often hide in thick undergrowth as a natural covert.
Her covert glances revealed unspoken interest.
cn: 这名间谍在敌占区执行秘密任务。
兔子常藏身于茂密灌木丛作为天然掩体。
她隐蔽的目光流露出未言明的兴趣。

definitions.definition: 渴望（尤指他人之物）；贪求

en: She secretly coveted her neighbor's antique vase.
The commandment warns against coveting others' possessions.
His eyes covet the trophy with undisguised longing.
cn: 她暗自垂涎邻居的古董花瓶。
十诫告诫人们勿贪他人财物。
他盯着奖杯，眼中流露出不加掩饰的渴望。

definitions.definition: 怯懦，胆小（缺乏勇气的行为或特质）

en: His cowardice in battle shocked his comrades.
She accused him of moral cowardice for avoiding the debate.
Cowardice often stems from fear of the unknown.
cn: 他在战斗中的怯懦令战友震惊。
她指责他逃避辩论是道德上的懦弱。
怯懦常源于对未知的恐惧。

definitions.definition: 腼腆的，害羞的（尤指故作矜持）
含糊其辞的，不愿透露的

en: She gave him a coy smile before turning away.
The politician remained coy about his future plans.
The cat was coy, hiding behind the curtains but peeking out occasionally.
cn: 她向他腼腆一笑，随即转身离去。
这位政客对自己未来的计划讳莫如深。
那只猫很害羞，躲在窗帘后却不时偷看。

en: The fire crackled softly in the hearth.
The glaze on the pottery created a beautiful crackle effect.
Dry leaves crackled under our feet as we walked through the forest.
cn: 炉火在壁炉中轻柔地噼啪作响。
陶器上的釉形成了美丽的裂纹效果。
我们穿过森林时，干枯的树叶在脚下发出清脆的碎裂声。

definitions.definition: 塞满；填塞；临时死记硬背

en: She tried to cram all her clothes into the suitcase.
Students often cram the night before exams.
The bus was crammed with tourists.
cn: 她试图把所有衣服塞进手提箱。
学生们常在考试前夜临时抱佛脚。
公交车上挤满了游客。

en: She got a cramp in her leg while swimming.
Tight shoes can cramp your feet.
The strict rules cramp our creativity.
cn: 游泳时她腿部抽筋了。
过紧的鞋子会挤压双脚。
严格的规则限制了我们的创造力。

en: The old man became cranky when his routine was disrupted.
My laptop is acting cranky again—it keeps freezing.
She’s always cranky before her morning coffee.
cn: 这位老人日常被打乱时就会变得暴躁。
我的笔记本电脑又出问题了，一直卡顿。
她早上不喝咖啡就会脾气很差。

en: Don't listen to him; he's talking crap.
I need to clean up this crap before the guests arrive.
The movie was so bad, it was pure crap.
cn: 别听他的，他在胡说八道。
我得在客人来之前把这些垃圾清理掉。
那部电影烂透了，完全是垃圾。

en: The astronauts explored a massive crater on the moon.
The volcano's crater emitted steam and ash.
Ancient Greeks used a crater to mix wine with water.
cn: 宇航员们探索了月球上一个巨大的陨石坑。
火山口喷发出蒸汽和火山灰。
古希腊人用混合酒器将葡萄酒与水调和。

definitions.definition: 恳求，请求（古义或正式用法）

en: She craved adventure after years of routine.
The prisoner craved a chance to prove his innocence.
Chocolate cravings are common during stress.
cn: 她在多年循规蹈矩后渴望冒险。
囚犯恳求一个证明清白的机会。
压力期间对巧克力的渴望很常见。

en: His craven refusal to join the protest shocked his friends.
The soldier was branded a craven for deserting his post.
She delivered a powerful speech, shaming the craven politicians into action.
cn: 他怯懦地拒绝参加抗议，这让他的朋友们感到震惊。
那名士兵因擅离职守而被视为懦夫。
她发表了一篇强有力的演说，让那些怯懦的政客们感到羞愧并采取了行动。

definitions.definition: 吱嘎声（物体摩擦或弯曲时发出的尖锐声音）

en: The old wooden floorboards creaked under his weight.
She heard the door creak open in the middle of the night.
The rusty hinges creaked with every movement.
cn: 陈旧的木地板在他的重量下吱嘎作响。
深夜，她听到门吱呀一声开了。
生锈的铰链每次转动都发出刺耳的声音。

en: The paper had a sharp crease where it was folded.
Be careful not to crease the pages of the book.
Her forehead creased with worry.
cn: 纸张折叠处有一道明显的折痕。
小心别把书页弄皱。
她因担忧而眉头紧锁。

en: The study lacks credibility due to its small sample size.
Her credibility as a journalist was unquestioned.
Transparency is key to maintaining credibility in business.
cn: 这项研究因样本量小而缺乏可信度。
她作为记者的可信性无可置疑。
透明度是保持商业可信性的关键。

en: The family chose to cremate their loved one according to his wishes.
In some cultures, it is traditional to cremate the deceased on a funeral pyre.
Modern crematories use high temperatures to cremate remains efficiently and safely.
cn: 这家人依照逝者遗愿选择了火化。
某些文化中，传统上会用柴堆火化逝者。
现代火葬场通过高温高效安全地火化遗体。

en: The crematorium was located on the outskirts of the town.
After the funeral service, the procession proceeded to the crematorium.
Modern crematoria are designed to be both efficient and respectful.
cn: 火葬场位于城镇的郊区。
葬礼仪式结束后，送葬队伍前往了火葬场。
现代火葬场的设计既高效又庄重。

definitions.definition: 克里奥尔人（殖民时期生于拉丁美洲的欧洲后裔）；克里奥尔语（混合语言）
克里奥尔人的；混合文化的

en: The Creole cuisine of Louisiana blends French, African, and Native American flavors.
She speaks Haitian Creole fluently.
Creole languages often emerge in multilingual colonial societies.
cn: 路易斯安那的克里奥尔菜融合了法国、非洲和原住民风味。
她能流利地说海地克里奥尔语。
克里奥尔语通常产生于多语言的殖民社会。

en: The crescent moon shone brightly over the desert.
She wore a necklace with a tiny golden crescent.
The company reported crescent profits for the third quarter.
cn: 新月在沙漠上空明亮地闪耀。
她戴着一串带有小金月牙的项链。
该公司报告第三季度利润逐步增长。

definitions.definition: （因尴尬、恐惧或不适）畏缩，退缩

en: She cringed when her mom showed her baby photos to friends.
His insincere apology made everyone cringe.
The movie’s forced humor is pure cringe.
cn: 她妈妈向朋友展示她婴儿时期的照片时，她尴尬得缩成一团。
他虚伪的道歉让所有人感到不适。
这部电影生硬的幽默纯粹是尬演。

definitions.definition: （使）起皱，卷曲；发出轻微的沙沙声

en: The old letter crinkled as she unfolded it.
Autumn leaves crinkle underfoot in the forest.
His eyes crinkled with laughter.
cn: 她展开旧信时，纸张发出沙沙的脆响。
森林中，秋叶在脚下窸窣作响。
他笑眯了眼，眼角泛起皱纹。

en: She wrote a sharp critique of the novel's historical inaccuracies.
The professor will critique our research proposals next week.
His film critiques often blend humor with incisive analysis.
cn: 她写了一篇尖锐的评论，指出小说中的历史错误。
教授将于下周对我们的研究计划进行批判性评价。
他的影评常将幽默与犀利分析融为一体。

definitions.definition: （青蛙或乌鸦）发出低沉沙哑的叫声；<俚语>死亡

en: The frogs began to croak as the sun set.
"Help me," he croaked, his throat parched.
The old pirate finally croaked after a long illness.
cn: 青蛙在日落时分开始呱呱叫。
“救救我，”他沙哑地说道，喉咙干涩。
老海盗久病后终于咽了气。

en: After dinner, I spent an hour washing the piles of crockery.
cn: 晚餐后，我花了一个小时清洗成堆的餐具。

en: The shepherd used a wooden crook to guide the sheep.
Be careful—that salesman is a real crook.
She crooked her finger to beckon him closer.
cn: 牧羊人用木钩引导羊群。
小心，那个推销员是个十足的骗子。
她弯了弯手指，示意他靠近。

en: The old man walked with a crooked stick.
She gave him a crooked smile, hiding her true intentions.
The investigation revealed a crooked business deal.
cn: 老人拄着一根弯曲的拐杖走路。
她冲他狡黠一笑，掩饰真实意图。
调查揭露了一桩欺诈交易。

definitions.definition: 弩，一种由托柄、弓和扳机组成的武器，通过机械装置发射箭矢

en: The medieval crossbow was a powerful weapon that could pierce knight's armor.
He aimed the crossbow carefully at the target before pulling the trigger.
The invention of the crossbow changed the dynamics of warfare in Europe.
cn: 中世纪弩是一种威力强大的武器，可以穿透骑士的盔甲。
他仔细地用弩瞄准目标，然后扣动了扳机。
弩的发明改变了欧洲战争的动态。

en: The defense attorney will cross-examine the witness tomorrow.
Under cross-examination, her story began to fall apart.
He was rigorously cross-examined about his whereabouts that night.
cn: 辩护律师将于明日盘问证人。
在反诘问下，她的说辞开始漏洞百出。
他被严格盘问了关于那晚行踪的细节。

definitions.definition: 人体或物体的分叉处（如双腿之间、树枝分叉处）

en: He slipped and hit his crotch on the edge of the table.
The bird built its nest in the crotch of a tree.
Her pants had a tear near the crotch.
cn: 他滑倒，胯部撞到了桌角。
鸟儿在树杈上筑巢。
她的裤子在裤裆附近撕破了。

definitions.definition: 钉死在十字架上；严厉惩罚；公开羞辱

en: The dictator ordered to crucify rebels as a warning.
Her mistakes were crucified by the media.
The team was crucified for their poor performance.
cn: 独裁者下令将反抗者钉十字架以儆效尤。
她的错误被媒体大肆抨击。
球队因糟糕表现遭到严厉批评。

definitions.definition: 嘎吱作响地咀嚼；压碎（硬物）
嘎吱声；关键时刻；财政紧缩

en: She crunched on an apple during the meeting.
The budget crunch forced the company to lay off staff.
We heard the crunch of gravel as the car pulled up.
cn: 她在会议期间嘎吱嘎吱地啃苹果。
预算紧缩迫使公司裁员。
汽车停下时，我们听到砾石嘎吱作响。

en: The crux of the problem lies in communication breakdown.
The mountain's crux is a steep rock face.
Her argument hit the crux of the debate.
cn: 问题的关键在于沟通失败。
这座山最险处是一面陡峭的岩壁。
她的论点直击辩论的核心。

definitions.definition: 地窖；地下室（尤指教堂下方的墓穴或藏骨堂）
（解剖学）隐窝（指组织中的小腔或腺体导管）

en: The ancient church had a crypt beneath the altar where saints were buried.
Tonsillar crypts are natural pockets in the throat that can trap bacteria.
Explorers found a hidden crypt filled with medieval artifacts.
cn: 这座古老的教堂祭坛下方有一处地窖，埋葬着圣徒遗骨。
扁桃体隐窝是喉咙中的天然凹陷，可能滞留细菌。
探险者发现了一处藏有中世纪文物的隐秘地窖。

definitions.definition: （生物学）伪装的（如动物保护色）

en: The message was written in cryptic symbols.
The butterfly's cryptic coloring helps it avoid predators.
His cryptic smile made me wonder what he really meant.
cn: 这条信息用隐晦的符号写成。
蝴蝶的保护色帮助它躲避天敌。
他神秘的笑容让我琢磨不透其真实意图。

definitions.definition: 幼兽（尤指熊、狮、狐等食肉动物的幼崽）

en: The lioness guarded her cubs fiercely.
He's just a cub reporter learning the ropes.
Fox cubs play near the den to develop hunting skills.
cn: 母狮凶狠地守护着她的幼崽。
他只是个初出茅庐的实习记者。
小狐狸在洞穴附近玩耍以培养狩猎能力。

en: The cuckoo is known for laying its eggs in the nests of other birds.
He was considered a bit of a cuckoo for believing in such unrealistic plans.
The sound of a cuckoo is often associated with the arrival of spring.
cn: 杜鹃鸟以在其他鸟类的巢中产卵而闻名。
他因相信如此不切实际的计划而被认为有点傻。
布谷鸟的叫声常常与春天的到来联系在一起。

en: The mother cuddled her baby to keep him warm.
They cuddled under the blanket while watching TV.
A good cuddle can relieve stress.
cn: 母亲搂着婴儿为他保暖。
他们裹着毯子依偎在一起看电视。
一个温暖的拥抱能缓解压力。

definitions.definition: 短而重的棍棒；用作武器的粗棒

en: The guard stood at the gate, armed with a heavy cudgel.
In the past, it was not uncommon to see people cudgel each other in street fights.
He had to cudgel his brains to remember where he had left the keys.
cn: 守卫站在门口，手持一根沉重的棍棒。
在过去，街头斗殴中人们互相用棍棒殴打并不少见。
他不得不绞尽脑汁（字面：敲打大脑）回想自己把钥匙丢在了哪里。

en: The year-long project will culminate in a public exhibition.
His career culminated with a Nobel Prize.
The festival culminates with a fireworks display.
cn: 这个为期一年的项目将以一场公开展览告终。
他的职业生涯以获得诺贝尔奖达到巅峰。
节日以烟花表演作为压轴。

en: The police finally identified the culprit behind the robbery.
Poor maintenance was the culprit of the machine's failure.
In the debate, she pointed to social inequality as the real culprit.
cn: 警方最终确定了抢劫案的罪犯。
维护不善是机器故障的根源。
辩论中，她指出社会不平等才是真正的症结所在。

definitions.definition: 2. 狂热崇拜；风靡一时的文化现象

en: The ancient tribe practiced a nature-worshipping cult.
cn: 这个古老部落信奉一种自然崇拜的异教。

definitions.definition: 笨重的，难以携带或操作的

en: The cumbersome package was difficult to carry up the stairs.
The legal process is often cumbersome and time-consuming.
She struggled with the cumbersome dress during the ceremony.
cn: 这个笨重的包裹很难搬上楼。
法律程序通常冗长低效且耗时。
仪式上，她穿着那件碍事的礼服行动不便。

definitions.definition: 累积的，渐增的（指通过连续添加而逐渐增加）

en: The cumulative effect of small daily improvements can lead to significant success over time.
Her cumulative knowledge in the field made her an expert.
The report analyzed the cumulative impact of pollution on the ecosystem.
cn: 每日微小进步的累积效应，终将带来巨大的成功。
她在该领域积累的知识使她成为专家。
报告分析了污染对生态系统的累积影响。

definitions.definition: （博物馆、美术馆等的）馆长；策展人

en: The museum curator carefully restored the ancient artifacts.
She was appointed curator of the contemporary art exhibition.
The court assigned a financial curator for the minor’s inheritance.
cn: 博物馆馆长精心修复了古代文物。
她被任命为当代艺术展览的策展人。
法院为未成年人的遗产指定了一位财务监护人。

definitions.definition: 凝乳（牛奶凝固后的软块，常用于制作奶酪）

en: She stirred the milk gently to separate the curd from the whey.
Lemon juice can be used to curd milk for homemade cheese.
The texture of this dessert resembles soft curd.
cn: 她轻轻搅拌牛奶，将凝乳与乳清分离。
柠檬汁可用于使牛奶凝结，以制作家庭奶酪。
这款甜点的质地类似柔软的凝乳。

definitions.definition: 宵禁（规定时间内禁止外出的法令）

en: The government imposed a curfew to control the riots.
In medieval towns, the curfew bell rang at sunset.
Teenagers protested against the strict curfew rules.
cn: 政府实施宵禁以控制骚乱。
中世纪城镇的宵禁钟声在日落时响起。
青少年抗议严格的宵禁规定。

en: She wrote a note in her elegant cursive handwriting.
Many students find it difficult to read classical cursive scripts.
The decline in teaching cursive writing in schools has been a topic of debate.
cn: 她用优雅的连笔字写了一张便条。
许多学生觉得阅读古典草书手稿很困难。
学校中草书教学的减少一直是一个争论的话题。

definitions.definition: 粗略的，仓促的（指快速完成且缺乏细节）

en: He gave the report a cursory glance before signing it.
A cursory inspection failed to reveal the hidden damage.
Her cursory knowledge of the topic was obvious during the discussion.
cn: 他草草扫了一眼报告就签了名。
粗略的检查未能发现隐藏的损坏。
讨论中明显看出她对话题只有浅显的了解。

definitions.definition: 简短生硬的（言语或行为）

en: His curt reply made it clear he wasn't interested.
The manager's curt nod dismissed the employees.
Avoid curt messages in professional emails.
cn: 他简短的回复明确表示他不感兴趣。
经理草率地点了点头打发走了员工。
在职业邮件中避免使用生硬的简短措辞。

en: The government decided to curtail public spending to reduce the deficit.
His speech was curtailed due to time constraints.
The new law curtails the freedom of the press.
cn: 政府决定削减公共开支以减少赤字。
由于时间限制，他的演讲被缩短了。
新法律限制了新闻自由。

definitions.definition: 蛋奶冻（一种由牛奶、鸡蛋和糖制成的甜点）

en: The chef topped the pie with vanilla custard.
Traditional custard thickens naturally with eggs.
She prefers her custard chilled with caramel sauce.
cn: 厨师在派上浇了一层香草蛋奶冻。
传统蛋奶冻靠鸡蛋自然增稠。
她喜欢冷藏的蛋奶冻配焦糖酱。

definitions.definition: 聪明的，机灵的（古义，现较少用）

en: The puppy has such a cute face.
She wore a cute dress to the party.
cn: 这只小狗的脸太可爱了。
她穿了一条可爱的裙子去参加派对。

definitions.definition: 刀具；餐具（尤指刀、叉、匙等）

en: The fine cutlery set was a wedding gift from their grandparents.
Please ensure the cutlery is properly polished before setting the table.
The restaurant is known for its exquisite cuisine rather than its cutlery.
cn: 这套精美的餐具是他们的祖父母送的结婚礼物。
请在摆放餐桌前确保餐具都擦亮了。
这家餐厅以其精美的菜肴而非其餐具闻名。

definitions.definition: 网络空间（指由计算机系统、互联网和数字通信构成的虚拟环境）

en: Many people spend hours daily navigating cyberspace for work and entertainment.
Cybersecurity is crucial to protect sensitive data in cyberspace.
The novel explores a dystopian future where cyberspace dominates human interaction.
cn: 许多人每天花数小时在网络空间中工作与娱乐。
网络安全对保护网络空间中的敏感数据至关重要。
这部小说探讨了一个反乌托邦未来，其中网络空间主导了人类互动。

en: The economy experiences cyclic periods of boom and bust.
Cyclic compounds are fundamental structures in organic chemistry.
Her sleep disorder disrupts the body's natural cyclic rhythms.
cn: 经济会经历繁荣与萧条的周期性循环。
环状化合物是有机化学中的基本结构。
她的睡眠障碍打乱了身体自然的周期节律。

definitions.definition: 愤世嫉俗者；认为人性皆自私的人
犬儒学派的（与古希腊哲学流派相关）

en: His cynical laughter revealed his distrust of human motives.
The ancient Cynics lived in barrels to reject materialism.
Don't be such a cynic—not everyone acts out of self-interest.
cn: 他讽刺的笑声暴露了对人类动机的不信任。
古代犬儒学者住在木桶里以摒弃物质主义。
别这么愤世嫉俗，并非所有人都出于私心行事。

definitions.definition: 愤世嫉俗，怀疑人性善良的倾向

en: His constant cynicism made it hard to discuss any hopeful ideas.
Ancient Cynicism advocated living in virtue rather than wealth.
Modern cynicism often stems from disillusionment with authority.
cn: 他持续的愤世嫉俗态度让人难以讨论任何有希望的想法。
古代犬儒主义倡导以德行而非财富为生活准则。
现代愤世嫉俗常源于对权威的幻灭感。

definitions.definition: 少量；轻拍；擅长某事的人（俚语）

en: She dabbed the wound gently with antiseptic.
Add just a dab of butter to the pan.
He's a dab hand at fixing computers.
cn: 她用消毒剂轻轻擦拭伤口。
往锅里加一小块黄油。
他是修电脑的好手。

en: The daffodils bloomed early this year, painting the fields yellow.
She carried a bouquet of daffodils, symbolizing new beginnings.
Wordsworth's poem "I Wandered Lonely as a Cloud" immortalized the daffodil.
cn: 今年的水仙花开得早，将田野染成一片金黄。
她手捧一束水仙花，象征新的开始。
华兹华斯的《水仙》诗让这种花名留青史。

en: That was a daft thing to do.
He must be daft to believe that.
She laughed at his daft jokes.
cn: 那样做很蠢。
他相信那事，一定是疯了。
她被他那些傻乎乎的笑话逗笑了。

en: She wore a dainty silver bracelet on her wrist.
The tea set was decorated with dainty floral patterns.
He offered her a plate of dainty sandwiches.
cn: 她手腕上戴着一只精致的银手链。
这套茶具饰有精美的花卉图案。
他递给她一盘可口的三明治。

definitions.definition: 高台，讲台（尤指供重要人物就座或演讲的抬升平台）

en: The speaker stood on the dais to address the crowd.
A floral arrangement decorated the edge of the wedding dais.
Medieval halls often featured a dais for the lord's table.
cn: 演讲者站在高台上向人群发表讲话。
花艺装饰点缀了婚礼高台的边缘。
中世纪大厅常设有供领主餐桌使用的高台。

en: She picked a daisy and tucked it behind her ear.
The field was dotted with white daisies.
That new restaurant is a real daisy!
cn: 她摘了一朵雏菊，别在耳后。
田野里点缀着白色的雏菊。
那家新餐厅真是太棒了！

definitions.definition: 使潮湿；减弱（声音、情绪等）

en: The rain dampened our clothes quickly.
Bad news can dampen one's spirits.
Use a cloth to dampen the dust before sweeping.
cn: 雨水很快打湿了我们的衣服。
坏消息会让人情绪低落。
扫地前用湿布压一压灰尘。

definitions.definition: 减震器；消音器（机械装置）
抑制因素；令人扫兴的事物

en: The mechanic installed a new damper to reduce the engine's vibration.
His criticism acted as a damper on the team's enthusiasm.
Adjust the damper to control the airflow in the fireplace.
cn: 机械师安装了新的减震器以减少发动机振动。
他的批评给团队的热情泼了冷水。
调节风门以控制壁炉的气流。

definitions.definition: 少女，姑娘（尤指需要被保护或浪漫语境中的年轻未婚女子）

en: The knight rescued the damsel from the tower.
She felt like a damsel in distress waiting for help.
The story features a brave damsel who saves the kingdom.
cn: 骑士从塔中救出了少女。
她感觉自己像个等待救援的落难少女。
故事塑造了一位拯救王国的勇敢少女。

en: The meadow was dotted with yellow dandelions.
She blew on the dandelion puff, scattering its seeds.
Dandelion roots can be used to make herbal tea.
cn: 草地上点缀着黄色的蒲公英。
她对着蒲公英的绒球吹气，散播它的种子。
蒲公英的根可用来制作草本茶。

definitions.definition: 过分讲究衣着的人；花花公子

en: He was known as a dandy, always dressed in the latest fashions.
That's a dandy little car you've got there!
The dandy strutted down the street, drawing everyone's attention.
cn: 他以花花公子闻名，总是穿着最时髦的服装。
你那辆小车可真棒！
那个讲究衣着的人大摇大摆地走在街上，吸引了所有人的目光。

en: The keys dangled from a hook by the door.
He dangled the toy in front of the kitten to get its attention.
The promise of promotion was dangled before the employees.
cn: 钥匙挂在门边的钩子上轻轻摇晃。
他在小猫面前摇晃玩具以吸引它的注意。
升职的承诺被用来吊员工的胃口。

definitions.definition: 阴冷潮湿的（常形容地下室、洞穴等）
（俚语）极好的，酷的（尤指大麻或相关文化）

en: The dungeon walls were covered in dank moss.
This weed is so dank, it smells like a pine forest.
His meme collection is legit dank.
cn: 地牢的墙壁长满了阴湿的苔藓。
这大麻太赞了，闻起来像松树林。
他的表情包收藏真是绝了。

definitions.definition: 整洁时髦的（尤指男性衣着或外表）
矫健敏捷的（古义，现较少用）

en: The dapper gentleman wore a tailored suit and polished shoes.
cn: 这位时髦的绅士穿着定制西装和锃亮的皮鞋。

en: The dappled sunlight filtered through the leaves of the ancient oak.
She rode a dappled grey horse through the meadow.
The artist captured the dappled effect of light on water in her painting.
cn: 斑驳的阳光透过古橡树的叶子洒落下来。
她骑着一匹有斑点的灰马穿过草地。
艺术家在她的画作中捕捉了光线在水面上形成的斑驳效果。

en: The daredevil motorcyclist jumped over twenty buses.
His daredevil stunt amazed the audience but also worried the safety team.
She has a reputation as a daredevil investor who takes huge risks.
cn: 那位鲁莽的摩托车手飞越了二十辆巴士。
他胆大妄为的特技表演震惊了观众，但也让安全团队担忧。
她是一位以敢于冒巨大风险而闻名的鲁莽投资者。

definitions.definition: /adv. （非正式）该死的（委婉表达，替代 damn）

en: She learned to darn socks to save money.
"Darn it! I forgot my keys again."
His darn stubbornness made the negotiation fail.
cn: 她学会了织补袜子以节省开支。
“该死！我又忘带钥匙了。”
他该死的固执让谈判失败了。

en: Her fashion style feels dated in today's trend.
The document was dated January 1st, 2020.
His jokes are painfully dated.
cn: 她的穿搭风格在当今潮流中显得过时。
这份文件标注的日期是2020年1月1日。
他的笑话老套得令人尴尬。

en: The steep climb daunted even the most experienced hikers.
She refused to be daunted by the critics' harsh comments.
cn: 陡峭的山坡连最老练的登山者也望而生畏。
她拒绝被评论家的尖锐批评吓倒。

en: The dauntless explorer ventured into the uncharted jungle.
Her dauntless spirit inspired everyone around her to persevere.
Despite the overwhelming odds, the soldiers remained dauntless.
cn: 这位无畏的探险家进入了那片未知的丛林。
她无畏的精神激励着她身边的每一个人坚持下去。
尽管胜算渺茫，士兵们依然无所畏惧。

en: Don't dawdle on your way to school, or you'll be late.
She dawdled the whole afternoon away, browsing shops without buying anything.
The manager warned him not to dawdle over his tasks.
cn: 上学路上不要磨蹭，否则你会迟到。
她闲逛了一整个下午，光看店却不买任何东西。
经理警告他不要在工作中拖拖拉拉。

definitions.definition: （某些新教教会的）低级圣职人员

en: The deacon assisted the priest during the Sunday mass.
She was ordained as a deacon in the Anglican Church last year.
In early Christianity, deacons often managed charitable works.
cn: 执事在周日弥撒中协助神父。
她去年被任命为英国国教会的执事。
在早期基督教中，执事常负责慈善事务。

definitions.definition: 使减弱；使麻木；使失去活力

en: The thick curtains helped to deaden the noise from the street.
The doctor used a local anesthetic to deaden the pain.
Over time, grief can deaden one’s emotional responses.
cn: 厚窗帘有效减弱了街上的噪音。
医生使用局部麻醉剂来麻痹痛感。
随着时间的推移，悲痛会使人情感麻木。

definitions.definition: 僵局（双方无法达成一致或行动的状态）
死锁（计算机术语：多进程因资源争夺而无法继续）

en: The negotiations reached a deadlock over budget issues.
A deadlock occurs when two programs hold resources needed by each other.
Breaking the deadlock required compromise from both sides.
cn: 谈判因预算问题陷入僵局。
当两个程序互相持有对方所需资源时，会发生死锁。
打破僵局需要双方妥协。

en: The product launch was a complete debacle, with protests from consumers.
The sudden debacle of the glacier caused flooding downstream.
His career ended in debacle after the financial scandal.
cn: 这次产品发布彻底失败，引发了消费者抗议。
冰川突然溃裂导致下游洪水泛滥。
他的职业生涯因财务丑闻而惨淡收场。

definitions.definition: 降低（质量、价值、品格）；使贬值

en: Adding too much water will debase the quality of the juice.
He would not debase himself by lying to the court.
The government was accused of debasing the currency by overprinting.
cn: 加入过多水会降低果汁的品质。
他不会通过向法庭撒谎来贬低自己的人格。
政府因过度印钞而被指责使货币贬值。

en: A prolonged fever can debilitate the body's immune system.
The economic crisis has debilitated many small businesses.
He was debilitated by the constant stress of his job.
cn: 长期发烧会削弱身体的免疫系统。
经济危机使许多小企业陷入困境。
他被工作的持续压力弄得身心俱疲。

definitions.definition: 记入借方；将…记入借方账户

en: The bank will debit your account immediately after the transaction.
Please record this amount as a debit to the expense account.
A debit balance indicates that more money was taken out than deposited.
cn: 交易完成后银行将立即从您的账户扣款。
请将此金额记入费用账户的借方。
借方余额表示取款金额大于存款金额。

definitions.definition: 碎片，残骸（尤指毁坏后的残余物）

en: The road was blocked by debris after the explosion.
Archaeologists sifted through the debris to find artifacts.
The comet left a trail of debris in its orbit.
cn: 爆炸后，道路被碎片堵住了。
考古学家在残骸中筛选文物。
彗星在轨道上留下了一条碎片带。

definitions.definition: 调试，排除故障；驱除害虫
调试过程；排除故障的程序

en: The developer spent all night trying to debug the new software.
Before you run the program, make sure to debug it thoroughly.
The term 'debug' originates from the process of removing actual insects from early computer hardware.
cn: 这名开发人员花了一整夜时间来调试新软件。
在运行程序之前，务必对其进行彻底调试。
“Debug”这个术语源于从早期计算机硬件中清除实际昆虫的过程。

en: The novel portrays a decadent aristocracy obsessed with luxury.
Some critics dismissed the art movement as merely decadent.
His decadent lifestyle eventually led to financial ruin.
cn: 这部小说描绘了一个沉迷奢华的堕落贵族阶层。
一些评论家将该艺术运动贬斥为纯粹的颓废。
他颓废的生活方式最终导致了经济崩溃。

en: The certificate confirms the decease of the property owner.
He deceased without leaving a will.
Upon his decease, the estate passed to his daughter.
cn: 该证书确认了房产所有者的死亡。
他去世时未留下遗嘱。
在他死后，遗产传给了他的女儿。

en: The car started to decelerate as it approached the sharp curve.
The government's policies are designed to decelerate the rate of inflation.
The economy is expected to decelerate in the second half of the year.
cn: 汽车在接近急弯时开始减速。
政府的政策旨在减缓通货膨胀率。
预计经济在今年下半年会放缓。

definitions.definition: 得体，正派（符合道德或社会规范的行为）
礼仪，体面（社会公认的恰当标准）

en: He acted with decency and apologized immediately.
Basic decency requires us to help those in need.
The film was banned for violating standards of public decency.
cn: 他举止得体，立即道了歉。
基本的礼仪要求我们帮助有需要的人。
这部电影因违反公共道德标准被禁。

definitions.definition: （古罗马）每十人杀一人；大规模毁灭或减少

en: The general decided to decimate the mutinous troops as a warning.
cn: 将军决定处决叛乱部队的十分之一以儆效尤。

definitions.definition: 破译（密码或复杂信息）；解读（难以理解的事物）

en: The archaeologist deciphered the ancient hieroglyphs using a newly discovered Rosetta Stone.
It took hours to decipher his messy handwriting.
Scientists are trying to decipher the genetic code of this rare species.
cn: 考古学家利用新发现的罗塞塔石碑破译了古代象形文字。
花了好几个小时才辨认出他潦草的字迹。
科学家正试图解读这一稀有物种的遗传密码。

definitions.definition: （轮船上的）甲板水手，普通水手

en: He started as a deckhand on a fishing boat before becoming a captain.
The deckhands were busy scrubbing the deck and tying ropes.
As a deckhand, her duties included loading cargo and assisting with navigation.
cn: 他在成为船长之前，是从一艘渔船上的甲板水手做起的。
水手们正忙着擦洗甲板和系绳索。
作为一名甲板水手，她的职责包括装卸货物和协助导航。

definitions.definition: 慷慨陈词；高声演说；抨击

en: The politician stood on the platform to declaim against the new policy.
She declaimed the poetry with great passion and dramatic flair.
Instead of engaging in dialogue, he simply declaimed his own opinions.
cn: 这位政治家站在讲台上，慷慨激昂地抨击新政策。
她以极大的热情和戏剧性的天赋朗诵了诗歌。
他没有进行对话，而是径直高声发表了自己的观点。

en: Leaves decompose faster in warm, humid climates.
The chemist decomposed water into hydrogen and oxygen.
Anxiety can decompose one's ability to focus.
cn: 树叶在温暖潮湿的气候中分解更快。
化学家将水分解为氢和氧。
焦虑会瓦解人的专注力。

en: The minimalist decor of the apartment creates a sense of calm.
The stage decor for the play included a realistic forest backdrop.
She specializes in vintage decor for boutique hotels.
cn: 公寓的极简装饰风格营造出宁静感。
该剧的舞台布景包含一片逼真的森林背景。
她专攻精品酒店的复古风格装饰。

definitions.definition: 端庄得体的；合乎礼节的

en: The audience maintained a decorous silence throughout the solemn ceremony.
Her decorous behavior at the diplomatic reception impressed all the guests.
It is important to remain decorous even in heated debates to show respect for opponents.
cn: 观众在整个庄严仪式中保持着得体的寂静。
她在外交招待会上端庄得体的举止给所有来宾留下了深刻印象。
即使在激烈的辩论中也要保持得体，以表达对对手的尊重。

definitions.definition: 礼仪，得体（指符合社会规范的行为或举止）

en: The diplomat maintained perfect decorum during the tense negotiations.
Wearing jeans to a formal wedding breaches social decorum.
His lack of decorum at the banquet shocked the guests.
cn: 这位外交官在紧张的谈判中始终保持得体举止。
在正式婚礼上穿牛仔裤有违社交礼仪。
他在宴会上的失礼行为让宾客震惊。

en: The hunters used a wooden duck as a decoy.
She felt decoyed into signing the contract.
The spy acted as a decoy to distract the guards.
cn: 猎人用木制鸭子作诱饵。
她觉得自己被诱骗签署了合同。
间谍充当诱饵分散警卫的注意力。

en: The editorial decried the government's lack of action.
Critics decry the film as overly sentimental.
She decried the decline of traditional values in her speech.
cn: 社论公开谴责政府的不作为。
评论家批评这部电影过于煽情。
她在演讲中痛斥传统价值观的衰落。

en: The cost of repairs is tax-deductible.
Her health insurance has a $500 deductible.
Only deductible expenses will be reimbursed.
cn: 维修费用可抵税。
她的医疗保险免赔额为500美元。
只有可扣除的费用才会被报销。

en: The court deemed the evidence insufficient.
She deemed it necessary to apologize.
His actions were deemed unacceptable by the committee.
cn: 法院认为证据不足。
她认为有必要道歉。
委员会认为他的行为不可接受。

en: Vandals defaced the historic monument with spray paint.
It is a criminal offense to deface currency.
The poster was defaced with offensive slogans.
cn: 破坏者用喷漆涂污了历史纪念碑。
损坏货币外观是一种犯罪行为。
海报被涂上了冒犯性的标语。

en: He was accused of trying to defame his opponent during the election.
Spreading false information online to defame someone can have serious legal consequences.
The article was a clear attempt to defame the character of an honest public servant.
cn: 他被指控在选举期间试图诽谤他的对手。
在网上散布虚假信息以诽谤他人可能会产生严重的法律后果。
这篇文章明显是在试图诋毁一位诚实公务员的人格。

definitions.definition: 服从，遵从（常与 to 连用）

en: The committee decided to defer the vote until next month.
As a junior member, I defer to your expertise on this matter.
The bank allows customers to defer loan payments during hardships.
cn: 委员会决定将投票推迟到下个月。
作为资历较浅的成员，此事我听从您的专业意见。
银行允许客户在困难时期延期偿还贷款。

en: The chemical spill defiled the pristine river, killing all aquatic life.
The troops marched through the narrow mountain defile in single file.
Vandalizing the ancient temple is considered an act that defiles sacred heritage.
cn: 化学泄漏玷污了 pristine 的河流，杀死了所有水生生物。
军队以单列队形行军穿过狭窄的山间隘路。
破坏古庙被视为亵渎神圣遗产的行为。

en: The study provides definitive evidence of climate change.
This dictionary is considered the definitive guide to modern English.
The judge's ruling was definitive and could not be appealed.
cn: 这项研究提供了气候变化的确凿证据。
该词典被视为现代英语的权威指南。
法官的裁决是终局性的，不可上诉。

definitions.definition: 放气；使泄气（物理或情绪上）

en: The balloon deflated slowly after the party.
Harsh criticism deflated his enthusiasm.
The government aims to deflate the housing bubble.
cn: 派对结束后，气球慢慢瘪了下去。
严厉的批评浇灭了他的热情。
政府计划抑制房地产泡沫。

en: The herbicide was used to defoliate the dense jungle during the war.
Some trees defoliate naturally in the autumn as a response to shorter days.
The invasive insect threatens to defoliate entire populations of ash trees.
cn: 在战争期间，这种除草剂被用来使茂密的丛林落叶。
一些树木在秋季会因日照变短而自然落叶。
这种入侵性昆虫威胁着整片整片的梣树林，使其落叶。

en: The intense heat can deform the metal components.
He was born with a foot that was slightly deformed.
The pressure deformed the container beyond recognition.
cn: 高温会使金属部件变形。
他出生时有一只脚有轻微畸形。
压力使得容器变形得面目全非。

definitions.definition: 通过欺骗手段剥夺（他人财物或权利）

en: He was accused of attempting to defraud the insurance company.
The scam artist defrauded elderly victims of their life savings.
Strict laws exist to prevent corporations from defrauding consumers.
cn: 他被指控试图诈骗保险公司。
诈骗犯骗走了老年受害者的毕生积蓄。
严格的法律旨在防止企业欺诈消费者。

en: Remember to defrost the freezer regularly to keep it running efficiently.
I forgot to defrost the chicken for dinner tonight.
The car's windshield slowly began to defrost as the heater warmed up.
cn: 记得定期给冰箱除霜，以保持其高效运行。
我忘了把今晚要吃的鸡肉拿出来解冻。
随着暖气升温，汽车的挡风玻璃开始慢慢解冻。

definitions.definition: 灵巧的，熟练的（尤指手部动作）
机敏的，巧妙的（解决问题或应对情况）

en: The chef's deft fingers shaped the dumplings in seconds.
She gave a deft reply that avoided the controversial topic.
His deft handling of the crisis impressed everyone.
cn: 厨师灵巧的手指几秒内就包好了饺子。
她机敏地回答，避开了争议性话题。
他对危机的巧妙处理让所有人印象深刻。

en: The defunct law was repealed in 2020.
The factory has been defunct since the economic crisis.
His defunct smartphone is now a museum exhibit.
cn: 这条已废止的法律于2020年被撤销。
这家工厂自经济危机后便停止运营。
他报废的智能手机如今成了博物馆展品。

definitions.definition: 拆除（炸弹等的）引信；缓和（紧张局势等）

en: The bomb squad successfully defused the explosive device.
Humor can help defuse tense situations in negotiations.
She managed to defuse the argument by changing the subject.
cn: 拆弹小组成功拆除了爆炸装置的引信。
幽默有助于缓和谈判中的紧张气氛。
她通过转移话题化解了争执。

en: The debate degenerated into a shouting match.
His health degenerated rapidly after the accident.
The film portrays a degenerate aristocrat in 18th-century France.
cn: 辩论演变成了争吵。
事故后他的健康状况迅速恶化。
这部电影描绘了18世纪法国一位堕落的贵族。

en: The officer was degraded for disobeying orders.
Plastic bags take centuries to degrade in nature.
His sarcastic comments degraded the value of her achievements.
cn: 这名军官因违抗命令被降级。
塑料袋在自然环境中需要数百年才能降解。
他的讽刺言论贬低了她成就的价值。

en: The sun can quickly dehydrate your skin if you don't use moisturizer.
Athletes must drink water regularly to avoid dehydrating during the marathon.
This machine dehydrates fruits to preserve them for longer periods.
cn: 阳光会迅速使皮肤脱水，如果不使用保湿霜的话。
运动员必须定期饮水，以免在马拉松比赛中脱水。
这台机器通过脱水保存水果，延长其保质期。

en: Some cultures deify natural phenomena like the sun or thunder.
The media often tends to deify celebrities, attributing to them qualities they may not possess.
He didn't want to be deified; he just wanted to be remembered as a man who tried his best.
cn: 某些文化会将如太阳或雷电等自然现象神化。
媒体常常倾向于神化名人，将一些他们可能并不具备的特质加诸其身。
他不想被神化，只希望被人们记住为一个尽力而为的人。

definitions.definition: 神性；神祇（泛指神灵或上帝）

en: The ancient Greeks worshipped multiple deities.
Compassion is often considered a mark of true deity.
Some cultures believe deities inhabit natural objects.
cn: 古希腊人崇拜多位神祇。
慈悲常被视为真正神性的标志。
某些文化认为神灵栖居于自然物体中。

en: She made a deliberate effort to avoid eye contact.
The jury deliberated for hours before reaching a verdict.
His slow speech was deliberate, not hesitant.
cn: 她刻意避免眼神接触。
陪审团商讨数小时后作出裁决。
他缓慢的语速是深思熟虑的，而非犹豫不决。

en: After much deliberation, she decided to accept the job offer.
The committee’s deliberation lasted for hours.
He spoke with slow deliberation, choosing his words carefully.
cn: 经过再三考虑，她决定接受这份工作。
委员会的审议持续了数小时。
他说话缓慢而谨慎，字斟句酌。

definitions.definition: 划定…的界限；确定…的范围

en: The treaty was used to delimit the maritime boundaries between the two countries.
Fences are built to delimit the private property from public land.
The researcher took care to delimit the scope of the study in the first chapter.
cn: 该条约被用来划定两国之间的海上边界。
修建围栏是为了划定私有土地与公共土地的界限。
研究人员在第一章仔细确定了研究的范围。

en: The map clearly delineates the borders of the national park.
Her report delineates the key steps to implement the policy.
The artist used charcoal to delineate the contours of the face.
cn: 这张地图清晰标出了国家公园的边界。
她的报告详细说明了实施该政策的关键步骤。
艺术家用木炭勾画出了面部的轮廓。

definitions.definition: 精神错乱的，极度兴奋的

en: The fever made him delirious, and he began speaking nonsense.
She was delirious with joy after winning the championship.
The patient became delirious due to severe dehydration.
cn: 高烧让他神志不清，开始胡言乱语。
赢得冠军后，她欣喜若狂。
患者因严重脱水出现谵妄症状。

definitions.definition: 解救；释放（尤指从困境或危险中）

en: The villagers prayed for deliverance from the drought.
His speech was a powerful deliverance of truth.
The treaty brought deliverance to the war-torn region.
cn: 村民们祈求从干旱中得救。
他的演讲是对真理的有力宣示。
条约给饱受战争蹂躏的地区带来了解脱。

definitions.definition: 欺骗，误导（使人相信虚假之事）

en: The scammer deluded investors with fake promises.
Don't delude yourself into thinking the problem will disappear.
His calm demeanor deluded us about the urgency of the situation.
cn: 骗子用虚假承诺欺骗投资者。
别自欺欺人地以为问题会自行消失。
他平静的举止让我们误以为情况并不紧急。

definitions.definition: 洪水；暴雨；大量涌现的事物

en: The village was destroyed by a sudden deluge.
She was deluged with emails after the announcement.
The deluge of information made it hard to focus.
cn: 村庄被突如其来的洪水摧毁。
公告发布后，她的邮箱被大量邮件淹没。
信息泛滥使人难以集中注意力。

en: She delved into ancient manuscripts to uncover the truth.
The archaeologist delved the soil carefully with a trowel.
His book delves deeply into the complexities of human psychology.
cn: 她深入研究古代手稿以揭露真相。
考古学家用小铲子仔细挖掘泥土。
他的书深入探讨了人类心理的复杂性。

definitions.definition: 煽动者（尤指利用民众情绪或偏见获取权力的政治领袖）

en: The politician was accused of being a demagogue who exploited fears to gain votes.
History shows how demagogues can undermine democratic institutions.
His speeches were full of emotional appeals, marking him as a modern demagogue.
cn: 这位政治家被指责为利用恐惧获取选票的煽动者。
历史表明，煽动者如何破坏民主制度。
他的演讲充满情绪化诉求，使他成为现代煽动者的典型。

definitions.definition: 煽动行为；蛊惑人心的宣传

en: His campaign was marked by demagogy rather than rational debate.
The leader’s demagogy exploited public fears during the crisis.
Historians criticized the regime’s reliance on demagogy to maintain power.
cn: 他的竞选活动以煽动而非理性辩论为特点。
领导人的蛊惑宣传利用了危机期间的公众恐惧。
历史学家批评该政权依赖煽动手段维持权力。

definitions.definition: 贬低（某人或某事的尊严或地位）
（古义）使行为举止符合某种标准

en: She refused to demean herself by responding to the insults.
His actions demeaned the integrity of the profession.
The article demeans the achievements of women in science.
cn: 她拒绝通过回应侮辱来贬低自己。
他的行为贬低了该职业的诚信。
这篇文章贬低了女性在科学领域的成就。

en: His calm demeanour under pressure impressed everyone.
She maintained a professional demeanour throughout the meeting.
The teacher’s stern demeanour discouraged interruptions.
cn: 他在压力下的冷静举止令众人印象深刻。
她在整个会议中保持着专业的风度。
老师严肃的态度让学生不敢插话。

en: The demented old man wandered the streets, talking to imaginary people.
His demented plan to build a flying car with cardboard shocked everyone.
The horror movie featured a demented villain who collected human shadows.
cn: 那位精神错乱的老人徘徊在街头，对着幻想中的人说话。
他用纸板造飞行汽车的疯狂计划让所有人震惊。
这部恐怖片的主角是一个收集人影的疯癫反派。

en: The software engineer gave a demo of the new app.
Thousands joined the climate change demo in the city center.
This song was originally recorded as a rough demo.
cn: 软件工程师演示了这款新应用。
数千人参加了市中心的气候变化示威游行。
这首歌最初录制为一个粗略的样本。

en: The government announced plans to demobilize 100,000 soldiers after the peace agreement was signed.
It took several months to fully demobilize the troops and reintegrate them into civilian life.
The company had to demobilize its remote workforce due to budget cuts.
cn: 政府在和平协议签署后宣布了让10万名士兵复员的计划。
完全遣散部队并让他们重新融入平民生活花费了数月时间。
由于预算削减，公司不得不解散其远程工作团队。

definitions.definition: 人口统计学（研究人口结构、分布和变化的学科）

en: Demography helps governments plan healthcare and education systems.
The demography of this region shows an aging population trend.
She specialized in demography to study migration patterns.
cn: 人口统计学帮助政府规划医疗和教育体系。
该地区的人口统计数据显示老龄化趋势。
她专攻人口统计学以研究迁移模式。

en: The villagers believed the cave was haunted by a demon.
His inner demon drove him to commit the crime.
She fought like a demon to protect her children.
cn: 村民们相信洞穴里栖息着恶魔。
他内心的恶魔驱使他犯罪。
她像恶魔般拼命保护自己的孩子。

en: The cult was accused of performing demonic rituals.
His laughter had a demonic edge that chilled everyone present.
The artist's paintings often explore themes of demonic possession.
cn: 该邪教被指控举行恶魔仪式。
他的笑声带着一丝恶魔般的尖锐，令在场所有人不寒而栗。
这位艺术家的画作常探讨恶魔附身的主题。

en: The link between smoking and lung cancer is now scientifically demonstrable.
There was a demonstrable increase in productivity after the new system was implemented.
He made a demonstrable error in his calculations that changed the entire outcome.
cn: 吸烟与肺癌之间的关联现在已有科学依据可以证明。
新系统实施后，生产力有了明显的提高。
他在计算中犯了一个显而易见的错误，改变了整个结果。

definitions.definition: 使士气低落；使意志消沉

en: The team's repeated losses began to demoralize even the most optimistic players.
Harsh criticism can demoralize young artists.
The dictator's propaganda aimed to demoralize opposition forces.
cn: 接连的失败开始让最乐观的队员也士气低落。
严厉的批评可能挫伤年轻艺术家的积极性。
独裁者的宣传旨在瓦解反对势力的斗志。

en: After the scandal, the manager was demoted to an entry-level position.
The army demoted the officer for disobeying orders.
Failure to meet targets may result in being demoted.
cn: 丑闻后，经理被降职为初级岗位。
军队因该军官违抗命令而将其降级。
未达成目标可能导致降职。

definitions.definition: 斜纹粗棉布（用于制作牛仔裤等）
牛仔裤（复数形式，口语用法）

en: She wore a denim jacket over her dress.
Denim is known for its durability and comfort.
His denims were faded from years of wear.
cn: 她在外套里穿了一件牛仔夹克。
牛仔布以其耐用和舒适著称。
他的牛仔裤因多年穿着已褪色。

definitions.definition: 居民（尤指非本土的长期居住者）
（特定环境的）常客或典型生物

en: The panda is a denizen of the bamboo forests.
As a denizen of New York for 20 years, she knew every corner of the city.
The café was a popular denizen for artists and writers.
cn: 熊猫是竹林中的常驻居民。
作为纽约二十年的老居民，她熟悉城市的每个角落。
这家咖啡馆曾是艺术家和作家的聚集地。

en: The central bank will denominate the new bond issue in euros.
cn: 中央银行将把这批新发行的债券以欧元计价。

en: The hailstorm left tiny dents on the car hood.
Criticism from her boss dented her enthusiasm.
He used a hammer to dent the metal sheet slightly.
cn: 冰雹在汽车引擎盖上留下细小的凹痕。
老板的批评削弱了她的热情。
他用锤子轻轻敲出金属板的凹痕。

en: Modern dentistry emphasizes preventive care.
She decided to pursue a career in dentistry.
Advances in dentistry have made procedures less painful.
cn: 现代牙科学注重预防性护理。
她决定从事牙科行业。
牙科技术的进步使治疗过程更无痛。

en: He applies deodorant every morning after showering.
This natural deodorant is free from aluminum and other harsh chemicals.
The strong fragrance of the deodorant effectively masks body odor.
cn: 他每天早晨洗完澡后都会用除臭剂。
这款天然除臭剂不含铝和其他刺激性化学物质。
这款除臭剂的浓烈香味能有效掩盖体味。

definitions.definition: 耗尽，使枯竭（资源、能量等）

en: Overfishing has depleted the ocean's tuna population.
The long drought depleted the region's water reserves.
The athlete felt depleted after the marathon.
cn: 过度捕捞已耗尽海洋中的金枪鱼资源。
长期干旱耗尽了该地区的水储备。
马拉松赛后，运动员感到精疲力竭。

en: The human rights group deplored the use of violence against civilians.
She deplored the lack of funding for public education.
Historians deplore the destruction of ancient artifacts in the war.
cn: 人权组织谴责针对平民的暴力行为。
她对公共教育资金匮乏深感痛心。
历史学家对战争中古文物的毁坏表示愤慨。

definitions.definition: 使人口减少；使（某地）人口剧减

en: The famine and subsequent diseases threatened to depopulate the entire region.
Policies that depopulate rural areas can have long-term economic consequences.
The goal was not to depopulate the city but to manage its growth more sustainably.
cn: 饥荒及随之而来的疾病威胁着整个地区，使其人口锐减。
使农村地区人口减少的政策可能会带来长期的经济后果。
目标并非减少城市人口，而是以更可持续的方式管理其增长。

definitions.definition: 罢免，废黜（尤指统治者或权威人士）

en: The rebels sought to depose the tyrannical king.
The witness will depose before the court tomorrow.
Historical records show how easily nobles could depose a weak ruler.
cn: 叛军试图废黜暴君。
证人将于明日出庭作证。
历史记载表明，贵族罢免弱势统治者易如反掌。

en: The bank serves as a depository for valuable documents and assets.
The old warehouse was used as a depository for historical archives.
Nuclear waste must be stored in a secure depository.
cn: 这家银行是贵重文件和资产的保管机构。
那个旧仓库曾被用作历史档案的存放处。
核废料必须储存在一个安全的储藏库中。

definitions.definition: 【计算机科学】声明弃用（指标记某软件功能为过时并计划在未来移除）

en: The committee deprecated the proposed changes due to their potential negative impact.
Many developers deprecate older functions in code to encourage the use of newer, more efficient methods.
She deprecated his attempts to trivialize the serious issue.
cn: 委员会不赞成所提议的变更，因其可能带来负面影响。
许多开发者会在代码中弃用旧函数，以鼓励使用更新、更高效的方法。
她抨击了他试图淡化这一严肃问题的行为。

en: The car will depreciate rapidly in the first year.
He felt that his boss was always depreciating his efforts.
The currency has depreciated by 10% against the dollar.
cn: 这辆车在第一年会迅速贬值。
他觉得老板总是在贬低他的努力。
该货币对美元已贬值10%。

en: A deputation of local residents came to the council meeting to protest the new development.
The manager appointed a deputation to negotiate with the suppliers.
He was part of a deputation sent to discuss the treaty terms.
cn: 当地居民代表团来到议会会议抗议新的开发项目。
经理委派了一个代表团与供应商谈判。
他是被派去讨论条约条款的代表团成员之一。

en: The train derailed due to a broken track.
Poor communication can derail a project.
His career was derailed by the scandal.
cn: 列车因铁轨断裂而脱轨。
沟通不畅可能导致项目偏离正轨。
他的职业生涯因丑闻而中断。

definitions.definition: 德比（英国城市名；源自该地的赛马活动）
竞赛（尤指同城或同地区对手间的激烈比赛）
圆顶礼帽（一种硬质男帽）

en: The Kentucky Derby is one of the most famous horse races in the world.
The Manchester derby between United and City always attracts huge crowds.
He tipped his derby hat politely as he passed by.
cn: 肯塔基德比是全球最著名的赛马赛事之一。
曼联与曼城之间的曼彻斯特德比总能吸引大量观众。
他经过时礼貌地轻触圆顶礼帽致意。

definitions.definition: 解除管制；撤销对…的法规限制

en: The government plans to deregulate the energy sector to encourage competition.
Many economists argue that deregulating airlines led to lower fares.
Critics warn that deregulating financial markets could increase risks.
cn: 政府计划解除能源行业管制以促进竞争。
许多经济学家认为，航空业解除管制后票价下降。
批评者警告，放松金融市场管制可能增加风险。

en: The audience began to deride the speaker after his obvious mistake.
It’s cruel to deride someone for their appearance.
His ideas were derided by the scientific community.
cn: 听众在演讲者犯下明显错误后开始嘲笑他。
因外貌嘲笑他人是残忍的。
他的观点遭到科学界的讥讽。

en: His proposal was met with derision from the audience.
She couldn't bear the derision in their eyes.
The politician became an object of derision after the scandal.
cn: 他的提议遭到了听众的嘲笑。
她无法忍受他们眼中的嘲弄。
丑闻后，这位政客成了笑柄。

definitions.definition: 贬低的，贬义的（表达轻蔑或批评）

en: His derogatory remarks about her work caused resentment.
Avoid using derogatory terms in formal discussions.
The article was criticized for its derogatory tone.
cn: 他对她工作的贬低言论引发了不满。
正式讨论中避免使用贬义词汇。
这篇文章因贬损的语气受到批评。

definitions.definition: 转臂起重机；钻塔；油井架

en: The towering derrick stood against the skyline, a symbol of the oil boom.
They used a derrick to lift the heavy engine out of the ship.
The old derrick creaked as it hoisted the load.
cn: 高耸的钻塔映衬在天际线上，是石油繁荣的象征。
他们用转臂起重机将沉重的发动机从船上吊起。
古老的起重机在吊起货物时发出吱吱声。

definitions.definition: 废除…的种族隔离；取消种族隔离

en: The federal government ordered the school district to desegregate its schools.
The city was one of the first in the country to desegregate its public facilities.
The policy aimed to desegregate the workforce and promote equality.
cn: 联邦政府命令该学区废除其学校的种族隔离。
该市是国内首批取消公共设施种族隔离的城市之一。
该政策旨在取消劳动力市场的种族隔离并促进平等。

en: The archaeologists desiccated the ancient seeds to prevent mold growth.
This machine can desiccate fruits within hours.
The climate here is so arid that it naturally desiccates organic matter.
cn: 考古学家将古代种子脱水以防止霉变。
这台机器能在几小时内将水果脱水。
此地气候极度干燥，能自然风干有机物。

en: He was desirous of obtaining a promotion.
She is desirous to learn more about the ancient culture.
They are desirous of peace and stability in the region.
cn: 他渴望获得晋升。
她渴望了解更多关于这种古代文化的知识。
他们渴望该地区的和平与稳定。

en: His despicable actions shocked the community.
Cheating in an exam is a despicable act.
The villain's despicable plot was finally exposed.
cn: 他的卑劣行径震惊了整个社区。
考试作弊是可鄙的行为。
反派的卑劣阴谋最终被揭露。

en: The invaders despoiled the village of all its treasures.
Mining companies must not despoil natural habitats for profit.
The museum was despoiled during the war, losing priceless artifacts.
cn: 侵略者掠夺了村庄的所有财宝。
矿业公司不应为利润破坏自然栖息地。
博物馆在战争期间遭洗劫，丢失了无价文物。

definitions.definition: 专制；专制政治；专制政府

en: The revolution aimed to overthrow the king's despotism.
Enlightenment philosophers wrote extensively against political despotism.
His rule gradually degenerated into a brutal despotism.
cn: 这场革命旨在推翻国王的专制统治。
启蒙运动哲学家们撰写了大量著作反对政治专制。
他的统治逐渐蜕变成残酷的暴政。

definitions.definition: 极度贫困的；缺乏基本生活资源的
（喻）完全缺乏某种特质或资源的

en: After the war, many families were left destitute.
The report highlights a system destitute of moral values.
He died destitute, though once a wealthy merchant.
cn: 战争过后，许多家庭一贫如洗。
报告揭露了一个毫无道德价值的体系。
他曾是富商，去世时却身无分文。

en: The device features a detachable battery for easy replacement.
She preferred a jacket with a detachable hood for versatility.
The keyboard is detachable, transforming the laptop into a tablet.
cn: 该设备配有可拆卸电池，便于更换。
她更喜欢带可拆卸风帽的夹克，以增加实用性。
键盘是可拆卸的，能将笔记本电脑变成平板电脑。

definitions.definition: 限定词（用于名词前，指定或限定其指示对象的词，如 a, the, this, some）
决定因素；决定性的人（或事物）

en: In the phrase "this book", the word "this" is a determiner.
Education is a major determiner of one's future success.
The choice of determiner can change the meaning of a noun phrase entirely.
cn: 在短语“this book”中，“this”这个词是一个限定词。
教育是一个人未来成功的一个主要决定因素。
限定词的选择可以完全改变一个名词短语的含义。

en: Nuclear weapons serve as a deterrent against large-scale wars.
The high cost is a major deterrent to potential buyers.
The alarm system has a strong deterrent effect on burglars.
cn: 核武器是对大规模战争的威慑。
高昂的成本是潜在买家的主要阻碍因素。
警报系统对窃贼有强烈的震慑作用。

en: She detests people who are cruel to animals.
He openly detests the new policy.
The smell of cigarette smoke makes me detest being in the same room.
cn: 她憎恶虐待动物的人。
他公开表示对新政策的厌恶。
香烟味让我极度厌恶待在同一个房间里。

en: The bomb failed to detonate due to a faulty trigger.
Scientists detonated the experimental device in a controlled environment.
His controversial remarks detonated a wave of protests online.
cn: 炸弹因触发器故障未能引爆。
科学家在受控环境中引爆了实验装置。
他的争议性言论引发了网络上的抗议浪潮。

en: The road construction forced us to take a detour.
She detoured through the park to avoid the crowd.
His answer was a detour from the main question.
cn: 道路施工迫使我们绕道而行。
她绕道穿过公园以避开人群。
他的回答避开了问题的核心。

definitions.definition: （常与 from 连用）转移注意力；分散

en: His constant complaints detract from the team's morale.
The minor error does not detract from the overall quality of the report.
Bright decorations can detract attention from the speaker.
cn: 他的频繁抱怨削弱了团队的士气。
这个小错误不影响报告的整体质量。
鲜艳的装饰可能分散听众对演讲者的注意力。

en: The hurricane devastated the coastal town, leaving thousands homeless.
She was devastated by the sudden loss of her mentor.
The economic crisis devastated small businesses across the country.
cn: 飓风摧毁了沿海小镇，导致数千人无家可归。
导师的突然离世让她悲痛欲绝。
经济危机重创了全国的小企业。

definitions.definition: 偏离常规者，行为异常者

en: His deviant behavior raised concerns among his peers.
The study focuses on social reactions to deviant individuals.
The artist’s deviant style challenged traditional norms.
cn: 他的异常行为引发了同龄人的担忧。
这项研究聚焦社会对行为异常者的反应。
这位艺术家离经叛道的风格挑战了传统规范。

en: The plane deviated from its original course due to bad weather.
She never deviates from her principles.
The study deviated slightly from traditional methods.
cn: 飞机因恶劣天气偏离了原定航线。
她从不违背自己的原则。
这项研究与传统方法略有不同。

en: The pilot corrected the plane's deviation from its flight path.
A slight deviation in temperature can affect the experiment results.
His behavior showed a clear deviation from social norms.
cn: 飞行员修正了飞机偏离航线的错误。
温度的微小偏差会影响实验结果。
他的行为明显偏离了社会规范。

en: The hiker took a devious route to avoid the steep cliffs.
His devious tactics in the negotiation shocked everyone.
The river flows in a devious course through the valley.
cn: 徒步者绕了一条迂回的路线以避开陡峭的悬崖。
他在谈判中使用的狡猾策略令所有人震惊。
河流蜿蜒流过山谷。

en: The desert is devoid of vegetation.
His speech was devoid of any real substance.
She felt devoid of emotion after the shock.
cn: 这片沙漠寸草不生。
他的演讲毫无实质内容。
震惊过后，她感到麻木无感。

definitions.definition: 使（责任、权力）转移至更低层级

en: The management decided to devolve more authority to regional teams.
If the CEO resigns, his duties will devolve to the deputy.
Ancient traditions often devolve into symbolic rituals over time.
cn: 管理层决定将更多权力下放给地区团队。
若CEO辞职，其职责将移交至副手。
古老的传统常随时间演变为象征性仪式。

definitions.definition: 虔诚的（宗教或信仰层面）

en: She is a devout Buddhist who meditates daily.
His devout commitment to environmental causes inspired many.
The monk spoke with devout sincerity about his faith.
cn: 她是一位每日冥想的虔诚佛教徒。
他对环保事业的热忱投入激励了众人。
僧人以虔诚的真诚谈论他的信仰。

en: The surgeon’s dexterity with the scalpel saved the patient’s life.
Her verbal dexterity made her an excellent debater.
Playing the piano requires both mental focus and finger dexterity.
cn: 外科医生持手术刀的灵巧手法挽救了患者的生命。
她的语言机敏使她成为出色的辩手。
弹钢琴需要精神集中和手指的灵活。

definitions.definition: 糖尿病（一种代谢性疾病，特征为高血糖）

en: Regular exercise can help manage type 2 diabetes.
The doctor explained how diabetes affects insulin production.
Early detection of diabetes is crucial for preventing complications.
cn: 定期锻炼有助于控制2型糖尿病。
医生解释了糖尿病如何影响胰岛素分泌。
糖尿病的早期发现对预防并发症至关重要。

en: The painter added diagonal lines to create a sense of movement.
Cut the fabric along the diagonal for a better fit.
The diagonal measurement of the TV screen is 55 inches.
cn: 画家添加了斜线以营造动感。
沿对角线裁剪布料会更合身。
这块电视屏幕的对角线长度为55英寸。

definitions.definition: 辩证法（哲学中通过对话与对立观点寻求真理的方法）

en: Hegel's dialectic explores the progression of ideas through contradiction.
The debate followed a dialectical structure, with opposing views gradually synthesizing.
Dialectic thinking helps resolve conflicts by finding common ground.
cn: 黑格尔的辩证法通过矛盾探讨思想的演进。
这场辩论遵循辩证结构，对立观点逐步综合。
辩证思维通过寻找共同点帮助解决冲突。

en: Their opinions are diametrically opposed on this issue.
The two theories are diametrically different in their approach.
His actions ran diametrically counter to his promises.
cn: 他们在这个问题上的意见截然相反。
这两种理论在方法上完全不同。
他的行动与他的承诺完全背道而驰。

en: The doctor advised drinking plenty of fluids to avoid dehydration caused by diarrhoea.
Travellers to certain regions should be cautious about food and water to prevent diarrhoea.
Severe diarrhoea can be a symptom of a more serious underlying condition.
cn: 医生建议饮用大量液体以避免腹泻引起的脱水。
前往某些地区的旅行者应注意饮食以防腹泻。
严重腹泻可能是某种更严重潜在疾病的症状。

definitions.definition: 骰子（单复数同形）；小方块（食物）
将（食物）切成小方块；用骰子决定

en: He rolled the dice and got a seven.
Dice the carrots into small cubes.
The outcome was decided by a throw of the dice.
cn: 他掷骰子得到了七点。
将胡萝卜切成小方块。
结果由掷骰子决定。

definitions.definition: 二分法；对立事物的严格区分

en: The dichotomy between theory and practice often complicates scientific progress.
Her essay explores the dichotomy of nature versus nurture in human development.
The political debate revealed a sharp dichotomy in public opinion.
cn: 理论与实践的对立常使科学进展复杂化。
她的论文探讨人类发展中先天与后天的二分法。
这场政治辩论暴露出舆论的尖锐对立。

en: The professor opened his lecture with a dictum from Aristotle.
The judge's dictum clarified the interpretation of the statute.
"Know thyself" is a famous dictum attributed to Socrates.
cn: 教授以亚里士多德的一句名言开始了讲座。
法官的附带意见阐明了法规的解释。
“认识你自己”是一句归功于苏格拉底的著名格言。

en: The novel's didactic tone made it feel like a textbook.
Her didactic approach to parenting often annoyed her children.
The museum's exhibit was informative without being didactic.
cn: 这部小说说教的语气让它读起来像教科书。
她好为人师的育儿方式常惹恼孩子。
博物馆的展览寓教于乐，毫不说教。

en: The street vendor tried to diddle tourists by selling fake souvenirs.
Stop diddling with your pen and focus on the meeting.
He felt he was diddled out of a fair price for his old car.
cn: 街头小贩试图通过出售假冒纪念品来欺骗游客。
别再摆弄你的笔了，专心开会。
他觉得自己的旧车没有卖到一个公道的价钱，被坑了。

definitions.definition: 顽固分子；死硬派（指拒绝改变或妥协的人）

en: He was a diehard fan of classical music, refusing to listen to anything modern.
The diehard conservatives opposed every reform proposal.
Despite the evidence, his diehard beliefs remained unchanged.
cn: 他是古典音乐的顽固粉丝，拒绝听任何现代音乐。
死硬派保守党人反对所有改革提案。
尽管证据确凿，他顽固的信念仍毫不动摇。

en: The hospital's chief dietician reviewed the patient's meal plan.
You should consult a registered dietician for personalized nutritional advice.
She worked as a dietician, helping people manage their health through food.
cn: 医院的主任营养师审核了病人的膳食计划。
你应该咨询注册营养师以获得个性化的营养建议。
她是一名营养师，通过食物帮助人们管理健康。

en: The microscope helps differentiate between bacterial and viral infections.
Cells begin to differentiate into specialized types during embryonic development.
Good teachers differentiate their teaching methods to suit diverse learners.
cn: 显微镜有助于区分细菌性和病毒性感染。
细胞在胚胎发育过程中开始分化为特定类型。
优秀的教师会调整教学方法以适应不同学习者。

en: His diffidence made it difficult for him to speak in public.
She overcame her natural diffidence and gave a brilliant presentation.
Behind his diffidence lies a sharp and insightful mind.
cn: 他的羞怯使他难以在公众面前发言。
她克服了天生的胆怯，做了一场精彩的演讲。
在他缺乏自信的外表下，隐藏着敏锐而富有洞察力的思维。

definitions.definition: 缺乏自信的，胆怯的，羞怯的

en: He was too diffident to speak up in the meeting.
Her diffident manner made her appear unapproachable.
Despite his diffident exterior, he was a deeply passionate artist.
cn: 他在会议上太缺乏自信，不敢发言。
她羞怯的举止让她显得难以接近。
尽管他外表缺乏自信，但他是一位充满热情的艺术家。

definitions.definition: 显要人物（尤指因职位或地位而受尊敬的人）

en: The conference was attended by dignitaries from over 50 countries.
As a local dignitary, he often mediated community disputes.
The mayor greeted the foreign dignitary with full honors.
cn: 这场会议有来自50多个国家的显要人物出席。
作为当地要人，他常调解社区纠纷。
市长以最高礼节迎接了这位外国贵宾。

en: The lecturer digressed into a lengthy anecdote about his childhood.
Let me digress for a moment to clarify this point.
His essay digresses from the main argument in the third paragraph.
cn: 演讲者离题讲了一段关于他童年的轶事。
请允许我暂时离题澄清这一点。
他的论文在第三段偏离了主要论点。

en: The dilapidated castle stood on the hill, its walls crumbling with age.
His dilapidated finances reflected years of poor management.
They refused to rent the dilapidated house due to safety concerns.
cn: 那座破败的城堡矗立在山丘上，墙壁因年久失修而坍塌。
他衰败的财务状况反映了多年的管理不善。
出于安全考虑，他们拒绝租用那栋破旧的房子。

en: The pupils of your eyes dilate in the dark.
She dilated on the importance of daily exercise.
The doctor used drops to dilate the blood vessels.
cn: 你的瞳孔在黑暗中会放大。
她详细阐述了每日锻炼的重要性。
医生用药滴扩张血管。

definitions.definition: 业余爱好者；浅薄的涉猎者

en: He was a dilettante in philosophy, reading widely but without deep understanding.
She pursued painting not as a profession but as a dilettante, enjoying it in her spare time.
The serious scholars often looked down upon the dilettantes who dabbled in their field.
cn: 他是一位哲学领域的业余爱好者，阅读广泛但理解不深。
她从事绘画并非作为职业，而是作为一名业余爱好者，在闲暇时享受其中。
严肃的学者们常常看不起那些在他们领域浅尝辄止的业余爱好者。

en: Her smile revealed two charming dimples.
The golf ball's surface is covered in dimples for aerodynamics.
He dimpled the clay with his thumb to create texture.
cn: 她的微笑露出两个迷人的酒窝。
高尔夫球表面布满凹痕以优化空气动力学。
他用拇指在黏土上压出凹痕以制造纹理。

definitions.definition: 持续不断的嘈杂声；喧闹

en: The din of the construction site made it impossible to concentrate.
A sudden din of car horns erupted in the traffic jam.
She shouted over the din of the party.
cn: 建筑工地的喧闹声让人无法集中注意力。
堵车时突然爆发出一阵刺耳的汽车喇叭声。
她在派对的嘈杂声中提高嗓门喊话。

definitions.definition: 小船，小艇，尤指用作救生艇或休闲划船的小型开放式船只

en: We loaded our supplies into the dinghy and rowed to the shore.
The sailboat was accompanied by a small dinghy used for trips to the harbor.
They anchored the yacht and came ashore in the dinghy.
cn: 我们将补给装上小艇，划向岸边。
那艘帆船配有一艘用于往返港口的小型救生艇。
他们停好游艇，乘小舟上了岸。

en: The curtains were old and dingy, barely letting any light through.
He lived in a dingy basement apartment with no windows.
The once-white shirt had turned a dingy gray after years of wear.
cn: 窗帘又旧又脏，几乎透不进光。
他住在一间没有窗户的昏暗地下室公寓里。
这件曾经洁白的衬衫经年累月已褪成灰暗色。

en: The bishop oversees all parishes within his diocese.
The diocese was established in the 12th century.
She works for the charitable foundation of the local diocese.
cn: 这位主教管辖其教区内的所有堂区。
该教区成立于12世纪。
她为当地教区的慈善基金会工作。

definitions.definition: 二极管（一种具有两个电极，只允许电流单向通过的电子元件）

en: A diode allows current to flow in one direction only.
The circuit was repaired by replacing a faulty diode.
LEDs are a special type of diode that emit light when current passes through them.
cn: 二极管只允许电流朝一个方向流动。
通过更换一个故障的二极管，电路被修复了。
LED（发光二极管）是一种特殊的二极管，当电流通过时会发光。

definitions.definition: 元音连字（如 coin 中的 oi 或 loud 中的 ou）；双元音；双元音字母组合

en: The word "coin" contains the diphthong /ɔɪ/.
Linguists often study how diphthongs change over time in a language.
The difference between a pure vowel and a diphthong can be subtle to non-native speakers.
cn: 单词 “coin” 包含双元音 /ɔɪ/。
语言学家经常研究双元音在一种语言中如何随时间变化。
对非母语者而言，纯元音和双元音之间的区别可能很细微。

definitions.definition: （D-）北斗七星（the Plough 的另一种称呼）
一种善于潜水的鸟（如河乌）

en: She used a dipper to pour water from the bucket.
The Big Dipper is one of the most recognizable constellations in the northern sky.
A dipper bird was diving into the stream to catch insects.
cn: 她用长柄勺从桶里舀水出来。
北斗七星是北方天空中最易辨认的星座之一。
一只河乌正潜入溪流中捕捉昆虫。

en: The country is facing dire economic challenges.
His dire warnings about climate change were ignored.
We are in dire need of medical supplies.
cn: 该国正面临严峻的经济挑战。
他关于气候变化的严厉警告被忽视了。
我们急需医疗物资。

en: The manager issued a new directive to streamline workflow.
EU directives require national laws to implement them.
Her directive tone left no room for negotiation.
cn: 经理发布了一项新指令以优化工作流程。
欧盟指令要求成员国通过国内法落实。
她命令式的语气毫无商量余地。

en: The office was in complete disarray after the renovation.
Her sudden resignation disarrayed the team's plans.
The documents lay in disarray on the desk.
cn: 翻修后，办公室一片狼藉。
她的突然辞职打乱了团队的计划。
文件杂乱地堆在桌上。

en: She tried to disassociate herself from the controversial statements of her colleagues.
The therapist encouraged him to disassociate from traumatic memories through mindfulness.
In chemistry, some compounds disassociate into ions when dissolved in water.
cn: 她试图让自己与同事们有争议的言论划清界限。
治疗师鼓励他通过正念练习与创伤记忆分离。
在化学中，某些化合物溶于水时会解离成离子。

definitions.definition: 否认，拒绝承认（责任、关联或知识）

en: The government swiftly moved to disavow any involvement in the attack.
cn: 政府迅速行动，否认与此次袭击有任何关联。

en: The government decided to disband the controversial committee.
After the war, the rebel forces voluntarily disbanded.
The band announced they would disband after their final tour.
cn: 政府决定解散那个备受争议的委员会。
战争结束后，叛军主动解散。
乐队宣布在最后一次巡演后解散。

en: The difference between the two samples is barely discernible.
His voice was scarcely discernible over the noise of the crowd.
A discernible pattern emerged after analyzing the data.
cn: 两个样本之间的差异几乎无法辨别。
在人群的嘈杂声中，他的声音几乎听不清。
分析数据后，一个可识别的模式显现出来。

en: She has a discerning eye for vintage fashion.
The restaurant caters to discerning customers who appreciate fine wine.
His discerning criticism helped improve the manuscript.
cn: 她对古着服饰有独到的眼光。
这家餐厅服务于懂行且挑剔的葡萄酒爱好者。
他犀利的批评帮助改进了手稿。

en: The company disclaims any responsibility for the content of external websites.
He disclaimed his right to the inheritance in favor of his sister.
The witness disclaimed any knowledge of the defendant's actions.
cn: 该公司否认对外部网站的内容负有任何责任。
他放弃了继承权，将其让给了他的妹妹。
证人拒绝承认对被告的行为有任何了解。

en: His sudden outburst disconcerted everyone in the meeting room.
The bad weather disconcerted our plans for a picnic.
She was disconcerted by the interviewer's unexpected question.
cn: 他的突然发怒让会议室里的每个人都感到不安。
恶劣的天气打乱了我们的野餐计划。
面试官出人意料的问题让她慌了神。

en: The false accusations discredited his reputation.
Scientists discredited the outdated theory.
The scandal brought discredit to the organization.
cn: 虚假指控败坏了他的声誉。
科学家们否定了这一过时的理论。
丑闻使该组织信誉扫地。

en: She gave him a discreet signal to leave the room.
The furniture had a discreet elegance.
Journalists must be discreet when handling sensitive information.
cn: 她谨慎地示意他离开房间。
这些家具低调而优雅。
记者处理敏感信息时必须谨慎。

en: The data is analyzed in discrete time intervals.
Each chapter forms a discrete unit of the book.
Quantum physics deals with discrete energy levels.
cn: 数据以离散时间间隔进行分析。
每一章构成书中独立的单元。
量子物理学研究离散的能级。

en: The athlete spun around before releasing the discus.
Discus throwing was a popular event in ancient Greek athletics.
She won a silver medal in the discus at the national championships.
cn: 运动员在释放铁饼前先旋转身体。
掷铁饼是古希腊体育中一项流行的赛事。
她在全国锦标赛上获得了铁饼项目的银牌。

en: The harsh reality disenchanted him about his dream job.
Traveling alone can disenchant you with romanticized notions of adventure.
Her honest critique disenchanted the team about their flawed project.
cn: 残酷的现实让他对理想工作不再抱有幻想。
独自旅行会打破你对冒险的浪漫化想象。
她直率的批评让团队意识到项目的缺陷而醒悟。

definitions.definition: 解开（结、缠绕物）；理顺，解决（复杂问题）

en: It took me hours to disentangle the knots in the fishing net.
The book helps to disentangle the complex issues of modern philosophy.
She needed to disentangle herself from the unhealthy relationship.
cn: 我花了数小时才解开渔网上的结。
这本书有助于厘清现代哲学的复杂问题。
她需要从那段不健康的关系中解脱出来。

definitions.definition: 公正的；无偏见的（指不因个人利益而影响判断）
不感兴趣的（过时或易混淆用法，现代英语中建议用 uninterested）

en: The judge remained disinterested throughout the trial.
His disinterested advice helped us resolve the conflict.
cn: 法官在整个审判过程中保持公正。
他无私的建议帮助我们解决了冲突。

definitions.definition: 脱节的， disjointed 的；不连贯的，支离破碎的

en: The patient gave a disjointed account of the accident.
His speech was disjointed and difficult to follow.
The novel's plot is interesting but disjointed.
cn: 病人对事故的描述支离破碎。
他的演讲内容不连贯，很难跟上。
这部小说的情节有趣但结构松散。

en: The argument presented a disjunctive set of possibilities, none of which were appealing.
In logic, a disjunctive syllogism is a valid argument form.
"Or" is a disjunctive conjunction that typically presents an alternative.
cn: 该论证提出了一组分离的可能性，但没有一个令人满意。
在逻辑学中，选言三段论是一种有效的论证形式。
“Or”是一个转折连词，通常用于引出另一个选项。

definitions.definition: 使脱臼；使（骨头）脱离关节位置
扰乱；打乱（正常秩序或位置）

en: The fall dislocated his shoulder.
The protest dislocated traffic in the city center.
Natural disasters can dislocate entire communities.
cn: 跌倒使他的肩膀脱臼了。
抗议活动扰乱了市中心的交通。
自然灾害可能打乱整个社区的秩序。

en: The dentist dislodged the food particle stuck between my teeth.
Heavy rains dislodged several rocks from the cliff.
The scandal failed to dislodge the CEO from his position.
cn: 牙医清除了卡在我牙缝中的食物残渣。
暴雨使几块岩石从悬崖上脱落。
丑闻未能迫使这位CEO离职。

en: The workers dismantled the old bridge carefully.
The government plans to dismantle the outdated tax system.
She dismantled his argument with precise evidence.
cn: 工人们小心地拆除了旧桥。
政府计划逐步废除过时的税收制度。
她用精确的证据推翻了他的论点。

definitions.definition: 完全不同的；本质上无法比较的

en: The two theories are disparate in their fundamental assumptions.
The report highlights disparate impacts of the policy across income groups.
Their disparate backgrounds made collaboration challenging.
cn: 这两种理论的基本假设截然不同。
报告揭示了该政策对不同收入群体的迥异影响。
他们迥异的背景使合作充满挑战。

definitions.definition: 差异，不平等（尤指数量、质量或地位的悬殊）

en: The disparity between rich and poor is widening globally.
There's a noticeable disparity in educational resources across regions.
The study highlights gender disparities in career advancement.
cn: 全球贫富差距正在扩大。
不同地区的教育资源存在明显差异。
该研究揭示了职业晋升中的性别不平等。

definitions.definition: 可分配的，可宽恕的（古义，现较少使用）

en: Many considered these formalities dispensable in the crisis.
The manual includes a list of dispensable components to reduce cost.
He argued that no one is dispensable in a well-functioning team.
cn: 许多人认为这些礼节在危机中是可有可无的。
手册中包含了一份可省略的组件清单以降低成本。
他辩称在一个运作良好的团队中，没有谁是可有可无的。

en: The charity is responsible for the dispensation of food and supplies to the refugees.
The pope granted a special dispensation allowing the priest to marry.
Many believe that all events occur by divine dispensation.
cn: 该慈善机构负责向难民分发食物和物资。
教皇授予了特许，允许这位神父结婚。
许多人相信一切事件都是天意安排。

definitions.definition: 沮丧的，气馁的，垂头丧气的

en: After receiving yet another rejection letter, she felt utterly dispirited.
The team looked dispirited after their narrow defeat in the finals.
He tried to offer some encouraging words to his dispirited friend.
cn: 在收到又一封拒信后，她感到彻底灰心丧气。
队伍在决赛中惜败后，看起来垂头丧气。
他试图向那位沮丧的朋友说些鼓励的话。

en: He is disposed to agree with your plan.
The property was disposed of in the will.
She is always well-disposed towards new ideas.
cn: 他倾向于同意你的计划。
该财产已在遗嘱中进行了处置。
她总是乐于接受新想法。

en: The scientist disproved the theory with experimental data.
No one could disprove his alibi during the trial.
New research may disprove long-held assumptions about climate change.
cn: 科学家用实验数据推翻了该理论。
庭审中无人能反驳他的不在场证明。
新研究可能颠覆关于气候变化的长期假设。

definitions.definition: 坏名声；丧失名誉；声名狼藉

en: The scandal brought the entire industry into disrepute.
His actions have fallen into disrepute among his peers.
The practice is now held in disrepute by modern scholars.
cn: 这一丑闻使整个行业声名狼藉。
他的行为在同行中已经名誉扫地。
这种做法如今被现代学者所鄙弃。

en: His tone was full of disrespect.
She felt disrespected by his comments.
Disrespect towards elders is unacceptable.
cn: 他的语气充满不敬。
她认为他的言论冒犯了自己。
对长辈不尊重是不可接受的。

en: The organization aims to disseminate scientific knowledge to the public.
Social media has accelerated the speed at which rumors disseminate.
The professor disseminated his research findings through academic journals.
cn: 该组织致力于向公众传播科学知识。
社交媒体加快了谣言传播的速度。
教授通过学术期刊发表了他的研究成果。

en: The policy change caused much dissension within the party.
Their dissension over the budget delayed the project for months.
Despite the apparent unity, there was underlying dissension among the members.
cn: 这一政策变化在党内引起了诸多分歧。
他们在预算问题上的不和使项目延误了数月。
尽管表面团结，成员间却存在着潜在的不和。

definitions.definition: 损害；有害的行为；帮倒忙

en: Spreading false rumors is a disservice to the community.
His biased advice did her a great disservice.
The misleading article was a disservice to scientific truth.
cn: 散布虚假谣言是对社区的损害。
他的偏见建议给她帮了倒忙。
这篇误导性文章损害了科学真相。

definitions.definition: 放荡的；浪荡的；沉迷于享乐的

en: In his youth, he led a dissipated life of parties and excess.
The dissipated fortune left him with nothing in his old age.
His dissipated appearance revealed a life of hard drinking and late nights.
cn: 他年轻时过着一种沉溺于派对和放纵的浪荡生活。
被挥霍一空的财产让他晚年一无所有。
他憔悴的面容揭示了其酗酒和熬夜的生活。

definitions.definition: 使分离；使脱离；[化学] 使离解
分离；脱离；[化学] 离解

en: She tried to dissociate herself from the controversial policies of her former party.
In chemistry, some compounds dissociate into ions when dissolved in water.
The trauma caused him to dissociate from reality during stressful situations.
cn: 她试图让自己与前政党的争议政策划清界限。
在化学中，一些化合物溶于水时会离解成离子。
创伤导致他在压力情境下会与现实脱离。

definitions.definition: 放荡的；无节制的；道德沦丧的

en: He led a dissolute life, spending his nights in revelry and his days in idleness.
The novel's protagonist is a dissolute nobleman who squanders his fortune.
Despite his dissolute youth, he eventually reformed and became a respected member of the community.
cn: 他过着放荡的生活，夜晚纵情狂欢，白日无所事事。
小说主人公是一个挥霍家产的放荡贵族。
尽管他年轻时放荡不羁，但最终改过自新，成为了社区中受人尊敬的成员。

en: The dissonance between the two violin parts created tension in the piece.
There was a clear dissonance between his actions and his words.
Cognitive dissonance occurs when beliefs contradict behaviors.
cn: 两段小提琴旋律的不协和音为乐曲制造了紧张感。
他的言行明显不一致。
当信念与行为矛盾时，会出现认知失调。

definitions.definition: 劝阻，说服（某人）不做某事

en: She tried to dissuade him from quitting his job.
The data dissuaded investors from taking risks.
His calm words dissuaded the crowd from violence.
cn: 她试图劝他不要辞职。
数据劝阻了投资者冒险。
他冷静的言辞劝住了人群避免暴力。

en: She wrinkled her nose in distaste at the smell of rotten eggs.
His distaste for politics made him avoid public debates.
The critic’s distaste for modern art was evident in his harsh review.
cn: 她因臭鸡蛋的气味厌恶地皱起鼻子。
他对政治的厌恶使他回避公开辩论。
这位评论家对现代艺术的厌恶在他尖锐的评论中显而易见。

definitions.definition: 极度焦虑或心神不宁的

en: She was distraught after losing her wedding ring.
His distraught voice revealed the depth of his panic.
The distraught parents searched everywhere for the missing child.
cn: 她丢失结婚戒指后心神大乱。
他慌乱的声音暴露了内心的恐慌。
忧心忡忡的父母四处寻找失踪的孩子。

en: Political conflicts threatened to disunite the nation.
The debate over the policy could disunite the committee.
A shared purpose helps prevent teams from disuniting under pressure.
cn: 政治冲突可能导致国家分裂。
关于这项政策的辩论可能使委员会内部分裂。
共同的目标能帮助团队在压力下避免分崩离析。

en: The old factory fell into disuse after the company moved its operations overseas.
Disuse of the muscles can lead to atrophy.
They decided to disuse the traditional method in favor of a more modern approach.
cn: 这家旧工厂在公司将业务转移到海外后便被废弃了。
肌肉长期不使用会导致萎缩。
他们决定废弃传统方法，转而采用更现代的方法。

definitions.definition: （计算机）使（数字音频或图像）产生抖动

en: Stop dithering and make a decision!
The manager was in a dither about the upcoming audit.
The software uses a algorithm to dither the image and reduce color banding.
cn: 别再犹豫了，做个决定吧！
经理对即将到来的审计感到惊慌失措。
该软件使用一种算法使图像抖动，以减少色彩带状失真。

definitions.definition: 同上，同前（用于表示同意或避免重复）
同上符号（″），表示重复的副本或极其相似的人或物

en: I'll have a coffee. Ditto for me.
She wrote her name on the form, and he put ditto underneath.
My opinion on the matter is ditto to what John said.
cn: 我要一杯咖啡。我也一样。
她在表格上写下了自己的名字，他在下面填了“同上”。
我对此事的看法和约翰说的一样。

definitions.definition: 小曲，短歌（通常简单或轻快的）

en: She hummed a cheerful ditty while baking cookies.
The sailor’s ditty echoed across the harbor at dusk.
His latest ditty became an unexpected viral hit on social media.
cn: 她一边烤饼干，一边哼着欢快的小曲。
黄昏时分，水手的短歌声在港口回荡。
他最新创作的短歌意外在社交媒体上走红。

en: The road diverges into two paths ahead.
Their opinions diverged sharply on the policy.
The infinite series diverges in mathematical analysis.
cn: 前方的道路分叉成两条小径。
他们对这项政策的看法截然不同。
这个无穷级数在数学分析中发散。

en: Their opinions are increasingly divergent on this issue.
The two roads become divergent after the bridge.
A divergent series does not converge to a finite limit.
cn: 他们在这个问题上的分歧越来越大。
这两条路在桥后分叉。
发散级数不会收敛于有限值。

definitions.definition: 股息（公司分配给股东的利润部分）

en: The company announced a higher dividend this quarter.
In 28 ÷ 7, 28 is the dividend.
Reinvesting dividends can accelerate wealth growth.
cn: 该公司宣布本季度股息上调。
在 28 ÷ 7 中，28 是被除数。
股息再投资能加速财富增长。

en: The temple was believed to be a divine place.
She has a divine voice that captivates everyone.
Ancient priests tried to divine the future through rituals.
cn: 这座寺庙曾被认为是神圣之地。
她的嗓音美妙绝伦，令人沉醉。
古祭司试图通过仪式预言未来。

definitions.definition: 神圣的存在（如神或天使）

en: The priest spoke of the divinity of Christ with deep reverence.
She decided to study Divinity at university to explore religious traditions.
Ancient myths often describe the divinities as having human emotions.
cn: 牧师以深深的敬畏谈论基督的神性。
她决定在大学攻读神学，以探索宗教传统。
古代神话常将神明描述为拥有人类情感。

definitions.definition: 引起分歧的；导致对立的

en: The politician's speech was highly divisive, sparking heated debates.
Avoid divisive topics at family gatherings to maintain harmony.
Her leadership style became increasingly divisive over time.
cn: 这位政治家的演讲极具分裂性，引发了激烈争论。
家庭聚会中避免讨论引发对立的话题以保持和谐。
她的领导风格逐渐变得更具分裂性。

en: She refused to divulge the source of her information.
The contract forbids employees to divulge company secrets.
He divulged his travel plans only to close friends.
cn: 她拒绝透露她的消息来源。
合同禁止员工泄露公司机密。
他只向密友透露了自己的旅行计划。

en: The docile horse allowed the children to pet it without hesitation.
She was a docile student, always eager to follow instructions.
The trainer praised the dog for its docile behavior during the session.
cn: 这匹温顺的马毫不犹豫地让孩子们抚摸它。
她是个顺从的学生，总是乐于听从指导。
训练师称赞了这只狗在训练中的温顺表现。

en: She earned her doctorate in molecular biology at Harvard.
The university conferred an honorary doctorate upon the Nobel laureate.
Completing a doctorate typically requires original research.
cn: 她在哈佛大学获得了分子生物学博士学位。
大学向这位诺贝尔奖得主授予了荣誉博士学位。
完成博士学位通常需要原创性研究。

en: He handed me a dog-eared copy of his favorite novel.
The dog-eared pages showed how much the book had been loved.
I found the recipe in a dog-eared magazine in the waiting room.
cn: 他递给我一本他最爱的小说，书页都已经卷角了。
那些卷角的书页表明这本书曾被多么地珍爱。
我在等候室一本翻旧了的杂志里找到了这个食谱。

definitions.definition: 教条；信条（尤指权威机构强加的）

en: The scientific community rejects dogma in favor of empirical evidence.
His political dogma left no room for compromise.
Challenging religious dogmas can be controversial.
cn: 科学界拒绝教条，推崇实证证据。
他的政治信条毫无妥协余地。
挑战宗教教条可能引发争议。

definitions.definition: 教条的；武断的（坚持某种教义或观点，不容置疑）

en: His dogmatic approach left no room for discussion.
The professor was criticized for being too dogmatic in his lectures.
Avoid dogmatic statements when dealing with complex issues.
cn: 他武断的态度让讨论无法进行。
这位教授因在课堂上过于教条而受到批评。
处理复杂问题时，避免使用武断的表述。

definitions.definition: 筋疲力尽的，极度疲倦的

en: After hiking for ten hours, we were all dog-tired and collapsed into our sleeping bags.
The construction workers came home dog-tired every single day.
I've been studying for finals all week; I'm absolutely dog-tired.
cn: 徒步走了十个小时后，我们都累瘫了，直接倒进了睡袋里。
那些建筑工人每天回到家时都筋疲力尽。
我整个星期都在为期末考试学习，现在简直累趴了。

en: The team has been in the doldrums since losing their star player.
Sailors feared being stuck in the doldrums for weeks.
Her creativity emerged from the doldrums after a long hiatus.
cn: 球队自失去明星球员后一直萎靡不振。
水手们害怕被困在无风带数周。
经过长期沉寂后，她的创作力终于走出低谷。

definitions.definition: 少量发放（尤指食物或钱）

en: He has been on the dole for six months since the factory closed.
The charity organization doled out food to the homeless.
She accepted her fate without a dole of self-pity.
cn: 自从工厂关闭后，他已经领了六个月的失业救济金。
该慈善机构向无家可归者分发食物。
她接受了自己的命运，没有一丝自怜。

en: The doleful sound of the funeral dirge echoed through the cemetery.
She spoke in a doleful tone about her lost opportunities.
His doleful expression revealed the depth of his disappointment.
cn: 葬礼挽歌那哀伤的声音在墓园中回荡。
她以悲伤的语气谈论着她失去的机会。
他沮丧的表情透露了他深深的失望。

definitions.definition: 一团（软质食物，如奶油、酱料等）；少量
随意舀取或放置（软质食物）

en: She added a dollop of whipped cream to the pie.
He dolloped the mashed potatoes onto his plate carelessly.
A dollop of kindness can go a long way.
cn: 她在派上加了一团打发奶油。
他随意舀了一堆土豆泥到盘子里。
一点善意能发挥巨大作用。

definitions.definition: 领域，范围（指知识、活动或控制的区域）

en: The study of marine biology falls within his domain of expertise.
They registered a new domain for their online business.
The king's domain extended across the entire valley.
cn: 海洋生物学的研究属于他的专业领域。
他们为在线业务注册了一个新域名。
国王的领地覆盖了整个山谷。

definitions.definition: 使习惯于家庭生活；使爱家

en: Humans were able to domesticate wolves, which eventually led to the development of dogs.
It took many generations to fully domesticate this species of wild rice.
The process to domesticate such a wild animal requires immense patience and knowledge.
cn: 人类能够驯化狼，这最终导致了狗的出现。
完全驯化这种野生稻花了许多代人的时间。
驯化如此野生的动物需要极大的耐心和知识。

definitions.definition: 家庭生活；对家庭生活的喜爱
（常指平淡的）家务事，家庭活动

en: After years of traveling, she longed for the quiet domesticity of home.
The novel offers a profound critique of the stifling domesticity expected of women in that era.
His paintings often depict scenes of cozy domesticity, with families gathered by the fireplace.
cn: 在多年的旅行之后，她渴望家庭宁静的生活。
这部小说深刻批判了那个时代对女性所期望的令人窒息的家庭生活。
他的画作常常描绘舒适的家庭生活场景，比如家人围聚在壁炉旁。

en: His legal domicile is in Florida, though he travels frequently for work.
The company is domiciled in Singapore for tax purposes.
After years of moving, she finally found a permanent domicile in the countryside.
cn: 他的法定居住地在佛罗里达州，尽管他经常因工作出差。
出于税务目的，该公司将总部设在新加坡。
在经历了多年的搬迁后，她终于在乡下找到了一个永久的住所。

en: He domineers over everyone in the office, and no one dares to oppose him.
She domineered the conversation, never letting others express their opinions.
The manager’s domineering attitude made the team members feel very uncomfortable.
cn: 他在办公室里对所有人专横跋扈，没人敢反对他。
她掌控了整个谈话，从不让别人表达意见。
经理盛气凌人的态度让团队成员感到非常不适。

en: His domineering attitude made the team members feel oppressed.
She rejected the domineering proposal with a firm stance.
The manager's domineering style stifled creativity in the office.
cn: 他的专横态度让团队成员感到压抑。
她以坚定立场回绝了这项盛气凌人的提案。
经理的专横作风扼杀了办公室的创造力。

en: The phone call was so long that I started to doodle all over my notepad.
His notebook margins were filled with intricate doodles of geometric patterns.
Instead of taking notes, she just doodled flowers and stars during the lecture.
cn: 通话时间太长了，我开始在记事本上到处乱画。
他笔记本的页边空白处画满了复杂的几何图案涂鸦。
她在讲座上没有记笔记，只是在画花朵和星星。

definitions.definition: 注定的；命定的（尤指不幸或灾难性的结局）
注定失败的；无可挽救的

en: The project was doomed from the start due to poor planning.
She felt doomed to repeat her mother's mistakes.
The ancient city was doomed by the volcanic eruption.
cn: 该项目因规划不善从一开始就注定失败。
她觉得自己注定会重蹈母亲的覆辙。
这座古城因火山喷发而难逃毁灭的命运。

definitions.definition: 世界末日，最后的审判日
任何灾难性或决定性的时刻

en: The ancient prophecy spoke of a doomsday when the stars would fall from the sky.
Some survivalists are building bunkers to prepare for a potential doomsday scenario.
The deadline for the project felt like a personal doomsday.
cn: 古老的预言讲述了一个星辰将从天空坠落的末日。
一些生存主义者正在建造地堡，为潜在的末日 scenario 做准备。
该项目的最后期限感觉就像个人的世界末日。

definitions.definition: 毒品；麻醉剂；笨蛋；内幕消息

en: The athlete was banned for using dope.
He always has the latest dope on tech trends.
Don't be such a dope—read the instructions first!
cn: 这名运动员因服用兴奋剂被禁赛。
他总是掌握科技趋势的最新内幕。
别犯傻了，先看说明书！

en: The volcano has been dormant for centuries.
Her artistic skills remained dormant until she took a painting class.
The project is dormant due to lack of funding.
cn: 这座火山已休眠数百年。
她的艺术天赋一直潜伏着，直到她上了绘画课。
该项目因资金短缺而搁置。

definitions.definition: 剂量（尤指药物或辐射的定量）

en: The doctor adjusted the dosage of the medication.
Proper dosage is critical in chemotherapy.
The machine calculates the radiation dosage automatically.
cn: 医生调整了药物的剂量。
化疗中剂量控制至关重要。
这台机器自动计算辐射剂量。

definitions.definition: 档案，卷宗；一套文件（尤指关于特定人物或事件的详细资料）

en: The intelligence agency compiled a thick dossier on the suspect.
Please submit the complete medical dossier before the consultation.
The journalist spent months building a dossier of evidence for the investigation.
cn: 情报机构编制了关于嫌疑人的厚厚档案。
请在咨询前提交完整的医疗档案。
记者花了数月时间为调查建立证据卷宗。

definitions.definition: （尤指因年老）溺爱，过分宠爱；变得衰老，智力衰退

en: Grandparents often dote on their grandchildren, spoiling them with treats and gifts.
As he grew older, he began to dote and repeat the same stories over and over.
She dotes on her cat, allowing it to sleep on her bed and even at the dinner table.
cn: 祖父母经常溺爱孙辈，用点心和礼物宠坏他们。
随着他年纪渐长，他开始变得糊涂，一遍又一遍地重复同样的故事。
她十分宠爱她的猫，允许它在她的床上甚至餐桌上睡觉。

en: Doting parents often give their children whatever they want.
He is a doting grandfather who spoils his grandchildren.
Despite her successful career, she remains a doting mother at heart.
cn: 溺爱孩子的父母常常对孩子有求必应。
他是一位溺爱孙辈的祖父，总是惯着他们。
尽管事业成功，她本质上仍是一位慈爱的母亲。

definitions.definition: 继承亡夫爵位（或遗产）的寡妇；年长贵妇

en: The Dowager Countess presided over the estate with unwavering authority.
She carried herself with the dignified air of a dowager.
The title passed to his son, while his widow became the dowager duchess.
cn: 这位伯爵遗孀以绝对的权威掌管着庄园。
她举手投足间带着年长贵妇的端庄气质。
爵位传给了他的儿子，而他的遗孀则成为了公爵夫人。

en: She walked down the stairs slowly.
He felt down after hearing the bad news.
The bird's nest was lined with soft down.
cn: 她缓缓走下楼梯。
听到坏消息后，他情绪低落。
鸟巢里垫着柔软的绒毛。

definitions.definition: 穷困潦倒的；一贫如洗的

en: After losing his job and home, he was completely down-and-out.
The novel portrays the life of a down-and-out trying to survive in the city.
She offered help to the down-and-out man on the street.
cn: 在失去工作和住所后，他彻底穷困潦倒了。
这部小说描绘了一个穷困潦倒者试图在城市中生存的故事。
她向街上那个潦倒的男子伸出了援手。

definitions.definition: 降级；降低（职位、重要性等）

en: The company decided to downgrade his position due to poor performance.
The weather service issued a downgrade from hurricane to tropical storm.
Using cheap materials can downgrade the quality of the product.
cn: 公司因他表现不佳决定降低他的职位。
气象部门将飓风降级为热带风暴。
使用廉价材料会降低产品质量。

en: After failing the exam, she felt utterly downhearted.
The team was downhearted but not ready to give up.
His encouraging words lifted her downhearted spirit.
cn: 考试失利后，她感到无比沮丧。
队伍士气低落，但并未放弃。
他鼓励的话语让她低落的情绪振作起来。

en: The cyclists sped downhill effortlessly.
After the scandal, his career went rapidly downhill.
The downhill slope was covered with fresh snow.
cn: 自行车手们轻松地飞驰下坡。
丑闻后，他的事业迅速走下坡路。
下坡处覆盖着新雪。

en: That was a downright lie.
She refused downright to attend the meeting.
The weather was downright miserable last week.
cn: 那是个彻头彻尾的谎言。
她直截了当地拒绝参加会议。
上周的天气简直糟透了。

en: The factory is located downstream from the village.
Fish often swim downstream to spawn.
In business, downstream processes add value to raw materials.
cn: 工厂位于村庄的下游。
鱼类常顺流而下产卵。
在商业中，下游工序为原材料增值。

definitions.definition: （机器或系统的）停机时间；停工期间

en: The factory scheduled downtime for equipment maintenance.
Everyone needs some downtime after a busy workweek.
