尽管下雨，游行的欢乐氛围丝毫未减。

en: The hall was festooned with ribbons for the ceremony.
A festoon of lights hung between the trees.
She festooned her room with paper flowers.
cn: 大厅为典礼挂满了彩带装饰。
树木间悬挂着灯饰花彩。
她用纸花装饰了自己的房间。

en: She wore a fetching hat that drew everyone's attention.
He has a fetching smile that makes people feel at ease.
The boutique is known for its fetching window displays.
cn: 她戴了一顶迷人的帽子，吸引了所有人的目光。
他有着迷人的微笑，让人感到轻松自在。
这家精品店以其吸引人的橱窗陈列而闻名。

en: The village held a annual fete to raise money for the local school.
The winning team was feted with a parade through the city.
The book's publication was feted by critics and readers alike.
cn: 村庄举办了一年一度的游园会为当地学校筹集资金。
获胜的队伍受到了全城巡游的隆重款待。
这本书的出版受到了评论家和读者的一致庆贺。

en: The detectives were led to the hidden room by a fetid odor emanating from under the door.
The fetid smell of the stagnant water made it difficult to breathe.
He quickly opened the windows to air out the fetid atmosphere in the old basement.
cn: 侦探们被门下方散发出的恶臭引到了那个隐藏的房间。
死水的恶臭气味让人难以呼吸。
他迅速打开窗户，以驱散旧地下室里污浊的空气。

en: He had a fetish for collecting vintage shoes.
The tribal chief regarded the statue as a fetish of protection.
Modern consumerism often turns brands into fetishes.
cn: 他对收藏复古鞋有种迷恋。
部落首领将雕像视为护身符。
现代消费主义常将品牌神化。

en: The prisoner was bound with heavy iron fetters.
Creative minds must break the fetters of convention.
Poverty can fetter human potential.
cn: 囚犯被沉重的铁镣束缚着。
创新的思维必须打破传统的束缚。
贫穷会束缚人的潜能。

definitions.definition: 胎儿（指发育中的哺乳动物或人类胚胎，尤指怀孕8周后的阶段）

en: The ultrasound showed a healthy fetus at 12 weeks.
Environmental factors can affect fetus development.
The law protects the rights of both mother and fetus.
cn: 超声波显示12周的胎儿发育健康。
环境因素可能影响胎儿发育。
法律保护母亲和胎儿的权利。

en: The two families have been engaged in a bitter feud for generations.
Their political feud dominated the headlines for months.
The feud over the inheritance finally ended in court.
cn: 这两个家族世代深陷血腥世仇。
他们的政治纷争占据了数月头条。
这场关于遗产的长期争斗最终在法庭上终结。

en: She felt feverish and decided to stay in bed.
The city was in a feverish state of preparation for the festival.
His feverish excitement made it hard to concentrate.
cn: 她感到发热，决定卧床休息。
整座城市为节日筹备而陷入狂热状态。
他狂热的兴奋情绪让人难以集中注意力。

en: The product launch turned into a complete fiasco due to technical glitches.
His attempt to impress the audience was a monumental fiasco.
The party became a fiasco when the caterers canceled last minute.
cn: 由于技术故障，产品发布会彻底搞砸了。
他试图打动观众的尝试是一场巨大的失败。
餐饮商临时取消，派对变成了一场灾难。

definitions.definition: （态度或行为）反复无常的，易变的

en: The weather here is fickle, sunny one moment and stormy the next.
Her fickle tastes in fashion make her closet full of unworn clothes.
Investors grew wary of his fickle business decisions.
cn: 这里的天气变幻无常，一会儿晴空万里，一会儿暴雨倾盆。
她对时尚的善变品味让衣柜里堆满了没穿过的衣服。
投资者对他反复无常的商业决策越来越警惕。

en: The characters in the novel are entirely fictitious.
He used a fictitious name to avoid detection.
The report contained fictitious data to support the claim.
cn: 小说中的角色纯属虚构。
他使用假名以躲避追查。
报告中包含伪造数据以支持该主张。

definitions.definition: 微不足道的，琐碎的；无足轻重的

en: He wasted the afternoon on fiddling tasks that accomplished nothing.
She dismissed the problem as a fiddling detail not worth discussing.
The constant fiddling with the settings made the device malfunction.
cn: 他把下午浪费在了一些毫无成果的琐碎任务上。
她认为这个问题微不足道，不值得讨论。
不停地胡乱调整设置导致设备出了故障。

en: The child began to fidget during the long lecture.
Stop fidgeting with your pen—it’s distracting.
She’s always been a fidget, even as a baby.
cn: 孩子在漫长的讲座中开始坐立不安。
别再摆弄钢笔了，这很分心。
她从小就是个闲不住的人，连婴儿时期也是。

definitions.definition: 实地考察（科学研究中在自然或实际环境中进行的数据收集）
野外工作（如地质、考古等领域的户外作业）

en: Anthropologists rely on fieldwork to study indigenous cultures.
Her fieldwork in the rainforest yielded groundbreaking ecological data.
The geology students completed two weeks of fieldwork in the mountains.
cn: 人类学家依赖实地考察研究土著文化。
她在雨林中的野外工作获得了突破性生态数据。
地质学学生在山区完成了两周的实地考察。

en: He was portrayed as a fiend who took pleasure in the suffering of others.
cn: 他被描绘成一个以他人痛苦为乐的恶魔。

definitions.definition: 恶魔般的；残忍的；极坏的

en: The dictator was known for his fiendish cruelty.
The escape room presented us with a series of fiendish puzzles.
She devised a fiendish plan to get her revenge.
cn: 这位独裁者以其恶魔般的残忍而闻名。
密室逃脱给我们出了一系列极其刁钻的难题。
她策划了一个恶毒的计划来进行报复。

en: She packed a fig and some nuts for a healthy snack.
The old fig tree in the garden still bears fruit every summer.
He doesn't care a fig about what others think.
cn: 她打包了一个无花果和一些坚果作为健康零食。
花园里的老无花果树每年夏天仍会结果。
他毫不在乎别人的看法（俚语用法）。

definitions.definition: 虚构的事物；臆造的事物

en: The monster in the story was merely a figment of the author's imagination.
She realized that her fears were baseless figments, not grounded in reality.
His account of the event was a complete figment, fabricated to avoid blame.
cn: 故事中的怪物只是作者臆造出来的东西。
她意识到自己的恐惧是毫无根据的臆想，并非基于现实。
他对事件的描述完全是虚构的，是为了逃避责任而编造的。

definitions.definition: 象征的；具象的（艺术风格）

en: The poet used figurative language to describe the sunset as a "burning ember".
Her paintings are more figurative than abstract, often featuring human forms.
"Time is a thief" is a figurative expression about life's fleeting nature.
cn: 诗人用比喻语言将日落描述为“燃烧的余烬”。
她的画作偏向具象而非抽象，常以人体为主题。
“时间是小偷”是一个关于生命短暂本质的比喻表达。

en: The king became a mere figurehead after the revolution.
The ship's figurehead was a carved mermaid with gilded scales.
As CEO, she refused to be a figurehead and actively shaped company policy.
cn: 革命后，国王沦为傀儡领袖。
船头雕像是一条鳞片镀金的美人鱼。
作为CEO，她拒绝做挂名领导，而是积极参与决策。

en: In many Eastern cultures, filial piety is considered a fundamental virtue.
She felt a strong filial duty to care for her aging parents.
Their filial affection was evident in the way they respected their family's wishes.
cn: 在许多东方文化中，孝道被视为一种基本美德。
她觉得照顾年迈的父母是自己强烈的子女责任。
他们对自己家庭意愿的尊重方式，明显流露出了子女对父母的爱。

definitions.definition: 肉片/鱼片；束发带；装饰线条
将（肉或鱼）切成片；用带子装饰

en: She ordered a salmon fillet with lemon sauce.
The chef will fillet the fish to remove all bones.
The column was adorned with a golden fillet.
cn: 她点了一份配柠檬酱的三文鱼片。
厨师会将鱼切片去骨。
柱子上装饰着一圈金边。

definitions.definition: （演出、事件等的）终场；结局；尾声

en: The fireworks marked the grand finale of the festival.
The symphony's finale left the audience in awe.
She saved her best performance for the finale.
cn: 烟花为节日画上了盛大的句号。
交响乐的终章让观众惊叹不已。
她将最精彩的表演留到了压轴环节。

en: The artist carved the statue finely, capturing every delicate detail.
She dressed finely for the gala, turning heads as she entered.
The spices were finely ground to enhance the flavor of the dish.
cn: 艺术家精细地雕刻了雕像，捕捉到了每一个微妙的细节。
她为晚宴穿着优雅，入场时引人注目。
香料被研磨得极细，以提升菜肴的风味。

en: She was dressed in all her finery for the royal ball.
The guests arrived in their finery, ready to celebrate.
The old finery was used to convert cast iron into wrought iron.
cn: 她身着盛装，出席了皇家舞会。
客人们身着华服抵达，准备庆祝。
这座古老的精炼炉曾用于将生铁转化为熟铁。

en: She handled the negotiation with remarkable finesse.
The artist’s finesse with brushstrokes amazed the critics.
He finessed the problem by proposing a creative compromise.
cn: 她以非凡的技巧处理了这场谈判。
艺术家笔触的精妙令评论家惊叹。
他通过提出一个创造性的折中方案巧妙解决了问题。

definitions.definition: （引申义）最细微的部分或触觉

en: She gently touched the butterfly with her fingertip.
The artist painted the details with the precision of a fingertip.
He could feel the texture of the fabric at his fingertips.
cn: 她用指尖轻轻触碰蝴蝶。
艺术家以指尖般的精准描绘细节。
他能通过指尖感受到织物的质地。

definitions.definition: 过分讲究的，吹毛求疵的，难以取悦的

en: He is so finicky about his food that he will only eat a specific brand of organic pasta.
The finicky cat refused to drink water unless it was fresh from the tap.
Her finicky attention to detail made her an excellent proofreader.
cn: 他对食物非常挑剔，只吃某个特定品牌的有机意面。
这只挑剔的猫不肯喝水，除非是刚从水龙头里流出来的。
她对细节的吹毛求疵使她成为一名出色的校对员。

en: The speaker was denounced as a firebrand who incited violence.
They used firebrands to light the path through the dark forest.
His fiery speeches marked him as the firebrand of the revolution.
cn: 这位演讲者被谴责为煽动暴力的激进分子。
他们用火把照亮穿过黑暗森林的路。
他激昂的演讲使他成为革命的煽动者。

definitions.definition: 火力（军事术语，指武器系统的攻击能力）
（引申义）实力、资源（如团队或组织的综合能力）

en: The battleship's firepower overwhelmed the enemy defenses.
Our startup lacks the financial firepower to compete with tech giants.
Modern artillery units prioritize mobility and firepower.
cn: 战舰的火力压制了敌方防御。
我们初创公司缺乏与科技巨头抗衡的资金实力。
现代炮兵部队注重机动性与火力的平衡。

en: The government announced new fiscal policies to boost the economy.
Fiscal responsibility is crucial for long-term stability.
The report analyzes the country's fiscal health over the past decade.
cn: 政府宣布了新财政政策以提振经济。
财政责任对长期稳定至关重要。
该报告分析了该国过去十年的财政健康状况。

en: The coastal town thrives on its local fishery.
Sustainable fishery management is crucial for marine ecosystems.
The government imposed quotas to protect the fishery resources.
cn: 这座沿海小镇依靠当地渔业繁荣发展。
可持续的渔业管理对海洋生态系统至关重要。
政府实施配额制度以保护渔业资源。

en: The fishmonger at the market always has the freshest catch of the day.
He bought a dozen oysters from the fishmonger's stall.
The old fishmonger shouted about his wares to attract customers.
cn: 市场里的鱼贩总是有当天最新鲜的渔获。
他从鱼贩的摊位上买了一打牡蛎。
那位老鱼贩大声吆喝着他的商品以招揽顾客。

definitions.definition: 裂缝，裂隙（尤指岩石或身体组织的裂痕）

en: The earthquake created a deep fissure in the ground.
Over time, the glacier developed fissures due to melting.
The surgeon carefully repaired the fissure in the patient’s intestine.
cn: 地震在地面撕开一道深沟。
冰川因融化逐渐形成裂隙。
外科医生细致地缝合了患者肠道的裂口。

definitions.definition: 一阵阵的；间歇的；不规则的

en: The night was marked by fitful sleep and unsettling dreams.
The fitful wind made sailing difficult for the small boat.
His recovery was fitful, with periods of improvement followed by setbacks.
cn: 夜晚时睡时醒，还做着令人不安的梦。
一阵阵的风使小船难以航行。
他的恢复是断断续续的，好转之后又出现了挫折。

en: The dress requires some fitting adjustments.
His apology was a fitting response to the situation.
Plumbing fittings are essential for water supply systems.
cn: 这条裙子需要一些尺寸调整。
他的道歉是对这一情境的恰当回应。
管道配件是供水系统的关键部件。

en: The company hired a fixer to manage the public relations crisis.
After developing the film, you must immerse it in fixer to make the image permanent.
In the film, the character is a fixer who knows how to get things done in the city's underworld.
cn: 该公司聘请了一名危机公关专家来处理此次公共关系危机。
胶片显影后，你必须将其浸入定影液中以使图像永久保存。
在电影中，这个角色是一个掮客，深谙如何在这个城市的地下世界办成各种事情。

definitions.definition: 固定装置（如家具、灯具等永久安装的物体）
固定状态（指长期存在或难以改变的事物）

en: The bathroom fixtures were replaced during the renovation.
He became a fixture in the local music scene.
The light fixture is securely attached to the ceiling.
cn: 翻修期间更换了浴室固定装置。
他成了当地音乐界的常驻人物。
灯具牢固地安装在天花板上。

definitions.definition: （液体，尤指碳酸饮料）发出嘶嘶声并冒泡

en: The soda will fizz if you shake the bottle.
The fizz of the champagne was a sign of its good quality.
After the holidays, it was hard to recapture the fizz of New Year's Eve.
cn: 如果你摇晃瓶子，苏打水会发出嘶嘶声并冒泡。
香槟的滋滋气泡是其品质上乘的标志。
假期过后，很难再找回新年前夜的兴奋劲儿了。

definitions.definition: 软弱无力的；优柔寡断的

en: His flabby arms jiggled as he waved goodbye.
The company's flabby response to the crisis disappointed its investors.
After months without exercise, my stomach became flabby.
cn: 他挥手告别时，松弛的手臂肉随之晃动。
该公司对危机软弱无力的回应让其投资者感到失望。
几个月不锻炼后，我的肚子变得松弛了。

definitions.definition: 松弛的；软弱的；软沓沓的

en: The skin becomes flaccid as we age.
The plant's leaves grew flaccid from lack of water.
He was criticized for his flaccid leadership during the crisis.
cn: 随着年龄增长，皮肤会变得松弛。
由于缺水，植物的叶子变得萎蔫了。
他因在危机期间领导软弱而受到批评。

en: The national flag fluttered in the wind.
She flagged the important emails for later review.
His energy began to flag after hours of hiking.
cn: 国旗在风中飘扬。
她标记了重要邮件以备后续查阅。
徒步数小时后，他的体力开始下降。

en: The flag was flying at half-mast on the flagpole.
They raised the new banner to the top of the flagpole.
The tall flagpole stood in the center of the town square.
cn: 旗杆上的旗帜降半旗致哀。
他们将新旗帜升到了旗杆顶端。
高大的旗杆矗立在城镇广场的中心。

definitions.definition: 公然的，明目张胆的（指恶劣行为）

en: The judge condemned the flagrant violation of human rights.
His flagrant disregard for rules shocked everyone.
The scandal was a flagrant abuse of power.
cn: 法官谴责了这一公然侵犯人权的行为。
他对规则的明目张胆漠视令所有人震惊。
这一丑闻是权力的公然滥用。

definitions.definition: 连枷（农具）；类似连枷的武器或工具

en: The farmer used a flail to separate grain from the husks.
The injured bird flailed its wings desperately.
His arms flailed wildly as he tried to keep balance.
cn: 农民用连枷将谷物与外壳分离。
受伤的鸟拼命扑腾翅膀。
他疯狂挥舞手臂试图保持平衡。

en: She has a flair for languages.
The designer's flair made the dress unforgettable.
His political flair helped him navigate complex negotiations.
cn: 她对语言有天赋。
设计师的独特风格让这条裙子令人过目不忘。
他的政治敏锐力帮助他驾驭了复杂的谈判。

en: The planes faced heavy flak over enemy territory.
The new policy drew flak from environmental groups.
Despite the flak, the CEO stood by her decision.
cn: 飞机在敌区遭遇密集高射炮火。
新政策遭到环保组织的猛烈批评。
尽管受到抨击，首席执行官仍坚持她的决定。

definitions.definition: 艳丽的；华丽的（尤指服饰或风格）
张扬的；炫耀的（形容性格或行为）

en: She wore a flamboyant dress covered in sequins.
His flamboyant personality made him the center of attention.
The flamboyant architecture of the cathedral impressed all visitors.
cn: 她穿了一条缀满亮片的华丽连衣裙。
他张扬的个性使他成为焦点。
大教堂华丽的建筑风格让所有游客惊叹。

en: Gasoline is highly flammable and should be stored away from heat sources.
The factory posted warning signs for flammable materials.
Cotton becomes flammable when exposed to open flames.
cn: 汽油高度易燃，应远离热源存放。
工厂为易燃材料张贴了警示标志。
棉花接触明火时会变得易燃。

en: The castle's flank was protected by a steep cliff.
The general ordered troops to flank the enemy from the east.
She placed a hand on her dog's flank as they walked.
cn: 城堡的侧面由陡峭的悬崖保护。
将军命令部队从东侧包抄敌人。
散步时，她的手轻放在狗的侧腹上。

definitions.definition: 燃烧；突然发怒；突然爆发

en: The flare of the match lit up her face.
Tempers flared during the debate.
The ship launched a distress flare.
cn: 火柴的亮光照亮了她的脸。
辩论中情绪突然激动起来。
船只发射了一枚求救信号弹。

en: The novel uses flashbacks to reveal the character's childhood trauma.
A sudden smell of lavender triggered a flashback to her grandmother's garden.
The film's nonlinear structure relies heavily on flashbacks.
cn: 这部小说通过闪回揭示角色的童年创伤。
一阵薰衣草的气味突然让她回想起祖母的花园。
这部电影的非线性叙事大量依赖倒叙手法。

definitions.definition: 招摇过市；引人注目地行动

en: She flaunted her new diamond ring at the party.
The peacock flaunts its colorful feathers to attract mates.
Avoid flaunting your wealth in public.
cn: 她在派对上炫耀自己的新钻戒。
孔雀开屏展示艳丽的羽毛以吸引配偶。
避免在公共场合炫富。

en: Her performance was flawless, earning a standing ovation.
The diamond is prized for its flawless clarity.
He executed the plan with flawless precision.
cn: 她的表演完美无瑕，赢得了全场起立鼓掌。
这颗钻石因其毫无瑕疵的净度而备受珍视。
他以一丝不苟的精确度执行了该计划。

en: Flax has been cultivated for its fiber and seeds for thousands of years.
Linen is a textile made from the fibers of the flax plant.
The blue flax flower is known for its delicate beauty and short lifespan.
cn: 亚麻因其纤维和种子已被种植了数千年。
亚麻布是由亚麻植物的纤维制成的纺织品。
蓝色亚麻花以其精致的美感和短暂的生命周期而闻名。

en: Her long, flaxen hair shimmered in the sunlight.
The portrait depicted a child with flaxen curls.
In the old tale, the princess wore a gown of flaxen thread.
cn: 她长长的亚麻色头发在阳光下闪闪发光。
画像中是一个长着亚麻色卷发的小孩。
在这个古老的故事里，公主穿着一件亚麻线织成的长袍。

en: The bird's wings had golden flecks in the sunlight.
She flecked the canvas with blue paint to mimic stars.
A fleck of dust landed on his glasses.
cn: 鸟的翅膀在阳光下闪烁着金色的斑点。
她用蓝色颜料在画布上点缀出星星的效果。
一粒灰尘落在了他的眼镜上。

en: The fleeting moment of happiness left a lasting impression on her.
Youth is fleeting, but memories can be eternal.
The photographer captured the fleeting expression on the child's face.
cn: 那一瞬的幸福在她心中留下了长久的印记。
青春易逝，但回忆可以永恒。
摄影师抓拍到了孩子脸上转瞬即逝的表情。

definitions.definition: 弹性；灵活性（非正式用法）

en: The gymnast can flex her body into incredible shapes.
This cable has enough flex to avoid breaking under tension.
He likes to flex his knowledge during meetings.
cn: 体操运动员能将身体弯曲成惊人的姿势。
这根电缆有足够的弹性，在拉力下不会断裂。
他总爱在会议上炫耀自己的知识（非正式引申义）。

definitions.definition: 闪烁的光；短暂的闪现（如情绪或想法）

en: The candle flame flickered in the draft.
A flicker of doubt crossed his face.
Old movies flicker on the projector.
cn: 烛火在微风中摇曳。
他脸上闪过一丝疑虑。
老电影在放映机上闪烁播放。

definitions.definition: 飞行物（如鸟、飞机等）；传单；有冒险精神的人

en: The eagle is a powerful flier.
She distributed fliers for the concert downtown.
He’s a flier in the stock market, always taking risks.
cn: 这只鹰是强壮的飞行者。
她为市中心的音乐会分发传单。
他是股市中的冒险家，总在冒险。

definitions.definition: 轻浮的；反复无常的；善变的

en: Her flighty nature made it difficult for her to commit to long-term projects.
He was dismissed as a flighty and unreliable young man.
The novel's protagonist is a flighty socialite who avoids any serious responsibility.
cn: 她轻浮的性格使她难以投身于长期项目。
他被认为是一个轻浮不可靠的年轻人而不予重用。
这部小说的主角是一位逃避一切严肃责任的轻浮社交名媛。

definitions.definition: 轻薄的；脆弱的；不牢固的
无说服力的；站不住脚的（指论点、借口等）

en: The evidence against him was flimsy at best.
She wore a flimsy dress that fluttered in the breeze.
The company built flimsy shelters for the temporary workers.
cn: 指控他的证据充其量是站不住脚的。
她穿着一件轻薄的连衣裙，在微风中飘动。
公司为临时工搭建了不牢固的棚屋。

en: He didn't flinch when the doctor gave him the injection.
She flinched at the sound of thunder.
True warriors never flinch from danger.
cn: 医生给他打针时，他没有退缩。
雷声让她吓得一哆嗦。
真正的勇士从不畏惧危险。

definitions.definition: 翻转；突然改变（态度、立场）

en: She flipped the pancake with a quick wrist motion.
The audience's opinion flipped after the shocking revelation.
His flip remark offended the serious panelists.
cn: 她手腕一抖，快速翻动了煎饼。
惊人的真相揭露后，观众的态度彻底反转。
他轻率的言论冒犯了严肃的评委们。

definitions.definition: 轻率的；无礼的；油嘴滑舌的

en: She gave a flippant answer to the serious question.
His flippant attitude during the meeting annoyed the clients.
Don't be flippant about matters of such importance.
cn: 她对那个严肃的问题给了一个轻率的回答。
他在会议期间轻浮的态度惹恼了客户。
不要对如此重要的事情油嘴滑舌。

en: She likes to flirt with everyone at parties.
His flirting was harmless but annoying.
The leaves flirted in the breeze.
cn: 她喜欢在聚会上和所有人调情。
他的调情无恶意但令人厌烦。
树叶在微风中轻快地摆动。

definitions.definition: 轻快地飞过；掠过；短暂迁移

en: A butterfly flitted from flower to flower.
He flits between jobs every few months.
Shadows flitted across the old walls.
cn: 一只蝴蝶在花丛间轻快地飞舞。
他每隔几个月就换一次工作。
影子在古老的墙面上掠过。

definitions.definition: （英式非正式）出售（尤指非法地）

en: In the past, sailors might be flogged for disobedience.
The new policy was flogged by critics in the media.
cn: 在过去，水手可能会因违抗命令而受到鞭打。
新政策遭到了媒体评论员的猛烈抨击。

definitions.definition: （尤指被压抑感情的）决堤，迸发

en: They opened the floodgates to allow the water to irrigate the fields.
The court's ruling opened the floodgates for thousands of similar claims.
He struggled to keep the floodgate of his emotions closed.
cn: 他们打开泄洪闸门，让水流进去灌溉田地。
法院的裁决为成千上万的类似索赔打开了闸门。
他努力守住情感的闸门，不让其决堤。

en: The football stadium was illuminated by powerful floodlights.
They decided to floodlight the building for the evening event.
The sudden darkness was replaced by the harsh glare of a floodlight.
cn: 足球场被强大的泛光灯照得通明。
他们决定用泛光灯照亮那栋建筑，以举办晚间活动。
突如其来的黑暗被泛光灯刺眼的强光所取代。

en: The fish flopped helplessly on the deck.
The movie was a total flop at the box office.
She flopped onto the sofa after a long day.
cn: 鱼在甲板上无力地扑腾着。
这部电影票房惨败。
漫长的一天后，她重重瘫倒在沙发上。

definitions.definition: 软盘（早期计算机存储设备，现已淘汰）

en: The puppy's ears were so floppy that they covered its eyes.
In the 1990s, people saved files on floppy disks.
Her hair tie became floppy after hours of wear.
cn: 小狗的耳朵软塌塌的，甚至盖住了眼睛。
20世纪90年代，人们用软盘保存文件。
她的发圈戴了几小时后变得松垮了。

definitions.definition: 花的；植物群的；饰以花的

en: The room was decorated with floral patterns.
She wore a delicate floral perfume.
Floral diversity is crucial to ecosystem health.
cn: 房间装饰着花卉图案。
她喷了一款淡雅的花香香水。
植物群的多样性对生态系统健康至关重要。

definitions.definition: 绚丽的，华丽的（尤指装饰或文风）

en: The ballroom was decorated in a florid style, with ornate gilded carvings and frescoed ceilings.
His florid complexion suggested he had been out in the sun for too long.
The author's florid prose was filled with elaborate metaphors and excessive adjectives.
cn: 舞厅装饰华丽，有镀金的华丽雕刻和壁画天花板。
他红润的脸色表明他在阳光下待得太久了。
作者华丽的散文充满了精巧的隐喻和过多的形容词。

en: She visited the florist to buy roses for her mother.
The florist arranged the bouquet with seasonal flowers.
As a florist, he specializes in exotic tropical plants.
cn: 她去了花店为母亲购买玫瑰。
花匠用当季花卉布置了花束。
作为花卉研究者，他专攻异域热带植物。

definitions.definition: 挣扎；艰难移动（尤指陷入困境时）

en: The hiker floundered in the deep snow, unable to move forward.
He floundered through the speech, forgetting half his lines.
Grilled flounder with lemon is a classic coastal dish.
cn: 徒步者在深雪中艰难挣扎，无法前进。
他结结巴巴地完成演讲，忘了大半台词。
柠檬烤比目鱼是经典的海滨菜肴。

en: The protesters flouted the curfew by gathering in the square at night.
She flouted tradition by wearing a black wedding dress.
His flouting of safety regulations led to the accident.
cn: 抗议者公然藐视宵禁，夜间在广场聚集。
她穿着黑色婚纱，以此蔑视传统。
他对安全规定的漠视导致了事故。

en: The fluidity of the dancer’s movements captivated the audience.
Modern workplaces value fluidity in adapting to new technologies.
The artist’s style shows remarkable fluidity between realism and abstraction.
cn: 舞者流畅的动作令观众着迷。
现代职场重视适应新技术的灵活性。
这位艺术家的风格在写实与抽象间展现出惊人的流动性。

en: Winning the lottery was a complete fluke.
The fisherman caught a fluke near the reef.
The ship's anchor held fast thanks to its fluke.
cn: 中彩票纯属侥幸。
渔民在礁石附近捕到一条比目鱼。
船锚因锚爪牢固而稳固定位。

en: He flunked math twice before finally passing.
The professor threatened to flunk anyone who skipped class.
I almost flunked out of college in my first year.
cn: 他数学挂了两次才终于通过。
教授威胁要让所有旷课的人不及格。
我大一差点因为成绩差被退学。

en: A flurry of snow blew into the room when she opened the window.
The news caused a flurry of excitement among the scientists.
Don’t flurry—just take your time and answer carefully.
cn: 她开窗时，一阵雪飘进了房间。
这则消息在科学家中引发了一阵兴奋。
别慌，慢慢来，仔细回答。

en: The flux of migrants has increased in recent years.
Magnetic flux is measured in webers.
The blacksmith used borax as a flux to purify the metal.
cn: 近年来移民流动量有所增加。
磁通量以韦伯为单位计量。
铁匠用硼砂作焊剂来提纯金属。

en: The company distributed flyers to promote the new product.
She is a frequent flyer on this airline.
The bird was a swift flyer, darting through the trees.
cn: 公司分发传单以推广新产品。
她是这家航空公司的常旅客。
这只鸟飞得极快，在树林间穿梭。

definitions.definition: 扉页（书籍卷首或卷尾的空白页）

en: The author signed her name on the flyleaf of my copy.
There's a heartfelt inscription on the flyleaf from the previous owner.
Librarians often place ownership stamps on the flyleaf.
cn: 作者在我那本书的扉页上签了名。
扉页上有前主人写下的 heartfelt 题词。
图书管理员通常会在扉页上盖馆藏章。

definitions.definition: 飞轮（一种通过旋转惯性储存动能的机械装置）

en: The flywheel in the engine smooths out the power delivery.
Modern flywheels can store energy more efficiently than traditional batteries.
The mechanic replaced the damaged flywheel to eliminate vibrations.
cn: 发动机中的飞轮使动力输出更加平稳。
现代飞轮比传统电池能更高效地储存能量。
机械师更换了损坏的飞轮以消除振动。

en: The ultrasound scan showed a healthy foetus.
The development of the foetus is a complex biological process.
Nutrients are transferred from the mother to the foetus through the placenta.
cn: 超声波扫描显示胎儿健康状况良好。
胎儿的发育是一个复杂的生物过程。
营养物质通过胎盘从母体传输给胎儿。

definitions.definition: 老顽固；老保守（尤指思想守旧、抗拒新事物的老年人）

en: He was regarded as an old fogy who refused to use a smartphone.
The new policies were opposed by the fogies on the board.
Don't be such a fogy; it's time to embrace some modern ideas.
cn: 他被认为是一个拒绝使用智能手机的老古董。
新政策遭到了董事会里那些老顽固的反对。
别这么老顽固了，是时候接受一些现代观念了。

en: Leaving coffee mugs around the office is one of his endearing foibles.
We all have our little foibles; nobody is perfect.
Her tendency to be overly punctual is a mere foible in an otherwise flawless character.
cn: 把咖啡杯随手放在办公室是他的一个小癖好，无伤大雅反而显得可爱。
我们都有自己的小缺点，人无完人。
她过于守时的倾向在她 otherwise 完美的性格中仅仅是一个小缺点。

en: The chocolate was wrapped in gold foil.
Her quick thinking foiled the robbery attempt.
The dark background acts as a foil to the bright flowers.
cn: 巧克力用金箔纸包裹。
她的机智挫败了抢劫企图。
深色背景衬托出鲜花的明亮。

en: The salesman tried to foist an expensive warranty on me.
She foisted her responsibilities onto her junior colleagues.
It’s unfair to foist your opinions on others without discussion.
cn: 推销员试图强行卖给我一份昂贵的保修服务。
她把她的责任强加给了资浅的同事。
不经讨论就把你的观点强加于人是不公平的。

en: She carefully folded the letter before putting it in the envelope.
The map had deep folds from being stored in a pocket.
The Himalayas were formed by the fold of tectonic plates.
cn: 她将信仔细折好，放入信封。
地图因长期放在口袋里而有了深深的折痕。
喜马拉雅山脉由板块褶皱形成。

definitions.definition: （计算机）文件夹（存储文件的虚拟目录）

en: She placed the documents in a blue folder.
Create a new folder to organize your photos.
The map was too large, so he used a folder to keep it neat.
cn: 她将文件放入一个蓝色文件夹中。
新建一个文件夹来整理你的照片。
地图太大，他用折叠器将其整齐收好。

definitions.definition: 民俗（指特定群体或地区的传统故事、习俗、信仰等）
民间传说（广义上包含口头传承的文化内容）

en: The festival celebrates local folklore through music and dance.
Many Japanese folklore tales feature supernatural creatures like yokai.
Scholars study folklore to understand cultural identity.
cn: 这个节日通过音乐和舞蹈展现当地民俗。
许多日本民间传说以妖怪等超自然生物为特色。
学者研究民俗以理解文化认同。

definitions.definition: 爱抚；抚弄（通常带有温柔或喜爱的意味）

en: She fondled the puppy's ears gently.
The old man fondled his treasured pocket watch.
Avoid fondling the exhibits in the museum.
cn: 她轻轻抚弄着小狗的耳朵。
老人摩挲着他珍爱的怀表。
请勿触摸博物馆展品。

definitions.definition: 字体；字形（印刷或电子显示）
洗礼盆；圣水器（宗教用途）

en: The document uses a classic serif font for readability.
The priest blessed the water in the stone font.
Custom fonts can enhance a brand’s visual identity.
cn: 这份文件使用经典衬线字体以提高可读性。
牧师为石制圣水器中的水祝圣。
定制字体能强化品牌的视觉识别度。

definitions.definition: 简单到不会出错的；防蠢的

en: The app has a foolproof interface for beginners.
Her instructions were foolproof—even children could follow them.
No system is truly foolproof, but this one comes close.
cn: 这款应用为新手设计了极简界面，操作无门槛。
她的说明极其易懂，连孩子都能照做。
没有绝对防呆的系统，但这个已接近完美。

en: The vineyards thrive in the sunny foothills of the Alps.
We set up camp at the edge of the foothills before ascending the peak.
The city is protected from strong winds by the surrounding foothills.
cn: 阿尔卑斯山脉阳光充足的山麓丘陵是葡萄园的理想生长地。
我们在攀登主峰前于山麓边缘扎营。
周围的山麓丘陵为这座城市挡住了强风。

definitions.definition: 立足点（物理或比喻意义上的支撑点）
稳固的基础或优势地位

en: The climber searched for a secure foothold on the icy slope.
The company gained a foothold in the Asian market last year.
Education provides a foothold for social mobility.
cn: 登山者在结冰的斜坡上寻找稳固的立足点。
该公司去年在亚洲市场站稳了脚跟。
教育为社会阶层流动提供了基础。

definitions.definition: 自由自在的，无拘无束的（尤指可以自由旅行或改变生活方式）

en: After retiring, he became footloose and traveled to over thirty countries.
The footloose lifestyle of a digital nomad appeals to many young professionals.
She felt footloose after finishing her exams, ready to explore new opportunities.
cn: 退休后，他变得无拘无束，游历了三十多个国家。
数字游民自由自在的生活方式吸引了许多年轻专业人士。
考试结束后她感到一身轻松，准备去探索新的机会。

definitions.definition: （旧时）男仆，侍从；（尤指王室或贵族的）步兵，随从

en: The footman opened the carriage door for the duchess.
In the 18th century, a footman's duties often included serving at table and announcing guests.
He was dressed in the traditional livery of a household footman.
cn: 男仆为公爵夫人打开了马车门。
在18世纪，男仆的职责通常包括在餐桌旁服务和通报客人到来。
他穿着传统的家仆制服。

definitions.definition: 步法；腿脚动作（尤指体育、舞蹈中的技巧性动作）
基础工作；准备工作（比喻义）

en: The boxer's agile footwork helped him dodge most punches.
Good footwork is essential in ballet dancing.
The success of the project relied on the careful footwork of the planning team.
cn: 这位拳击手灵活的步法帮助他躲过了大部分攻击。
在芭蕾舞中，良好的腿脚动作至关重要。
项目的成功依赖于规划团队细致的基础准备工作。

en: The deer went out to forage in the forest at dusk.
Soldiers foraged the countryside for supplies.
Winter forage is stored in the barn.
cn: 鹿群在黄昏时去森林中觅食。
士兵们在乡村搜寻补给。
冬季饲料储存在谷仓中。

en: The bandits made a foray into the village at night.
She decided to foray into freelance writing after years in finance.
His first foray into politics was unsuccessful but enlightening.
cn: 土匪夜间突袭了村庄。
在金融业工作多年后，她决定尝试自由写作。
他的首次政治尝试虽失败却富有启发性。

en: She had to forbear from expressing her true opinion during the meeting.
The teacher forbore to punish the student, giving him a second chance.
Forbear to judge others until you have all the facts.
cn: 她不得不在会议期间克制自己，不表达真实意见。
老师忍住了没有惩罚学生，给了他第二次机会。
在掌握所有事实之前，请避免评判他人。

en: The castle stood on a forbidding cliff, shrouded in mist.
Her forbidding expression made the children hesitate to approach.
The sign had a forbidding message: "Trespassers will be prosecuted."
cn: 这座城堡矗立在险峻的悬崖上，笼罩在迷雾中。
她严厉的表情让孩子们不敢靠近。
告示牌上写着令人却步的警告："闯入者将依法追究。"

definitions.definition: 钳子，镊子（尤指外科手术或牙科用的器械）

en: The surgeon used forceps to clamp the blood vessel during the operation.
Dental forceps are essential for extracting teeth with precision.
She carefully handled the specimen with forceps to avoid contamination.
cn: 外科医生在手术中用钳子夹住了血管。
牙科镊子对于精准拔牙至关重要。
她用镊子小心地处理标本以避免污染。

en: The police made a forcible entry into the building.
She presented a forcible argument that changed everyone's mind.
Resisting arrest led to his forcible removal from the premises.
cn: 警方强行进入了该建筑。
她提出了一个强有力的论点，改变了所有人的想法。
他拒捕导致被强行带离现场。

en: The dark clouds forebode a storm.
Her silence forebode bad news.
Ancient people believed eclipses foreboded disasters.
cn: 乌云预示着暴风雨将至。
她的沉默预示着坏消息。
古人认为日食预示灾祸。

en: The dark clouds gave a sense of foreboding.
She spoke with a foreboding tone about the upcoming storm.
His silence was filled with foreboding.
cn: 乌云让人产生一种不祥的预感。
她用一种预示不祥的语气谈论即将到来的风暴。
他的沉默中充满了不祥的预兆。

definitions.definition: （建筑物或加油站前的）前院，前庭； （网球场等的）前场

en: The cars were parked in the forecourt of the hotel.
She hit a powerful shot from the forecourt that her opponent couldn't return.
He pulled into the forecourt of the gas station to fill up the tank.
cn: 汽车停放在酒店的前院里。
她在前场打出了一记强有力的击球，让对手无法回击。
他把车开进加油站的前院去加油。

en: She is at the forefront of cancer research.
The new model puts sustainability at the forefront of design.
His ideas brought him to the forefront of the movement.
cn: 她站在癌症研究的最前沿。
这款新模型将可持续性置于设计的核心位置。
他的观点使他成为这场运动的先锋人物。

definitions.definition: 放弃，摒弃（自愿选择不做某事）
在时间或顺序上先于（古义，现代多用 "foregone" 形式）

en: She decided to forego dessert to maintain her diet.
The artist chose to forego traditional techniques in her latest work.
His reputation as a wise leader was foregone by years of poor decisions.
cn: 她决定放弃甜点以保持饮食控制。
这位艺术家在新作中摒弃了传统技法。
他作为明智领导者的声誉被多年的错误决策先行葬送。（古义用例）

definitions.definition: 前景（画面或场景中最靠近观察者的部分）
突出，强调（某事物的重要性）

en: The artist painted vivid flowers in the foreground.
The report foregrounds the impact of climate change.
Keep the main subject in sharp foreground focus.
cn: 画家在前景中绘制了鲜艳的花朵。
报告强调了气候变化的影响。
保持主体在清晰的前景焦点中。

en: His foreknowledge of the market trends made him a successful investor.
The prophet was believed to have foreknowledge of future events.
She claimed no foreknowledge of the plan that was about to unfold.
cn: 他对市场趋势的预知使他成为一名成功的投资者。
这位先知被认为能预知未来事件。
她声称对即将展开的计划并不知情。

definitions.definition: 法庭的；法医的（与法律或科学调查相关）
辩论的；公开演讲的（古义，现较少用）

en: The forensic evidence was crucial in solving the case.
She specializes in forensic psychology.
His forensic skills in debate impressed the audience.
cn: 法医证据对破解此案至关重要。
她专攻司法心理学。
他辩论中的缜密分析能力令观众印象深刻。（古义示例）

en: The invention was a forerunner of modern computers.
Dark clouds are often forerunners of a storm.
He is considered a forerunner in the field of genetic research.
cn: 这项发明是现代计算机的先驱。
乌云通常是暴风雨的前兆。
他被视为基因研究领域的先行者。

definitions.definition: 预示，预兆（通过暗示或线索提前暗示未来事件）

en: The dark clouds foreshadowed an approaching storm.
Her uneasy smile foreshadowed the bad news she was about to deliver.
The protagonist’s nightmare foreshadows the tragic ending of the story.
cn: 乌云预示着暴风雨即将来临。
她不安的微笑预示着她即将宣布的坏消息。
主角的噩梦预兆了故事的悲剧结局。

definitions.definition: 前滩， foreshore（高潮线和低潮线之间的海滨地带）

en: We walked along the foreshore, searching for shells left by the retreating tide.
The foreshore is rich in marine life that adapts to both air and water exposure.
Development on the foreshore is often restricted to protect the coastal environment.
cn: 我们沿着前滩行走，寻找退潮后留下的贝壳。
前滩拥有丰富的海洋生物，它们适应了空气和水的交替暴露。
前滩的开发通常受到限制，以保护海岸环境。

en: The company forestalled competitors by patenting the technology first.
Medieval laws forbade merchants to forestall goods on the road to market.
She forestalled his question by handing him the report directly.
cn: 该公司通过抢先申请专利阻止了竞争对手。
中世纪法律禁止商人在货物运往市场途中垄断囤积。
她直接递给他报告，预先打断了他的提问。

en: The forester patrols the woods to prevent illegal logging.
As a forester, she specializes in sustainable timber harvesting.
The forester identified deer tracks near the riverbank.
cn: 护林员巡视森林以防止非法砍伐。
作为一名林务员，她专攻可持续木材采伐。
护林员在河岸附近发现了鹿的足迹。

en: The sunny morning was a foretaste of the beautiful day to come.
She had a foretaste of success when her first article was published.
The brutal training camp gave him a foretaste of the hardships of military life.
cn: 阳光明媚的早晨预示着接下来美好的一天。
当她的第一篇文章发表时，她提前尝到了成功的滋味。
残酷的训练营让他预先体验了军旅生活的艰辛。

en: With a little forethought, many accidents could be avoided.
Her decision was made with great forethought and care.
The project's success was due to the forethought of its planners.
cn: 稍加事先考虑，许多事故本可以避免。
她的决定是经过深思熟虑和仔细斟酌后做出的。
该项目的成功归功于规划者的深谋远虑。

en: The weather forecast serves to forewarn the public of approaching storms.
I must forewarn you that the path ahead is quite steep and slippery.
His experience forewarned him of the potential risks involved in the investment.
cn: 天气预报用于预先警告公众即将到来的风暴。
我必须事先告诫你，前面的路相当陡峭和湿滑。
他的经验预先警告了他这项投资中存在的潜在风险。

definitions.definition: （因违规、违约等而）丧失的东西；罚金
（因过失、违规等）失去（权利、财产等）

en: He had to pay a forfeit for breaking the rules.
Failure to comply will forfeit your right to appeal.
The team forfeited the match due to insufficient players.
cn: 他因违反规则必须缴纳罚金。
未遵守规定将丧失上诉权。
该队因球员不足而弃赛。

en: The blacksmith will forge a sword from the heated metal.
He was arrested for trying to forge a banknote.
Despite obstacles, the team continued to forge ahead with the project.
cn: 铁匠将用烧红的金属锻造一把剑。
他因试图伪造钞票被捕。
尽管遇到阻碍，团队仍坚定推进项目。

en: The forlorn puppy whimpered at the empty food bowl.
She gave a forlorn glance at the departing train.
Their chances of winning now seem forlorn.
cn: 那只被遗弃的小狗对着空碗呜咽。
她绝望地瞥了一眼远去的火车。
他们现在获胜的希望似乎渺茫。

definitions.definition: 形成的；塑造的（指对发展或性格有深远影响的）
构词的（语言学中指构成新词的词素）

en: The formative years of childhood deeply influence personality development.
"-able" is a formative suffix in English, as seen in "readable".
Her travels had a formative effect on her worldview.
cn: 童年时期的成长阶段深刻影响人格发展。
“-able”是英语中的构词后缀，如“readable”（可读的）。
她的旅行经历塑造了她的世界观。

definitions.definition: 系统阐述；规划；用公式表示

en: Scientists formulated a new theory to explain the phenomenon.
The pharmacist formulated the medicine according to the prescription.
It took months to formulate a response to the complex issue.
cn: 科学家提出新理论来解释这一现象。
药剂师根据处方配制药剂。
针对这一复杂问题，耗时数月才制定出应对方案。

definitions.definition: 配方；制剂（指物质的精确组合）
系统表述；规划（指思想或计划的清晰表达）

en: The new drug formulation passed clinical trials successfully.
His formulation of the policy was praised for its clarity.
The scientist spent years perfecting the formulation of the hypothesis.
cn: 这种新药物配方成功通过了临床试验。
他对政策的系统表述因清晰性而受到赞扬。
这位科学家花了多年时间完善该假设的表述。

definitions.definition: 发生婚前或婚外性行为；私通

en: The religious texts explicitly forbid adherents to fornicate.
In some historical periods, women could be punished severely for fornicating.
The study aimed to understand the social factors that lead young adults to fornicate.
cn: 宗教经文明确禁止信徒发生婚外性行为。
在某些历史时期，女性会因私通而受到严厉惩罚。
这项研究旨在理解导致年轻人发生婚前性行为的社会因素。

en: He vowed never to forsake his principles.
The ancient temple was forsaken for centuries.
She decided to forsake sugar for health reasons.
cn: 他发誓永不背弃自己的原则。
这座古庙被遗弃了数百年。
出于健康考虑，她决定戒糖。

definitions.definition: / adv. （音乐术语）强而有力的（地）

en: Languages were never my forte; I was much better at science subjects.
The pianist played the final movement forte, with great passion.
He turned his hobby into his professional forte.
cn: 语言从来不是我的强项；我更擅长理科科目。
钢琴家以极强的力度，充满激情地演奏了终曲。
他将自己的业余爱好变成了职业专长。

en: She appreciated his forthright opinion during the meeting.
The manager answered the question forthright, without hesitation.
His forthright manner sometimes offends people.
cn: 她在会议上很欣赏他直率的意见。
经理毫不犹豫地直截了当回答了问题。
他直来直往的作风有时会冒犯他人。

en: The judge ordered the defendant to cease operations forthwith.
Upon receiving the alert, the team responded forthwith.
Payment must be made forthwith to avoid additional charges.
cn: 法官命令被告立即停止运营。
接到警报后，团队立即作出了响应。
必须立即付款以避免额外费用。

en: The soldiers worked to fortify the castle walls before the attack.
Eating vitamin-rich foods can help fortify your immune system.
The cereal is fortified with iron and folic acid.
cn: 士兵们在敌军进攻前加固了城堡围墙。
食用富含维生素的食物有助于增强免疫系统。
这种谷物添加了铁和叶酸以强化营养。

definitions.definition: 幸运的（常见但词源学上不严谨的引申义）

en: The discovery of the ancient ruins was entirely fortuitous; they were found during a routine construction project.
cn: 这些古代遗迹的发现纯属偶然；它们是在一次常规施工中被找到的。

definitions.definition: 肮脏的；恶臭的；违反规则的

en: The water in the pond smelled foul.
He fouled his opponent during the match and received a yellow card.
The politician’s reputation was fouled by corruption scandals.
cn: 池塘里的水散发恶臭。
他在比赛中对对手犯规，吃到黄牌。
这位政客的名誉因腐败丑闻而败坏。

en: The library was a fount of knowledge for the eager students.
He is regarded as the fount of all wisdom in this field.
The ancient fount in the village square still provides fresh water.
cn: 这座图书馆是求知若渴的学生们的知识源泉。
他被视为这个领域所有智慧的源泉。
村庄广场上的古老喷泉至今仍提供着清澈的泉水。

en: The fractious child refused to take a nap.
The meeting was delayed by fractious debates.
He became increasingly fractious as the wait dragged on.
cn: 这个脾气暴躁的孩子拒绝午睡。
会议被难以控制的争论拖延了。
随着等待的时间越来越长，他变得愈发易怒。

en: The X-ray revealed a hairline fracture in his wrist.
Extreme pressure can fracture even the strongest materials.
The political scandal fractured public trust in the government.
cn: X光显示他的手腕有一处骨裂。
极大压力甚至能使最坚固的材料断裂。
政治丑闻瓦解了公众对政府的信任。

en: The company expanded rapidly by selling franchises to local entrepreneurs.
In the 19th century, the franchise was limited to male property owners.
She decided to franchise her bakery brand internationally.
cn: 这家公司通过向当地企业家出售特许经营权迅速扩张。
19世纪时，选举权仅限于拥有财产的男性。
她决定在国际上授权她的烘焙品牌特许经营。

definitions.definition: 疯狂的；狂乱的（因极度恐惧或兴奋）
匆忙的；紧张的（形容活动或行为）

en: She made a frantic call to the police after witnessing the accident.
The office was in a frantic rush to meet the deadline.
His frantic gestures showed how desperate he was.
cn: 目睹事故后，她疯狂地打电话报警。
办公室里人们为赶截止日期忙得焦头烂额。
他狂乱的手势暴露了内心的绝望。

definitions.definition: 兄弟的；兄弟般的；友爱的

en: The fraternal bond between the two soldiers was unbreakable.
The organization promotes fraternal cooperation among members.
His tone was warm and fraternal, putting everyone at ease.
cn: 这两位士兵之间的兄弟情谊坚不可摧。
该组织促进成员间的兄弟般合作。
他的语气温暖而友善，让所有人都感到放松。

en: The company was accused of fraudulent advertising.
She gave him a fraudulent smile, hiding her true intentions.
The bank detected fraudulent activity in his account.
cn: 该公司被指控进行欺诈性广告宣传。
她对他露出虚伪的微笑，掩饰真实意图。
银行检测到他账户中的欺诈活动。

definitions.definition: 充满的（通常指负面事物，如紧张、危险等）

en: The meeting was fraught with tension after the disagreement.
His voice was fraught with emotion as he spoke about the past.
cn: 会议在分歧后充满紧张气氛。
他谈及往事时，声音里饱含情绪。

en: The cuffs of his shirt were beginning to fray.
Tempers began to fray as the debate dragged on.
The knight entered the fray without hesitation.
cn: 他的衬衫袖口开始磨损了。
随着辩论持续，情绪逐渐紧张。
骑士毫不犹豫地加入了战斗。

definitions.definition: 怪人；狂热爱好者；反常现象
（非正式）因兴奋或恐惧而失控

en: The two-headed calf was considered a freak of nature.
She's a real music freak—her room is full of vinyl records.
The audience freaked out when the band played their hit song.
cn: 这只双头小牛被视为自然界的反常现象。
她是个真正的音乐狂热爱好者——房间里全是黑胶唱片。
乐队演奏热门歌曲时，观众兴奋得失控了。

en: Her face was covered with cute freckles after summer.
The sun freckled his shoulders during the hike.
Freckles are often genetic but can darken with sun exposure.
cn: 夏日过后，她脸上布满了可爱的雀斑。
徒步时阳光给他的肩膀晒出了斑点。
雀斑通常与遗传有关，但日晒会使其加深。

definitions.definition: 徒手绘制的（不用仪器辅助）

en: She drew the map freehand, without using any tools.
Freehand sketching is an essential skill for artists.
The signature must be written freehand to be valid.
cn: 她徒手绘制了地图，未使用任何工具。
徒手素描是艺术家的必备技能。
签名必须徒手书写才有效。

definitions.definition: 自由职业者；独立工作者

en: She works as a freelance journalist for several magazines.
Many designers choose to freelance after gaining experience.
The company hired a freelance programmer to complete the project.
cn: 她是一名为多家杂志供稿的自由记者。
许多设计师在积累经验后选择从事自由职业。
公司雇佣了一名自由职业程序员来完成项目。

definitions.definition: 飞轮；（自行车的）后链轮活飞
（骑自行车）靠惯性滑行；自由转动；随心所欲地行动

en: The mechanic explained how the freewheel allows the rear wheel to continue turning even when you stop pedaling.
We turned off the engine and freewheeled down the hill to save fuel.
After retiring, he freewheeled through life, taking each day as it came.
cn: 机械师解释了飞轮如何让你停止蹬踏时后轮仍能继续转动。
我们关闭了引擎，靠惯性滑行下山以节省燃料。
退休后，他过着随心所欲的生活，过好每一天。

en: The freighter carried coal from Australia to China.
Modern freighters can transport hundreds of containers at once.
The airline added two new freighters to its fleet.
cn: 这艘货船将煤炭从澳大利亚运往中国。
现代货轮可一次性运输数百个集装箱。
该航空公司新增了两架运输机至其机队。

en: The frenetic pace of city life exhausts many people.
She typed with frenetic energy to meet the deadline.
The concert ended in a frenetic burst of applause.
cn: 城市生活的快节奏让许多人精疲力竭。
她以疯狂的速度打字以赶上截止日期。
音乐会在狂热的掌声中结束。

en: The crowd grew frenzied as the concert reached its climax.
She wrote in a frenzied rush to meet the deadline.
His frenzied laughter unnerved everyone in the room.
cn: 人群在演唱会达到高潮时变得疯狂。
她为了赶截止日期，疯狂地写作。
他狂乱的笑声让房间里所有人都不安。

en: The crowd worked themselves into a frenzy during the concert.
Her sudden outburst was a brief frenzy of anger.
The stock market frenzy caused many inexperienced investors to lose money.
cn: 人群在演唱会中陷入狂热。
她的突然爆发是一阵短暂的愤怒狂乱。
股市的疯狂让许多缺乏经验的投资者亏损。

definitions.definition: 用湿壁画法绘制的作品

en: Michelangelo spent four years painting the Sistine Chapel frescoes.
The artist mastered the challenging technique of true fresco.
Frescoes in Pompeii survived volcanic ash for centuries.
cn: 米开朗基罗花了四年时间绘制西斯廷教堂的湿壁画。
这位艺术家掌握了真正的湿壁画这一高难度技法。
庞贝的湿壁画在火山灰中保存了数个世纪。

definitions.definition: 烦躁；磨损痕迹；（乐器上的）品

en: Constant noise frets my nerves.
The river fretted away the rock over centuries.
Adjust the guitar's frets for better intonation.
cn: 持续的噪音让我神经紧张。
河流经年累月侵蚀着岩石。
调节吉他的品以改善音准。

en: The lack of sleep made the child fretful and prone to crying.
She cast a fretful glance at the darkening sky, worrying about the impending storm.
After hours of waiting in the fretful crowd, his patience was wearing thin.
cn: 睡眠不足让孩子变得烦躁爱哭。
她焦虑地瞥了一眼越来越暗的天空，担心即将来临的暴风雨。
在烦躁的人群中等待了几个小时后，他逐渐失去了耐心。

en: The frigid wind made it impossible to stay outside for long.
She responded with a frigid silence that unnerved everyone.
Scientists study how animals adapt to frigid climates.
cn: 刺骨的寒风让人无法长时间待在户外。
她以冰冷的沉默回应，令所有人不安。
科学家研究动物如何适应极寒气候。

definitions.definition: 装饰性皱边（服装或织物的边缘褶皱装饰）
不必要的装饰；虚饰（比喻义）

en: The dress was adorned with delicate lace frills along the neckline.
cn: 连衣裙的领口装饰着精致的蕾丝皱边。

en: The puppies began to frisk around in the garden after their nap.
The security guard had to frisk the visitor before allowing him into the building.
She frisked about the room, too excited to sit still.
cn: 小狗们小睡后在花园里开始欢快地四处跑跳。
保安必须对这名访客进行搜身后才允许他进入大楼。
她在房间里雀跃不已，兴奋得坐不住。

definitions.definition: 油炸馅饼（尤指水果或肉馅）

en: Don't fritter away your savings on unnecessary gadgets.
She bought a banana fritter from the street vendor.
He tends to fritter his energy on trivial tasks.
cn: 别把积蓄浪费在无用的电子产品上。
她从路边摊买了一份香蕉馅饼。
他总把精力耗费在琐事上。

en: The frivolity of their conversation was a welcome distraction from the serious news.
She was criticized for her frivolity and lack of dedication.
The party was an occasion for pure frivolity and laughter.
cn: 他们谈话的轻浮内容是对严肃新闻的一种受欢迎的调剂。
她因轻浮和缺乏奉献精神而受到批评。
那个派对是一个纯粹为了轻佻和欢笑的场合。

en: She dismissed his argument as a frivolous distraction.
The lawsuit was criticized for being frivolous and wasteful.
He spent money on frivolous luxuries instead of saving.
cn: 她认为他的论点是无谓的干扰，不予理会。
这场诉讼因琐碎且浪费资源而受到批评。
他把钱花在毫无意义的奢侈品上，而不是存起来。

en: The humid weather made her hair frizzy and unmanageable.
He has a head of thick, frizzy hair.
This conditioner is specifically designed to tame frizzy hair.
cn: 潮湿的天气让她的头发变得卷曲蓬乱，难以打理。
他有一头浓密鬈曲的头发。
这款护发素是专门为抚平毛躁卷发而设计的。

definitions.definition: （尤指女性或儿童的）连衣裙；僧袍

en: She wore a cotton frock with floral prints.
The medieval monk's frock was made of coarse wool.
The designer frocked the models in silk for the show.
cn: 她穿了一件印花棉布连衣裙。
中世纪僧侣的长袍由粗羊毛制成。
设计师为秀场模特穿上丝绸长裙（古旧用法）。

definitions.definition: 蛙人（指经过特殊训练、配备潜水装备进行水下作业的人员）

en: The navy frogmen were deployed to inspect the shipwreck.
Equipped with fins and oxygen tanks, the frogman completed the underwater mission.
Frogmen play a crucial role in search and rescue operations at sea.
cn: 海军蛙人被派遣去检查沉船残骸。
这名蛙人配备脚蹼和氧气罐，完成了水下任务。
蛙人在海上搜救行动中发挥着关键作用。

en: The children frolicked in the park on the sunny afternoon.
The party was a frolic of music and laughter.
Her frolic demeanor always brings joy to the team.
cn: 孩子们在阳光明媚的下午在公园里嬉戏。
那次聚会是一场充满了音乐和欢笑的欢乐盛宴。
她活泼欢乐的举止总能给团队带来快乐。

definitions.definition: （建筑物的）临街面，正面；临街土地；前方空地

en: The building has an impressive frontage on the main street.
They paid a premium for the property due to its extensive river frontage.
The shop’s narrow frontage belies its surprising depth.
cn: 该建筑在主街上拥有引人注目的临街立面。
因其广阔的临河地块，他们为这处房产支付了溢价。
店铺狭窄的门面掩盖了其惊人的进深。

definitions.definition: 前面的，正面的（与身体或物体前部相关）
前额的（医学/解剖学专用）
建筑物正面装饰；气象学中的锋面（专业术语）

en: The frontal lobe of the brain controls decision-making.
The cathedral's frontal sculpture depicts biblical scenes.
A frontal attack was launched at dawn.
cn: 大脑额叶负责决策功能。
大教堂的正面雕塑描绘了圣经故事。
黎明时分发动了正面进攻。

en: The climbers suffered from severe frostbite on their fingers and toes.
Exposed skin can be frostbitten in a matter of minutes in the Arctic.
The doctor treated him for frostbite after he was rescued from the mountain.
cn: 登山者们的手指和脚趾出现了严重的冻伤。
在北极，暴露在外的皮肤在几分钟内就可能被冻伤。
他从山上被救下后，医生为他处理了冻伤。

definitions.definition: 泡沫；泡；空谈；浅薄空洞的想法

en: The barista skillfully poured the milk to create a perfect froth on top of the latte.
His promises were just froth, with no real substance or intention behind them.
The rabid dog began to froth at the mouth.
cn: 咖啡师熟练地倒入牛奶，在拿铁咖啡上形成了一层完美的泡沫。
他的承诺只是空谈，背后没有任何实质内容或诚意。
那只疯狗开始口吐白沫。

definitions.definition: 实现，完成（尤指计划或努力的成果）

en: After years of hard work, her dream finally came to fruition.
The project reached fruition ahead of schedule.
cn: 多年努力后，她的梦想终于实现了。
该项目提前完成。

en: She fried the eggs in olive oil.
The fish fry attracted hundreds of visitors.
Tiny fries swam in the shallow stream.
cn: 她用橄榄油煎了鸡蛋。
炸鱼活动吸引了数百名游客。
小鱼苗在浅溪中游动。

en: The strong drink fuddled his mind.
She was in a complete fuddle after the meeting.
Don't fuddle with the instructions—follow them carefully.
cn: 烈酒让他神志不清。
会议结束后她完全晕头转向。
别把说明搞混了，仔细照着做。

definitions.definition: 软糖；胡言乱语；敷衍了事的行为

en: She made a batch of chocolate fudge for the party.
Politicians often fudge the truth to avoid controversy.
His excuse was a complete fudge—no one believed it.
cn: 她为聚会做了一批巧克力软糖。
政客常含糊其辞以回避争议。
他的借口完全是胡扯，没人相信。

en: The police are searching for the fugitive who escaped from prison last night.
Beauty is often fugitive, slipping through our fingers like sand.
The documentary captured the fugitive moments of wildlife in the forest.
cn: 警方正在搜捕昨晚越狱的逃犯。
美往往是短暂的，如沙粒般从指间溜走。
这部纪录片捕捉了森林中野生动物转瞬即逝的瞬间。

definitions.definition: 完全成熟的；全面发展的

en: The garden was full of full-blown roses in summer.
cn: 夏天，花园里盛开着完全绽放的玫瑰。

definitions.definition: 全长度的（如衣服、电影等）
未删节的；完整的（如书籍、录音等）

en: She wore a full-length gown to the gala.
The director released a full-length version of the documentary.
This is his first full-length novel after years of writing short stories.
cn: 她穿着一件拖地长裙出席晚宴。
导演发布了这部纪录片的未删节版。
这是他多年创作短篇小说后的第一部长篇小说。

en: He fumbled with the keys in the dark.
The speaker fumbled through his notes nervously.
A fumble in the last minute cost them the game.
cn: 他在黑暗中笨拙地摸索钥匙。
演讲者紧张地翻找笔记，显得手忙脚乱。
最后一分钟的失误让他们输掉了比赛。

en: The city's iconic funicular climbs the steep hillside to offer breathtaking views.
The old funicular railway has been in operation for over a century.
The mechanics of a funicular involve two counterbalanced cars on a single cable.
cn: 这座城市标志性的缆索铁道攀爬陡峭的山坡，沿途景色令人叹为观止。
这条古老的缆索铁路已经运行了一个多世纪。
缆索铁路的机械原理涉及一辆缆绳上的两个平衡车厢。

definitions.definition: 1. 恐惧，忧虑；2. 抑郁情绪；3. （音乐）放克（一种节奏强烈的黑人音乐）

en: The basement had a damp funk that made her uneasy.
He was in a funk after losing the game.
James Brown is the king of funk music.
cn: 地下室的霉味让她感到不安。
比赛失利后，他情绪低落。
詹姆斯·布朗是放克音乐之王。

definitions.definition: 有强烈气味的（尤指霉味或土腥味）
时髦的，独特的（尤指音乐或风格）

en: This old basement has a funky smell.
Her funky outfit turned heads at the party.
The band played a funky rhythm that got everyone dancing.
cn: 这座老地下室有股霉味。
她时髦的穿搭在派对上引人注目。
乐队演奏了一段动感的节奏，让所有人都跳起舞来。

definitions.definition: 卷起，收拢（旗帜、船帆、雨伞等）

en: The sailor quickly furled the sails before the storm hit.
Please furl the umbrella before bringing it inside.
The flag was furled and stored away at sunset.
cn: 在风暴来临前，水手迅速卷起了船帆。
请把伞收拢后再带进屋。
日落时，旗帜被卷起收好。

definitions.definition: 衬有毛皮的；有毛皮内衬的

en: She wore a luxurious, fur-lined coat to brave the Arctic cold.
cn: 她穿了一件奢华衬毛皮的大衣来抵御北极的严寒。

en: The apartment comes with basic furnishings, including a bed and a sofa.
She specializes in antique furnishings for historic homes.
The hotel’s luxurious furnishings impressed all the guests.
cn: 公寓配备基本家具，包括一张床和沙发。
她专长为历史住宅搭配古董陈设。
酒店豪华的装饰给所有客人留下深刻印象。

en: The furrier showed us a collection of exquisite mink coats.
His grandfather was a furrier who specialized in fox furs.
She apprenticed with a master furrier to learn the craft.
cn: 这位皮草商向我们展示了一系列精美的貂皮大衣。
他的祖父是一位专门加工狐狸毛皮的皮草匠。
她师从一位皮草大师学习这门手艺。

en: The farmer plowed deep furrows into the field.
Anxiety furrowed her brow as she waited for the news.
Old age had furrowed his face with wrinkles.
cn: 农夫在田里犁出深深的沟垄。
等待消息时，焦虑让她皱起眉头。
岁月在他脸上刻下了皱纹。

definitions.definition: 偷偷摸摸的；鬼鬼祟祟的

en: He cast a furtive glance at the documents on her desk.
The thief moved with furtive steps through the dark alley.
Their furtive meeting suggested a secret agreement.
cn: 他偷偷瞥了一眼她桌上的文件。
小偷鬼鬼祟祟地穿过黑暗的小巷。
他们隐秘的会面暗示着某种秘密协议。

en: The fuse blew when the circuit was overloaded.
The two companies plan to fuse their resources for the project.
Heat caused the metals to fuse into a single alloy.
cn: 电路过载时保险丝熔断了。
两家公司计划合并资源完成该项目。
高温使金属熔合成一种合金。

en: He realized the futility of trying to change her mind.
The debate descended into futility after hours of circular arguments.
History is full of stories about the futility of war.
cn: 他意识到试图改变她的想法是徒劳的。
数小时循环辩论后，讨论陷入了无意义的僵局。
历史充满了关于战争徒劳性的故事。

definitions.definition: 未来主义的；超前的；极具未来感的

en: The architect designed a futuristic building with solar-paneled walls.
Her ideas about AI were considered futuristic in the 1990s.
The car’s sleek, futuristic appearance drew crowds at the exhibition.
cn: 这位建筑师设计了一栋覆盖太阳能板的未来主义建筑。
她关于人工智能的构想在上世纪90年代被视为极具前瞻性。
这款车流线型的未来感外观在展览会上吸引了大量观众。

definitions.definition: 绒毛，细毛；模糊不清的事物

en: The peach skin was covered in soft fuzz.
The photo turned out fuzzy because the camera shook.
My brain feels like fuzz after studying all night.
cn: 桃子的表皮覆着一层柔软的绒毛。
由于相机抖动，照片变得模糊。
通宵学习后，我的脑子像一团浆糊。

definitions.definition: 毛茸茸的；模糊的；不清楚的

en: The peach has a fuzzy skin.
My memory of the event is fuzzy.
The photo turned out fuzzy because the camera shook.
cn: 桃子的表皮毛茸茸的。
我对那件事的记忆很模糊。
由于相机抖动，照片拍模糊了。

definitions.definition: 急促不清地说话，叽里咕噜地说

en: The excited children began to gabble about their day at the zoo.
He gabbled his apologies so quickly that no one could understand him.
The announcer's gabble was incomprehensible over the poor radio connection.
cn: 兴奋的孩子们开始叽里呱啦地讲述他们在动物园的一天。
他急促地嘟囔着道歉，快得没人能听懂。
由于无线电连接状况很差，播音员急促的播报变得无法理解。

en: The old house featured ornate carvings on its gable.
The steep gable of the cathedral was visible above the rooftops.
They decided to add a window to the gable end of the attic.
cn: 老房子的山墙上装饰着华丽的雕刻。
大教堂高耸的山墙在屋顶之上清晰可见。
他们决定在阁楼的三角墙一端加一扇窗户。

en: The kidnappers used a cloth to gag the victim.
The new law is seen as a gag on free speech.
His awful joke made me gag.
cn: 绑匪用布堵住了受害者的嘴。
这项新法律被视为对言论自由的压制。
他的烂笑话让我作呕。

definitions.definition: 庆祝活动；欢乐的场合（多用于复数形式 gaieties）

en: The decorations added a sense of gaiety to the room.
Her infectious gaiety lifted everyone's spirits.
The festival is a time of gaiety and celebration.
cn: 装饰给房间增添了一种欢乐的气氛。
她那富有感染力的快乐情绪鼓舞了每个人的精神。
这个节日是一个充满欢乐和庆祝的时刻。

definitions.definition: 盛大的庆祝活动；节日庆典

en: The museum held a gala to celebrate its 100th anniversary.
She wore a diamond necklace to the charity gala.
The film festival's opening gala attracted international stars.
cn: 博物馆举办了一场庆典以纪念其成立100周年。
她戴着钻石项链出席慈善晚宴。
电影节开幕盛会吸引了国际明星。

definitions.definition: 时髦绅士；对女性献殷勤的男子

en: The gallant knight rescued the villagers from the dragon.
He was always gallant, holding doors for ladies and praising their beauty.
Despite his age, the old captain remained a gallant figure at sea.
cn: 那位英勇的骑士从恶龙手中救出了村民。
他总是殷勤周到，为女士们开门并赞美她们的美貌。
尽管年迈，这位老船长在海上仍是个英勇的人物。

en: The speech galvanized the crowd into action.
These steel pipes are galvanized to prevent rust.
A crisis can galvanize people to work together.
cn: 演讲激励人群采取行动。
这些钢管经过镀锌防锈处理。
危机能促使人们团结协作。

definitions.definition: （国际象棋）开局让子法；策略性开局
（引申）精心策划的策略或行动

en: His opening gambit in the negotiation was to concede a minor point.
The politician’s speech was a clever gambit to gain public sympathy.
In chess, the Queen’s Gambit involves sacrificing a pawn for control of the center.
cn: 他在谈判中的开局策略是让步一个小点。
这位政治家的演讲是博取公众同情的巧妙策略。
国际象棋中，“后翼弃兵”通过牺牲兵来掌控中心。

en: The child gaped at the towering dinosaur skeleton.
A deep gape in the earth appeared after the earthquake.
His speech left the audience gaping in disbelief.
cn: 孩子目瞪口呆地盯着巨大的恐龙骨架。
地震后地面上出现了一道深深的裂缝。
他的演讲让观众不可置信地张大了嘴。

en: She wore a garland of roses in her hair.
The poet was garlanded with awards for his work.
Ancient Greeks garlanded statues of gods during festivals.
cn: 她头发上戴着一个玫瑰花环。
这位诗人因其作品被授予多项荣誉。
古希腊人在节日期间用花环装饰神像。

en: The doctor suspected a gastric ulcer after reviewing the symptoms.
Gastric bypass surgery can help with severe obesity.
Spicy foods may increase gastric discomfort in some people.
cn: 医生检查症状后怀疑是胃溃疡。
胃绕道手术可辅助治疗严重肥胖症。
辛辣食物可能加剧某些人的胃部不适。

en: The patient was diagnosed with gastritis after experiencing persistent stomach pain.
Excessive alcohol consumption can lead to acute gastritis.
Treatment for gastritis often includes dietary changes and medication to reduce stomach acid.
cn: 在经历持续性胃痛后，病人被诊断患有胃炎。
过量饮酒可能导致急性胃炎。
胃炎的治疗通常包括改变饮食和服用减少胃酸的药物。

definitions.definition: 测量标准；计量器；厚度/直径

en: The fuel gauge shows the tank is almost empty.
It’s difficult to gauge her true feelings.
This wire has a 12-gauge thickness.
cn: 燃油表显示油箱几乎空了。
很难揣测她的真实感受。
这根电线的直径为12号规格。

definitions.definition: 憔悴的，瘦削的（尤指因疾病或饥饿）
荒凉的，贫瘠的（形容地方）

en: His face looked gaunt after weeks of illness.
The gaunt landscape was stripped of all vegetation.
She stared at her gaunt reflection in the mirror.
cn: 数周病痛后，他的面容显得憔悴。
这片荒凉的地区寸草不生。
她凝视着镜中瘦削的自己。

definitions.definition: 公报；报纸（尤用于报刊名称）
在公报上公布；正式公告

en: The government announcement was published in the official gazette.
She was gazetted as the new ambassador to France.
I read about the new regulations in the London Gazette.
cn: 这项政府公告已在官方公报上发布。
她被正式公告任命为新任驻法国大使。
我在《伦敦公报》上读到了新法规。

en: The mechanic is installing a new gearbox in the car.
A faulty gearbox can cause serious problems with shifting gears.
The electric vehicle's gearbox is much simpler than that of a traditional combustion engine car.
cn: 机械师正在给汽车安装一个新的变速箱。
有故障的变速箱会导致换挡出现严重问题。
电动汽车的变速箱比传统内燃机汽车的要简单得多。

en: Wind turbines generate electricity from wind power.
The discussion generated many innovative ideas.
Some animals generate offspring rapidly in favorable conditions.
cn: 风力涡轮机通过风能发电。
这次讨论催生了许多创新想法。
某些动物在适宜环境下繁殖迅速。

definitions.definition: 有生产能力的；能生成的

en: Generative AI systems can create original text and images.
Chomsky's theory of generative grammar revolutionized linguistics.
The artist's generative process involves combining multiple cultural influences.
cn: 生成式人工智能系统能创造原创文本和图像。
乔姆斯基的生成语法理论革新了语言学。
这位艺术家的创作过程融合了多种文化影响。

definitions.definition: 通用的；非特定的；类属的

en: The store sells both brand-name and generic medicines.
His speech was full of generic phrases without concrete solutions.
In biology, "homo sapiens" is the generic term for humans.
cn: 这家商店销售品牌药和非专利药。
他的演讲充满空泛的套话，缺乏具体解决方案。
在生物学中，“智人”是对人类的统称。

en: The discovery of DNA marked a new genesis in genetic research.
The artist’s sketchbook reveals the genesis of her famous painting.
"Genesis" describes the creation of the world in seven days.
cn: DNA的发现标志着遗传学研究的新开端。
艺术家的素描本揭示了她那幅名画的创作起源。
《创世纪》描述了世界在七日内的创造过程。

en: The host gave us a genial welcome.
The island enjoys a genial climate year-round.
His genial manner made everyone feel at ease.
cn: 主人热情地欢迎了我们。
这座岛屿全年气候宜人。
他和蔼的态度让所有人都感到放松。

definitions.definition: 文雅的，有教养的（尤指刻意表现的上流社会举止）
过分讲究的，矫揉造作的（含贬义）

en: She spoke in a genteel accent, though her hands betrayed years of labor.
cn: 她说话带着刻意优雅的口音，但双手暴露了多年的劳作痕迹。

definitions.definition: 文雅，彬彬有礼；上流社会，有教养的阶层

en: She possessed a natural gentility that put everyone at ease.
In bygone eras, gentility was often associated with land ownership and family lineage.
His manners were an affected gentility, lacking in genuine warmth.
cn: 她有一种与生俱来的优雅，能让每个人都感到放松。
在过去，上流社会身份常与土地所有权和家族血统相联系。
他的举止是一种矫揉造作的文雅，缺乏真正的热情。

en: The seeds will germinate faster in warm, moist soil.
His idea began to germinate during the long research process.
Farmers soak the beans to germinate them before planting.
cn: 温暖潮湿的土壤中种子会更快发芽。
在漫长的研究过程中，他的想法开始萌芽。
农民在种植前浸泡豆子以促使其发芽。

en: She gesticulated wildly to get their attention across the noisy room.
The tour guide gesticulated towards the ancient monument while explaining its history.
He gesticulates so much when he talks that it almost seems like a performance.
cn: 在嘈杂的房间里，她疯狂地做手势以引起他们的注意。
导游在解释历史时，用手势指向那座古老的纪念碑。
他说话时手势如此之多，几乎像一场表演。

en: The ghastly sight of the accident left everyone in shock.
Her face turned ghastly pale when she heard the news.
The old house had a ghastly atmosphere, as if haunted.
cn: 事故的可怕景象让所有人震惊不已。
听到消息时，她的脸色变得惨白。
老房子笼罩着阴森的气氛，仿佛闹鬼一般。

definitions.definition: 急促而不清楚地说话；叽里咕噜地说
急促不清的话；胡言乱语

en: The feverish patient began to gibber incoherently.
It's hard to take advice seriously when it sounds like gibber.
They were gibbering with fear after watching the horror movie.
cn: 发烧的病人开始语无伦次地胡言乱语。
当建议听起来像胡言乱语时，很难认真对待。
看完恐怖片后，他们吓得叽里咕噜地说话。

definitions.definition: 莫名其妙的话；胡言乱语；叽里咕噜

en: He was so nervous that he started speaking complete gibberish during the presentation.
The technical document was full of jargon and sounded like gibberish to me.
Don't talk gibberish; explain your idea clearly.
cn: 他紧张极了，在演示过程中开始语无伦次，完全是在胡言乱语。
这份技术文件充满了行话，在我听来就像天书一样。
别说些莫名其妙的话，把你的想法解释清楚。

definitions.definition: 长臂猿（一种体型较小的猿，主要分布于东南亚）

en: The hiker was delighted to spot a family of gibbons swinging through the treetops.
Gibbons are known for their incredibly long arms and loud, melodious calls.
Conservation efforts are crucial to protect the natural habitats of the gibbon.
cn: 徒步旅行者高兴地发现了一家长臂猿在树梢间荡悠。
长臂猿以其极长的手臂和响亮、悦耳的叫声而闻名。
保护工作对于保护长臂猿的自然栖息地至关重要。

en: The spinning ride made her feel giddy.
He was giddy with excitement before the concert.
Their giddy laughter filled the room.
cn: 旋转游乐设施让她头晕目眩。
音乐会前，他兴奋得忘乎所以。
他们轻浮的笑声充满了房间。

definitions.definition: 菌褶（蘑菇下方的片状结构）

en: The fish gasped for air, its gills flaring red.
Carefully examine the gills under the mushroom cap to identify the species.
Add two gills of water to the mixture for proper consistency.
cn: 鱼喘息着，鳃部张开发红。
仔细检查蘑菇菌盖下的菌褶以辨别种类。
加入两吉耳水以使混合物达到适当稠度。

definitions.definition: 噱头；花招（用于吸引注意的巧妙设计或伎俩）
用花招装饰；使带有噱头

en: The product's packaging is just a marketing gimmick.
He gimmicked his presentation with flashy animations.
Don't fall for that old gimmick – it's a scam.
cn: 这款产品的包装不过是营销噱头。
他用花哨的动画给演示加了噱头。
别上那个老套花招的当，那是骗局。

en: The steel girders of the new bridge were hoisted into place by a massive crane.
Engineers are inspecting the main girder for any signs of stress or fatigue.
The collapse was caused by a crack in a critical girder that had gone unnoticed.
cn: 新桥的钢梁由一台巨型起重机吊装到位。
工程师正在检查主梁是否有任何应力或疲劳迹象。
倒塌是由于一根关键大梁上一条未被注意的裂缝造成的。

en: She wore a silver girdle around her waist.
The mountains girdle the valley like a protective barrier.
The old oak tree was girdled by vines.
cn: 她腰间系着一条银色腰带。
群山环绕山谷，如同保护的屏障。
老橡树被藤蔓缠绕。

en: The glacial landscape was breathtakingly beautiful.
She gave him a glacial stare, making him uneasy.
Progress on the project has been glacial due to bureaucracy.
cn: 冰川景观美得令人窒息。
她冷冷地瞪了他一眼，让他感到不安。
由于官僚主义，项目进展极其缓慢。

en: The gladiator raised his sword to the cheering crowd.
The film depicts the life of a famous Roman gladiator.
He entered the political debate like a verbal gladiator.
cn: 角斗士向欢呼的人群举起了他的剑。
这部电影描绘了一位著名罗马角斗士的一生。
他像一位言语上的角斗士般加入了那场政治辩论。

en: The potter glazed the vase to give it a shiny finish.
A thin glaze of ice covered the sidewalk.
Her eyes glazed over with boredom during the lecture.
cn: 陶工给花瓶上釉，使其表面光亮。
人行道上覆盖着一层薄冰。
讲座期间，她的眼神因无聊而变得呆滞。

definitions.definition: 收集（信息、知识等碎片化内容）
拾取（田间收割后遗留的谷物）

en: She gleaned important data from old archives.
Farmers allowed the poor to glean wheat from their fields.
His report gleans insights from diverse sources.
cn: 她从旧档案中搜集到重要数据。
农民允许穷人在田里拾麦穗。
他的报告从多种来源中提炼出见解。

definitions.definition: 欢欣，快乐（尤指因他人不幸而生的幸灾乐祸或单纯的喜悦）

en: The children shouted with glee when they saw the ice cream truck.
Her face lit up with glee as she unwrapped the gift.
cn: 孩子们看到冰淇淋车时欢呼雀跃。
她拆礼物时脸上洋溢着喜悦。

definitions.definition: 幸灾乐祸；得意洋洋地注视
幸灾乐祸的表情或态度

en: He couldn't help but gloat over his rival's failure.
Her gloating smile revealed her true feelings.
It's unkind to gloat when someone makes a mistake.
cn: 他忍不住对竞争对手的失败幸灾乐祸。
她得意的笑容暴露了真实情绪。
在别人犯错时幸灾乐祸是不友善的。

en: The table had a high gloss finish.
She added a gloss to the difficult text.
He tried to gloss over his mistakes.
cn: 桌子表面有高光泽度。
她为晦涩的文本添加了注释。
他试图掩饰自己的错误。

definitions.definition: 术语表（特定领域或文本中的词汇解释集合）

en: The textbook includes a glossary of technical terms.
Check the glossary if you encounter unfamiliar words.
She compiled a glossary for her research paper.
cn: 教科书附有一份技术术语表。
遇到不熟悉的词汇时查阅术语表。
她为研究论文编写了术语表。

definitions.definition: 闷闷不乐的，忧郁的，阴郁的

en: He grew increasingly glum as the results came in.
The team was glum after their devastating loss.
She gave a glum look when she heard the news.
cn: 随着结果公布，他变得越来越闷闷不乐。
球队在遭遇惨败后情绪低落。
听到这个消息时，她露出了忧郁的神情。

definitions.definition: 对…入迷的人，酷爱…的人 (常与 for 搭配)

en: He was a glutton who could finish an entire pizza by himself.
She is a glutton for hard work and never shies away from a challenge.
The documentary exposed the gluttonous consumption habits of modern society.
cn: 他是一个饕餮之徒，能独自吃完一整张披萨。
她是个酷爱努力工作的人，从不回避挑战。
这部纪录片揭露了现代社会暴饮暴食的消费习惯。

en: The old oak tree had a gnarled trunk covered in moss.
Her gnarled hands told a lifetime of hard work.
He carved a walking stick from a gnarled branch.
cn: 那棵老橡树的树干扭曲多节，布满苔藓。
她粗糙变形的手诉说着一生的辛劳。
他用一根扭曲的树枝雕了一根手杖。

en: The turkey gobbled loudly in the farmyard.
He gobbled down his sandwich in two bites.
The sound of gobbling echoed through the woods during mating season.
cn: 火鸡在农院里大声咯咯叫。
他两口就狼吞虎咽地吃完了三明治。
交配季节，火鸡的咯咯声在树林中回荡。

en: The tourists goggled at the extravagant display of wealth.
You must wear safety goggles in the chemistry lab.
The frog's goggle eyes seemed to observe everything around the pond.
cn: 游客们瞪大眼睛看着这奢华的财富展示。
在化学实验室里必须佩戴安全护目镜。
青蛙凸出的眼睛仿佛在观察池塘周围的一切。

definitions.definition: 好吃的小零食；糖果；好极了（表示高兴的感叹词）
（小说、电影中）正面人物，好人（常带贬义）

en: The children were excited to get some goodies after the party.
"Goody! We're going to the zoo tomorrow!" she exclaimed.
He always plays the goody in his films, which can seem a bit predictable.
cn: 孩子们很高兴在派对后得到了一些糖果。
“太好了！我们明天要去动物园了！”她欢呼道。
他在电影里总是扮演老好人，这似乎有点 predictable（可预测）。

en: The hikers stood at the edge of the deep gorge, marveling at its beauty.
He gorged himself on pizza during the party.
Her necklace rested lightly on her gorge.
cn: 徒步者站在深邃的峡谷边缘，惊叹其壮丽。
他在派对上狼吞虎咽地吃披萨。
项链轻轻垂在她的颈前。

definitions.definition: 福音（基督教教义的核心内容）

en: The gospel of Matthew is one of the four canonical Gospels.
He preached the gospel of environmental sustainability.
Her words were taken as gospel by her followers.
cn: 《马太福音》是四部正典福音书之一。
他宣扬环境可持续性的信条。
她的话被追随者视为绝对真理。

definitions.definition: （在公共墙壁等表面涂画的）涂鸦（通常含艺术或反叛意味）

en: The subway walls are covered with colorful graffiti.
Some consider graffiti vandalism, while others see it as urban art.
Ancient Roman graffiti reveals daily life in Pompeii.
cn: 地铁墙上布满彩色涂鸦。
有人视涂鸦为破坏公物，也有人认为它是城市艺术。
古罗马涂鸦揭示了庞贝城的日常生活。

en: The gardener grafted a rose onto a wild rootstock.
Corruption cases often involve graft by public officials.
He was accused of grafting funds from the project.
cn: 园丁将玫瑰嫁接在野生根茎上。
腐败案件常涉及公务员的受贿行为。
他被指控挪用项目资金。

en: The grandeur of the ancient cathedral took our breath away.
She carried herself with natural grandeur.
The film captures the grandeur of the Himalayan landscape.
cn: 这座古老教堂的宏伟令我们惊叹不已。
她举止间流露出天然的尊贵气质。
这部电影捕捉到了喜马拉雅山脉的壮丽景色。

definitions.definition: 宏伟的，壮丽的（常含夸张或浮夸之意）
自命不凡的，华而不实的

en: The dictator built grandiose monuments to glorify his regime.
Her speech was full of grandiose promises but no concrete plans.
The hotel lobby impressed visitors with its grandiose chandeliers.
cn: 这位独裁者建造了宏伟的纪念碑来美化他的政权。
她的演讲充满浮夸的承诺，却无具体计划。
酒店大堂以其华丽的枝形吊灯令访客惊叹。

definitions.definition: 颗粒状的；由颗粒构成的
细致入微的；详尽的（引申义）

en: The sand felt granular under my feet.
She provided a granular analysis of the market trends.
This sugar is more granular than the powdered kind.
cn: 我脚下的沙子摸起来是颗粒状的。
她对市场趋势进行了极其详尽的分析。
这种糖比粉状的那种颗粒更粗。

en: The sugar dissolved, leaving no granules visible.
Sand granules stuck to her wet feet.
Under the microscope, pollen appears as tiny granules.
cn: 糖溶解后，看不到任何颗粒。
沙粒粘在她潮湿的脚上。
显微镜下，花粉呈现为微小颗粒。

definitions.definition: /vi. 扭打；搏斗；努力解决（问题）

en: The climbers used grappling hooks to scale the icy cliff.
Politicians continue to grapple with the economic crisis.
The wrestlers grappled fiercely in the ring.
cn: 登山者用抓钩攀爬结冰的悬崖。
政客们仍在努力应对经济危机。
摔跤手在擂台上激烈扭打。

en: The fire crackled in the grate.
Grate the cheese finely before sprinkling it on the pasta.
His constant whining began to grate on her nerves.
cn: 炉火在壁炉栅栏里噼啪作响。
将奶酪磨碎后撒在意面上。
他不停的抱怨开始让她心烦意乱。

en: The teacher's praise gratified the student's efforts.
A good meal can gratify both hunger and the soul.
Companies use bonuses to gratify employees' desire for recognition.
cn: 老师的表扬让学生感到自己的努力得到了认可。
一顿美餐既能满足饥饿，也能愉悦心灵。
企业用奖金来满足员工对认可的渴望。

en: The film was criticized for its gratuitous use of special effects.
He offered gratuitous advice despite knowing nothing about the situation.
The charity provides gratuitous meals to the homeless.
cn: 这部电影因滥用特效而受到批评。
他对情况一无所知，却给出了毫无必要的建议。
该慈善机构为无家可归者提供免费餐食。

en: The path was covered with loose gravel.
They decided to gravel the driveway for better drainage.
Gravel crunched under our boots as we walked.
cn: 小路铺满了松散的砾石。
他们决定用砾石铺车道以改善排水。
我们行走时，靴子下的砾石嘎吱作响。

definitions.definition: 倾向于（某种状态或行为）

en: Objects in space gravitate toward larger celestial bodies.
She tends to gravitate to creative people.
The discussion gravitated toward environmental issues.
cn: 太空中的物体会被更大的天体吸引。
她总容易被有创造力的人吸引。
讨论逐渐转向了环境问题。

en: She was a gregarious child who loved team sports.
Dolphins are highly gregarious animals.
The plant grows in gregarious clusters on rocky slopes.
cn: 她是个热爱团体运动的合群孩子。
海豚是高度群居的动物。
这种植物在岩石坡上成簇生长。

en: The city streets were laid out in a perfect grid.
The power grid failed during the storm.
Use the grid to align the text and images.
cn: 城市街道按完美的网格布局铺设。
暴风雨期间电网瘫痪了。
用网格对齐文本和图片。

definitions.definition: 申诉，投诉（法律或职场语境）

en: The employee filed a grievance about unfair treatment.
His voice trembled with grievance as he told the story.
The union negotiated to address workers' grievances.
cn: 该员工就不公平待遇提出了申诉。
他讲述时声音因委屈而颤抖。
工会通过谈判解决工人的不满。

definitions.definition: 极其严重的；引起痛苦的；充满悲伤的

en: The general sustained a grievous wound in the battle.
The decision to close the factory will have grievous consequences for the entire community.
She let out a grievous sigh upon hearing the tragic news.
cn: 将军在战斗中受了重伤。
关闭工厂的决定将对整个社区造成严重的后果。
听到这个悲惨的消息，她发出了一个悲伤的叹息。

en: She always finds something to gripe about.
The team griped over the unfair rules.
cn: 她总能找到抱怨的事情。
团队对不公平的规则牢骚不断。

definitions.definition: 恐怖的，可怕的（尤指与死亡或暴力相关）

en: The detective uncovered a grisly scene in the abandoned house.
She told a grisly ghost story that made everyone shudder.
The movie's grisly special effects were too intense for some viewers.
cn: 侦探在废弃房屋中发现了一幕可怕的场景。
她讲了一个令人毛骨悚然的鬼故事，让所有人不寒而栗。
这部电影恐怖的特效对一些观众来说过于刺激。

definitions.definition: 怪诞的，奇形怪状的（形容事物扭曲或不自然）

en: The building was adorned with grotesque carvings of mythical creatures.
His grotesque exaggerations made the story unbelievable.
The play’s grotesque humor left the audience both shocked and amused.
cn: 这座建筑装饰着神话生物的怪诞雕刻。
他夸张到荒诞的叙述让故事显得不可信。
这部剧的诡异幽默让观众既震惊又忍俊不禁。

definitions.definition: 基础训练；基础知识（尤指某领域的系统性学习）

en: The course provides a solid grounding in mathematics.
Proper grounding is essential for electrical safety.
Her grounding in classical music helped her innovate in jazz.
cn: 这门课程提供扎实的数学基础训练。
正确的接地对用电安全至关重要。
她的古典音乐基础助力她在爵士乐中创新。

en: We picnicked in a shady grove near the river.
The house was hidden behind a grove of oak trees.
Ancient druids worshipped in sacred groves.
cn: 我们在河边一片荫凉的小树林里野餐。
房子隐藏在一片橡树林后面。
古德鲁伊教徒在神圣的树丛中祭祀。

definitions.definition: 匍匐，趴伏（尤指表示屈服或乞求）

en: The prisoners were forced to grovel in the dirt before the emperor.
He refused to grovel for forgiveness, even if it meant losing his job.
I won't grovel just to get a promotion; I believe in earning it with merit.
cn: 囚犯们被迫在皇帝面前的泥土中匍匐跪拜。
他拒绝卑躬屈膝地乞求原谅，即使这意味着他会失去工作。
我不会为了升职而奴颜婢膝，我相信要靠实力赢得它。

definitions.definition: 令人厌恶的；恐怖的（尤指与死亡或暴力相关）

en: The detective uncovered a gruesome crime scene.
Fairy tales often contain gruesome details to warn children.
His injuries were too gruesome to describe.
cn: 侦探发现了一处恐怖的犯罪现场。
童话常包含骇人细节以警示儿童。
他的伤势可怕到难以描述。

en: His gruff voice made the children nervous.
Despite his gruff manner, he was kind at heart.
The guard gave a gruff reply and turned away.
cn: 他粗哑的嗓音让孩子们紧张。
尽管态度生硬，他内心很善良。
守卫生硬地回了一句便转身离开。

en: The grumpy old man shouted at the kids playing outside.
She’s always grumpy before her morning coffee.
Don’t be grumpy—it’s just a minor mistake.
cn: 那个脾气暴躁的老人朝外面玩耍的孩子大喊。
她早上喝咖啡前总是脾气很差。
别生气了，只是个小错误。

en: The thief entered the mansion in the guise of a delivery man.
Her kindness was merely a guise to gain people’s trust.
The festival celebrates cultural traditions in a modern guise.
cn: 小偷伪装成送货员进入豪宅。
她的友善只是获取人们信任的伪装。
这个节日以现代形式庆祝文化传统。

en: The stream gurgled merrily over the rocks.
The baby let out a happy gurgle when she saw her toy.
I could hear the water gurgling in the pipes.
cn: 小溪欢快地从岩石上潺潺流过。
看到玩具时，宝宝发出了开心的咯咯笑声。
我能听到水管里的水汩汩作响。

definitions.definition: 导师（尤指精神或宗教领域的权威）

en: He is regarded as a marketing guru in the tech industry.
The yoga guru shared ancient wisdom with his disciples.
She became a fitness guru after publishing her best-selling book.
cn: 他被视为科技行业的营销大师。
这位瑜伽导师向弟子传授古老的智慧。
她在出版畅销书后成为健身领域的权威。

definitions.definition: 涌出物；热情洋溢的表达

en: Water gushed from the broken pipe.
She gushed about her favorite book for hours.
The oil gush caused an environmental disaster.
cn: 水从破裂的管道中喷涌而出。
她滔滔不绝地赞美她最喜欢的书，说了几个小时。
石油喷涌引发了环境灾难。

en: She sang the aria with great gusto.
The children ate the cake with gusto.
His gusto for life inspired everyone around him.
cn: 她热情洋溢地演唱了咏叹调。
孩子们津津有味地吃蛋糕。
他对生活的热忱感染了身边所有人。

definitions.definition: 喉的；喉部发出的；（声音）粗哑的，低沉的

en: The actor's guttural voice gave his villainous character a menacing quality.
Some languages, like Arabic or German, contain distinct guttural consonants.
He let out a guttural cry of pain when he injured his hand.
cn: 这位演员粗哑的嗓音为他饰演的反派角色增添了一种威胁感。
一些语言，如阿拉伯语或德语，包含独特的喉辅音。
他手受伤时，发出了一声低沉的痛苦喊叫。

en: He was a habitué of the local library, spending every afternoon there.
The café was filled with its usual habitués, discussing art and politics.
As a habitué of the jazz club, she knew all the musicians by name.
cn: 他是当地图书馆的常客，每天下午都在那里度过。
咖啡馆里坐满了常客，他们正在讨论艺术和政治。
作为这家爵士俱乐部的熟客，她知道所有音乐家的名字。

definitions.definition: 砍，劈；非法侵入（计算机系统）
雇佣文人；蹩脚作家；计算机黑客

en: He hacked at the branches with an old axe.
The system was hacked by an anonymous group.
She’s just a hack writer churning out romance novels.
cn: 他用一把旧斧头砍树枝。
该系统被匿名组织入侵。
她只是个批量生产爱情小说的蹩脚作家。

definitions.definition: （雄禽颈部的）细长羽毛；针排，梳麻垫

en: The fighting cock had its hackles raised, making it look larger and more aggressive.
Before spinning, the flax fibers were carefully hackled to remove any impurities.
Her criticism made his hackles rise immediately.
cn: 那只斗鸡颈羽倒竖，显得更大、更具攻击性。
在纺线之前，亚麻纤维被仔细梳理以去除所有杂质。
她的批评立刻让他怒发冲冠（字面：颈毛倒竖）。

definitions.definition: 陈腐的，老套的（指想法、表达方式等因过度使用而失去新意和影响力）

en: The speech was full of hackneyed phrases and empty promises.
I'm tired of reading hackneyed plots in romantic novels.
To avoid sounding hackneyed, try to express your ideas in a fresh and original way.
cn: 这篇演讲充满了陈词滥调和空洞的承诺。
我已经厌倦了阅读浪漫小说中那些老套的情节。
为了避免听起来陈腐，试着用新颖、原创的方式表达你的想法。

definitions.definition: 弓锯，钢锯（一种用于切割金属的手锯）

en: The mechanic reached for a hacksaw to cut through the rusty bolt.
For this project, you will need a hacksaw with a fine-toothed blade.
He carefully made the cut using a hacksaw, ensuring the edge was straight.
cn: 机械师伸手去拿一把钢锯来锯断生锈的螺栓。
这个项目你需要一把细齿的钢锯。
他使用钢锯仔细地进行切割，以确保边缘笔直。

en: The children were frightened by the story of the old hag who lived in the woods.
In the fairy tale, the hero had to outsmart the cunning hag to rescue the princess.
The mist rose from the hag, giving the landscape an eerie atmosphere.
cn: 孩子们被那个住在森林里的老巫婆的故事吓坏了。
在童话故事里，英雄必须智取狡猾的女巫才能救出公主。
薄雾从沼泽地升起，给这片景色增添了一种怪异的气氛。

definitions.definition: （因疲惫、焦虑、生病而）憔悴的，形容枯槁的
（鹰）成年后被捕获的，野性难驯的

en: After weeks of caring for the sick child, she looked haggard and worn.
The haggard faces of the refugees told a story of immense suffering.
He was a haggard man, aged beyond his years by worry and stress.
cn: 在照顾生病的孩子几周后，她看起来憔悴不堪。
难民们憔悴的面容诉说着他们所经历的巨大痛苦。
他是一个面容憔悴的男人，忧虑和压力让他显得比实际年龄老得多。

en: They haggled over the price of the rug for an hour.
Tourists often haggle at local markets to get better deals.
Don't haggle with him; his prices are fixed.
cn: 他们为地毯的价格讨价还价了一小时。
游客常在当地市场砍价以获得更优惠的价格。
别和他讨价还价，他的价格是固定的。

definitions.definition: 发型（尤指精心设计的或正式场合的发型）

en: She spent an hour at the salon getting an elaborate hairdo for the wedding.
Vintage hairdos from the 1950s are making a comeback.
His messy hairdo suggested he had just woken up.
cn: 她花了1小时在沙龙做婚礼用的精致发型。
20世纪50年代的复古发型正再度流行。
他凌乱的发型显示他刚起床。

definitions.definition: 假发；假发片（尤指部分假发，用于遮盖秃顶或增加发量）

en: He wears a hairpiece to cover his bald spot.
The actor's hairpiece looked noticeably artificial under the bright lights.
She opted for a subtle hairpiece to add volume to her updo.
cn: 他戴着一片假发来遮盖秃顶处。
在强光下，那位演员的假发看起来明显很人工。
她选择用一款不易察觉的假发片来增加发髻的发量。

definitions.definition: 强壮的，健壮的（尤指老年人）
强迫，强拉（古用法或文学用语）

en: Despite his age, the hale old man chops wood every morning.
The villagers were haled before the king to answer for the rebellion.
Her hale complexion surprised the doctor, given her 90 years.
cn: 尽管年事已高，这位健壮的老人每天早晨仍劈柴。
村民们被强行带到国王面前为叛乱受审。（古用法）
她90岁仍面色红润，令医生惊讶。

definitions.definition: 加盖纯度标记；使具有典型特征

en: The film bears all the hallmarks of a classic Hitchcock thriller.
cn: 这部电影具备希区柯克式惊悚片的所有标志性特征。

en: The hallowed halls of the university have inspired generations of scholars.
cn: 这座大学神圣的殿堂激励了无数代学者。

definitions.definition: 万圣节前夕（10月31日夜晚，传统节日，常伴有化妆和讨糖活动）

en: Children dress up as ghosts for Halloween.
Carving pumpkins is a popular Halloween tradition.
She decorated her house with spider webs for Halloween.
cn: 孩子们在万圣节扮成鬼怪。
雕刻南瓜是万圣节的流行传统。
她用蜘蛛网装饰房子迎接万圣节。

en: The patient began to hallucinate after taking the medication.
Extreme sleep deprivation can cause people to hallucinate.
She hallucinated that the walls were melting.
cn: 患者在服药后开始产生幻觉。
极度睡眠剥夺会使人产生幻觉。
她产生幻觉，觉得墙壁在融化。

definitions.definition: 妄想（错误但坚定的信念）

en: The patient reported vivid hallucinations of floating lights.
Sleep deprivation can trigger temporary hallucinations.
His conspiracy theories bordered on hallucination.
cn: 患者报告看到漂浮光点的生动幻觉。
睡眠不足可能引发短暂幻觉。
他的阴谋论近乎妄想。

definitions.definition: 光环（尤指宗教绘画中圣像头顶的光圈）；光晕（天文或气象现象）

en: The angel in the painting has a golden halo around its head.
A faint halo surrounded the moon last night.
The old tree seemed to be haloed by the morning mist.
cn: 画中的天使头顶有一圈金色光环。
昨晚月亮周围有一层淡淡的光晕。
晨雾仿佛为那棵老树笼上了一层光晕。

en: The horse tossed its head, uneasy in the new halter.
She wore a black halter dress to the party.
The farmer halted the foal with a rope halter.
cn: 马不安地甩着头，不适应新笼头。
她穿了一条黑色露背裙参加派对。
农夫用绳笼头拴住了小马驹。

definitions.definition: （戏剧）《哈姆雷特》（莎士比亚悲剧名）

en: The artist lived in a quiet hamlet surrounded by fields.
"To be or not to be" is the most famous soliloquy in Hamlet.
Few hamlets in the valley have access to modern amenities.
cn: 这位艺术家住在田野环绕的宁静小村里。
“生存还是毁灭”是《哈姆雷特》中最著名的独白。
山谷中少有村落能享受现代设施。

definitions.definition: 吊床（悬挂于两固定点之间的网状或布制睡眠用具）

en: He swayed gently in the hammock, enjoying the tropical breeze.
The sailors slept in hammocks below the ship's deck.
We hung a hammock between two palm trees by the beach.
cn: 他在吊床上轻轻摇晃，享受着热带微风。
水手们在甲板下的吊床上睡觉。
我们在海滩边的两棵棕榈树之间挂了一张吊床。

en: The storm hampered rescue efforts.
She packed a picnic hamper with sandwiches and fruit.
Heavy traffic hampered our progress.
cn: 暴风雨阻碍了救援工作。
她将三明治和水果装进野餐篮。
拥堵的交通拖慢了我们的进度。

definitions.definition: 腘绳肌（大腿后侧的肌腱群）
切断腘绳肌；比喻使瘫痪或削弱能力

en: The athlete pulled his hamstring during the sprint.
The economic sanctions were designed to hamstring the country's development.
Medieval warriors would hamstring enemy horses to disable them.
cn: 这名运动员在短跑时拉伤了腘绳肌。
经济制裁旨在削弱该国的发展能力。
中世纪的武士会切断敌马的腿筋使其丧失行动力。

en: She handily won the chess match in under ten moves.
The new app organizes files handily with a single swipe.
He handily fixed the broken shelf using just a hammer.
cn: 她轻松地在十步内赢得了象棋比赛。
这款新应用只需一滑就能便捷地整理文件。
他仅用一把锤子就熟练地修好了坏掉的架子。

en: The delicate embroidery is clearly her handiwork.
Archaeologists study the handiwork of ancient civilizations.
The messy room bore the handiwork of a toddler.
cn: 这件精美的刺绣显然是她的手工杰作。
考古学家研究古代文明的手工制品。
凌乱的房间留下了幼儿的“杰作”。

definitions.definition: （口语）八字胡（因形状类似把手）

en: He gripped the handlebars tightly as the bike sped downhill.
The old man twirled his handlebar mustache while telling stories.
Adjust the angle of the handlebar for a more comfortable ride.
cn: 他紧握车把，自行车飞速下坡。
老人讲故事时捻着他的八字胡。
调节车把角度以获得更舒适的骑行体验。

en: He tipped the waiter handsomely for the excellent service.
The room was handsomely decorated with antique furniture.
She smiled handsomely, revealing a row of perfect teeth.
cn: 他因服务出色，慷慨地给了服务员小费。
房间用古董家具装饰得十分雅致。
她优雅一笑，露出一排完美的牙齿。

en: The gymnast held a perfect handstand for ten seconds.
Learning to do a handstand requires good balance and upper body strength.
He fell over while attempting a handstand against the wall.
cn: 体操运动员保持了十秒钟完美的手倒立。
学习手倒立需要良好的平衡能力和上肢力量。
他尝试靠墙做手倒立时摔倒了。

definitions.definition: 受雇做零碎杂活或修理工作的人；手巧的人

en: We hired a handyman to fix the leaky faucet and repair the fence.
My grandfather was a true handyman who could build anything from scratch.
The handyman comes every month to take care of minor maintenance issues around the house.
cn: 我们雇了一个杂工来修理漏水的水龙头和修补篱笆。
我祖父是个真正手巧的人，他能从零开始做出任何东西。
这位杂工每月来一次，处理房子里的小修小补问题。

en: The aircraft was towed into the hangar for maintenance.
Military hangars are often built to withstand extreme weather.
The vintage planes filled every corner of the old hangar.
cn: 飞机被拖进机库进行维修。
军用机库通常能抵御极端天气。
老式飞机塞满了旧机库的每个角落。

en: She hung her coat on the wooden hanger.
The aircraft’s weapon hanger was fully loaded.
Don’t leave wet towels on the hanger for too long.
cn: 她把外套挂在木制衣架上。
飞机的武器挂架已满载。
湿毛巾不要长时间挂在挂钩上。

en: In medieval times, the hangman was a feared figure in every town.
We played a quick game of hangman while waiting for the bus.
The word for our hangman game was "etymology".
cn: 在中世纪，刽子手是每个城镇里都令人畏惧的人物。
我们在等公交车时玩了一局快速的“刽子手”猜词游戏。
我们“刽子手”游戏要猜的词是“词源学”。

definitions.definition: 手指上的倒刺或逆剥的皮肤

en: I got a painful hangnail after gardening without gloves.
Don't pull at that hangnail; you should trim it with clippers.
Moisturizing your hands regularly can help prevent hangnails.
cn: 我在没戴手套打理花园后，手指上长了一个疼痛的倒刺。
别去撕那倒刺；你应该用指甲刀把它剪掉。
经常给手部保湿有助于防止长倒刺。

definitions.definition: 宿醉（因过量饮酒导致的头痛、恶心等不适）
遗留影响（比喻过去事件或状态的持续后果）

en: He had a terrible hangover after the party.
The economic crisis is a hangover from poor policies.
Her fatigue was a hangover from weeks of overtime.
cn: 他在派对后宿醉严重。
这场经济危机是糟糕政策的遗留影响。
她的疲劳是连续加班数周的后遗症。

en: He would often hanker for the peaceful days of his childhood.
cn: 他常常渴望回到童年那宁静的岁月。

en: She always carries a lace hankie in her purse.
He offered his hankie to the crying child.
It's just a little stain on your hankie; it'll wash out.
cn: 她手提包里总是带着一块蕾丝手帕。
他把自己的手帕递给了那个正在哭泣的孩子。
只是你手帕上的一点污渍，能洗掉的。

definitions.definition: 随意的；偶然的；无计划的

en: The books were piled in a haphazard manner on the shelf.
She approached the problem in a haphazard way.
Haphazard planning led to the project's failure.
cn: 书本杂乱无章地堆在书架上。
她用一种随意的方式处理这个问题。
无计划的随意性导致了项目失败。

en: The hapless traveler lost his passport and luggage on the first day.
Despite his hapless attempts, the audience applauded his courage.
The hapless kitten was stuck in the tree for hours before being rescued.
cn: 这位倒霉的旅行者在第一天就丢了护照和行李。
