definitions.definition: 无可争议的；不容否认的

en: The scientific evidence is incontrovertible.
Her logic was so clear that it seemed incontrovertible.
The document provided incontrovertible proof of his innocence.
cn: 科学证据无可辩驳。
她的逻辑清晰到不容置疑。
这份文件提供了他清白的确凿证据。

en: She gave him an incredulous look when he claimed to have seen a UFO.
The audience was incredulous at the magician’s final trick.
His incredulous tone suggested he thought I was lying.
cn: 当他声称看到UFO时，她投以怀疑的目光。
观众对魔术师的压轴戏感到难以置信。
他怀疑的语气表明他认为我在撒谎。

en: The leaked documents incriminated several high-ranking officials.
She refused to answer questions that might incriminate her.
His silence was interpreted as an attempt to avoid incriminating himself.
cn: 泄露的文件使数名高级官员被指控。
她拒绝回答可能使自己负罪的问题。
他的沉默被解读为试图避免自证其罪。

definitions.definition: 孵（卵）；培养（细菌、细胞等）；酝酿（想法）

en: The bird incubated its eggs for three weeks.
Scientists incubated the bacteria at 37°C.
His idea incubated slowly before becoming a best-selling novel.
cn: 这只鸟孵蛋三周。
科学家在37摄氏度下培养细菌。
他的想法酝酿许久，最终成就了一本畅销小说。

definitions.definition: 孵化（指卵生动物保持温度使胚胎发育的过程）

en: The incubation period for chicken eggs is about 21 days.
The project is still in the incubation phase, with no concrete plans yet.
Doctors monitored him closely during the incubation of the virus.
cn: 鸡蛋的孵化期约为21天。
该项目仍处于酝酿阶段，尚无具体计划。
医生在病毒潜伏期间对他进行了密切监测。

definitions.definition: 恒温箱（用于早产儿或培养微生物）
创业孵化器（支持初创企业发展的机构）

en: The hospital uses advanced incubators for premature babies.
Farmers check the eggs in the incubator daily.
The startup joined a tech incubator to accelerate its growth.
cn: 医院为早产儿使用先进的恒温箱。
农民每天检查孵化器中的蛋。
这家初创公司加入科技孵化器以加速发展。

en: Teachers inculcate the value of honesty in students through daily examples.
The military training inculcated discipline into the recruits.
Parents often inculcate cultural traditions in their children unconsciously.
cn: 教师通过日常事例向学生反复灌输诚实的价值。
军事训练让新兵将纪律铭记于心。
父母常在不经意间向孩子灌输文化传统。

en: The incumbent president will face reelection next year.
It is incumbent upon us to protect the environment.
The incumbent in this position must have five years of experience.
cn: 现任总统将于明年面临连任选举。
保护环境是我们义不容辞的责任。
该职位的现任者必须具备五年工作经验。

definitions.definition: 招致（尤指不愉快的事，如债务、损失、愤怒等）

en: Failure to comply may incur legal penalties.
The project incurred significant costs due to delays.
She didn’t want to incur his wrath by being late again.
cn: 未遵守可能导致法律处罚。
该项目因延误产生了巨额费用。
她不想因再次迟到而惹怒他。

definitions.definition: （非军事领域）突然介入或干扰

en: The border village faced frequent incursions by armed groups.
The new policy was an incursion into personal freedoms.
Cybersecurity systems prevent data incursions.
cn: 这个边境村庄常遭武装团伙突袭。
新政策是对个人自由的侵犯。
网络安全系统防止数据入侵。

en: His indecision cost him the job opportunity.
The team's indecision led to a missed deadline.
She shook her head in frustration at her own indecision.
cn: 他的优柔寡断让他错失了工作机会。
团队的犹豫不决导致错过了截止日期。
她对自己优柔寡断的沮丧地摇了摇头。

en: The trauma left an indelible mark on her psyche.
Use indelible ink to prevent ballot tampering.
His kindness created an indelible memory in my heart.
cn: 这段创伤在她的心灵上留下了不可磨灭的印记。
使用防篡改墨水以确保选票安全。
他的善意在我心中留下了永恒的回忆。

en: The insurance company agreed to indemnify the homeowner for flood damage.
The contract clauses indemnify both parties against legal liabilities.
Governments often indemnify banks during financial crises.
cn: 保险公司同意为房主的洪水损失提供赔偿。
合同条款使双方免于承担法律责任。
政府常在金融危机期间为银行提供担保。

en: The contract includes a clause of indemnity against third-party claims.
The company paid a high indemnity to the victims of the accident.
The treaty granted indemnity to all officials involved in the war.
cn: 合同包含对第三方索赔的赔偿条款。
公司向事故受害者支付了高额赔偿金。
该条约授予所有参与战争的官员免罚权。

definitions.definition: 使成锯齿状；缩进排版；正式订购

en: Please indent the first line of each paragraph.
The carpenter used a tool to indent the wood.
We received an indent for new supplies from the headquarters.
cn: 请将每个段落的首行缩进。
木匠用工具在木头上压出凹痕。
我们收到了总部发来的新物资订购单。

en: The report provides an in-depth analysis of climate change impacts.
She conducted in-depth interviews with all participants.
The course offers in-depth training in data science.
cn: 这份报告对气候变化影响进行了深入分析。
她对所有参与者进行了深度访谈。
该课程提供数据科学的全面培训。

en: The test results were indeterminate, requiring further analysis.
In algebra, an indeterminate equation has infinitely many solutions.
His role in the project remains indeterminate due to unclear responsibilities.
cn: 测试结果不确定，需进一步分析。
代数中，不定方程拥有无限多解。
由于职责不明，他在项目中的角色仍不明确。

en: The grand jury decided to indict the suspect for fraud.
He was indicted on charges of corruption.
Without sufficient evidence, it's hard to indict someone.
cn: 大陪审团决定以欺诈罪起诉嫌疑人。
他因腐败指控被起诉。
缺乏足够证据时，难以起诉某人。

en: The indigenous culture of Australia is deeply connected to the land.
Kangaroos are indigenous to Australia.
Protecting indigenous languages is crucial for cultural diversity.
cn: 澳大利亚的土著文化与土地有着深厚的联系。
袋鼠原产于澳大利亚。
保护土著语言对文化多样性至关重要。

en: Eating too quickly often leads to indigestion.
His explanation only caused more mental indigestion among the students.
She took some medicine to relieve her indigestion after the heavy meal.
cn: 吃得太快常常导致消化不良。
他的解释只让学生们更加难以理解。
大餐后，她吃了些药来缓解消化不良。

definitions.definition: 靛蓝（一种深蓝色染料或颜色）

en: She dyed the fabric with natural indigo.
The sky at dusk turned a deep indigo.
Indigo was once a highly valued trade commodity.
cn: 她用天然靛蓝染制布料。
黄昏的天空呈现出深靛蓝色。
靛蓝曾是备受重视的贸易商品。

definitions.definition: 不谨慎的，轻率的（指言行）

en: It was indiscreet of him to disclose that confidential information at the party.
She regretted her indiscreet comments as soon as she saw the reaction on his face.
An indiscreet inquiry about his personal life made the whole conversation awkward.
cn: 他在聚会上泄露那份机密信息，实在是不谨慎。
一看到他脸上的反应，她就后悔自己说了那些欠考虑的话。
一个关于他个人生活的轻率提问使得整个谈话变得尴尬。

en: The bombing was indiscriminate, killing civilians and soldiers alike.
She has an indiscriminate taste in music, listening to everything from jazz to heavy metal.
Avoid indiscriminate use of antibiotics to prevent drug resistance.
cn: 轰炸不分目标，平民与士兵均遇难。
她对音乐来者不拒，从爵士到重金属都听。
避免滥用抗生素以防耐药性。

en: The manager is indisposed with a fever and cannot attend the meeting.
She seemed somewhat indisposed to help us with the project.
Feeling slightly indisposed, he decided to work from home for the day.
cn: 经理因发烧身体不适，无法出席会议。
她似乎不太愿意帮助我们完成这个项目。
他感觉有点不舒服，于是决定那天在家工作。

definitions.definition: 无可争议的，不容置疑的

en: His leadership skills are indisputable after the company's record profits.
The evidence presented in court was indisputable.
It is indisputable that climate change affects global ecosystems.
cn: 他的领导能力在公司创纪录的盈利后已无可争议。
法庭上提交的证据不容置疑。
气候变化影响全球生态系统是不争的事实。

definitions.definition: 难以区分的；无法辨别的

en: The twins were nearly indistinguishable in appearance.
The counterfeit bills were indistinguishable from real ones.
Their voices on the phone were indistinguishable to me.
cn: 这对双胞胎的外貌几乎无法区分。
这些假钞与真钞难以辨别。
电话里他们的声音对我来说一模一样。

definitions.definition: 向…灌输（信仰、学说或观点）

en: The regime used schools to indoctrinate children with its ideology.
He was indoctrinated into the cult's beliefs from a very young age.
Critical thinking skills help people resist being indoctrinated.
cn: 该政权利用学校向儿童灌输其意识形态。
他从小就被灌输了那个邪教的信仰。
批判性思维技能有助于人们抵制被灌输思想。

definitions.definition: 【医学】无痛的，进展缓慢的（尤指疾病）

en: The indolent student spent the entire afternoon lounging on the sofa instead of studying.
The tropical climate encouraged an indolent lifestyle among the settlers.
The patient was diagnosed with an indolent form of lymphoma that required monitoring rather than immediate treatment.
cn: 这名懒惰的学生整个下午都躺在沙发上消磨时间，而不是学习。
热带气候助长了定居者们懒散的生活方式。
患者被诊断出一种惰性淋巴瘤，需要观察而非立即治疗。

en: His honesty is indubitable; everyone trusts him completely.
The evidence presented in court was indubitable and led to a quick verdict.
She has an indubitable talent for music, recognized by experts worldwide.
cn: 他的诚实不容置疑，所有人都完全信任他。
法庭上提交的证据确凿无疑，迅速促成了判决。
她拥有毋庸置疑的音乐天赋，受到全球专家的认可。

definitions.definition: 正式接纳（加入组织或职位）；使入门

en: She was inducted into the Hall of Fame for her scientific achievements.
The ceremony inducted new members with an oath.
A changing magnetic field can induct an electric current in a wire.
cn: 她因科学成就入选名人堂。
仪式通过宣誓正式接纳新成员。
变化的磁场能在导线中感应出电流。

en: Mathematical induction is a powerful proof technique in discrete mathematics.
The new employees will attend a two-day induction program.
Faraday discovered electromagnetic induction in 1831.
cn: 数学归纳法是离散数学中一种强大的证明方法。
新员工将参加为期两天的入职培训。
法拉第于1831年发现了电磁感应现象。

definitions.definition: 无效的；无能的（指行动或人未能产生预期效果）

en: His ineffectual attempts to fix the leak only made it worse.
The committee's ineffectual policies failed to address the crisis.
She felt ineffectual when her advice was repeatedly ignored.
cn: 他试图修补漏水的徒劳努力反而让情况更糟。
委员会无效的政策未能解决危机。
当建议屡遭忽视时，她感到无能为力。

definitions.definition: 不可避免的；无法逃避的

en: She felt caught in the ineluctable progress of time.
The outcome of the conflict seemed ineluctable.
They were moving toward an ineluctable confrontation.
cn: 她感觉自己被困在了时间不可阻挡的流逝中。
冲突的结果似乎是不可避免的。
他们正走向一场无可避免的对抗。

en: His inept handling of the crisis made the situation worse.
The speech was full of inept comparisons that confused the audience.
She felt inept at social gatherings, often saying the wrong thing.
cn: 他对危机的拙劣处理使情况恶化。
演讲中充斥着不恰当的比喻，让听众困惑不已。
她在社交场合中感到笨拙，常常说错话。

definitions.definition: 不可避免的；无法逃避的

en: The consequences of climate change are now inescapable.
She felt an inescapable sense of guilt after the accident.
The movie’s plot creates an inescapable tension.
cn: 气候变化的后果现已无法避免。
事故后，她感到一种无法摆脱的愧疚。
这部电影的情节营造了一种无法逃避的紧张感。

definitions.definition: (因过大或过好而) 难以估量的，无法计算的；极其珍贵的

en: The discovery of penicillin was of inestimable value to humanity.
She has made an inestimable contribution to the field of scientific research.
The loss of these ancient artifacts is an inestimable tragedy for our cultural heritage.
cn: 盘尼西林的发现对人类有着不可估量的价值。
她为科学研究领域做出了无比宝贵的贡献。
这些古代文物的丢失对我们文化遗产而言是一场无法估量的悲剧。

en: The sun is an inexhaustible source of energy.
Her inexhaustible enthusiasm inspired the team.
The library seemed inexhaustible, with books on every topic.
cn: 太阳是取之不尽的能源。
她永不枯竭的热情激励了整个团队。
这座图书馆似乎无穷无尽，涵盖所有主题的书籍。

definitions.definition: 不可阻挡的；不可改变的

en: The march of time is inexorable.
She met his plea with an inexorable refusal.
Climate change is an inexorable reality we must face.
cn: 时间的流逝不可阻挡。
她以无情的拒绝回应了他的恳求。
气候变化是我们必须面对的不可改变的现实。

definitions.definition: 无法解释的；难以理解的

en: The sudden disappearance of the artifact remains inexplicable.
Her inexplicable fear of butterflies puzzled her friends.
Scientists encountered inexplicable data in the experiment.
cn: 这件文物突然消失的原因仍无法解释。
她对蝴蝶莫名其妙的恐惧让朋友们困惑不已。
科学家们在实验中遇到了无法解释的数据。

definitions.definition: 绝对可靠的；不可能犯错的

en: No human being is truly infallible.
The algorithm was designed to be infallible in detecting fraud.
Her reputation as an infallible judge made her highly respected.
cn: 凡人皆会犯错。
该算法被设计为可万无一失地检测欺诈。
她作为“从不误判”的法官声誉使她备受尊敬。

definitions.definition: 声名狼藉的；臭名昭著的

en: The castle was once the hideout of an infamous pirate.
His infamous betrayal shocked the entire nation.
The area is infamous for its high crime rate.
cn: 这座城堡曾是一位臭名昭著的海盗的藏身处。
他声名狼藉的背叛震惊了全国。
该地区因高犯罪率而恶名远扬。

definitions.definition: 婴儿的；幼稚的，孩子气的

en: His infantile laughter echoed through the playground.
The politician's infantile remarks offended many voters.
Some diseases are specific to the infantile stage.
cn: 他孩子气的笑声在游乐场上回荡。
那位政客幼稚的言论激怒了许多选民。
某些疾病是婴儿期特有的。

definitions.definition: 步兵（军队中徒步作战的士兵）

en: The infantry advanced under heavy fire.
Modern armies still rely on infantry for ground operations.
He joined the infantry straight out of high school.
cn: 步兵在猛烈炮火下前进。
现代军队仍依赖步兵执行地面行动。
他高中毕业直接加入了步兵部队。

definitions.definition: 热恋的，痴迷的（通常指因感情而失去理性判断）

en: He was utterly infatuated with her, blind to all her flaws.
The public grew infatuated with the new tech trend, investing without caution.
She gave an infatuated sigh while watching her favorite actor on screen.
cn: 他完全被她迷住了，对她的所有缺点都视而不见。
公众对新的科技趋势变得狂热，不加谨慎地投资。
她在屏幕上看到最喜欢的演员时，发出了痴迷的叹息。

definitions.definition: 热恋，痴迷（尤指短暂或不理智的）

en: His infatuation with her lasted only a few months.
Teenage infatuation often blinds people to reality.
She mistook his infatuation for true love.
cn: 他对她的热恋仅持续了几个月。
青少年的痴迷常让人对现实视而不见。
她误将他的痴迷当作真爱。

definitions.definition: 阴间的，地狱般的；穷凶极恶的；可恨的（口语中表恼怒）

en: The engine let out an infernal roar just as I was trying to sleep.
In many mythologies, heroes must journey through the infernal regions.
This infernal noise is driving me mad!
cn: 就在我试图入睡时，发动机发出了可恶的轰鸣声。
在许多神话中，英雄必须穿越阴间地府。
这该死的噪音快把我逼疯了！

en: The warehouse was infested with rats.
Mosquitoes infest the swampy areas in summer.
Fake news infests social media platforms.
cn: 仓库里鼠患成灾。
夏季沼泽地区蚊虫肆虐。
虚假新闻充斥社交媒体平台。

definitions.definition: 不忠（尤指婚姻或感情中的背叛）

en: His infidelity destroyed their marriage.
The politician's infidelity to his promises cost him the election.
Historical records reveal cases of royal infidelity in many cultures.
cn: 他的不忠摧毁了他们的婚姻。
这位政客对承诺的失信让他输掉了选举。
历史记载揭示了多种文化中王室成员的不忠行为。

en: The company's infighting delayed the product launch.
Political infighting weakened the party's public image.
She avoided office infighting by staying neutral.
cn: 公司内讧导致产品发布延迟。
政治内斗削弱了该党的公众形象。
她保持中立，避免了办公室内斗。

definitions.definition: 渗透；潜入（尤指秘密或缓慢地进入）

en: The spy managed to infiltrate the enemy headquarters undetected.
Water can infiltrate through tiny cracks in the rock.
The organization aims to infiltrate political groups to gather information.
cn: 间谍成功潜入敌方总部而未被发现。
水会从岩石的微小裂缝中渗入。
该组织试图渗透政治团体以收集信息。

definitions.definition: 虚弱的；体弱的（尤指因年老或疾病）
不坚定的；动摇的（引申义）

en: The infirm old man needed assistance to walk.
Her resolve grew infirm after repeated failures.
The bridge's infirm structure posed a safety risk.
cn: 那位虚弱的老人需要搀扶才能行走。
屡次失败后，她的决心动摇了。
这座桥结构不稳固，存在安全隐患。

definitions.definition: 医院；医务室（尤指学校、监狱等机构内的）

en: The injured hiker was carried to the mountain infirmary for treatment.
Each prison has its own infirmary to care for sick inmates.
The school infirmary is staffed by a qualified nurse during school hours.
cn: 受伤的徒步旅行者被抬到山上的医务室接受治疗。
每所监狱都有自己的医务室来照顾生病的囚犯。
学校医务室在上课时间有一名合格的护士值班。

definitions.definition: （身体或精神的）虚弱，衰弱；疾病，病症

en: Old age is often accompanied by infirmity.
He suffered from a period of infirmity after the surgery.
Her main infirmity was a profound lack of confidence.
cn: 年老常伴随着体弱多病。
手术后他经历了一段虚弱期。
她主要的弱点是严重缺乏自信。

en: His harsh words only served to inflame the crowd.
The wound may inflame if not treated properly.
The politician's speech inflamed tensions between the two groups.
cn: 他的尖锐言辞只会激怒人群。
如果处理不当，伤口可能会发炎。
政治家的演讲加剧了两派间的紧张关系。

en: The skin around the wound became red and inflamed.
His inflamed rhetoric stirred up the crowd.
She applied cream to soothe the inflamed area.
cn: 伤口周围的皮肤变得又红又肿。
他激昂的言辞煽动了人群。
她涂抹药膏以舒缓发炎的部位。

en: Gasoline is highly inflammable and must be kept away from flames.
His inflammable temper often got him into unnecessary arguments.
The warehouse was full of inflammable materials, requiring strict safety protocols.
cn: 汽油高度易燃，必须远离火焰。
他火暴的脾气常常让他陷入不必要的争论。
仓库里堆满了易燃材料，需要严格的安全规程。

en: The doctor prescribed antibiotics to reduce the inflammation.
Ancient poets described love as an inflammation of the heart.
Prolonged inflammation can lead to tissue damage.
cn: 医生开了抗生素以减轻炎症。
古代诗人将爱描述为心的炽热。
长期炎症可能导致组织损伤。

en: The doctor prescribed medication to reduce the inflammatory response.
His speech was criticized for its inflammatory remarks.
Spicy food can sometimes cause inflammatory reactions in sensitive individuals.
cn: 医生开了药以减轻炎症反应。
他的演讲因煽动性言论受到批评。
辛辣食物可能引发敏感人群的炎症反应。

definitions.definition: （语音或语法中的）屈折变化；音调抑扬变化

en: The actor's voice rose with an emotional inflection.
Latin nouns have complex inflectional endings.
The graph shows an inflection point at x=2.
cn: 演员的嗓音因情感起伏而升高。
拉丁语名词有复杂的屈折词尾。
图表在x=2处有一个拐点。

en: The steel rod is completely inflexible.
Her inflexible attitude caused conflicts in the team.
The school has inflexible rules about uniforms.
cn: 这根钢杆完全无法弯曲。
她固执的态度引发了团队矛盾。
学校对制服有着不可变通的规定。

definitions.definition: 使遭受（痛苦、伤害等）；强加

en: The hurricane inflicted severe damage on the coastal towns.
He hated to inflict pain on anyone, even his enemies.
New policies should not inflict unnecessary burdens on small businesses.
cn: 飓风给沿海城镇造成了严重破坏。
他厌恶给任何人带来痛苦，哪怕是敌人。
新政策不应给小企业强加不必要的负担。

definitions.definition: 流入（指液体、资金、信息等的进入）
流入量（特定时间内进入的数量）

en: The inflow of foreign investment boosted the local economy.
Scientists measured the daily inflow of water into the reservoir.
A sudden inflow of customers overwhelmed the small shop.
cn: 外国投资的流入促进了当地经济发展。
科学家测量了每日流入水库的水量。
顾客突然涌入，让这家小店应接不暇。

en: The city saw an influx of tourists during the festival.
The influx of foreign capital boosted the local economy.
The river delta forms where the influx of freshwater meets the sea.
cn: 节日期间，这座城市迎来了大量游客的涌入。
外资的涌入提振了当地经济。
淡水汇入海洋之处形成了河口三角洲。

en: Infrared cameras detect heat signatures invisible to the human eye.
Many reptiles rely on infrared radiation to locate prey.
The remote control uses infrared light to communicate with the TV.
cn: 红外摄像机可探测人眼不可见的热信号。
许多爬行动物依靠红外辐射定位猎物。
遥控器通过红外光与电视通信。

definitions.definition: 基础设施（如交通、通信等公共设施）

en: The government invested heavily in upgrading the country's transportation infrastructure.
cn: 政府大力投资升级国家交通基础设施。

definitions.definition: 构成侵犯（常与 on/upon 连用）

en: The new law infringes on citizens' privacy rights.
Copying this design may infringe the patent.
He was fined for infringing copyright regulations.
cn: 这项新法律侵犯了公民的隐私权。
复制此设计可能构成专利侵权。
他因违反版权法规被罚款。

en: His arrogant attitude infuriated the entire team.
The unfair decision infuriated the protesters.
Deliberate misinformation can infuriate the public.
cn: 他的傲慢态度激怒了整个团队。
不公正的决定激怒了抗议者。
蓄意传播虚假信息会激怒公众。

en: She infused the tea leaves with hot water to release their flavor.
His speeches are infused with a sense of urgency.
The coach infused the team with confidence before the match.
cn: 她用热水冲泡茶叶以释放香气。
他的演讲充满紧迫感。
教练在赛前给团队注入了信心。

definitions.definition: 天真无邪的；坦率的；不谙世故的

en: His ingenuous smile made it impossible to doubt his sincerity.
She was charmed by his ingenuous confession of his mistakes.
The child's ingenuous questions about the world reminded us of the beauty of curiosity.
cn: 他天真无邪的笑容让人无法怀疑他的真诚。
他对自己错误坦率的承认让她着迷。
孩子对这个世界天真无邪的提问让我们想起了好奇心的美好。

definitions.definition: 不光彩的；可耻的；不名誉的
湮没无闻的；默默无闻的

en: He met an inglorious end after his betrayal was exposed.
The battle was an inglorious defeat for the once-proud army.
Many of the project's contributors remained inglorious, though their work was vital.
cn: 他的背叛被揭露后，落得个不光彩的下场。
这场战役对那支曾经骄傲的军队来说是一次可耻的失败。
该项目的许多贡献者依然默默无闻，尽管他们的工作至关重要。

definitions.definition: （习惯、信仰、态度等）根深蒂固的，难以改变的

en: He has an ingrained distrust of politicians.
The dirt was so ingrained in the fabric that it wouldn't wash out.
Good manners should be ingrained in childhood.
cn: 他对政客有一种根深蒂固的不信任感。
污垢深深嵌入织物中，根本洗不掉。
良好的举止应在童年时期就养成。

definitions.definition: 使讨好；使迎合；使得到…的欢心

en: He tried to ingratiate himself with the boss by always agreeing with her.
The new student ingratiated herself with the teachers by being helpful and polite.
His attempts to ingratiate were so obvious that they had the opposite effect.
cn: 他试图通过总是附和老板来讨好她。
这位新同学通过乐于助人和彬彬有礼赢得了老师们的欢心。
他试图讨好的行为太过明显，结果适得其反。

en: He spoke in an ingratiating tone, hoping to win her favor.
She gave the teacher an ingratiating smile before asking for an extension on the assignment.
Despite his ingratiating manners, many found him insincere.
cn: 他以一种讨好的语气说话，希望能赢得她的欢心。
在请求延长作业截止日期之前，她给了老师一个谄媚的微笑。
尽管他举止讨好，但许多人觉得他不真诚。

definitions.definition: 使拘束；妨碍（心理或情感表达）

en: The drug inhibits the growth of bacteria.
Shyness inhibited her from speaking in public.
Strict rules can inhibit creativity.
cn: 这种药物抑制细菌生长。
羞怯使她不敢公开讲话。
严格的规则可能扼杀创造力。

definitions.definition: 禁令（法律术语：法院强制或禁止某项行为的命令）
指令；告诫（正式或权威性的要求）

en: The court issued an injunction to stop the construction.
She obeyed her doctor's injunction to rest.
The injunction against publishing the report was lifted.
cn: 法院颁布禁令，要求停止施工。
她遵从医生的指令休息。
禁止发布报告的禁令被撤销了。

en: Smoking is injurious to health.
The article contained injurious statements about the company's practices.
His injurious actions resulted in a lawsuit.
cn: 吸烟对健康有害。
这篇文章包含了关于该公司商业行为的诽谤性陈述。
他的侵害行为导致了一场诉讼。

definitions.definition: 模糊的概念；细微的暗示；隐约的感觉

en: She had an inkling that the meeting would be canceled.
There wasn't even an inkling of doubt in his voice.
The first inkling of trouble came when the lights flickered.
cn: 她隐约感觉到会议会被取消。
他的声音里没有一丝怀疑。
灯光闪烁时，人们才第一次察觉到有问题。

definitions.definition: 镶嵌的（指装饰物嵌入另一材料表面）
inlay 的过去式和过去分词

en: The table had an inlaid pattern of mother-of-pearl.
She admired the inlaid jewels on the antique box.
The craftsman inlaid gold wires into the wooden surface.
cn: 桌面上镶嵌着珍珠母贝的图案。
她赞叹古董盒子上镶嵌的宝石。
工匠将金丝镶嵌到木质表面。

definitions.definition: （监狱、精神病院等的）同住者；囚犯

en: The prison provides educational programs for its inmates.
She worked as a nurse caring for mental health inmates.
The inmates shared a small cell with minimal privacy.
cn: 监狱为囚犯提供教育课程。
她曾担任护士，照料精神病院的患者。
囚犯们共用一间几乎没有隐私的小牢房。

en: She kept her inmost thoughts to herself.
The expedition aimed to reach the inmost reaches of the jungle.
He felt a sense of peace in his inmost being.
cn: 她将自己内心最深处的想法埋藏心底。
这次探险旨在抵达丛林最深处。
在他灵魂最深处，他感到了一种平静。

en: Her innate musical talent amazed the teachers.
Birds have an innate ability to navigate long distances.
His innate kindness made him popular among peers.
cn: 她与生俱来的音乐天赋让老师们惊叹。
鸟类天生具备长距离导航的能力。
他天生的善良使他在同龄人中很受欢迎。

en: Doctors inoculate children against measles routinely.
The teacher tried to inoculate students with critical thinking skills.
Early farmers inoculated fruit trees to improve yields.
cn: 医生定期为儿童接种麻疹疫苗。
老师试图向学生灌输批判性思维技巧。
早期农民通过嫁接果树提高产量。

definitions.definition: 无害的；不冒犯人的；不令人讨厌的

en: The chemical is considered inoffensive and safe for household use.
He made a few inoffensive jokes to lighten the mood.
The drink has a mild, inoffensive flavor that appeals to many.
cn: 这种化学品被认为无害，可安全用于家庭。
他讲了几个无伤大雅的笑话来缓和气氛。
这种饮料味道温和、不冲，深受许多人喜爱。

en: She spent an inordinate amount of time on trivial details.
The project was delayed due to inordinate bureaucratic procedures.
His inordinate love for sweets led to health problems.
cn: 她花了过多时间在琐碎细节上。
由于冗长的官僚程序，项目被延误了。
他对甜食的过度热爱导致了健康问题。

definitions.definition: （尤指当权者进行的）严厉盘问，审讯
（罗马天主教的）宗教裁判所，异端审判

en: His response sounded more like an inquisition than a friendly conversation.
The Spanish Inquisition was established to suppress heresy.
She faced a relentless inquisition from the press about her personal life.
cn: 他的回应听起来不像友好交谈，倒像是严厉的盘问。
西班牙宗教裁判所的建立是为了镇压异端。
她面临着媒体对她个人生活无休止的追问。

en: The inquisitive child asked endless questions about the stars.
Journalists must be inquisitive to uncover the truth.
Her inquisitive nature led her to study philosophy.
cn: 这个好奇的孩子对星星提出了无数问题。
记者必须保持追问精神才能揭露真相。
她天性好奇，因而选择了研究哲学。

definitions.definition: 极端愚蠢或荒谬的行为

en: The defendant pleaded not guilty by reason of insanity.
It would be insanity to ignore the climate crisis.
His laughter bordered on insanity after days of isolation.
cn: 被告以精神错乱为由提出无罪抗辩。
忽视气候危机是极其愚蠢的行为。
数日隔离后，他的笑声近乎癫狂。

definitions.definition: 无法满足的；贪得无厌的

en: His insatiable curiosity led him to explore every corner of the library.
The market's insatiable demand for innovation keeps companies competitive.
She had an insatiable appetite for adventure, always seeking new challenges.
cn: 他无法满足的好奇心驱使他探索图书馆的每个角落。
市场对创新的无尽需求使企业保持竞争力。
她对冒险有着永不满足的渴望，总在寻找新的挑战。

en: The book includes an inset map of the city center.
She carefully inset the gemstone into the silver ring.
The magazine's inset featured exclusive interviews.
cn: 书中附有一张市中心的插页地图。
她将宝石小心翼翼地镶嵌进银戒指中。
杂志的插页部分刊登了独家访谈。

definitions.definition: 阴险的，狡诈的（指危害或欺骗行为不易察觉但后果严重）
潜伏的，隐伏的（指疾病或问题缓慢发展）

en: The disease progresses in an insidious manner, often showing no symptoms until it's too late.
His insidious flattery made her trust him completely.
The software contains insidious code that steals data without detection.
cn: 这种疾病发展隐匿，通常直到晚期才显现症状。
他阴险的奉承让她完全信任了他。
该软件含有隐蔽代码，可窃取数据而不被发现。

definitions.definition: 使（自己）巧妙融入（某环境或群体）

en: She insinuated that he was lying without directly accusing him.
The politician insinuated himself into the inner circle of power.
His tone insinuated doubt about the project's success.
cn: 她暗示他在说谎，但并未直接指责。
这位政客巧妙跻身权力核心圈。
他的语气透露出对项目成功的怀疑。

en: The soup was rather insipid and needed more seasoning.
He dismissed the film as a visually stunning but emotionally insipid spectacle.
Her insipid conversation made the long journey seem even longer.
cn: 这汤相当淡而无味，需要多加些调料。
他认为这部电影视觉上令人惊叹，但情感上乏善可陈。
她枯燥乏味的谈话让漫长的旅途显得更加漫长。

en: This theory is valid insofar as it aligns with experimental data.
He helped me insofar as his limited resources allowed.
Insofar as I understand, the project will proceed next month.
cn: 该理论仅在符合实验数据的范围内成立。
他在自己有限的资源范围内帮助了我。
据我所知，项目将于下月启动。

en: The insolent student was reprimanded for talking back to the professor.
She gave an insolent shrug when asked to apologize.
His insolent behavior towards the guests was utterly unacceptable.
cn: 那名无礼的学生因与教授顶嘴而受到训斥。
被要求道歉时，她无礼地耸了耸肩。
他对客人的傲慢行为是完全不可接受的。

definitions.definition: 无法解决的；难以解释的

en: The conflict seemed insoluble without external mediation.
Oil is insoluble in water.
He faced the seemingly insoluble problem of balancing the budget.
cn: 没有外部调解，这场冲突似乎无法解决。
油不能溶解于水。
他面临着平衡预算这个看似无法解决的难题。

definitions.definition: 失眠（症）；无法入睡的状态

en: Chronic insomnia can severely impact one's quality of life.
She drank chamomile tea to alleviate her insomnia.
The study focused on cognitive therapies for insomnia.
cn: 长期失眠会严重影响生活质量。
她喝洋甘菊茶以缓解失眠。
该研究聚焦失眠的认知疗法。

en: As a chronic insomniac, he was familiar with every late-night television show.
The insomniac nights began to take a toll on her health.
The support group provides a community for insomniacs to share their experiences.
cn: 作为一名慢性失眠症患者，他对所有深夜电视节目都了如指掌。
一个个失眠之夜开始损害她的健康。
这个互助小组为失眠症患者提供了一个分享经验的社群。

en: He felt a sharp pain in his instep while running.
The shoe design provides extra support for the instep.
She gently massaged the baby’s instep during the bath.
cn: 他在跑步时感到脚背一阵剧痛。
这款鞋的设计为脚背提供了额外支撑。
洗澡时她轻轻按摩了宝宝的脚背。

definitions.definition: 煽动；教唆（尤指负面行为）
引发；激起（某种情绪或状态）

en: The rebel leader was accused of instigating violence.
Her speech instigated a wave of protests across the country.
Curiosity instigated him to investigate the mysterious noise.
cn: 叛乱首领被指控煽动暴力。
她的演讲引发了全国范围的抗议浪潮。
好奇心驱使他去调查那个神秘的声响。

en: Teachers aim to instil a love of learning in their students.
The nurse instilled the medicine drop by drop.
His parents instilled strong values in him from childhood.
cn: 教师旨在向学生灌输对学习的热爱。
护士将药物一滴一滴地滴注进去。
他的父母从小向他灌输坚定的价值观。

en: The island's insular culture preserved ancient traditions.
His insular attitude prevents him from accepting new ideas.
The insular climate is milder than the mainland.
cn: 这座岛屿的封闭文化保存了古老传统。
他狭隘的态度使他无法接受新观念。
岛屿气候比大陆更温和。

definitions.definition: 使隔热/隔音；使绝缘（物理隔离）
使隔绝（社会、情感等抽象隔离）

en: The walls are insulated to keep the house warm in winter.
Wealth can sometimes insulate people from real-world problems.
Rubber is used to insulate electrical wires for safety.
cn: 墙壁经过隔热处理，确保冬季室内温暖。
财富有时会让人与现实问题隔绝。
橡胶用于包裹电线以实现绝缘安全。

definitions.definition: 不可逾越的，难以克服的

en: The mountain range posed an insuperable barrier to early explorers.
Her determination made the challenges seem insuperable.
Technically, the problem is not insuperable, but it requires massive resources.
cn: 这座山脉对早期探险者构成了不可逾越的障碍。
她的决心让这些挑战显得难以克服。
从技术上讲，这个问题并非无法解决，但需要大量资源。

en: The government forces clashed with the insurgents in the northern region.
An insurgent group claimed responsibility for the attack.
His insurgent ideas challenged the traditional academic norms.
cn: 政府军与叛乱分子在北部地区发生冲突。
一个叛乱组织宣称对此次袭击负责。
他反叛的思想挑战了传统的学术规范。

definitions.definition: 暴动，叛乱（尤指针对政府的武装反抗）

en: The failed insurrection left the capital in chaos.
Historical records show peasant insurrections were often triggered by famine.
The government swiftly suppressed the insurrection before it spread.
cn: 这场失败的暴动使首都陷入混乱。
历史记载显示，农民叛乱常由饥荒引发。
政府在叛乱蔓延前迅速镇压了它。

definitions.definition: 摄入量；吸收量（如食物、空气等）
入口；进气口（机械或系统）

en: The doctor advised me to reduce my sugar intake.
The car's air intake was clogged with leaves.
High intake of vitamins can boost immunity.
cn: 医生建议我减少糖分摄入。
汽车的进气口被树叶堵住了。
大量摄入维生素能增强免疫力。

definitions.definition: 无形资产（如品牌价值、知识产权等）

en: Goodwill is an intangible asset that reflects a company's reputation.
The artist captured the intangible mood of the sunset.
Digital currencies are intangible but have real-world value.
cn: 商誉是一种无形资产，反映企业声誉。
艺术家捕捉到了日落时难以言喻的氛围。
数字货币虽无形，却具备现实价值。

en: The number 7 is an integer, but 7.5 is not.
He believes in treating people as an integer, not just as a means to an end.
The function returns the integer part of the input value.
cn: 数字7是整数，但7.5不是。
他主张将人视为完整的个体，而不仅仅是达到目的的工具。
该函数返回输入值的整数部分。

definitions.definition: 可理解的；清晰的（指语言或表达）

en: The professor's explanation was so intelligible that even beginners grasped the concept.
The document needs to be rewritten in more intelligible language.
Her speech was barely intelligible due to the poor audio quality.
cn: 教授的讲解非常清晰，连初学者都理解了这一概念。
这份文件需要用更易懂的语言重写。
由于音频质量差，她的演讲几乎听不清。

en: The dispute was settled through the intercession of a neutral third party.
She sought the priest's intercession on behalf of her sick child.
His timely intercession prevented a violent confrontation between the two groups.
cn: 这场争端通过一个中立第三方的调解得以解决。
她为生病的孩子寻求神父的代祷。
他的及时调停避免了两个团体间的暴力冲突。

definitions.definition: 界面（不同系统或实体的交互点）
接口（计算机硬件/软件的连接部分）

en: The app has a user-friendly interface.
Scientists study the interface between ocean and atmosphere.
The devices can interface via Bluetooth.
cn: 这款应用程序拥有用户友好的界面。
科学家研究海洋与大气间的交互界面。
这些设备可通过蓝牙连接。

definitions.definition: 插话；突然插入（言语或评论）

en: She interjected a witty remark during the debate.
"That's not true!" he interjected angrily.
The professor allowed students to interject questions at any time.
cn: 她在辩论中插了一句机智的话。
“那不是真的！”他愤怒地插嘴道。
教授允许学生随时插话提问。

definitions.definition: 感叹词，用于表达强烈或突然的情感

en: "Oh!" is an interjection used to express surprise.
His remark was a sudden interjection into our serious discussion.
In grammar, interjections are often followed by an exclamation mark.
cn: “哦！”是一个用于表达惊讶的感叹词。
他的评论突然插入了我们严肃的讨论中。
在语法中，感叹词后常接感叹号。

en: The gears interlock to transfer motion smoothly.
Safety systems are designed to interlock with each other.
Their fingers interlocked as they walked.
cn: 齿轮互锁以平稳传递动力。
安全系统被设计为彼此联动。
他们边走边十指相扣。

definitions.definition: 对话者（尤指正式讨论或辩论中的参与者）
（法律或商业文件中的）中间人

en: The lawyer acted as an interlocutor between the disputing parties.
In a Socratic dialogue, the philosopher plays the role of the interlocutor.
The treaty required an interlocutor to facilitate negotiations.
cn: 律师担任争议双方之间的调解人。
在苏格拉底式对话中，哲学家扮演提问者的角色。
该条约需要一名中间人来推动谈判。

definitions.definition: 闯入者（尤指干涉他人事务者）
无执照营业者（商业语境）

en: The committee viewed the new consultant as an interloper disrupting their workflow.
In the 17th century, British interloper ships often broke the East India Company's monopoly.
Wildlife cameras captured an interloper wolf entering the rival pack's territory.
cn: 委员会将新顾问视为扰乱工作流程的闯入者。
17世纪时，英国无照商船常打破东印度公司的贸易垄断。
野生动物摄像机拍到一只狼闯入敌对族群的领地。

en: The concert included a short interlude of classical piano.
Rain provided a quiet interlude during the hiking trip.
The play's comic interlude lightened the mood.
cn: 音乐会中穿插了一段古典钢琴插曲。
降雨为徒步旅行带来了一段宁静的间歇。
戏剧的滑稽幕间表演缓和了气氛。

en: The UN acted as an intermediary in the peace negotiations.
She used her phone as an intermediary device to transfer files.
Cultural intermediaries help translate artistic works for broader audiences.
cn: 联合国在和平谈判中充当调解人。
她用手机作为中间设备传输文件。
文化中介帮助将艺术作品传播给更广泛的观众。

en: The interment will take place at the local cemetery at noon.
The family held a private interment service.
The law requires a death certificate before interment can occur.
cn: 中午时分，葬礼将在当地公墓举行。
这家人举行了一场私人的安葬仪式。
法律规定，必须持有死亡证明方可进行安葬。

en: The meeting felt interminable, stretching over six hours.
Children often complain about interminable car rides.
His interminable stories made everyone yawn.
cn: 会议似乎永无止境，持续了六个多小时。
孩子们常抱怨漫长的车程。
他没完没了的故事让所有人打哈欠。

en: The flavours intermingle perfectly in this dish.
It's easy for facts and opinions to intermingle in his accounts.
The two cultures have intermingled for centuries without losing their distinct identities.
cn: 这道菜的风味完美地融合在一起。
在他的叙述中，事实和观点很容易交织在一起。
这两种文化交融了数百年，却未失去各自的特色。

en: The intermittent rain made the hike more challenging.
She suffers from intermittent migraines.
The old radio produced only intermittent sound.
cn: 间歇的降雨让徒步更加困难。
她患有间歇性偏头痛。
这台旧收音机只能断断续续地发出声音。

definitions.definition: 拘留（战时或政治原因）；安排实习

en: She worked as an intern at a law firm last summer.
The hospital requires all medical interns to complete a two-year program.
During the war, foreign journalists were interned by the government.
cn: 她去年夏天在一家律师事务所实习。
医院要求所有住院实习医生完成两年的培训计划。
战争期间，外国记者被政府拘留。

en: The interplay between genes and environment shapes human behavior.
Her research focuses on the interplay of light and shadow in photography.
Economic policies must consider the interplay of global markets.
cn: 基因与环境的相互作用塑造了人类行为。
她的研究聚焦摄影中光与影的相互影响。
经济政策必须考虑全球市场的互动关系。

definitions.definition: 插入，介入（尤指在争论或对话中）

en: She interposed herself between the arguing colleagues.
A brief silence interposed before he continued speaking.
The judge interposed to clarify the legal point.
cn: 她介入争吵的同事之间进行调解。
他继续说话前，短暂的沉默插了进来。
法官插话以澄清法律要点。

en: The police interrogated the suspect for hours.
The program can interrogate the database to retrieve specific records.
His silence made her feel like she was being interrogated.
cn: 警方审问嫌疑人数小时。
该程序可查询数据库以检索特定记录。
他的沉默让她感觉自己像在被盘问。

definitions.definition: 散布，点缀（将某物分散插入其他事物中）

en: The author intersperses historical facts with fictional dialogues.
Tiny villages are interspersed among the mountains.
She interspersed her lecture with humorous anecdotes.
cn: 作者在历史事实中穿插虚构对话。
小村庄散落在群山之间。
她在讲座中穿插幽默轶事。

en: The doctor suspected an intestinal infection.
This medication targets intestinal bacteria.
Intestinal health is crucial for overall immunity.
cn: 医生怀疑是肠道感染。
这种药物针对肠道细菌。
肠道健康对整体免疫力至关重要。

en: Their friendship developed into a deep intimacy over the years.
The novel explores the intimacy between strangers in a wartime setting.
She valued the intimacy of small gatherings rather than large parties.
cn: 他们的友谊在多年间发展为深厚的亲密关系。
这部小说探讨了战时陌生人之间的亲密感。
她更珍视小型聚会的私密性，而非大型派对。

en: His aggressive tone was meant to intimidate the witnesses.
Don't let their size intimidate you—they're actually very friendly.
The dark alley intimidated her into walking faster.
cn: 他咄咄逼人的语气意在恐吓目击者。
别被他们的体型吓到，他们其实很友好。
幽暗的小巷让她害怕得加快了脚步。

definitions.definition: 麻醉剂；毒药；醉人的物质

en: Alcohol is a legal intoxicant in most parts of the world.
The plant contains chemicals that act as an intoxicant when ingested.
The use of any intoxicant before driving is strictly prohibited.
cn: 酒精是世界上大部分地区合法的麻醉剂。
这种植物含有摄入后起醉人作用的化学物质。
严禁在驾驶前使用任何醉人物质。

definitions.definition: （引申义）使极度兴奋或失去理智

en: The fumes from the chemical plant could intoxicate unprotected workers.
The vibrant music and lights intoxicated the crowd at the festival.
Power can intoxicate even the most disciplined leaders.
cn: 化工厂的烟雾会使未受保护的工人中毒。
欢快的音乐和灯光让节日人群陶醉不已。
权力甚至能让最自律的领导者失去理智。

definitions.definition: 难处理的；难控制的（指问题、人或情况）
倔强的；不听话的（指人或动物）

en: The intractable weeds choked the garden.
His intractable attitude frustrated the negotiators.
Climate change remains an intractable global issue.
cn: 顽固的杂草扼杀了花园的生机。
他倔强的态度让谈判者倍感挫败。
气候变化仍是棘手的全球性难题。

definitions.definition: 不妥协的；不让步的；顽固的

en: The intransigent negotiator refused to make any concessions.
Their intransigent attitude became the biggest obstacle to peace.
He was known for his intransigent stance on environmental issues.
cn: 这位不妥协的谈判者拒绝做出任何让步。
他们顽固的态度成了和平的最大障碍。
他以在环境问题上不妥协的立场而闻名。

en: Verbs like "sleep" and "arrive" are typically intransitive.
The linguist explained the difference between transitive and intransitive verbs.
In this sentence, the verb is used intransitively without a direct object.
cn: 像“睡觉”和“到达”这样的动词通常是不及物的。
这位语言学家解释了及物动词和不及物动词的区别。
在这个句子里，这个动词作为不及物动词使用，没有直接宾语。

en: The intrepid explorer ventured into the uncharted jungle.
Her intrepid leadership inspired the team during the crisis.
Despite the storm, the intrepid sailors continued their voyage.
cn: 这位无畏的探险家深入了未知的丛林。
她勇敢的领导在危机中激励了团队。
尽管遭遇风暴，勇敢的水手们仍继续航行。

definitions.definition: 错综复杂（的状态或细节）

en: The intricacy of the lace pattern amazed the artisans.
Legal documents often hide dangers in their intricacy.
She admired the intricacy of the ecosystem's balance.
cn: 蕾丝图案的精细复杂令工匠惊叹。
法律文件的繁复条款常暗藏风险。
她赞叹生态系统平衡的微妙精妙。

en: The political intrigue behind the scandal shocked the public.
Her mysterious smile intrigued him.
They were accused of intriguing against the government.
cn: 这起丑闻背后的政治阴谋震惊了公众。
她神秘的微笑激起了他的兴趣。
他们被指控密谋反对政府。

en: The book offers an intriguing perspective on ancient history.
Her smile was mysterious and intriguing.
Scientists found an intriguing pattern in the data.
cn: 这本书为古代史提供了一个引人入胜的视角。
她的笑容神秘而耐人寻味。
科学家在数据中发现了一个有趣的模式。

en: The intrinsic value of a diamond lies in its rarity.
Her intrinsic motivation drives her to learn without rewards.
The artist focused on the intrinsic beauty of the material.
cn: 钻石的内在价值在于其稀有性。
她的内在动力驱使她在没有奖励的情况下学习。
这位艺术家关注材料本身的美感。

en: She is a classic introvert who recharges by spending time alone.
The seminar made him introvert his focus from external achievements to inner values.
Some flowers introvert their petals at night.
cn: 她是一个典型的内向者，通过独处来恢复精力。
这次研讨会让他将焦点从外部成就转向了内在价值。
有些花在夜晚会使花瓣向内弯曲。

definitions.definition: （地质学）侵入的（指火成岩挤入地壳岩石中形成的）

en: The loud music became intrusive during the meeting.
Granite is a common intrusive igneous rock.
She avoided asking intrusive questions about his private life.
cn: 会议期间，吵闹的音乐声成了干扰。
花岗岩是一种常见的侵入性火成岩。
她避免询问涉及他隐私的冒昧问题。

definitions.definition: 直觉（无需推理的直接感知或理解）
直觉力（快速洞察本质的能力）

en: She trusted her intuition and avoided the suspicious alley.
His artistic intuition helps him capture subtle emotions.
Scientific discoveries often begin with a flash of intuition.
cn: 她凭直觉避开了那条可疑的小巷。
他的艺术直觉帮助他捕捉微妙情感。
科学发现常始于灵光一现的直觉。

en: She has an intuitive understanding of human behavior.
The software’s interface is highly intuitive for beginners.
His decision was based on intuitive judgment rather than facts.
cn: 她对人类行为有一种直觉性的理解。
该软件的界面对初学者非常直观。
他的决定基于直觉判断而非事实。

en: Heavy rains inundated the coastal town, forcing residents to evacuate.
The office was inundated with emails after the announcement.
Ancient Egyptians relied on the Nile's inundation to fertilize their fields.
cn: 暴雨淹没了沿海小镇，居民被迫撤离。
公告发布后，办公室的电子邮件应接不暇。
古埃及人依赖尼罗河的泛滥来肥沃土地。

en: The court ruling could invalidate the entire contract.
New evidence invalidated his previous theory.
A single signature missing will invalidate the document.
cn: 法庭裁决可能使整份合同失效。
新证据推翻了他先前的理论。
缺少一个签名就会让文件作废。

definitions.definition: (指习惯或感觉) 根深蒂固的；积习难改的

en: He is an inveterate liar; you cannot believe a word he says.
Her inveterate optimism helped her through many difficult times.
The campaign aims to change the inveterate habits of littering in the community.
cn: 他是个积习难改的说谎者，他说的话一个字都不能信。
她那种根深蒂固的乐观主义帮助她度过了许多艰难时期。
这场运动旨在改变社区里乱扔垃圾的积习。

definitions.definition: 招致不满的；引起反感的；惹人嫉妒的

en: She was placed in the invidious position of having to choose between her colleagues.
cn: 她陷入了不得不从同事中做出选择的尴尬境地。

en: Teachers must invigilate during final exams to prevent cheating.
The professor was assigned to invigilate the chemistry test.
Strict rules require two staff members to invigilate important assessments.
cn: 教师在期末考试期间必须监考以防作弊。
这位教授被指派监督化学考试。
严格规定要求两名工作人员监考重要评估。

definitions.definition: 使精力充沛；使振奋；使健壮

en: The cold shower in the morning helps to invigorate the mind and body.
They planned to invigorate the economy with a series of new policies.
Her inspiring speech invigorated the team's passion for the project.
cn: 早晨的冷水淋浴有助于振奋身心。
他们计划通过一系列新政策来振兴经济。
她鼓舞人心的演讲重新激发了团队对该项目的热情。

en: The team seemed invincible after winning 20 consecutive games.
His invincible spirit inspired everyone around him.
No fortress is truly invincible.
cn: 这支队伍连续赢下20场比赛后似乎不可战胜。
他无敌的精神激励了身边的每个人。
没有堡垒是真正无法攻破的。

definitions.definition: （仪式中的）祈祷，咒语；援引（法律、权威等）

en: The priest began the ceremony with an ancient invocation.
Her speech included an invocation of the First Amendment.
Poets often use invocations to the Muse for inspiration.
cn: 祭司以一段古老的祷词开始了仪式。
她的演讲援引了《第一修正案》。
诗人常向缪斯女神祈求灵感。

en: The supplier emailed the invoice for the recent order.
Please invoice the client separately for shipping costs.
Discrepancies in the invoice delayed the payment.
cn: 供应商通过邮件发送了最新订单的发票。
请单独为客户开具运费发票。
发票中的 discrepancies（差异）导致付款延迟。

definitions.definition: 援引（法律、权威等）；调用（程序或数据）

en: The lawyer invoked a precedent to support her case.
The ritual invokes the spirits of ancestors.
This command will invoke the system's backup function.
cn: 律师援引先例支持她的论点。
仪式召唤祖先的灵魂。
此命令将调用系统的备份功能。

en: An involuntary shudder ran through her body when she heard the news.
Breathing is an involuntary action controlled by the brainstem.
He gave an involuntary smile at the memory.
cn: 听到消息时，她不由自主地颤抖起来。
呼吸是由脑干控制的无意识行为。
回忆往事时，他不自觉地露出了微笑。

definitions.definition: 无法伤害的；无懈可击的

en: The fortress was considered invulnerable to attack.
His confidence made him feel invulnerable.
No system is entirely invulnerable to cyber threats.
cn: 这座堡垒曾被认为是无法攻破的。
他的自信让他觉得自己无懈可击。
没有任何系统能完全免受网络威胁的侵害。

en: Potassium iodide is often added to table salt to prevent iodine deficiency.
The laboratory test confirmed the presence of silver iodide in the solution.
Some photographic films are sensitive to light due to the silver iodide within them.
cn: 碘化钾常被添加到食盐中以预防碘缺乏症。
实验室测试证实了溶液中存在碘化银。
一些摄影胶片因其内部的碘化银而对光敏感。

en: Iodine is essential for thyroid hormone production.
The doctor applied iodine to disinfect the wound.
Seaweed is a natural source of iodine.
cn: 碘对甲状腺激素的生成至关重要。
医生用碘酒消毒伤口。
海藻是碘的天然来源。

definitions.definition: 离子（带电的原子或分子）

en: Sodium ions are crucial for nerve signal transmission.
The battery generates power by moving ions between electrodes.
This filter removes heavy metal ions from water.
cn: 钠离子对神经信号传递至关重要。
电池通过电极间离子的移动产生电能。
该过滤器可去除水中的重金属离子。

en: His irascible temper made negotiations difficult.
The old professor was known for being irascible but brilliant.
Sleep deprivation often leaves people feeling irascible.
cn: 他暴躁的脾气使谈判变得困难。
这位老教授以脾气暴躁但才华横溢著称。
睡眠不足常会让人易怒。

en: The doctor examined the patient's iris for signs of disease.
She planted purple irises along the garden path.
In ancient art, Iris was often depicted with wings and a rainbow.
cn: 医生检查了患者的虹膜以寻找疾病迹象。
她在花园小径旁种了紫色鸢尾花。
在古代艺术中，彩虹女神 Iris 常被描绘成带有翅膀和彩虹的形象。

en: The constant noise began to irk the students during the exam.
His habit of interrupting people really irks me.
Small delays like this irk her more than major problems.
cn: 持续的噪音开始让考试中的学生们感到烦躁。
他打断别人说话的习惯让我非常厌烦。
这种小延误比大问题更让她恼火。

definitions.definition: 令人厌烦的；使人烦恼的

en: The constant noise from the construction site became increasingly irksome.
Her irksome habit of interrupting others made the meeting unbearable.
Filling out lengthy forms is an irksome but necessary task.
cn: 建筑工地的持续噪音变得越来越烦人。
她打断别人的恼人习惯让会议难以忍受。
填写冗长的表格是件烦人但必要的工作。

definitions.definition: 照亮；用辐射处理；使生辉

en: The sun continues to irradiate the earth with warmth and light.
Food is sometimes irradiated to kill bacteria and extend its shelf life.
Her smile seemed to irradiate the entire room with joy.
cn: 太阳持续以温暖和光芒照耀地球。
食物有时经过辐射处理以杀死细菌并延长保质期。
她的笑容仿佛让整个房间都洋溢着欢乐。

definitions.definition: 无法和解的；势不两立的

en: Their differences were irreconcilable, leading to a permanent rift.
The two theories are irreconcilable on this fundamental point.
He viewed the demands as irreconcilable with his principles.
cn: 他们的分歧不可调和，最终导致永久决裂。
这两种理论在这一基本点上无法相容。
他认为这些要求与自己的原则势不两立。

definitions.definition: 不可简化的；不可约分的；不能削减的
（尤指数学或物理学中）不可简化的，不可约的

en: The complexity of human emotion is irreducible to simple chemical reactions.
In mathematics, an irreducible fraction is one that cannot be simplified further.
He argued that there is an irreducible minimum of rights that every citizen should possess.
cn: 人类情感的复杂性无法被简化为简单的化学反应。
在数学中，最简分数是指一个无法再被进一步简化的分数。
他主张存在一个每位公民都应享有的、不可削减的最低限度的权利。

definitions.definition: 无法修复的；不可挽回的；不能弥补的

en: The storm caused irreparable damage to the coastal village.
Losing that contract was an irreparable blow to the company's finances.
Some mistakes in life are irreparable, so think carefully before you act.
cn: 风暴对沿海村庄造成了不可挽回的破坏。
失去那份合同对公司的财务状况是一个无法弥补的打击。
人生中的一些错误是无法弥补的，因此要三思而后行。

definitions.definition: 压抑不住的；控制不住的

en: Her irrepressible optimism lifted the spirits of the entire team.
He felt an irrepressible urge to laugh during the serious meeting.
The children's irrepressible energy is both exhausting and delightful.
cn: 她那种压抑不住的乐观精神鼓舞了整个团队的士气。
在那场严肃的会议中，他感到一种抑制不住想笑的冲动。
孩子们那压抑不住的精力既让人筋疲力尽，又令人愉悦。

definitions.definition: 不考虑的；无关的（常与 of 连用）

en: The law applies to everyone, irrespective of nationality.
He was hired irrespective of his lack of experience.
The event is open to all, irrespective of income level.
cn: 法律适用于所有人，无论国籍。
尽管缺乏经验，他仍被录用。
活动向所有人开放，与收入水平无关。

definitions.definition: 无法挽回的；不能恢复的；无法补救的

en: The loss of the data was irretrievable, causing a major setback for the project.
He realized that the opportunity was irretrievably gone.
The damage to the ecosystem is thought to be irretrievable.
cn: 数据的丢失是无法恢复的，给项目造成了重大挫折。
他意识到那个机会已经一去不复返了。
生态系统的损害被认为是不可逆转的。

definitions.definition: 不敬的，无礼的（尤指对神圣或权威事物）

en: His irreverent jokes about the ceremony shocked the elders.
The artist’s irreverent style challenges societal norms.
She wrote an irreverent biography of the famous politician.
cn: 他对仪式的无礼玩笑让长辈们震惊。
这位艺术家叛逆的风格挑战了社会规范。
她为那位著名政治家写了一本不敬的传记。

en: Climate change may soon reach an irreversible tipping point.
The damage to the ancient artifact is irreversible.
His decision to resign was irreversible once submitted.
cn: 气候变化可能很快达到不可逆转的临界点。
这件古代文物的损坏是不可修复的。
他的辞职申请一旦提交便无法撤回。

definitions.definition: 不可撤销的；不可改变的

en: The judge’s decision is irrevocable.
Signing the contract made the agreement irrevocable.
Time’s passage is irrevocable, like water flowing downstream.
cn: 法官的判决不可撤销。
签署合同后，协议便不可更改。
时间的流逝如江水东流，不可逆转。

definitions.definition: 刺激物；令人烦恼的事物

en: The chemical is a known skin irritant.
His constant interruptions were an irritant during the meeting.
Pollen can be a major irritant for allergy sufferers.
cn: 这种化学物质是已知的皮肤刺激物。
他频繁的打断让会议变得令人烦躁。
花粉可能是过敏患者的主要刺激源。

en: The irruption of protesters into the government building caused chaos.
There was a sudden irruption of birds from the trees as the fox approached.
The company struggled to handle the irruption of customer complaints after the product recall.
cn: 抗议者突然闯入政府大楼引发了混乱。
狐狸靠近时，鸟群突然从树林中涌出。
产品召回后，公司难以应对客户投诉的激增。

definitions.definition: 同位素（化学中原子序数相同但质量数不同的元素变体）

en: Carbon-14 is a radioactive isotope used in dating ancient artifacts.
Stable isotopes like oxygen-18 help scientists study climate history.
The hospital uses medical isotopes for diagnostic imaging.
cn: 碳14是一种用于测定文物年代的放射性同位素。
氧18等稳定同位素帮助科学家研究气候历史。
医院使用医用同位素进行诊断成像。

en: The company announced the issuance of new shares to raise capital.
The issuance of the decree caused widespread public discussion.
There is a strict procedure for the issuance of official documents.
cn: 公司宣布发行新股以筹集资金。
该项法令的颁布引起了公众的广泛讨论。
官方文件的签发有一套严格的程序。

en: The mosquito bite made my arm itch terribly.
She has an itch to travel the world alone.
Wool sweaters always give me an itch.
cn: 蚊虫叮咬让我的手臂奇痒难忍。
她渴望独自环游世界。
羊毛毛衣总让我觉得发痒。

definitions.definition: 巡回的；流动的（指工作或生活方式）
巡回工作者（如巡回牧师、商贩等）

en: The itinerant preacher visited remote villages every month.
Circus performers often lead an itinerant lifestyle.
She worked as an itinerant nurse in rural areas.
cn: 这位巡回传教士每月造访偏远村庄。
马戏团演员常过着流动的生活。
她曾在农村地区担任流动护士。

en: She printed out her travel itinerary before the trip.
The ancient Roman itineraries included distances between towns.
Our itinerary covers three cities in five days.
cn: 她在出发前打印了旅行行程。
古罗马的旅行记录包含城镇间的距离。
我们的行程计划在五天内游览三座城市。

en: The old stone wall was covered with lush ivy.
Ivy League universities are renowned for their academic excellence.
She wore a crown of ivy leaves in the spring festival.
cn: 古老的石墙上爬满了茂盛的常春藤。
常春藤盟校以学术卓越著称。
她在春节时戴了一顶常春藤叶编成的花环。

definitions.definition: 戳刺的动作；短促的击打（如拳击中的刺拳）

en: She jabbed her finger at the map to emphasize the location.
The boxer trained his jab for hours every day.
He felt a sharp jab in his arm from the needle.
cn: 她用手指戳着地图强调那个位置。
拳击手每天花数小时练习刺拳。
他感到针头在手臂上猛地刺了一下。

ipa: UK /ˈdʒæk ɪn ðə ˌbɒks/ · US /ˈdʒæk ɪn ðə ˌbɑːks/

definitions.definition: 玩偶盒（一种玩具，打开盒盖会弹出一个玩偶）
（首字母大写J）杰克魔豆（一种植物）

en: The children screamed with delight when the jack-in-the-box popped up.
He turned the handle of the jack-in-the-box, waiting for the surprise.
The old jack-in-the-box was a cherished toy from her childhood.
cn: 当玩偶盒里的玩偶突然弹出来时，孩子们兴奋地尖叫起来。
他转动着玩偶盒的把手，等待着那个惊喜。
那个旧的玩偶盒是她童年时代珍爱的玩具。

definitions.definition: 万事通；杂而不精的人；万金油

en: He's a jack-of-all-trades, able to fix everything from a leaky faucet to a broken computer.
While she's a jack-of-all-trades in the office, she hasn't truly mastered a specific skill.
The term "jack-of-all-trades" is often completed by the phrase "master of none."
cn: 他是个万事通，从修理漏水的水龙头到修电脑样样都会。
虽然她在办公室里是个多面手，但并没有真正掌握一门特定的技能。
“万事通”这个说法后面常会接上一句“但样样不精”。

definitions.definition: 边缘不规则的，锯齿状的

en: The mountain ridge rose in a jagged line against the sky.
Her voice had a jagged edge, full of unresolved anger.
Be careful with that broken bottle—the edges are jagged.
cn: 山脊在天空映衬下呈现锯齿状的轮廓。
她的声音带着尖锐的棱角，充满未消解的愤怒。
小心那个碎瓶子——边缘很锋利。

definitions.definition: 术语，行话（特定领域或群体使用的专业或晦涩语言）
胡言乱语，难以理解的话

en: The doctor's report was full of medical jargon.
Don't use jargon when explaining it to beginners.
His speech devolved into incoherent jargon.
cn: 医生的报告里满是医学术语。
向初学者解释时不要用行话。
他的演讲逐渐变成了语无伦次的胡话。

definitions.definition: 标枪（一种轻型投掷长矛）

en: The athlete trained for years to perfect his javelin throw.
In ancient warfare, the javelin was a common weapon among light infantry.
She won a gold medal in the javelin at the national championships.
cn: 这名运动员训练了多年，以完善他的标枪投掷技术。
在古代战争中，标枪是轻步兵的常见武器。
她在全国锦标赛中赢得了标枪项目的金牌。

definitions.definition: 乱穿马路，不遵守交通规则横穿街道

en: The police officer fined the pedestrian for jaywalking across the busy intersection.
cn: 警察对乱穿繁忙十字路口的行人处以罚款。

en: The crowd began to jeer when the opposing team missed the penalty kick.
He tried to ignore the jeers from the audience and continued his speech.
It's cruel to jeer at someone for making a mistake.
cn: 当对方球队罚失点球时，人群开始发出嘲笑。
他试图无视观众的嘲弄，继续他的演讲。
因为别人犯了错而嘲笑他们是残酷的。

definitions.definition: 水母（海洋中透明的胶状生物）

en: The jellyfish glowed faintly in the dark ocean.
Don’t be such a jellyfish—stand up for yourself!
Scientists study jellyfish to understand marine ecosystems.
cn: 水母在黑暗的海洋中发出微弱的光。
别这么懦弱，为自己挺身而出！
科学家研究水母以了解海洋生态系统。

en: Smoking will jeopardize your health.
The scandal could jeopardize his political career.
Delaying repairs may jeopardize the building's safety.
cn: 吸烟会危害你的健康。
这桩丑闻可能断送他的政治生涯。
拖延维修可能危及建筑安全。

definitions.definition: 抽动的；颠簸的；不平稳的

en: The car moved in a jerky manner over the rough road.
He prefers beef jerky as a high-protein snack.
Her handwriting was jerky due to nervousness.
cn: 汽车在崎岖的路上颠簸前行。
他喜欢把牛肉干作为高蛋白零食。
由于紧张，她的字迹显得潦草断续。

en: He said it in jest, not meaning to offend anyone.
Her jests lightened the mood of the meeting.
Don't jest about such serious matters.
cn: 他是开玩笑说的，并非有意冒犯任何人。
她的玩笑缓和了会议的气氛。
不要拿这么严肃的事情开玩笑。

definitions.definition: 突堤；防波堤（延伸至水中的建筑物，用于船只停靠或保护海岸）

en: The fishing boat was moored at the end of the jetty.
Waves crashed against the stone jetty during the storm.
They walked hand in hand along the wooden jetty at sunset.
cn: 渔船停泊在突堤的尽头。
暴风雨中，海浪猛烈拍打着石砌防波堤。
日落时分，他们手牵手走在木制突堤上。

definitions.definition: 用线锯切割；使错综复杂

en: She spent hours assembling the jigsaw puzzle.
The carpenter used a jigsaw to cut intricate shapes.
The plot was jigsawed with unexpected twists.
cn: 她花了几个小时拼拼图。
木匠用线锯切割出复杂的形状。
剧情错综复杂，充满意外转折。

definitions.definition: 叮当声；短小押韵的广告语

en: The bells jingled merrily as the sleigh moved through the snow.
She couldn't get that catchy jingle out of her head.
He jingled the coins in his pocket nervously.
cn: 雪橇穿过雪地时，铃铛欢快地叮当作响。
她无法忘记那段朗朗上口的广告歌谣。
他紧张地拨弄着口袋里的硬币，发出叮当声。

en: He made a jocular remark to lighten the mood.
Her jocular personality makes her very popular at parties.
The meeting was conducted in a jocular spirit, despite the serious topic.
cn: 他开了个玩笑来缓和气氛。
她幽默的性格使她在聚会上很受欢迎。
尽管话题严肃，会议还是在一种诙谐的气氛中进行。

en: She jogs every morning to stay healthy.
He gave the table a slight jog to straighten it.
A quick jog around the park clears my mind.
cn: 她每天早晨慢跑以保持健康。
他轻轻推了下桌子让它摆正。
在公园里慢跑一圈能让我的头脑清醒。

en: The bus jolted to a stop, throwing passengers forward.
cn: 公交车猛地停下，乘客们向前倾倒。

definitions.definition: /vi. 推挤，冲撞（尤指在人群中）

en: Tourists jostled for the best view of the parade.
The crowd jostled him as he tried to exit the subway.
A playful jostle between siblings turned into an argument.
cn: 游客们推挤着争夺游行最佳观赏位置。
他试图离开地铁时，人群不断推挤他。
兄妹间嬉闹的推挤演变成了争吵。

definitions.definition: 操纵杆（控制飞机、游戏等的杆状装置）

en: The pilot gripped the joystick tightly during the turbulent flight.
He customized his gaming joystick with LED lights.
cn: 飞行员在颠簸的飞行中紧握操纵杆。
他为游戏操纵杆加装了LED灯。

en: The crowd was jubilant after their team won the championship.
She gave a jubilant shout when she received the good news.
The jubilant atmosphere filled the entire city during the festival.
cn: 人群在球队夺冠后欢欣鼓舞。
她听到好消息时发出了喜悦的呼喊。
节日期间，整座城市洋溢着欢庆的气氛。

en: She made a judicious decision to invest in renewable energy.
His judicious remarks helped resolve the conflict.
A judicious blend of tradition and innovation defines their approach.
cn: 她做出了明智的决定，投资可再生能源。
他审慎的发言帮助化解了冲突。
传统与创新的明智结合定义了他们的方法。

definitions.definition: 同时应付多项任务；篡改（数据等）

en: He can juggle five balls at once.
She juggles work and family effortlessly.
The accountant was caught juggling the numbers.
cn: 他能同时抛接五个球。
她游刃有余地兼顾工作和家庭。
这名会计因篡改数据被抓获。

definitions.definition: 混乱的混合物；杂乱的一堆

en: The drawer was a jumble of old receipts and broken pens.
Don't jumble the files—keep them in order.
Her thoughts were a jumble of excitement and fear.
cn: 抽屉里杂乱地堆着旧收据和坏掉的笔。
别把文件弄乱，保持有序。
她的思绪交织着兴奋与恐惧，一片混乱。

definitions.definition: 庞然大物（尤指大象或其他大型物体）

en: The jumbo jet can carry over 500 passengers.
Kids were excited to ride the jumbo roller coaster.
She bought a jumbo pack of toilet paper during the sale.
cn: 这架巨型喷气式飞机可搭载500多名乘客。
孩子们对乘坐巨型过山车感到兴奋。
促销期间她买了一大包卫生纸。

en: The company is at a critical juncture in its expansion plan.
Pay attention to the juncture between the two syllables.
Historical junctures often redefine national identities.
cn: 公司正处于扩张计划的关键时刻。
注意两个音节之间的音渡。
历史转折点常重塑民族认同。

en: The court has no jurisdiction over foreign diplomats.
This matter falls outside our jurisdiction.
The federal and state governments share jurisdiction in some areas.
cn: 该法院对外国外交官无管辖权。
此事超出我们的管辖范围。
联邦和州政府在某些领域共享管辖权。

definitions.definition: 陪审员（法庭中参与裁决的公民）

en: The juror listened carefully to the witness testimony.
Twelve jurors must reach a unanimous verdict in this case.
She was excused from serving as a juror due to personal bias.
cn: 陪审员仔细聆听了证人的证词。
本案需十二名陪审员达成一致裁决。
她因个人偏见被免除陪审员义务。

en: The park has a special area for juvenile offenders to receive education.
His juvenile behavior annoyed the serious committee members.
The zoo’s new exhibit features juvenile elephants playing in the water.
cn: 公园设有专门区域让青少年罪犯接受教育。
他幼稚的行为惹恼了严肃的委员会成员。
动物园的新展区展示了幼象在水中嬉戏的场景。

definitions.definition: 将（两事物）并列或并置以形成对比

en: The exhibition juxtaposes modern art with ancient artifacts.
By juxtaposing these two images, the photographer highlights social inequality.
The poet often juxtaposes light and darkness in her works.
cn: 展览将现代艺术与古代文物并置对比。
摄影师通过并置这两张图片，突显社会不平等。
这位诗人常在作品中并置光明与黑暗。

en: The ship's keel was damaged in the storm.
The yacht keeled over in strong winds.
Carpenters reinforced the keel with oak timber.
cn: 风暴中船的龙骨受损。
游艇在强风中倾覆。
木匠用橡木加固了龙骨。

en: The dog ran back to its kennel when it started raining.
She kennels her Labrador during the day while she's at work.
The city requires all pet owners to license their kennels.
cn: 下雨时，狗跑回了它的狗舍。
她白天上班时会把拉布拉多犬关在狗舍里。
市政府要求所有宠物主人为狗舍办理许可证。

definitions.definition: 【计算机】内核（操作系统的核心部分）

en: The kernel of a walnut is rich in healthy fats.
The kernel of his argument was hard to refute.
Linux is known for its modular kernel design.
cn: 核桃仁富含健康脂肪。
他论点的核心难以反驳。
Linux以其模块化的内核设计闻名。

definitions.definition: （事件、活动的）开始；足球比赛的开球

en: The project kickoff meeting is scheduled for Monday.
The crowd cheered as the player prepared for the kickoff.
We'll kick off the campaign with a social media blast.
cn: 项目启动会议定于周一举行。
球员准备开球时，人群欢呼起来。
我们将通过社交媒体轰炸启动这场活动。

en: She invited all her kin to the reunion.
They are not related by blood, but they are kin in spirit.
The tribe protects its kin fiercely.
cn: 她邀请了所有亲属参加家族聚会。
他们没有血缘关系，但精神上是亲人。
这个部落竭力保护自己的族人。

en: She discovered a kindred spirit in her love for poetry.
The festival gathers people of kindred cultures.
His kindred still live in the ancestral village.
cn: 她在对诗歌的热爱中找到了志同道合的人。
这个节日汇聚了文化同源的人们。
他的亲属仍住在祖辈的村庄里。

definitions.definition: （情感或特征的）相似性，紧密联系

en: The kinship between the two cultures is evident in their shared traditions.
She felt a deep kinship with the orphaned child.
Genetic testing can reveal unexpected kinships.
cn: 两种文化间的亲缘关系体现在它们共有的传统中。
她对那个孤儿有一种深深的亲近感。
基因检测能揭示意想不到的血缘关系。

definitions.definition: 几维（一种新西兰特有的无翼鸟）

en: The kiwi is a flightless bird native to New Zealand.
I added some fresh kiwi to the fruit salad.
The team is comprised of both Australians and Kiwis.
cn: 几维是一种原产于新西兰的不会飞的鸟。
我在水果沙拉里加了一些新鲜的猕猴桃。
这支队伍由澳大利亚人和新西兰人组成。

definitions.definition: 诀窍；技能（尤指通过实践获得的灵巧能力）
习惯；癖好（常指难以解释的行为倾向）

en: She has a knack for making people feel at ease.
The old carpenter’s knack with wood was unmatched.
He developed a knack of tapping his fingers when thinking.
cn: 她擅长让人放松。
这位老木匠的木材处理技艺无人能及。
他养成了思考时轻敲手指的习惯。

en: She kneaded the dough until it became smooth and elastic.
The masseur kneaded my sore shoulders with firm pressure.
Kneading clay helps to remove air bubbles before sculpting.
cn: 她揉面团直到它变得光滑有弹性。
按摩师用有力的手法揉捏我酸痛的肩膀。
在塑形前揉捏黏土有助于去除气泡。

definitions.definition: 实际知识；技术诀窍；专业技能

en: The company's success lies in its technical knowhow.
She acquired her culinary knowhow from years of practice.
Sharing knowhow is essential for team collaboration.
cn: 这家公司的成功在于其技术诀窍。
她的烹饪技巧来自多年的实践。
分享专业知识对团队协作至关重要。

en: The construction of the pyramid was a laborious process.
She made laborious progress in learning the violin.
His laborious research finally led to a breakthrough.
cn: 金字塔的建造是一个艰苦的过程。
她在学习小提琴方面取得了艰辛的进步。
他刻苦的研究最终带来了突破。

en: The artist applied lacquer to the wooden box for a glossy finish.
Traditional Japanese lacquerware is highly durable.
She lacquered her nails with a vibrant red color.
cn: 艺术家给木盒上漆，使其表面光滑。
日本传统漆器非常耐用。
她给指甲涂上了鲜艳的红色指甲油。

en: She used a wooden ladle to serve the soup.
He carefully ladled the sauce over the pasta.
The antique silver ladle was a family heirloom.
cn: 她用木勺盛汤。
他小心地将酱汁舀到意大利面上。
这把古董银勺是家族传家宝。

definitions.definition: 一种底部发酵的淡啤酒；拉格啤酒

en: He prefers the crisp, clean taste of a lager to heavier ales.
The brewery is famous for its classic German-style lager.
We sat in the beer garden, each with a cold pint of lager.
cn: 他更喜欢拉格啤酒清爽的口感，而不是更浓烈的艾尔啤酒。
这家啤酒厂以其经典的德式拉格啤酒而闻名。
我们坐在啤酒花园里，每人拿着一品脱冰镇的拉格啤酒。

definitions.definition: 潟湖（被沙洲或珊瑚礁与海洋隔开的浅水湖）

en: The resort is built beside a crystal-clear lagoon.
Coral reefs often form protective barriers around lagoons.
The flamingos feed in the shallow waters of the lagoon.
cn: 度假村建在清澈的潟湖畔。
珊瑚礁常构成潟湖的天然防护屏障。
火烈鸟在潟湖的浅水区觅食。

en: She lamented the passing of an era.
The poem is a lament for fallen soldiers.
He laments loudly about his misfortunes.
cn: 她为一个时代的逝去而哀叹。
这首诗是对阵亡士兵的挽歌。
他大声哀叹自己的不幸。

definitions.definition: 长矛；矛状器具（如手术刀、鱼叉）
用矛刺穿；用手术刀切开

en: The knight lowered his lance and charged at the enemy.
The surgeon used a lance to drain the abscess.
Fishermen in the region still lance whales as part of traditional hunting.
cn: 骑士压低长矛，向敌人冲锋。
外科医生用柳叶刀切开脓肿引流。
该地区的渔民仍保留用鱼叉捕鲸的传统。

en: The heat made everyone feel languid and uninterested in work.
She moved with a languid grace, as if time had slowed down.
His languid response suggested he hadn't slept well.
cn: 高温让所有人都无精打采，对工作提不起兴趣。
她的动作带着慵懒的优雅，仿佛时间已放缓。
他有气无力的回答表明他没睡好。

en: The flowers languished in the drought.
His talents languished in a dead-end job.
Refugees languish in overcrowded camps.
cn: 花朵在干旱中凋萎。
他的才华在毫无前途的工作中被埋没。
难民在拥挤的营地里备受煎熬。

definitions.definition: 疏忽；小错误；（时间的）流逝
失效；衰退；陷入（某种状态）

en: The contract will lapse if not renewed within 30 days.
A momentary lapse in concentration caused the accident.
Years had lapsed since their last meeting.
cn: 若30天内未续签，合同将失效。
一时走神导致了事故。
距离他们上次见面已过去多年。

en: His persistent cough was diagnosed as laryngitis by the doctor.
Laryngitis often results in hoarseness or complete loss of the voice.
She was advised to rest her voice to recover from laryngitis.
cn: 医生诊断他持续的咳嗽是喉炎。
喉炎常常导致声音嘶哑或完全失声。
她被建议少说话，以便从喉炎中恢复。

definitions.definition: 喉，喉头，位于咽和气管之间的器官，包含声带。

en: The larynx is commonly known as the voice box.
During the procedure, the surgeon examined the patient's larynx for any abnormalities.
When you swallow, the larynx moves upward to help prevent food from entering the airway.
cn: 喉通常被称为嗓音盒。
在手术过程中，外科医生检查了病人的喉部以排查任何异常。
当你吞咽时，喉部会向上移动，帮助防止食物进入气道。

en: She lifted the latch and pushed the door open.
The child latched onto his mother’s arm in fear.
Investors quickly latched onto the new trend.
cn: 她抬起门闩，推开了门。
孩子害怕地紧紧抓住母亲的手臂。
投资者迅速抓住了这一新趋势。

en: The lateral movement of the dancer impressed the audience.
The car sustained damage to its lateral panel in the accident.
She proposed a lateral solution to the problem, avoiding direct confrontation.
cn: 舞者的横向移动让观众印象深刻。
事故中车辆的侧面面板受损。
她提出一个侧面解决问题的方案，避免了直接冲突。

en: The craftsman used a lathe to shape the piece of wood into a table leg.
Modern lathes are often controlled by computers for precision manufacturing.
Learning to operate a lathe requires patience and practice.
cn: 这位工匠使用车床将一块木头加工成桌子腿。
现代车床通常由计算机控制以实现精密制造。
学习操作车床需要耐心和练习。

en: I need to go to the launderette to wash my blankets.
cn: 我得去自助洗衣店洗我的毯子。

definitions.definition: 月桂树；桂冠（象征胜利或荣誉）

en: She wore a crown of laurel leaves in the ancient Greek festival.
The poet’s laurels were well-deserved after his masterpiece was published.
Don’t rest on your laurels; keep striving for improvement.
cn: 她在古希腊节日中戴着一顶月桂叶编成的冠冕。
这位诗人的杰作出版后，他的荣誉实至名归。
不要安于现状，继续追求进步。

en: The host laid out a lavish feast for the guests.
She lavished praise on her team for their hard work.
Critics accused him of lavish spending on unnecessary projects.
cn: 主人为宾客准备了奢华的盛宴。
她慷慨赞扬团队的辛勤付出。
批评者指责他在不必要的项目上挥霍无度。

en: The company filed a lawsuit against its competitor for patent infringement.
The lawsuit was settled out of court to avoid negative publicity.
She won the lawsuit and received compensation for damages.
cn: 该公司因专利侵权对竞争对手提起了诉讼。
为避免负面舆论，该诉讼在庭外和解。
她赢得了诉讼，并获得了损害赔偿。

en: The company's lax security policies led to a data breach.
After the massage, her shoulders felt pleasantly lax.
Critics accused the government of being too lax on environmental regulations.
cn: 该公司松散的安全政策导致了数据泄露。
按摩后，她的肩膀感到舒适放松。
批评者指责政府对环境法规过于宽松。

en: The company announced massive layoffs due to financial losses.
He struggled to find a new job after the layoff.
Temporary layoffs are common in the automotive industry.
cn: 公司因财务亏损宣布大规模裁员。
被裁员后，他艰难地寻找新工作。
临时解雇在汽车行业中很常见。

en: She placed the vase on the window ledge.
The climbers rested on a narrow ledge halfway up the cliff.
His experience gave him a ledge over other candidates.
cn: 她把花瓶放在窗台上。
登山者在悬崖中段狭窄的岩架上休息。
他的经验使他比其他候选人更具优势。

en: The accountant updated the company's ledger every Friday.
They found an ancient ledger stone in the churchyard.
The carpenter measured the ledger board before installation.
cn: 会计每周五更新公司的分类账。
他们在教堂墓地发现了一块古老的平卧墓碑。
木匠在安装前测量了横木板。

definitions.definition: 韭菜；韭葱（一种类似洋葱的蔬菜）

en: Welsh soldiers wore leeks in their hats to identify themselves.
The soup is flavored with fresh leeks and potatoes.
Leeks belong to the same family as onions and garlic.
cn: 威尔士士兵在帽子上佩戴韭葱以标识身份。
这道汤用新鲜韭葱和土豆调味。
韭葱与洋葱、大蒜同属一科。

en: The new policy gives teachers more leeway in designing curricula.
The ship lost leeway in the storm and drifted off course.
We should leave some leeway for unexpected delays.
cn: 新政策为教师设计课程提供了更大灵活性。
船只在风暴中因风压差偏离航线。
我们应为意外延误留出缓冲余地。

en: The government plans to legalise cannabis for medical use.
Some argue it’s time to legalise euthanasia under strict regulations.
The bill failed to legalise online gambling last year.
cn: 政府计划将医用大麻合法化。
有人认为应在严格监管下将安乐死合法化。
该法案去年未能使网络赌博合法化。

en: His legendary bravery inspired generations.
The restaurant is legendary for its spicy noodles.
Some of the details in the story are clearly legendary.
cn: 他的传奇勇气激励了数代人。
这家餐厅以辣面闻名遐迩。
故事中的某些细节显然是虚构的。

en: Her handwriting is remarkably legible despite being written in haste.
Please ensure that all forms are filled out in black ink and are completely legible.
The document was old, but the text was still legible under the light.
cn: 尽管是匆忙写就，她的笔迹依然异常清晰。
请确保所有表格都用黑色墨水填写，并且字迹完全清晰可读。
文件很旧，但在灯光下文字仍然清晰可辨。

en: The council meets monthly to legislate on local issues.
It is not the court's role to legislate, but to interpret laws.
Many countries have legislated against discrimination in the workplace.
cn: 理事会每月开会为地方事务立法。
法院的职责并非立法，而是解释法律。
许多国家已立法禁止职场歧视。

en: The new law aims to legitimize same-sex marriage nationwide.
Historians debate whether the treaty truly legitimized the colonial occupation.
She used scientific data to legitimize her controversial theory.
cn: 新法律旨在全国范围内使同性婚姻合法化。
历史学家争论该条约是否真正使殖民占领合法化。
她用科学数据证明自己争议性理论的合理性。

en: The judge showed leniency due to the defendant's remorse and clean record.
Her leniency as a manager made her very popular among the interns.
There is a call for greater leniency in the sentencing of non-violent offenders.
cn: 法官因被告的悔意和清白过往而给予了宽大处理。
她作为经理的宽厚仁慈使她在实习生中非常受欢迎。
对于非暴力罪犯的量刑，外界呼吁应给予更大的宽容。

en: The teacher was lenient with the students who missed the deadline.
The judge imposed a lenient sentence due to the defendant’s remorse.
Some argue that lenient parenting leads to irresponsible children.
cn: 这位老师对逾期未交作业的学生很宽容。
因被告悔过，法官作出了从轻判决。
有人认为宽松的育儿方式会让孩子缺乏责任感。

definitions.definition: 麻风病，一种慢性传染病，主要影响皮肤、神经和黏膜

en: Leprosy is now curable with multidrug therapy.
Historical records show leprosy was often misunderstood in ancient societies.
Early detection of leprosy prevents permanent nerve damage.
cn: 麻风病如今可通过联合药物疗法治愈。
历史记录表明，古代社会常对麻风病存在误解。
早期发现麻风病可避免永久性神经损伤。

definitions.definition: 女同性恋的；与女同性恋相关的

en: She came out as a lesbian in her college years.
The film explores lesbian relationships in the 1920s.
The term "lesbian" originates from the Greek island of Lesbos.
cn: 她在大学时期公开了自己的女同性恋身份。
这部电影探讨了20世纪20年代的女同性恋关系。
“Lesbian”一词源于希腊的莱斯博斯岛。

en: The snake's venom is lethal to small animals.
The accident resulted in lethal injuries.
The chemical was declared a lethal weapon.
cn: 这种蛇的毒液对小型动物是致命的。
事故造成了致命伤害。
该化学品被列为致命武器。

definitions.definition: 白血病（一种造血系统的恶性疾病）

en: The child was diagnosed with acute lymphoblastic leukemia.
Advances in chemotherapy have improved survival rates for leukemia patients.
Bone marrow transplants can cure certain types of leukemia.
cn: 这名儿童被诊断为急性淋巴细胞白血病。
化疗技术的进步提高了白血病患者的生存率。
骨髓移植可以治愈某些类型的白血病。

definitions.definition: 堤坝（人工修筑的防洪结构）
（君主或高官的）早晨接见会（历史用法）

en: The town built a levee to protect against river floods.
In 18th-century France, nobles attended the king's morning levee.
The levee broke after days of heavy rain.
cn: 小镇修筑了堤坝以防御河水泛滥。
18世纪法国，贵族们参加国王的晨间接见会。
连日暴雨后，堤坝决口了。

definitions.definition: 利用（资源或优势）；举债经营

en: The company used leverage to expand its market share.
She leveraged her network to find a new job.
Political leverage can be more powerful than economic force.
cn: 该公司利用杠杆效应扩大市场份额。
她借助人脉网络找到了新工作。
政治影响力有时比经济力量更强大。

definitions.definition: 轻浮，轻率（尤指不合时宜的幽默或轻松态度）

en: His joke brought momentary levity to the tense meeting.
The film balances dark themes with moments of levity.
cn: 他的玩笑为紧张的会议带来了片刻轻松。
这部电影用轻松瞬间平衡了黑暗主题。

en: The study focuses on lexical differences between dialects.
Lexical ambiguity can complicate language processing.
She specializes in lexical semantics.
cn: 这项研究关注方言间的词汇差异。
词汇歧义可能使语言处理复杂化。
她专攻词汇语义学。

definitions.definition: 场所，位置（现主要用于短语 in lieu of，表示“代替”）

en: He accepted a cash payment in lieu of vacation days.
The painting was donated to the museum in lieu of taxes.
She took on extra tasks in lieu of her absent colleague.
cn: 他接受了现金补偿以替代休假。
这幅画被捐赠给博物馆以抵税。
她代替缺席的同事承担了额外任务。

definitions.definition: 韧带（连接骨骼或固定器官的纤维结缔组织）

en: The athlete tore a ligament in his knee during the game.
Ligaments provide stability to joints by connecting bones.
Surgical repair is often needed for severe ligament damage.
cn: 运动员在比赛中撕裂了膝盖的一条韧带。
韧带通过连接骨骼为关节提供稳定性。
严重的韧带损伤通常需要手术修复。

en: The sunrise began to lighten the sky.
Her smile lightened the mood of the room.
The backpack is designed to lighten the load on your shoulders.
cn: 日出开始照亮天空。
她的笑容让房间里的气氛轻松起来。
这款背包的设计能减轻你肩部的负担。

en: Poets often liken love to a rose.
She likened the chaos to a storm.
The report likens the economic crisis to the Great Depression.
cn: 诗人常将爱情比作玫瑰。
她把混乱比作一场风暴。
报告将此次经济危机比作大萧条。

en: The likeness between the twins is uncanny.
The artist captured her likeness in charcoal.
There's a strong likeness in their writing styles.
cn: 这对双胞胎的相似程度令人难以置信。
艺术家用炭笔捕捉了她的肖像。
他们的写作风格极为相似。

definitions.definition: 丁香花（紫丁香属植物）；淡紫色

en: The garden was filled with the scent of lilacs in spring.
She wore a lilac dress to the party.
The sunset painted the sky in shades of lilac and pink.
cn: 春天，花园里弥漫着丁香花的芬芳。
她穿了一条淡紫色的裙子参加派对。
夕阳将天空染成淡紫与粉红的渐变色。

definitions.definition: 公众关注的中心；舞台聚光灯（原指石灰光灯）

en: The actor basked in the limelight after his award-winning performance.
Scientists rarely enjoy the limelight, though their work changes the world.
The invention of electric lights made limelights obsolete in theaters.
cn: 这位演员因获奖表演而备受瞩目。
科学家很少成为焦点，尽管他们的工作改变了世界。
电灯的发明使石灰光灯在剧院中被淘汰。

en: His lineage can be traced back to a royal family in the 15th century.
The study focuses on the lineage of ancient manuscripts.
Genetic testing revealed a surprising lineage in her ancestry.
cn: 他的世系可追溯至15世纪的一个王室家族。
这项研究专注于古代手稿的传承谱系。
基因检测显示她的祖先血统出人意料。

definitions.definition: （体育比赛中的）边线裁判员，司线员
（铁路或电话线的）线务员，架线工

en: The linesman raised his flag to signal that the ball had gone out of play.
His father worked as a linesman for the local telephone company.
The controversial offside call by the linesman was later confirmed by VAR.
cn: 边裁举旗示意球已出界。
他的父亲曾是当地电话公司的一名线务员。
边裁那次有争议的越位判罚后来被VAR（视频助理裁判）确认。

definitions.definition: 清算（债务或资产）；彻底处理
消灭，清除（尤指敌人或威胁）

en: The company was forced to liquidate its assets to pay creditors.
The dictator ordered his rivals to be liquidated.
She liquidated her stocks before the market crashed.
cn: 该公司被迫清算资产以偿还债权人。
独裁者下令清除政敌。
她在市场崩盘前抛售了股票。

en: The literal meaning of "blue" is a color, not sadness.
She translated the poem in a literal way, losing its poetic beauty.
His story was a literal account of the event.
cn: “蓝色”的字面意义是一种颜色，而非悲伤。
她逐字翻译了这首诗，失去了诗意的美感。
他的描述是对事件的真实记录。

definitions.definition: 字面上；确实地（用于强调事实）
（非正式）夸张地（用于加强语气，但实际并非字面意义）

en: The translation should follow the original text literally.
He was literally jumping for joy when he heard the news.
Some people misuse "literally" to emphasize figurative statements.
cn: 翻译应严格遵循原文的字面意思。
听到消息时，他简直高兴得跳了起来（夸张用法）。
有些人误用“literally”来强调比喻性的陈述。

definitions.definition: 有读写能力的；通晓文学的
识字的人；受过教育的人

en: Only 30% of adults were literate in the region a century ago.
Her literate analysis of the novel impressed the professors.
The program aims to make children financially literate.
cn: 一个世纪前，该地区仅有30%的成年人识字。
她对小说的博学分析令教授们印象深刻。
该项目旨在培养儿童的财务素养。

en: The company faced prolonged litigation over patent infringement.
Alternative dispute resolution can avoid costly litigation.
The litigation process requires extensive documentation.
cn: 该公司因专利侵权面临长期诉讼。
替代性纠纷解决机制可避免高昂的诉讼费用。
诉讼程序需要大量文件材料。

definitions.definition: & vi. 使活跃起来；使更有趣；变得活跃

en: He told a joke to liven up the meeting.
The music livened the party instantly.
Her mood livened when she heard the good news.
cn: 他讲了个笑话让会议活跃起来。
音乐立刻让派对活跃了起来。
听到这个好消息，她的情绪变得欢快起来。

definitions.definition: 青灰色的（尤指因淤伤或死亡）

en: His face turned livid after the accident.
She was livid when she discovered the betrayal.
The livid bruise on his arm faded slowly.
cn: 事故后他的脸色变得青灰。
发现背叛时，她暴怒不已。
他手臂上的淤青慢慢褪去。

en: She loathes the smell of cigarette smoke.
They loathe each other after the bitter argument.
He loathes having to wake up early.
cn: 她极度厌恶香烟的气味。
激烈争吵后，他们彼此憎恶。
他非常讨厌早起。

definitions.definition: （器官的）叶状部分（如脑叶、肺叶）
（植物或几何形状的）圆形凸起部分

en: The frontal lobe of the brain controls decision-making.
The leaf has three distinct lobes.
She gently touched the soft lobe of his ear.
cn: 大脑的额叶负责决策功能。
这片叶子有三个明显的裂瓣。
她轻轻触碰他柔软的耳垂。

definitions.definition: （仓库改造的）开放式高层空间

en: She converted the loft into a cozy bedroom.
The artist's studio was a bright loft in an old factory.
The golfer lofted the ball over the sand trap.
cn: 她把阁楼改造成了一间舒适的卧室。
这位艺术家的工作室是旧工厂里一个明亮的挑高层空间。
高尔夫球手将球高抛过沙坑。

definitions.definition: 物流；后勤（指物资、人员或信息的组织与协调）

en: Modern logistics relies heavily on data analytics.
The army improved its logistics to supply troops efficiently.
She studies logistics to optimize supply chains.
cn: 现代物流高度依赖数据分析。
军队优化了后勤系统以高效补给部队。
她学习物流学以优化供应链。

definitions.definition: 徽标；标识（企业或组织的视觉象征）
标志性符号（代表特定概念的图形或文字）

en: The company's logo features a stylized eagle.
A good logo should be simple and memorable.
She redesigned the school logo to reflect its modern values.
cn: 这家公司的徽标采用了一只抽象化的鹰。
优秀的标识应简洁且令人过目不忘。
她重新设计了校徽，以体现学校的现代价值观。

en: The chef grilled the loin of pork with rosemary.
He felt a sharp pain in his loins after lifting the heavy box.
Lamb loin is considered one of the most tender cuts.
cn: 厨师用迷迭香烤猪腰肉。
搬起重箱后，他感到腰部一阵剧痛。
羊腰肉被认为是最嫩的部位之一。

definitions.definition: 闲逛，游荡（尤指无明确目的或拖延时间）

en: Teenagers often loiter around the mall after school.
The security guard asked the man not to loiter near the entrance.
She loitered by the window, watching the rain fall.
cn: 青少年放学后常在商场闲逛。
保安要求那名男子不要在入口处逗留。
她在窗边徘徊，望着雨落下。

definitions.definition: 懒散地倚靠或悬挂；放松地垂下
让（舌头或肢体）松弛地垂下

en: The dog's tongue lolled out as it panted in the heat.
She lolled against the sofa, too tired to move.
The ripe apples lolled heavily on the branches.
cn: 狗狗在炎热中喘气，舌头懒洋洋地耷拉着。
她懒散地靠在沙发上，累得不想动弹。
成熟的苹果沉甸甸地垂挂在枝头。

en: The sailor climbed to the lookout to scan the horizon.
Keep a lookout for suspicious activity in the neighborhood.
The economic lookout for next year seems uncertain.
cn: 水手爬上瞭望台扫视地平线。
注意监视社区内的可疑活动。
明年的经济前景似乎不明朗。

definitions.definition: 漏洞（法律或规则中的不完善处）
狭小开口（原指城墙上的射箭孔）

en: The lawyer found a legal loophole to avoid taxes.
Medieval castles had loopholes for archers.
They exploited a loophole in the system.
cn: 律师发现了一个避税的法律漏洞。
中世纪城堡有为弓箭手设计的射箭孔。
他们利用了系统中的漏洞。

en: The thieves hid their loot in an abandoned warehouse.
During the riot, shops were looted and burned.
Archaeologists discovered ancient loot buried by pirates.
cn: 窃贼将赃物藏在一座废弃仓库里。
暴乱期间，商店遭抢劫并焚毁。
考古学家发现了海盗埋藏的古战利品。

definitions.definition: 修剪下来的树枝；被砍下的部分

en: The gardener lops the overhanging branches every spring.
The dog's ears lop down adorably when it runs.
We gathered the lops from the orchard floor to use as firewood.
cn: 园丁每年春天都会修剪垂悬的树枝。
那只狗奔跑时，耳朵可爱地耷拉着。
我们收集了果园地上修剪下的树枝用作木柴。

en: The painting hung lopsided on the wall.
The team had a lopsided victory with a score of 10-1.
Her lopsided grin made him laugh.
cn: 这幅画歪斜地挂在墙上。
球队以10-1的比分取得压倒性胜利。
她歪着嘴的笑容逗笑了他。

definitions.definition: 乳液；护肤液（用于皮肤清洁或保湿的液体或半液体）

en: She applied a soothing lotion to her sunburned skin.
This lotion helps to moisturize dry hands in winter.
The doctor recommended a medicated lotion for the rash.
cn: 她将舒缓乳液涂抹在晒伤的皮肤上。
这款乳液能滋润冬季干燥的双手。
医生推荐了一种药用洗剂治疗皮疹。

definitions.definition: 忘忧果（希腊神话中一种能使人忘记烦恼的果实）
荷花饰（建筑或艺术中的装饰图案）

en: The pond was dotted with beautiful pink lotuses.
In Homer's Odyssey, the lotus-eaters offered a fruit that caused pleasant forgetfulness.
The capital of the column was carved with an intricate lotus design.
cn: 池塘里点缀着美丽的粉色莲花。
在荷马的《奥德赛》中，食莲者提供了一种能让人产生愉悦遗忘的果实。
柱头雕刻着复杂的荷花图案。

en: The child scratched his head constantly due to a louse infestation.
In medieval times, lice were a common problem among all social classes.
He was denounced as a louse for betraying his colleagues.
cn: 这个孩子因虱子侵扰而不断抓挠头部。
中世纪时，虱子是所有社会阶层的普遍困扰。
他因背叛同事而被斥为卑鄙小人。

definitions.definition: 充满（虱子等寄生虫）的（古义/字面义）

en: The service at that restaurant was lousy.
He felt lousy after missing the deadline.
The old mattress was lousy with bugs.
cn: 那家餐厅的服务糟透了。
错过截止日期后，他觉得自己很失败。
那张旧床垫上爬满了虫子。

definitions.definition: 文化修养不高的人；庸俗的人
文化修养不高的；通俗的；庸俗的

en: He considers reality TV to be entertainment for the lowbrow.
The gallery was criticized for its lowbrow exhibitions.
She enjoys both highbrow literature and lowbrow comedy shows.
cn: 他认为真人秀是给庸俗之人看的娱乐节目。
这家画廊因其庸俗的展览而受到批评。
她既喜欢阳春白雪的文学，也喜欢通俗的喜剧节目。

en: The mechanic applied a lubricant to the engine parts.
Silicone spray is a common household lubricant.
Its lubricant properties prevent wear and tear.
cn: 机械师给发动机部件涂抹了润滑剂。
硅酮喷雾是常见的家用润滑剂。
它的润滑特性防止了磨损。

definitions.definition: 清晰的；易懂的（指表达或思维）
清醒的（尤指梦境中意识到自己在做梦）

en: Her explanation was lucid and concise.
He experienced a lucid dream where he could control his actions.
The professor’s lecture made the complex theory lucid.
cn: 她的解释清晰而简洁。
他做了一个能自主控制行动的清醒梦。
教授的讲座让复杂理论变得易懂。

en: She turned her hobby into a lucrative business.
The tech industry is known for its lucrative job opportunities.
Investing in real estate can be highly lucrative if done wisely.
cn: 她将爱好变成了赚钱的事业。
科技行业以高薪工作机会闻名。
明智的房地产投资可能带来丰厚回报。

en: The idea that pigs can fly is utterly ludicrous.
He made a ludicrous attempt to blame the weather for his lateness.
The politician's ludicrous claims were widely mocked on social media.
cn: 认为猪会飞的想法荒谬至极。
他荒谬地试图把迟到归咎于天气。
该政客的可笑言论在社交媒体上广受嘲讽。

definitions.definition: 拉拽的动作；笨重的人/物

en: She had to lug the suitcase up three flights of stairs.
The engine is a real lug to carry.
Stop lugging at my sleeve—it’s tearing!
cn: 她不得不把行李箱拖上三层楼梯。
这台发动机搬起来真费劲。
别拽我袖子了——要扯破了！

en: The soup was lukewarm, neither hot nor cold.
His response to the proposal was lukewarm at best.
She washed her face with lukewarm water to avoid irritation.
cn: 汤是温的，既不热也不冷。
他对提案的反应充其量是不冷不热。
她用温水洗脸以避免刺激。

definitions.definition: 使安静；使缓和；哄（婴儿）入睡

en: The mother lulled the baby to sleep with a soft song.
There was a brief lull in the storm before it resumed.
Don't be lulled into a false sense of security.
cn: 母亲用轻柔的歌谣哄婴儿入睡。
风暴暂停片刻后再次袭来。
不要被麻痹而产生虚假的安全感。

en: She sang a lullaby to soothe the crying baby.
The gentle rhythm of the lullaby put him to sleep within minutes.
Traditional lullabies often reflect cultural stories.
cn: 她哼唱摇篮曲安抚哭闹的婴儿。
摇篮曲轻柔的节奏让他在几分钟内入睡。
传统摇篮曲常反映文化故事。

en: The watch has a luminous dial for easy reading in the dark.
Her luminous explanation made the complex theory accessible.
The jellyfish emitted a luminous blue glow underwater.
cn: 这款手表配有夜光表盘，便于在黑暗中阅读时间。
她清晰的解释让复杂理论变得易懂。
水母在水下散发出莹莹蓝光。

definitions.definition: 精神错乱；疯狂；极端愚蠢的行为

en: It would be sheer lunacy to attempt the climb in this blizzard.
The decision was later denounced as an act of economic lunacy.
In the old days, lunacy was often attributed to the influence of the moon.
cn: 试图在这场暴风雪中攀登简直是疯狂之举。
该决定后来被谴责为经济上的愚蠢行为。
在过去，精神错乱常被归因于月亮的影响。

en: The cat made a sudden lunge at the toy.
She practiced lunges to strengthen her legs.
The boxer lunged forward with a right hook.
cn: 猫突然扑向玩具。
她练习弓箭步来增强腿部力量。
拳击手向前猛冲，打出一记右勾拳。

en: The ship gave a sudden lurch in the storm.
He lurched forward after tripping on the step.
The company is in a lurch after losing its major investor.
cn: 船在暴风雨中突然倾斜。
他被台阶绊倒后踉跄向前。
公司因失去主要投资者而陷入困境。

en: The shiny necklace was used as a lure to catch the thief.
Many gamers are lured by the promise of virtual rewards.
Fishermen often use artificial lures to attract fish.
cn: 闪亮的项链被用作引诱小偷的诱饵。
许多玩家被虚拟奖励的承诺所吸引。
渔民常用人工诱饵吸引鱼类。

en: The cat lurks behind the bushes, waiting for its prey.
Trolls often lurk in online forums to provoke arguments.
A sense of danger lurked in the abandoned house.
cn: 猫潜伏在灌木丛后，等待猎物。
网络喷子常潜伏在论坛里挑起争端。
废弃房屋中潜藏着危险的气息。

definitions.definition: （感官体验）极度愉悦的；奢华的

en: The luscious mangoes melted in her mouth.
The actress wore a luscious red velvet gown.
The poem describes the luscious beauty of a summer garden.
cn: 多汁的芒果在她口中融化。
女演员身着一袭诱人的红色天鹅绒长裙。
这首诗描绘了夏日花园令人沉醉的美景。

definitions.definition: 茂盛的，繁茂的（形容植物）
