豪华的，奢华的（形容物品或生活方式）

en: The garden was filled with lush greenery after the rain.
She stayed in a lush hotel with marble floors and golden chandeliers.
cn: 雨后花园里草木葱茏。
她入住了一家铺着大理石地板、悬挂水晶吊灯的豪华酒店。

definitions.definition: 强烈的欲望（尤指性欲或贪欲）
对…有强烈的欲望（常与 after/for 连用）

en: His lust for power destroyed his relationships.
The novel explores themes of love and lust.
She felt a sudden lust for adventure.
cn: 他对权力的欲望毁掉了他的关系。
这部小说探讨了爱与欲望的主题。
她突然对冒险产生了强烈的渴望。

definitions.definition: 丰富的，华丽的（指头发、文笔、装饰等）

en: The garden was filled with luxuriant foliage after the spring rains.
She was famous for her luxuriant, auburn hair.
The author's luxuriant prose style is both admired and criticized.
cn: 春雨过后，花园里枝叶繁茂。
她因拥有一头浓密的赤褐色秀发而闻名。
这位作者华丽的散文风格既受人钦佩也遭人批评。

en: The lychee is a tropical fruit with a sweet and fragrant taste.
She bought a basket of fresh lychees from the market.
Lychee is often used in desserts and drinks in Southeast Asia.
cn: 荔枝是一种带有甜美芳香味道的热带水果。
她从市场买了一篮新鲜荔枝。
荔枝在东南亚常被用于甜点和饮料中。

definitions.definition: 以私刑处死（尤指未经法律程序）

en: The mob threatened to lynch the accused man without a trial.
Lynchings were tragically common in the post-Civil War South.
Modern societies condemn lynching as a barbaric practice.
cn: 暴民威胁未经审判就对被告处以私刑。
内战后，私刑在美国南方屡见不鲜。
现代社会谴责私刑为野蛮行径。

en: She wrote a beautiful lyric for the song.
His poetry has a deeply lyric quality.
The band’s lyrics often explore themes of love and loss.
cn: 她为这首歌写了一首优美的歌词。
他的诗歌具有强烈的抒情特质。
这支乐队的歌词常探讨爱与失去的主题。

en: Her lyrical voice captivated the audience.
The poet’s lyrical descriptions of nature are breathtaking.
The film’s lyrical pacing mirrors the protagonist’s emotional journey.
cn: 她富有感染力的嗓音让观众着迷。
诗人对自然的诗意描写令人叹服。
电影抒情的节奏映衬了主角的心路历程。

definitions.definition: 通心粉（一种管状意大利面）
（18世纪英国）追求时髦的男性（历史用法）

en: She cooked macaroni and cheese for dinner.
The 18th-century dandy was called a "macaroni" for his flamboyant style.
Add the macaroni to boiling water and stir occasionally.
cn: 她晚餐做了芝士通心粉。
这位18世纪的花花公子因浮夸风格被称为“时髦客”。
将通心粉加入沸水中，偶尔搅拌。

definitions.definition: 大男子气概的；男子汉的（常含贬义，指过度或夸张的阳刚特质）

en: His macho attitude made him refuse to ask for help.
The film parodies the macho stereotypes of action heroes.
She mocked his macho posturing as insecurity.
cn: 他的大男子主义让他拒绝求助。
这部电影讽刺了动作片中刻板的硬汉形象。
她嘲笑他虚张声势的男性气概其实是缺乏安全感。

definitions.definition: 鲭鱼（一种常见食用海鱼，体侧有斑纹）

en: Grilled mackerel is rich in omega-3 fatty acids.
The fishermen caught dozens of mackerel this morning.
Her recipe for pickled mackerel won a local cooking contest.
cn: 烤鲭鱼富含欧米伽-3脂肪酸。
渔民们今早捕获了数十条鲭鱼。
她的腌鲭鱼食谱赢得了当地烹饪比赛。

definitions.definition: 宏观经济的（与整个经济体系相关，而非个体或企业）

en: The government introduced new policies to improve macroeconomic stability.
Macroeconomic indicators suggest a slowdown in global growth.
She specializes in analyzing macroeconomic trends in developing countries.
cn: 政府推出新政策以提升宏观经济稳定性。
宏观经济指标显示全球增长放缓。
她专注于分析发展中国家的宏观经济趋势。

en: The constant noise began to madden the trapped miners.
His arrogant attitude would madden even the most patient person.
cn: 持续的噪音开始让受困的矿工发狂。
他傲慢的态度连最有耐心的人也会被激怒。

definitions.definition: 黑手党（有组织的犯罪集团）
（引申义）任何排外或秘密操纵的团体

en: The police cracked down on a local mafia operating in the city.
Some critics accuse the industry of being controlled by a tech mafia.
The film depicts the rise and fall of a New York mafia family.
cn: 警方打击了活跃在该市的本地黑手党。
一些批评者指责该行业被科技寡头秘密操控。
这部电影讲述了一个纽约黑手党家族的兴衰。

definitions.definition: 蛆（昆虫幼虫，尤指苍蝇的幼虫）
（古义/俚语）古怪的念头或癖好

en: The rotten meat was infested with maggots.
He has a maggot in his head about becoming a pirate.
Fishermen sometimes use maggots as bait.
cn: 腐烂的肉里爬满了蛆虫。
他脑子里有个古怪念头，想当海盗。
钓鱼者有时用蛆作鱼饵。

definitions.definition: 巨头，大亨（尤指商界或工业界的权势人物）

en: The oil magnate donated millions to environmental causes.
She became a media magnate by acquiring several newspapers.
cn: 这位石油大亨为环保事业捐赠了数百万。
她通过收购多家报社成为传媒巨头。

en: The magnetism of the Earth's core generates the magnetic field.
Her charisma and magnetism drew people to her speeches.
Scientists study animal magnetism to understand migration patterns.
cn: 地球核心的磁性产生了磁场。
她的魅力和吸引力让人们倾心于她的演讲。
科学家研究动物磁感以理解迁徙模式。

definitions.definition: （尺寸、规模、重要性等的）巨大；重大

en: The magnitude of the earthquake was recorded at 7.2 on the Richter scale.
Scientists were stunned by the magnitude of the newly discovered galaxy.
She finally understood the magnitude of her decision after seeing its impact.
cn: 这次地震的震级被记录为里氏7.2级。
科学家们对新发现星系的庞大程度感到震惊。
在看到影响后，她终于理解了这一决定的重要性。

definitions.definition: 木兰（植物学中木兰属植物的统称）
浅粉白色（因木兰花颜色得名）

en: The magnolia tree in our garden blooms every April.
She painted her room a soft magnolia to match the vintage style.
Magnolias are considered ancient plants, dating back millions of years.
cn: 我们花园里的木兰树每年四月开花。
她把房间刷成柔和的木兰花色，以搭配复古风格。
木兰被认为是远古植物，可追溯至数百万年前。

definitions.definition: 爱收集零碎物品的人；爱说话的人

en: The magpie is known for its intelligence and its tendency to collect shiny objects.
My grandmother is a real magpie; her house is full of interesting trinkets she's found.
I heard a magpie chattering in the tree outside my window this morning.
cn: 喜鹊以其聪明和喜欢收集闪亮物体的习性而闻名。
我祖母是个真正的“收藏家”；她的房子里满是她找到的有趣小玩意。
今天早上我听到一只喜鹊在我窗外的树上叽叽喳喳地叫。

en: The explosion maimed several bystanders.
Landmines continue to maim civilians in war zones.
He was maimed for life in the industrial accident.
cn: 爆炸导致数名旁观者重伤致残。
地雷仍在战区造成平民伤残。
他在工业事故中终身残疾。

definitions.definition: 钟表或机械装置中的主发条，核心动力源

en: The mainspring of the old watch had broken, so it would no longer wind.
Curiosity was the mainspring of his success as a research scientist.
The desire for freedom is the mainspring of all revolutionary movements.
cn: 这块旧手表的主发条断了，所以再也上不了弦了。
好奇心是他作为一名研究科学家取得成功的主要动力。
对自由的渴望是所有革命运动的主要驱动力。

definitions.definition: 支柱；主要依靠；中流砥柱

en: Education is the mainstay of a prosperous society.
She became the mainstay of her family after her father’s illness.
Traditional industries remain the mainstay of the local economy.
cn: 教育是繁荣社会的支柱。
父亲患病后，她成了家庭的顶梁柱。
传统产业仍是当地经济的中流砥柱。

en: The majestic mountains were covered in snow.
She walked with a majestic grace that commanded respect.
The orchestra played a majestic symphony under the stars.
cn: 巍峨的群山被白雪覆盖。
她步履庄严优雅，令人肃然起敬。
乐团在星空下演奏了一曲宏伟的交响乐。

en: The children created an elaborate world of make-believe in the backyard.
His make-believe injury didn't fool the coach for a second.
She couldn't tell if his promises were real or just make-believe.
cn: 孩子们在后院创造了一个复杂的幻想世界。
他假装的伤一刻也没骗过教练。
她分不清他的承诺是真实的还是只是空想。

en: They built a makeshift shelter from fallen branches.
The old crate served as a makeshift table during the picnic.
His apology was clearly a makeshift attempt to avoid conflict.
cn: 他们用掉落的树枝搭了一个临时避难所。
野餐时，旧木箱被当作临时桌子使用。
他的道歉显然是避免冲突的权宜之举。

definitions.definition: 适应不良的；无法适应（社会环境）的

en: Maladjusted children often struggle with social interactions.
The school provides special programs for maladjusted students.
He felt maladjusted to the fast-paced urban life after moving from the countryside.
cn: 适应不良的儿童通常在社交方面存在困难。
学校为适应不良的学生提供了特殊项目。
从农村搬来后，他感到自己无法适应快节奏的城市生活。

en: The surgeons successfully separated the malformed conjoined twins.
The software crashed due to malformed data packets.
Prenatal screening can detect some malformed organs.
cn: 外科医生们成功分离了连体畸形的双胞胎。
由于数据包格式错误，软件崩溃了。
产前筛查可以检测出某些器官畸形。

en: The elevator malfunctioned, trapping people inside.
A software malfunction caused the rocket launch delay.
His liver began to malfunction due to the toxin.
cn: 电梯发生故障，将人们困在里面。
软件故障导致火箭发射延迟。
他的肝脏因毒素开始功能失常。

en: She felt the need to malign his character in order to get the promotion.
The politician ignored the malign accusations from his opponents.
The doctor was concerned about the malign tumor discovered during the scan.
cn: 她觉得有必要诋毁他的人品以获得晋升。
这位政治家无视了来自对手的恶意指控。
医生对扫描中发现的恶性肿瘤感到担忧。

definitions.definition: 恶性（疾病或肿瘤的特性）

en: The biopsy confirmed the malignancy of the tumor.
His speech was full of hidden malignancy.
Early detection reduces the risks associated with malignancy.
cn: 活检确认了肿瘤的恶性性质。
他的言辞中暗藏恶意。
早期检测可降低恶性疾病的风险。

en: The biopsy confirmed that the tumor was malignant.
She gave him a malignant glare before turning away.
Malignant rumors can destroy a person's reputation.
cn: 活检确认肿瘤是恶性的。
她恶狠狠地瞪了他一眼，然后转身离开。
恶意的谣言能毁掉一个人的名誉。

definitions.definition: 玩忽职守，渎职（尤指医疗或法律领域的职业不当行为）

en: The doctor was sued for malpractice after misdiagnosing the patient.
Legal malpractice can result in severe financial penalties.
The hospital implemented new policies to reduce cases of medical malpractice.
cn: 医生因误诊被指控渎职。
法律渎职可能导致严厉的经济处罚。
医院实施新政策以减少医疗事故。

definitions.definition: 麦芽（发芽并烘干的大麦或其他谷物，用于酿酒或制糖）

en: The whiskey is made from malted barley.
Malt gives beer its distinctive flavor.
Farmers malt the grain in controlled conditions.
cn: 这款威士忌由发芽大麦制成。
麦芽赋予啤酒独特的风味。
农民在受控环境下将谷物制成麦芽。

definitions.definition: 猛犸象（已灭绝的古代长毛象）

en: Scientists extracted DNA from a frozen mammoth.
The project required a mammoth effort to complete.
A mammoth skeleton is displayed in the museum.
cn: 科学家从冰冻的猛犸象中提取了DNA。
完成该项目需要付出巨大努力。
博物馆展出了一具猛犸象骨架。

definitions.definition: 给…戴上手铐或脚镣；束缚

en: The prisoner's manacles were removed after he entered the cell.
She felt manacled by the expectations of her family and society.
The activist decried the manacles of censorship that limited free speech.
cn: 囚犯进入牢房后，他的手铐被除去了。
她感觉自己被家庭和社会的期望所束缚。
这位活动家谴责了限制言论自由的审查枷锁。

definitions.definition: 可应付的（指任务或问题）

en: The project was complex but ultimately manageable.
She divided the workload into manageable chunks.
His temper is barely manageable under stress.
cn: 这个项目很复杂，但最终是可完成的。
她将工作量划分为可应付的小块。
在压力下，他的脾气几乎难以控制。

en: She excels in her managerial role, leading the team with efficiency.
The course focuses on developing managerial skills for future executives.
His report analyzed the company's managerial structure in detail.
cn: 她在管理岗位上表现出色，高效领导团队。
该课程专注于培养未来高管的管理技能。
他的报告详细分析了公司的管理架构。

definitions.definition: 普通话（中国的官方语言）
官僚，官员（尤指墨守成规、态度傲慢者）

en: Mandarin is the official language of China and is spoken by over a billion people.
The corporate mandarins in their expensive suits made decisions without consulting the employees.
She peeled a mandarin and enjoyed its sweet and juicy segments.
cn: 普通话是中国的官方语言，有超过十亿人使用。
那些衣着昂贵的公司官僚们在做决定时从未咨询过员工。
她剥了一个橘子，享受着它甜美多汁的橘瓣。

en: The government received a clear mandate to reform healthcare.
The policy mandates recycling in all public buildings.
His mandate as CEO expires next year.
cn: 政府获得了明确的医疗改革授权。
该政策强制要求所有公共建筑实施回收。
他作为首席执行官的任期明年结束。

en: Wearing masks was mandatory during the pandemic.
The course includes mandatory attendance at all lectures.
Safety training is mandatory for new employees.
cn: 疫情期间必须佩戴口罩。
该课程要求必须出席所有讲座。
新员工必须参加安全培训。

en: The lion shook its golden mane in the sunlight.
Her thick black mane flowed down her back.
Wind tangled the horse's mane as it galloped.
cn: 狮子在阳光下甩动金色的鬃毛。
她浓密的黑发如鬃毛般垂在背后。
马匹飞奔时，风将它的鬃毛吹得凌乱。

en: The horses gathered around the wooden manger at feeding time.
Hay was piled high in the manger for the cattle.
The newborn lamb nestled in the straw near the manger.
cn: 喂食时间，马匹围在木制饲料槽周围。
干草在牛槽中堆得高高的。
新生的羔羊偎依在饲料槽旁的稻草中。

en: His mania for collecting stamps filled every shelf in the house.
The artist’s creative mania led to three sleepless nights.
Bipolar disorder involves alternating episodes of depression and mania.
cn: 他对集邮的狂热让家里每个架子都塞满了邮票。
这位艺术家的创作狂热让他连续三晚未眠。
双相情感障碍表现为抑郁与躁狂的交替发作。

en: The crowd cheered like maniacs when the band appeared.
He has a maniac obsession with cleanliness.
The film portrays a genius bordering on maniac.
cn: 乐队出场时，人群像疯子一样欢呼。
他对清洁有种疯狂的执着。
这部电影描绘了一个近乎癫狂的天才。

en: His manic laughter made everyone uneasy.
She worked with manic energy to finish the project.
The band's manic performance electrified the crowd.
cn: 他狂躁的笑声让所有人不安。
她以疯狂的精力赶完项目。
乐队癫狂的表演点燃了观众。

en: She booked a manicure before the wedding.
Regular manicures keep your nails healthy.
He learned to manicure his own nails during the lockdown.
cn: 她在婚礼前预约了修甲服务。
定期修甲能保持指甲健康。
他在居家隔离期间学会了给自己修指甲。

definitions.definition: 表现；显现（指抽象事物的具体化）

en: The rash is a manifestation of an allergic reaction.
The protest was a peaceful manifestation of public discontent.
Her artwork is a manifestation of her inner struggles.
cn: 皮疹是过敏反应的表现。
这次抗议是公众不满情绪的和平表达。
她的艺术作品是她内心挣扎的外化。

definitions.definition: 宣言（公开声明原则或目标的正式文件）

en: The party released a new manifesto before the election.
The Futurist Manifesto revolutionized art in the early 20th century.
Her speech sounded more like a personal manifesto than a policy proposal.
cn: 该党在选举前发布了一份新宣言。
《未来主义宣言》在20世纪初革新了艺术界。
她的演讲更像个人宣言而非政策提议。

definitions.definition: 过失杀人（非预谋的非法杀人行为）

en: The driver was charged with manslaughter after the fatal accident.
Manslaughter carries a lighter sentence than murder in most jurisdictions.
The court ruled the death was accidental manslaughter.
cn: 司机在致命事故后被控过失杀人。
在多数司法辖区，过失杀人比谋杀量刑更轻。
法庭裁定该死亡属于意外过失杀人。

en: The family photo was displayed proudly on the marble mantelpiece.
He leaned against the mantelpiece while delivering his speech.
The antique clock on the mantelpiece chimed midnight.
cn: 全家福被自豪地陈列在大理石壁炉台上。
他靠在壁炉架上发表演讲。
壁炉架上的古董钟敲响了午夜的钟声。

en: She wrapped herself in a velvet mantle against the cold.
cn: 她裹着天鹅绒斗篷抵御寒冷。

en: Farmers spread manure to enrich the soil.
The field was heavily manured before planting.
Organic manure improves soil structure.
cn: 农民撒肥料以肥沃土壤。
这块地在种植前施了大量肥料。
有机肥能改善土壤结构。

en: The scratch will mar the surface of the table.
His reputation was marred by the scandal.
A single mistake can mar an otherwise perfect performance.
cn: 这道划痕会损坏桌子的表面。
他的名誉因丑闻而受损。
一个失误就可能毁掉一场原本完美的演出。

definitions.definition: （神话或天文）月球或火星表面的阴暗区域（如月海）

en: The farmer saddled the mare for the morning ride.
The Mare Imbrium on the Moon is visible with binoculars.
In folklore, a nightmare was believed to be caused by a demonic mare.
cn: 农夫给母马装上马鞍，准备晨骑。
通过双筒望远镜可观察到月球上的雨海。
民间传说中，"噩梦"被认为由恶魔化身的母马引发。

definitions.definition: 边缘的；不重要的；微小的
（经济学）边际的（指成本或收益的增量变化）

en: The differences between the two proposals are marginal.
Farmers often cultivate marginal lands to expand production.
The marginal cost of producing one more unit decreases at scale.
cn: 这两项提案的差异微不足道。
农民常开垦边缘土地以扩大生产。
规模化生产时，每多生产一单位的边际成本会降低。

en: The use of marijuana for medical purposes is legal in some countries.
He was arrested for possessing marijuana.
Research on the effects of marijuana is still ongoing.
cn: 医用大麻在一些国家是合法的。
他因持有大麻被捕。
关于大麻影响的研究仍在进行中。

en: Their marital problems began after years of poor communication.
The study focuses on marital satisfaction in dual-career couples.
She sought counseling to improve her marital relationship.
cn: 他们的婚姻问题始于长期缺乏沟通。
该研究关注双职工夫妻的婚姻满意度。
她寻求咨询以改善夫妻关系。

definitions.definition: 标记；记号（如符号、线条或颜色）
打分；评分（尤指作业或考试）

en: The teacher spent hours on the marking of exam papers.
The tiger's distinctive markings help it blend into the grass.
Archaeologists found ancient markings on the cave walls.
cn: 老师花了数小时批改试卷。
老虎独特的斑纹帮助它融入草丛。
考古学家在洞穴墙壁上发现了古老的标记。

en: The elite unit was comprised of the best marksmen in the country.
cn: 这支精英部队由全国最顶尖的神枪手组成。

definitions.definition: 大帐篷；华盖（尤指活动用的大型临时帐篷）
（剧院或酒店的）入口雨棚；霓虹灯招牌

en: The wedding reception was held under a white marquee in the garden.
The theater's marquee lights illuminated the entire street.
They set up a marquee for the outdoor concert.
cn: 婚礼招待会在花园的白色大帐篷下举行。
剧院的霓虹灯招牌照亮了整个街道。
他们为户外音乐会搭起了一个大帐篷。

en: The city is known for its historic cattle mart.
We found some unique spices at the local mart.
The flower mart is bustling with activity on weekends.
cn: 这座城市以其历史悠久牲畜市场而闻名。
我们在当地市场找到了一些独特的香料。
周末的花市熙熙攘攘，热闹非凡。

definitions.definition: 与火星相关的（古义，现罕见）

en: The general maintained a martial demeanor during the crisis.
Ancient Romans celebrated martial virtues like courage and discipline.
cn: 将军在危机期间保持着威严的军人风范。
古罗马人崇尚勇气与纪律等尚武美德。

definitions.definition: 吉祥物（象征好运或团队精神的动物、人物或物品）

en: The team's mascot, a roaring lion, energized the crowd.
She carries a lucky rabbit's foot as her personal mascot.
The Olympic mascot symbolizes unity and athletic spirit.
cn: 球队的吉祥物——一只咆哮的狮子——点燃了观众的热情。
她随身携带一只兔脚作为个人幸运物。
奥运吉祥物象征着团结与运动精神。

definitions.definition: 糊状物；麦芽浆（酿酒原料）

en: Mash the bananas before adding them to the cake batter.
The brewery uses high-quality barley for their mash.
He accidentally mashed his finger in the car door.
cn: 在将香蕉加入蛋糕面糊前先捣碎。
这家酿酒厂用优质大麦制作麦芽浆。
他的手指不小心被车门夹伤了。

en: The masked figure slipped silently through the crowd.
Her masked emotions made it hard to guess her true feelings.
The virus can spread from both masked and unmasked individuals.
cn: 那个戴面具的身影无声地穿过人群。
她隐藏的情绪让人难以揣测她的真实想法。
病毒可能通过戴口罩和未戴口罩的人传播。

definitions.definition: 参加化装舞会；伪装，假扮

en: The grand masquerade ball was the highlight of the carnival season.
Her smile was a masquerade to hide the pain.
Some insects masquerade as leaves to avoid predators.
cn: 这场盛大的化装舞会是狂欢节季的重头戏。
她的微笑只是掩饰痛苦的伪装。
某些昆虫伪装成树叶以躲避天敌。

en: He was the mastermind behind the company's global expansion.
The robbery was masterminded by a former security expert.
Her ability to mastermind large-scale events impressed everyone.
cn: 他是公司全球扩张的幕后策划者。
这起抢劫案由一名前安保专家策划。
她策划大型活动的能力令所有人印象深刻。

en: We booked tickets for the Saturday matinee of the new musical.
The matinee performance is often cheaper than the evening show.
Children's plays usually have a matinee to accommodate young audiences.
cn: 我们预订了周六下午场的新音乐剧门票。
日场演出通常比晚场便宜。
儿童剧常设日场以适应小观众。

en: The birds were observed during their mating season.
Successful mating requires cooperation between both partners.
The study focuses on mating behaviors in marine mammals.
cn: 这些鸟类在交配季节被观察到。
成功的交配需要双方合作。
该研究聚焦于海洋哺乳动物的交配行为。

definitions.definition: & vt. 被大学录取；注册入学

en: She was thrilled to matriculate at her first-choice university.
All new students must matriculate before the start of the semester.
As a matriculate, you now have access to the university library.
cn: 她欣喜若狂地被她的第一志愿大学录取了。
所有新生都必须在学期开始前完成注册。
作为一名被录取的学生，你现在可以使用大学图书馆了。

definitions.definition: 矩阵（数学中的矩形数组）

en: The data was organized in a 3x3 matrix.
Ancient Rome was the matrix of Western civilization.
The movie explores the idea of a simulated reality called the Matrix.
cn: 数据被排列成一个3x3的矩阵。
古罗马是西方文明的发源地。
这部电影探讨了一个名为“矩阵”的模拟现实概念。

definitions.definition: 已婚妇女（尤指年长或庄重的）
女监护人（如学校、监狱等机构中的女性主管）

en: The hospital matron ensured all patients received proper care.
She carried herself with the dignity of a Victorian matron.
The school matron was both feared and respected by the students.
cn: 医院女主管确保所有患者得到妥善照料。
她的举止带着维多利亚时代已婚妇女的庄重。
学生们对这位女舍监既敬畏又尊重。

definitions.definition: 猛烈袭击；粗暴对待；用大锤击打

en: The workers used a maul to drive the stakes into the ground.
The bear began to maul the unfortunate hiker.
Critics mauled the director's new play for its weak storyline.
cn: 工人们用一个大锤将木桩打入地里。
熊开始猛烈袭击那个不幸的徒步旅行者。
评论家们因剧情薄弱而粗暴抨击了这位导演的新剧。

en: She painted her bedroom walls a soft shade of mauve.
The mauve dye was a revolutionary discovery in the history of chemistry.
The sky at dusk was a beautiful mauve and pink.
cn: 她把卧室的墙壁刷成了柔和的淡紫色。
这种苯胺紫染料是化学史上一次革命性的发现。
黄昏的天空呈现出美丽的淡紫色和粉红色。

definitions.definition: 特立独行的人；不墨守成规者

en: She was a maverick in the field of physics, challenging established theories.
The company’s maverick approach to design set it apart from competitors.
Political mavericks often face resistance from traditional parties.
cn: 她是物理学界的特立独行者，不断挑战既定理论。
这家公司标新立异的设计方式使其脱颖而出。
政治上的反叛者常遭遇传统党派的抵制。

definitions.definition: 格言，箴言（简明表达普遍真理或行为准则的语句）

en: "Honesty is the best policy" is a well-known maxim.
She lived her life according to the maxim "carpe diem."
Ancient maxims often reflect universal human values.
cn: “诚实为上策”是一句广为人知的格言。
她遵循“及时行乐”的格言生活。
古代箴言常反映普世的人类价值观。

definitions.definition: 混乱、骚乱（尤指暴力或破坏性事件）
【法律】故意致人伤残罪（古用法）

en: The protest escalated into complete mayhem, with shattered windows and burning cars.
In medieval times, mayhem was a punishable crime involving permanent disfigurement.
The children left the room in mayhem after the birthday party.
cn: 抗议升级为彻底骚乱，窗户碎裂，汽车燃烧。
中世纪时，致残罪是一种涉及永久伤残的可惩处罪行。
生日派对后，孩子们把房间弄得一片狼藉。

definitions.definition: 迷宫；错综复杂的布局或系统

en: The garden was designed as a maze of hedges.
She felt completely mazed by the complicated instructions.
His mind was a maze of conflicting emotions.
cn: 花园被设计成树篱迷宫。
她被复杂的说明彻底搞糊涂了。
他的内心充满矛盾的情绪，如同一团乱麻。

en: The prisoners were subsisting on a meagre diet of bread and water.
He could only afford a meagre donation to the charity.
Her meagre savings were not enough to cover the emergency expense.
cn: 囚犯们仅靠面包和水这样贫乏的饮食维持生命。
他只能向慈善机构捐出很少的一点钱。
她微薄的积蓄不足以支付这笔紧急开销。

en: She’s too mean to share her dessert.
The mean temperature in July is 30°C.
What do you mean by that remark?
cn: 她吝啬到不愿分享甜点。
七月的平均气温是30摄氏度。
你说这话是什么意思？

en: The river meanders through the valley before reaching the sea.
His speech meandered without a clear conclusion.
We hiked along the meanders of the ancient trail.
cn: 这条河蜿蜒流过山谷，最终汇入大海。
他的演讲东拉西扯，没有明确结论。
我们沿着古道迂回曲折的路径徒步。

en: Measles is highly contagious among unvaccinated children.
She developed a rash typical of measles.
Global efforts have reduced measles deaths by 73% since 2000.
cn: 麻疹在未接种疫苗的儿童中传染性极强。
她出现了麻疹特有的皮疹。
自2000年以来，全球努力使麻疹死亡人数减少了73%。

en: The impact of the policy is not immediately measurable.
She made measurable progress in her language studies.
The device provides measurable data with high accuracy.
cn: 这项政策的影响无法立即衡量。
她的语言学习取得了显著进步。
该设备提供高精度的可测量数据。

en: Millions of Muslims pilgrimage to Mecca every year.
Silicon Valley is a mecca for tech entrepreneurs.
The festival turned the small town into a mecca of jazz lovers.
cn: 每年有数百万穆斯林前往麦加朝圣。
硅谷是科技创业者的圣地。
这个音乐节让小镇成为爵士乐爱好者的聚集地。

en: Don't meddle in affairs you don't understand.
She accused him of meddling with her personal documents.
Politicians should not meddle in scientific research.
cn: 别插手你不懂的事情。
她指责他翻动她的私人文件。
政客不应干涉科学研究。

en: The UN attempted to mediate between the warring factions.
She has a talent for mediating disputes in the workplace.
The lawyer acted as a mediating force in the negotiation.
cn: 联合国试图在交战派系之间进行调解。
她擅长调解职场纠纷。
律师在谈判中充当了调停者的角色。

definitions.definition: （美国）医疗补助计划（政府为低收入人群提供的医疗保险项目）

en: Millions of low-income families rely on Medicaid for healthcare coverage.
The state expanded Medicaid eligibility to include more uninsured residents.
Medicaid funding is a contentious topic in federal budget debates.
cn: 数百万低收入家庭依赖医疗补助计划获得医疗保障。
该州扩大了医疗补助计划的覆盖范围，纳入更多无保险居民。
医疗补助计划的资金问题是联邦预算辩论中的争议焦点。

en: The doctor prescribed a new medication for her chronic pain.
Proper medication storage is essential to maintain efficacy.
The study compared the effects of two different medications.
cn: 医生为她的慢性疼痛开了一种新药。
正确的药物储存对保持药效至关重要。
该研究比较了两种不同药物的效果。

definitions.definition: 平庸的；普通的；中等偏下的

en: The restaurant received mediocre reviews for its bland food.
He was a mediocre student, but excelled in sports.
Don’t settle for mediocre results when you can strive for excellence.
cn: 这家餐厅因食物乏味而评价平庸。
他学业平平，但擅长运动。
当你能够追求卓越时，不要满足于平庸的结果。

en: She meditates for 20 minutes every morning to clear her mind.
The team is meditating a new strategy to tackle the crisis.
He sat by the river, meditating on the meaning of life.
cn: 她每天早晨冥想20分钟以清空思绪。
团队正在酝酿新策略以应对危机。
他坐在河边，沉思生命的意义。

en: She was a meek girl who never raised her voice.
His meek acceptance of injustice frustrated his friends.
The meek shall inherit the earth.
cn: 她是个温顺的女孩，从不高声说话。
他对不公的逆来顺受让朋友们感到沮丧。
谦和之人终将承继土地。（《圣经》典故）

definitions.definition: 扩音器，传声筒（俗称“喇叭”）
用扩音器传达；大肆宣扬

en: The protest leader used a megaphone to address the crowd.
Social media can megaphone rumors to millions within minutes.
The cheerleader’s megaphone echoed across the football field.
cn: 抗议领袖用扩音器向人群发表讲话。
社交媒体能在几分钟内将谣言传播给数百万人。
啦啦队长的扩音器声音在足球场上回荡。

definitions.definition: （颜色/光线）柔和的；（味道）醇香的；（性格）温和的

en: The mellow sunlight filtered through the curtains.
Aged wine develops a mellow flavor.
Time has mellowed his stubborn personality.
cn: 柔和的阳光透过窗帘洒进来。
陈年葡萄酒会形成醇香的风味。
岁月磨平了他固执的个性。

definitions.definition: 情节夸张的戏剧或事件；煽情剧
（引申义）情绪化或夸张的行为

en: The play was pure melodrama, with villains tying heroines to railroad tracks.
Her reaction turned a small disagreement into a melodrama.
Classic melodramas often use orchestral music to heighten emotions.
cn: 这部戏是典型的煽情剧，反派将女主角绑在铁轨上。
她的反应让一个小分歧变成了夸张的闹剧。
经典煽情剧常用管弦乐强化情绪。

definitions.definition: 膜，薄膜（生物学/物理学中的薄层结构）
隔膜（技术或机械领域的柔性分隔层）

en: The cell membrane regulates the passage of nutrients.
A thin membrane vibrates to produce sound in this instrument.
Engineers developed a synthetic membrane for water filtration.
cn: 细胞膜调控营养物质的传递。
该乐器中，一片薄膜通过振动产生声音。
工程师开发了一种用于水过滤的合成膜。

definitions.definition: 纪念物；引起回忆的物品

en: She kept the seashell as a memento of her trip to the beach.
The old photo served as a poignant memento of his childhood.
The museum sells miniature statues as mementos for visitors.
cn: 她保留着贝壳，作为海滩之旅的纪念。
这张老照片是他童年时光的伤感纪念。
博物馆出售迷你雕像作为游客的纪念品。

definitions.definition: 备忘录（正式书面记录或提醒）
外交文件（用于国际协商的书面声明）

en: She sent a memorandum to all staff about the policy change.
The two countries exchanged memoranda during the negotiations.
Please refer to the memorandum for detailed instructions.
cn: 她向全体员工发送了一份关于政策变更的备忘录。
谈判期间两国交换了外交备忘录。
详细说明请参阅备忘录。

definitions.definition: 卑微的；低贱的（指工作或地位）
仆人；从事低贱工作的人

en: He quit his menial job at the factory to pursue education.
In medieval times, menial tasks were often assigned to servants.
She refused to be treated as a menial worker despite her position.
cn: 他辞去了工厂里的卑微工作去追求教育。
中世纪时，低贱的工作常分配给仆人。
尽管职位低微，她拒绝被当作卑贱工人对待。

definitions.definition: 脑膜炎（中枢神经系统脑膜组织的炎症性疾病）

en: The patient was hospitalized with symptoms suggesting bacterial meningitis.
Vaccines can prevent certain types of viral meningitis.
Early diagnosis of meningitis is critical to avoid neurological damage.
cn: 患者因疑似细菌性脑膜炎的症状入院。
疫苗可预防某些类型的病毒性脑膜炎。
脑膜炎的早期诊断对避免神经损伤至关重要。

definitions.definition: 更年期（女性生育能力自然终止的生理阶段）

en: Menopause typically occurs between the ages of 45 and 55.
Hormone therapy can alleviate some symptoms of menopause.
She researched natural ways to manage menopause-related hot flashes.
cn: 更年期通常发生在45至55岁之间。
激素疗法可缓解更年期的部分症状。
她研究了管理更年期潮热的自然方法。

en: She tracks her menstrual cycle using a mobile app.
Menstrual pain can be alleviated with proper care.
The study focuses on menstrual health education in schools.
cn: 她用手机应用记录月经周期。
适当的护理可以缓解经痛。
这项研究关注学校的月经健康教育。

en: London and Amsterdam were major mercantile centers in the 17th century.
The government's mercantile policies focused on maximizing exports.
His mercantile background gave him a keen understanding of global markets.
cn: 17世纪，伦敦和阿姆斯特丹是主要的商业中心。
该政府的重商主义政策侧重于最大化出口。
他的商人背景使他对全球市场有着敏锐的理解。

en: The warlord hired mercenaries to defend his territory.
Her mercenary attitude made her unpopular among colleagues.
The company was accused of mercenary practices in developing countries.
cn: 军阀雇佣了佣兵来保卫他的领地。
她唯利是图的态度让她在同事中不受欢迎。
这家公司被指控在发展中国家进行牟利性操作。

definitions.definition: 美人鱼（传说中半人半鱼的生物）

en: The little girl dressed as a mermaid for Halloween.
Ancient sailors often claimed to see mermaids in the ocean.
The story describes a mermaid who traded her voice for legs.
cn: 这个小女孩在万圣节装扮成了美人鱼。
古代水手常声称在海上见到美人鱼。
这个故事描述了一位用声音换取双腿的美人鱼。

definitions.definition: 一连串周而复始的活动

en: The children laughed as they rode the colorful merry-go-round.
The endless meetings felt like a political merry-go-round.
We took a nostalgic photo by the vintage merry-go-round at the fair.
cn: 孩子们骑着五彩缤纷的旋转木马时哈哈大笑。
这些无休止的会议感觉像是一场政治上的循环往复。
我们在集市上的复古旋转木马旁拍了一张怀旧的照片。

definitions.definition: 网状物；网状结构；错综复杂的事物

en: The gears meshed smoothly, ensuring efficient power transmission.
Her ideas meshed perfectly with the team’s objectives.
A fine mesh filter prevents debris from entering the system.
cn: 齿轮啮合顺畅，保障了动力高效传递。
她的想法与团队目标完美契合。
细密的网状过滤器能阻挡碎屑进入系统。

definitions.definition: 弥赛亚（犹太教中的救世主）

en: Many Jews in the first century were expecting a political messiah to liberate them from Roman rule.
The fans hailed the returning champion as their messiah.
His teachings inspired followers to believe he was the messiah foretold in scriptures.
cn: 公元一世纪许多犹太人期待一位政治弥赛亚来解放他们脱离罗马统治。
粉丝们将回归的冠军欢呼为救世主。
他的教导使追随者相信他就是经文中预言的弥赛亚。

definitions.definition: 新陈代谢（生物体内物质与能量的转化过程）
代谢作用（特定化学反应的统称）

en: Exercise can accelerate your metabolism.
The drug affects the metabolism of glucose.
Fish have a slower metabolism in cold water.
cn: 运动能加速新陈代谢。
这种药物影响葡萄糖的代谢。
鱼类在冷水中新陈代谢较慢。

en: Modern metallurgy has made significant advances in developing stronger and lighter alloys for aerospace applications.
He decided to study metallurgy in order to understand the properties of different metals.
The ancient metallurgy of bronze making involved combining copper with tin.
cn: 现代冶金学在开发用于航空航天应用的更坚固、更轻的合金方面取得了重大进展。
他决定学习冶金学，以了解不同金属的特性。
古代的青铜制造冶金术需要将铜与锡结合在一起。

definitions.definition: 形而上学的（与超验或抽象理论相关）

en: The poet John Donne is famous for his metaphysical conceits.
Her interest in metaphysical questions led her to study philosophy.
Some believe in metaphysical healing beyond scientific explanation.
cn: 诗人约翰·多恩以其形而上的奇喻闻名。
她对形而上学问题的兴趣促使她学习哲学。
一些人相信科学无法解释的超自然疗愈力量。

definitions.definition: 流星；大气现象（如闪电、虹等）

en: A bright meteor streaked across the night sky.
Ancient scholars studied meteors as atmospheric phenomena.
The museum exhibit explained the difference between meteors and meteorites.
cn: 一颗明亮的流星划过夜空。
古代学者将流星作为大气现象研究。
博物馆展览解释了流星与陨石的区别。

definitions.definition: 气象学，一门研究大气现象和天气过程的科学。

en: Modern meteorology relies heavily on satellite data and computer models.
She decided to study meteorology because of her fascination with extreme weather events.
The accuracy of weather forecasting has improved significantly with advances in meteorology.
cn: 现代气象学极大地依赖于卫星数据和计算机模型。
由于对极端天气事件的着迷，她决定学习气象学。
随着气象学的进步，天气预报的准确性已显著提高。

definitions.definition: 气象学的；与气象有关的

en: The meteorological department issued a storm warning.
His research focuses on meteorological data analysis.
Advanced satellites improve meteorological predictions.
cn: 气象部门发布了风暴预警。
他的研究聚焦于气象数据分析。
先进卫星提升了气象预测的准确性。

definitions.definition: 甲烷（一种无色无味的易燃气体，是天然气的主要成分）

en: Methane is a potent greenhouse gas emitted by livestock and landfills.
Scientists detected methane plumes on Mars, hinting at possible microbial life.
The explosion was caused by a buildup of methane in the coal mine.
cn: 甲烷是牲畜和垃圾填埋场排放的一种强效温室气体。
科学家在火星上探测到甲烷羽流，暗示可能存在微生物生命。
爆炸是由煤矿中甲烷积聚引起的。

en: She approached the problem in a methodical manner, analyzing each variable step by step.
cn: 她以系统化的方式处理问题，逐步分析每个变量。

definitions.definition: 方法论（研究某一学科或领域所用的系统化方法）
方法体系（特定领域或活动的操作原则或流程）

en: The course focuses on research methodology in social sciences.
Their methodology for data analysis was criticized for lacking rigor.
A sound methodology is essential for reproducible scientific results.
cn: 这门课程专注于社会科学的研究方法论。
他们的数据分析方法体系因缺乏严谨性而受到批评。
完善的方法论对可复现的科学结果至关重要。

definitions.definition: 极其仔细的，一丝不苟的
过度注重细节的（含贬义）

en: She kept meticulous records of every transaction.
His meticulous attention to detail made him a brilliant scientist.
The report was criticized for being overly meticulous and hard to read.
cn: 她一丝不苟地记录了每一笔交易。
他对细节的极致关注使他成为杰出的科学家。
这份报告因过度琐碎难读而受到批评。

en: She decided to major in microbiology to study viruses and bacteria.
Advances in microbiology have led to the development of new vaccines.
The microbiology lab is equipped with high-powered microscopes for observing microorganisms.
cn: 她决定主修微生物学，以研究病毒和细菌。
微生物学的进步促进了新疫苗的开发。
微生物学实验室配备了高功率显微镜用于观察微生物。

definitions.definition: 显微镜（光学仪器，用于观察微小物体）

en: The scientist used a microscope to examine the bacteria.
Modern microscopes can magnify objects up to 1000 times.
Students learned how to adjust the focus of the microscope in lab class.
cn: 科学家用显微镜观察细菌。
现代显微镜可将物体放大至1000倍。
学生们在实验课上学习如何调节显微镜焦距。

definitions.definition: 侏儒；矮人（现多视为冒犯性用语）

en: The circus featured a performer labeled as a "midget," a term now considered offensive.
She collected midget cars as a hobby.
Historical photos showed midget submarines used in WWII.
cn: 马戏团曾将一名演员称为“midget”，该词如今被视为冒犯性用语。
她以收集微型汽车为爱好。
历史照片展示了二战中使用的微型潜艇。

definitions.definition: 偏头痛（一种剧烈的头痛，常伴随恶心或视觉异常）

en: She had to cancel her meeting due to a severe migraine.
Bright lights can trigger migraines in some people.
His migraine was accompanied by nausea and blurred vision.
cn: 她因严重偏头痛不得不取消会议。
强光可能引发某些人的偏头痛。
他的偏头痛伴随恶心和视力模糊。

en: The geese are seasonal migrants, flying south every winter.
Many migrant workers send money back to their families.
The city provides support services for migrant communities.
cn: 雁是季节性迁徙动物，每年冬季南飞。
许多移民工人将钱寄回家乡。
该市为移民社区提供支持服务。

en: The group became increasingly militant in its protests.
She was known as a militant advocate for women's rights.
The government cracked down on militant factions.
cn: 该团体在抗议活动中变得愈发激进。
她是著名的女权激进倡导者。
政府镇压了激进派系。

en: The rapid growth of militarism in the region destabilized the delicate peace.
His speeches were filled with militarism, glorifying war and military conquest.
The nation's culture was deeply influenced by militarism, with military service considered the highest honor.
cn: 该地区军国主义的迅速增长破坏了脆弱的和平。
他的演讲充满了军国主义思想，颂扬战争和军事征服。
该国的文化深受军国主义影响，服兵役被视为最高荣誉。

en: The militiaman guarded the village bridge at night.
Every able-bodied male was required to serve as a militiaman.
The old militiaman still remembered his training from decades ago.
cn: 这名民兵夜间守卫村庄的桥梁。
每个身体健全的男性都被要求担任民兵。
这位老民兵仍记得几十年前的训练内容。

en: Millet is a staple food in many parts of Asia and Africa.
The farmer decided to plant millet because it is drought-resistant.
The bird feeder was filled with seeds like millet and sunflower hearts.
cn: 小米是亚洲和非洲许多地区的主食。
这位农民决定种植黍子，因为它耐旱。
鸟食器中装满了小米和葵花籽仁等种子。

definitions.definition: 马陆，千足虫（一种节肢动物）

en: The millipede curled into a tight spiral when touched.
Millipedes are detritivores, primarily feeding on decaying plant material.
Unlike centipedes, millipedes have two pairs of legs per body segment.
cn: 当被触碰时，这只千足虫蜷缩成了一个紧密的螺旋形。
马陆是食腐动物，主要以腐烂的植物材料为食。
与蜈蚣不同，千足虫每个体节有两对足。

definitions.definition: 哑剧；哑剧表演；哑剧演员

en: The performer told a whole story through mime alone.
He can mime the movements of different animals perfectly.
Street mimes often entertain tourists in city centers.
cn: 这位表演者仅通过哑剧就讲述了一个完整的故事。
他能惟妙惟肖地模仿各种动物的动作。
街头哑剧演员经常在市中心娱乐游客。

definitions.definition: 模仿（尤指为逗笑或嘲讽）

en: The parrot can mimic human speech with astonishing accuracy.
His talent for mimicry made him a popular comedian.
The robot’s software allows it to mimic facial expressions.
cn: 这只鹦鹉能以惊人的准确度模仿人类说话。
他的模仿天赋使他成为受欢迎的喜剧演员。
该机器人的软件能让它模仿面部表情。

en: She minced the garlic finely for the sauce.
The actor minced across the stage in exaggerated high heels.
Add 200g of beef mince to the frying pan.
cn: 她将大蒜剁得极碎用来做酱汁。
演员穿着夸张的高跟鞋，扭捏作态地走过舞台。
向平底锅中加入200克牛肉末。

definitions.definition: 水貂（一种小型鼬科动物，毛皮珍贵）
水貂毛皮（制成的衣物或饰品）

en: The riverbank was home to a family of wild minks.
Her coat was made of genuine mink, soft and luxurious.
Conservationists are working to protect the endangered European mink.
cn: 河岸曾是一群野生水貂的栖息地。
她的外套由真水貂毛制成，柔软而奢华。
环保人士正致力于保护濒危的欧洲水貂。

definitions.definition: 海市蜃楼（因光线折射产生的虚幻景象）

en: The travelers were deceived by a mirage of an oasis in the desert.
His dream of becoming a billionaire turned out to be a mirage.
Scientists explain how temperature gradients create mirages.
cn: 旅行者们被沙漠中绿洲的海市蜃楼所欺骗。
他成为亿万富翁的梦想最终只是幻影。
科学家解释了温度梯度如何形成海市蜃楼。

definitions.definition: 使陷入泥沼；使陷入困境

en: The tractor was stuck deep in the mire.
His financial decisions mired him in debt.
The negotiations are mired in disagreements.
cn: 拖拉机深陷泥沼中。
他的财务决策使自己负债累累。
谈判因分歧陷入僵局。

en: The room was filled with mirth and laughter after the joke was told.
Her infectious mirth lifted the spirits of everyone around her.
There was a sense of pure mirth in the air during the festival.
cn: 笑话讲完后，房间里充满了欢乐和笑声。
她那富有感染力的欢乐振奋了身边每个人的精神。
节日期间，空气中弥漫着一种纯粹的欢乐气息。

en: The expedition was doomed by a series of misadventures, including bad weather and lost equipment.
His attempt to fix the sink himself turned into a comical misadventure, resulting in a flooded kitchen.
cn: 这次远征被一系列不幸事件所困扰，包括恶劣天气和装备丢失，最终以失败告终。
他试图自己修理水槽，却变成了一场滑稽的灾难，最终导致厨房被水淹。

definitions.definition: 挪用；盗用；侵吞（尤指公款）

en: The treasurer was accused of misappropriating club funds for personal use.
It is a serious crime to misappropriate public money.
The director misappropriated the grant money intended for research.
cn: 财务主管被指控将俱乐部资金挪作私用。
侵吞公款是严重的犯罪行为。
这位主管盗用了本应用于研究的拨款。

en: The teacher warned the students not to misbehave during the field trip.
Children may misbehave when they feel ignored.
His dog misbehaves only around strangers.
cn: 老师警告学生不要在实地考察期间行为不端。
孩子感到被忽视时可能会举止不当。
他的狗只在陌生人面前行为失礼。

en: The doctor explained the possible causes of her miscarriage.
A miscarriage of justice can damage public trust in the legal system.
The courier company apologized for the miscarriage of the package.
cn: 医生解释了她流产的可能原因。
司法不公会损害公众对法律体系的信任。
快递公司为包裹误送道歉。

en: The box contained miscellaneous items like buttons, coins, and old photos.
She sorted through the miscellaneous papers on her desk.
The store sells miscellaneous gadgets and tools.
cn: 盒子里装着纽扣、硬币和老照片等杂七杂八的东西。
她整理了桌上乱七八糟的文件。
这家店出售各种小工具和杂件。

en: The officer was accused of serious misconduct.
Misconduct in scientific research can damage credibility.
He misconducted the project, leading to huge losses.
cn: 这名官员被指控严重渎职。
科研不端行为会损害可信度。
他管理项目不当，造成巨大损失。

definitions.definition: 不适应环境的人；与群体格格不入者

en: She always felt like a misfit in her conservative family.
The jacket misfits around the shoulders, making it uncomfortable.
The school club welcomed misfits who shared unconventional interests.
cn: 她在保守的家庭中总觉得自己格格不入。
这件夹克肩部不合身，穿着不舒服。
学校社团欢迎那些有非常规兴趣的“异类”。

definitions.definition: 疑虑，担忧（a feeling of doubt or apprehension）

en: She agreed to the plan despite some misgivings.
His sudden kindness filled me with misgiving.
The dark clouds gave him a misgiving about the picnic.
cn: 尽管有些疑虑，她还是同意了该计划。
他突然的善意让我心生不安。
乌云让他对野餐产生了担忧。

definitions.definition: （情感上）错付，寄托于不合适的对象

en: I often misplace my glasses when I'm in a hurry.
She misplaced her trust in someone who betrayed her.
The librarian found a book that had been misplaced in the wrong section.
cn: 我匆忙时经常把眼镜放错地方。
她错信了一个背叛她的人。
图书管理员发现一本被误放在错误区域的书。

definitions.definition: 减轻（痛苦、严重性等）；缓和

en: Planting trees can help mitigate climate change.
The lawyer presented evidence to mitigate his client's guilt.
A warm compress may mitigate muscle soreness.
cn: 植树有助于缓解气候变化。
律师提交证据以减轻其委托人的罪责。
热敷可减轻肌肉酸痛。

definitions.definition: 连指手套（拇指单独分开，其他四指连在一起的手套）

en: She lost one mitten in the snowstorm.
Wool mittens are warmer than gloves for icy weather.
The toddler struggled to put on his mittens by himself.
cn: 她在暴风雪中丢了一只连指手套。
羊毛连指手套在严寒天气中比分指手套更保暖。
幼儿努力自己戴上连指手套。

definitions.definition: 护城河（城堡或城墙周围的深沟，通常充满水）

en: The castle was surrounded by a wide moat filled with water.
They crossed the moat using a retractable drawbridge.
The dry moat served as an additional layer of defense.
cn: 这座城堡被一条宽阔的护城河环绕，河中蓄满了水。
他们通过可伸缩的吊桥越过了护城河。
干涸的护城河充当了额外的防御层。

definitions.definition: 动员（人员或资源）；使可移动
动员起来（尤指军事行动）

en: The government mobilised troops to defend the border.
We need to mobilise public support for environmental protection.
The enzyme helps to mobilise stored fats in the body.
cn: 政府动员军队保卫边境。
我们需要动员公众支持环境保护。
这种酶有助于调动体内储存的脂肪。

definitions.definition: 拙劣的模仿；可笑的歪曲

en: His speech was met with loud mockery from the crowd.
The trial became a mockery of justice.
Her imitation of the teacher’s accent was pure mockery.
cn: 他的演讲引来人群的阵阵嘲弄。
这场审判成了对正义的荒唐践踏。
她模仿老师口音的样子纯属讥讽。

definitions.definition: 模块化的；由独立组件组成的

en: The furniture is designed in a modular way, allowing customization.
The software uses a modular architecture for easy updates.
Modular housing is gaining popularity for its affordability.
cn: 这套家具采用模块化设计，可自由组合。
该软件采用模块化架构，便于升级。
模块化住宅因性价比高而日益流行。

definitions.definition: 模块；组件（独立功能单元）

en: The spacecraft was built with interchangeable modules.
Each module of the course focuses on a specific skill.
The software module handles all data encryption.
cn: 航天器由可互换的模块组成。
课程的每个模块专注于一项特定技能。
该软件模块负责所有数据加密。

en: The manager was accused of molesting an employee.
Stop molesting the dog with your loud noises.
Historical texts show how invaders would molest local populations.
cn: 经理被指控骚扰一名员工。
别用噪音打扰那只狗。
历史文献记载了侵略者如何侵扰当地居民。

definitions.definition: 安抚，抚慰；使软化，使缓和

en: He tried to mollify his angry boss by offering a sincere apology.
A warm cup of tea can help to mollify a sore throat.
The government announced new policies to mollify public concern over the issue.
cn: 他试图通过真诚的道歉来安抚愤怒的老板。
一杯热茶有助于缓解喉咙痛。
政府宣布了新政策以平息公众对此事的担忧。

en: A momentary lapse in concentration caused the accident.
The fireworks brought momentary joy to the crowd.
Her hesitation was only momentary before she answered.
cn: 一时的分心导致了事故。
烟花为人群带来了短暂的喜悦。
她的犹豫仅是片刻，随后便给出了回答。

en: The signing of the treaty was a momentous occasion in history.
Her discovery had a momentous impact on scientific research.
They made a momentous decision to change the company's direction.
cn: 这份条约的签署是历史上的重大时刻。
她的发现对科学研究产生了重大影响。
他们做出了改变公司方向的重大决定。

definitions.definition: 动量（物理学中物体的质量与速度的乘积）
势头，动力（比喻事物发展的趋势或力量）

en: The rolling ball gained momentum as it moved downhill.
The campaign lost momentum after the initial enthusiasm faded.
In physics, momentum is always conserved in a closed system.
cn: 滚落的球随着下山加速，动量不断增加。
最初的热情消退后，这场运动失去了势头。
物理学中，封闭系统的动量总是守恒的。

definitions.definition: 杂种狗；混血动物；杂交植物

en: They adopted a friendly mongrel from the animal shelter.
The plant is a mongrel, produced by cross-pollinating two different species.
He referred to the mixed-breed dog as a mongrel with disdain.
cn: 他们从动物收容所收养了一只友好的杂种狗。
这种植物是杂种，通过两种不同物种异花授粉产生。
他不屑地称那只混血狗为杂种狗。

en: The artist prefers monochrome sketches to colorful paintings.
Early television broadcasts were only available in monochrome.
His wardrobe is strictly monochrome, filled with shades of black and white.
cn: 这位艺术家偏爱单色素描而非彩色绘画。
早期的电视广播只有黑白画面。
他的衣橱严格遵循单色系，只有黑白两色。

en: Many bird species practice monogamy for life.
The study compared the benefits of monogamy and polygamy in human societies.
Cultural norms often influence whether monogamy is expected in a relationship.
cn: 许多鸟类终生实行一夫一妻制。
这项研究比较了人类社会中一夫一妻制与多配偶制的利弊。
文化规范常影响一段关系是否要求专一性。

definitions.definition: 单语的；仅使用一种语言的

en: Monolingual dictionaries are designed for speakers of a specific language.
The country's largely monolingual education system has been a topic of debate.
Despite globalization, many regions remain predominantly monolingual.
cn: 单语词典是为特定语言的使用者设计的。
该国以单语为主的教育系统一直是一个争论的话题。
尽管全球化进程不断推进，许多地区仍然以使用单一语言为主。

definitions.definition: 独块巨石；庞然大物（比喻庞大而统一的组织或结构）

en: The ancient monolith stood silently in the desert, untouched for centuries.
cn: 这座古老的独石柱矗立在沙漠中，数个世纪未被触及。

en: His speech was delivered in a flat monotone, putting the audience to sleep.
The artist used a monotone color palette to create a sense of melancholy.
The monotone hum of the refrigerator was the only sound in the empty house.
cn: 他的演讲语调平淡，让听众昏昏欲睡。
艺术家用单调的色调营造忧郁感。
冰箱低沉的嗡嗡声是空房子里唯一的声音。

en: The monotony of his daily routine was beginning to depress him.
The landscape was flat, giving a feeling of endless monotony.
She needed to find a hobby to break the monotony of her weekends.
cn: 日复一日的单调生活开始让他感到压抑。
地势平坦，给人一种无边无际的单调感。
她需要找个爱好来打破周末的单调。

definitions.definition: 季风（亚洲地区的季节性强风系统，伴随雨季或旱季）

en: The monsoon brings heavy rains to India every summer.
Farmers rely on the monsoon for their crops.
Delayed monsoons can cause droughts in Southeast Asia.
cn: 季风每年夏季为印度带来暴雨。
农民依赖季风灌溉作物。
季风延迟可能导致东南亚干旱。

en: The film uses rapid montage to convey the chaos of battle.
Her art exhibition features a montage of vintage postcards.
The director’s signature style relies heavily on symbolic montage.
cn: 这部电影用快速蒙太奇表现战斗的混乱。
她的艺术展展出了一组复古明信片的拼贴作品。
这位导演的标志性风格大量依赖象征性蒙太奇。

definitions.definition: 纪念碑的；巨大的，宏伟的
（重要性或规模）非凡的，重大的

en: The pyramids are monumental achievements of ancient engineering.
She faced monumental challenges in her career but never gave up.
The artist spent years creating this monumental sculpture.
cn: 金字塔是古代工程学的宏伟成就。
她在职业生涯中面临重大挑战，但从未放弃。
艺术家耗时多年创作这座巨型雕塑。

definitions.definition: 忧郁的人；闷闷不乐的状态

en: Don't mope around the house all day; go out and get some fresh air.
After losing the game, he moped for a week.
She's such a mope when her favorite show is canceled.
cn: 别一整天都在家里闷闷不乐地闲逛；出去呼吸点新鲜空气。
比赛失利后，他闷闷不乐了一个星期。
她最喜欢的节目被取消时，她就会变得非常忧郁。

definitions.definition: 病态的；不健康的（指心理或情绪）
与疾病相关的（医学语境）

en: His fascination with crime scenes reveals a morbid curiosity.
The doctor noted the morbid swelling in the patient’s leg.
She avoided morbid topics to maintain a positive atmosphere.
cn: 他对犯罪现场的痴迷暴露了一种病态的好奇心。
医生注意到患者腿部的病理性肿胀。
她避开阴郁的话题以保持积极氛围。

definitions.definition: （特定群体的）风俗习惯，道德观念

en: The mores of Victorian society emphasized strict moral codes.
Anthropologists study the mores of indigenous tribes to understand their values.
Changing mores around gender roles reflect broader societal shifts.
cn: 维多利亚时代的社会风俗强调严格的道德规范。
人类学家研究土著部落的习俗以理解其价值观。
关于性别角色的习俗变迁反映了更广泛的社会变革。

definitions.definition: 停滞的；即将消亡的（比喻义）

en: The moribund patient refused artificial life support.
Traditional bookstores are not moribund; they’re adapting to digital trends.
The moribund empire collapsed under its own corruption.
cn: 这位垂死的病人拒绝使用人工生命维持系统。
传统书店并未消亡，而是在适应数字化趋势。
这个濒临崩溃的帝国因自身腐败而瓦解。

definitions.definition: 吗啡（一种镇痛麻醉药物）

en: Morphine is often used in hospitals to relieve severe pain.
The patient was administered morphine after the surgery.
Prolonged use of morphine can lead to dependence.
cn: 吗啡常用于医院以缓解剧烈疼痛。
术后患者被注射了吗啡。
长期使用吗啡可能导致依赖性。

definitions.definition: 必死性；死亡的状态或事实

en: The plague dramatically increased the mortality rate in medieval Europe.
Philosophers often ponder the inevitability of human mortality.
Advances in medicine have reduced infant mortality worldwide.
cn: 黑死病大幅提高了中世纪欧洲的死亡率。
哲学家常思考人类必死性的必然。
医学进步降低了全球婴儿死亡率。

en: The bricklayer applied mortar between the stones.
The soldiers fired a mortar round at the enemy position.
Traditional mortar is made of lime, sand, and water.
cn: 泥瓦匠在石块间涂抹砂浆。
士兵向敌军阵地发射了一枚迫击炮弹。
传统砂浆由石灰、沙子和水制成。

definitions.definition: 抵押贷款（法律上以房产作为债务担保的契约）

en: They took out a mortgage to buy their first home.
The bank may foreclose if you default on your mortgage.
He mortgaged his antique collection to start the business.
cn: 他们申请了抵押贷款购买第一套房子。
如果你拖欠抵押贷款，银行可能会收回房产。
他抵押了古董收藏来创业。

en: The body was taken to the mortuary for identification.
cn: 遗体被送往太平间进行身份确认。

definitions.definition: 马赛克（由小块材料拼成的装饰图案）

en: The cathedral floor is covered with a beautiful mosaic of colorful stones.
Her research presents a mosaic of data from different cultures.
The ancient mosaic depicts a scene from Greek mythology.
cn: 大教堂的地面铺满了色彩斑斓的石制马赛克。
她的研究呈现了来自不同文化的拼合式数据。
这幅古代镶嵌画描绘了希腊神话中的场景。

definitions.definition: （文学作品中的）反复出现的元素

en: The floral motif on the fabric was inspired by traditional Japanese art.
Beethoven's Fifth Symphony opens with a famous four-note motif.
The motif of betrayal recurs throughout Shakespeare's plays.
cn: 布料上的花卉图案灵感源自日本传统艺术。
贝多芬第五交响曲以著名的四音符动机开头。
背叛的主题在莎士比亚戏剧中反复出现。

en: The cat remained motionless, watching the bird intently.
The lake was motionless under the moonlight.
He stood motionless, afraid to make a sound.
cn: 那只猫一动不动，紧盯着小鸟。
湖面在月光下静止如镜。
他站着不动，生怕发出声响。

en: The crowd was a motley assortment of tourists and locals.
He wore a motley jacket patched with bright fabrics.
Her motley career included jobs as a chef and a pilot.
cn: 人群是游客和本地人的混杂组合。
他穿着一件用鲜艳布料拼凑的杂色夹克。
她混杂的职业经历包括厨师和飞行员。

en: The children built a small mound of sand at the beach.
The pitcher stood confidently on the mound.
Archaeologists discovered artifacts buried under the ancient mound.
cn: 孩子们在沙滩上堆了一个小沙丘。
投手自信地站在投手丘上。
考古学家在这座古土堆下发现了文物。

en: She ordered a chocolate mousse for dessert.
Apply a small amount of mousse to damp hair before styling.
The chef garnished the cake with berry mousse.
cn: 她点了一份巧克力慕斯作为甜点。
造型前将少量摩丝涂抹于湿发上。
厨师用浆果慕斯装饰蛋糕。

definitions.definition: 可移动物品（法律或会计术语中指动产）

en: The furniture is lightweight and easily movable.
In legal terms, cars are considered movable property.
The exhibition features movable sculptures powered by wind.
cn: 这些家具重量轻，易于移动。
在法律术语中，车辆被视为动产。
展览展示了由风力驱动的活动雕塑。

en: The farmer spread muck over the fields to enrich the soil.
Her shoes were covered in muck after walking through the swamp.
Don’t muck up the clean floor with your muddy boots!
cn: 农民在田地里撒粪肥以肥沃土壤。
她的鞋子穿过沼泽后沾满了污泥。
别用你的泥靴子弄脏干净的地板！

en: Don't muddle the instructions with unnecessary details.
His mind was in a muddle after the long meeting.
She muddled through the exam without proper preparation.
cn: 别用多余的细节把说明搞混。
长时间会议后，他的脑子一团乱。
她没有充分准备，糊里糊涂地应付了考试。

definitions.definition: 松饼（一种小型圆形蛋糕，通常甜味或咸味）

en: She baked blueberry muffins for breakfast.
The bakery sells freshly baked muffins every morning.
He prefers savory muffins with cheese and herbs.
cn: 她烤了蓝莓松饼当早餐。
这家面包店每天早晨现烤松饼。
他更喜欢芝士香草味的咸口松饼。

definitions.definition: 多边的（涉及多个国家或群体的）
多方面的（涉及多个领域或层面）

en: The treaty is a multilateral agreement among five nations.
Climate change requires multilateral solutions involving governments and businesses.
Her research takes a multilateral approach, combining economics and sociology.
cn: 这份条约是五国间的多边协议。
气候变化需要政府与企业共同参与的多边解决方案。
她的研究采用结合经济学与社会学的多层面方法。

en: A multitude of stars twinkled in the night sky.
The policy aims to benefit the multitude.
She faced a multitude of challenges with courage.
cn: 夜空中繁星点点。
该政策旨在惠及大众。
她勇敢面对重重挑战。

en: He tends to mumble when he's nervous.
The old man's mumble was barely audible.
Don't mumble—speak clearly!
cn: 他紧张时说话总是含糊不清。
老人的咕哝声几乎听不清。
别咕哝，说清楚点！

definitions.definition: 木乃伊（经防腐处理的尸体）

en: The museum displayed an ancient Egyptian mummy.
"Where's my mummy?" the toddler asked tearfully.
Scientists used CT scans to study the mummy's bones.
cn: 博物馆展出了一具古埃及木乃伊。
“我的妈妈在哪儿？”小孩含着泪问。
科学家用CT扫描研究木乃伊的骨骼。

en: The child stayed home from school after contracting mumps.
Vaccination has made cases of mumps much rarer.
Swollen salivary glands are a typical symptom of mumps.
cn: 感染腮腺炎后，这个孩子没去上学待在家里。
疫苗接种使得腮腺炎病例变得更为罕见。
唾液腺肿胀是腮腺炎的典型症状。

en: His job involved mundane tasks like filing papers and answering emails.
She longed for adventure to escape her mundane routine.
The movie transformed mundane city life into a magical experience.
cn: 他的工作涉及诸如整理文件和回复邮件之类的平凡任务。
她渴望冒险以摆脱单调的日常生活。
这部电影将平凡的城市生活变成了神奇的体验。

definitions.definition: 自治市；市政当局；自治区

en: The municipality is responsible for maintaining local parks and roads.
She works for the municipality’s urban planning department.
This small island became a municipality with its own elected council last year.
cn: 市政当局负责维护当地的公园和道路。
她在市政当局的城市规划部门工作。
这座小岛去年成为拥有民选议会的自治市。

definitions.definition: 军火，弹药（常指军用武器和装备的统称）

en: The army stockpiled munitions in secret warehouses.
Modern munitions require precise manufacturing standards.
The treaty restricted the export of munitions to conflict zones.
cn: 军队在秘密仓库中囤积军火。
现代弹药需要精确的制造标准。
该条约限制向冲突地区出口军用物资。

en: The museum commissioned a mural to celebrate the city's history.
She specializes in mural painting for public spaces.
The ancient mural depicts a hunting scene.
cn: 博物馆委托创作了一幅壁画以纪念城市的历史。
她专攻公共空间的壁画创作。
这幅古代壁画描绘了狩猎场景。

definitions.definition: 缪斯（希腊神话中的文艺女神）；灵感源泉

en: The painter sought his muse in the quiet countryside.
She sat by the window, musing over her past.
Ancient poets often invoked the muses before writing.
cn: 这位画家在宁静的乡村寻找灵感。
她坐在窗边，沉思往事。
古代诗人常在创作前祈求缪斯庇佑。

definitions.definition: 麝香（从雄麝鹿腺体中提取的芳香物质）
麝香气味（类似麝香的香味）

en: The perfume has a strong base note of musk.
Musk was once more valuable than gold in some cultures.
The hunter tracked the musk deer through the Himalayas.
cn: 这款香水有很浓的麝香底调。
在某些文化中，麝香曾比黄金更贵重。
猎人穿越喜马拉雅山脉追踪麝香鹿。

en: The general mustered his troops at dawn.
She mustered all her courage to face the challenge.
The annual muster of volunteers drew a large crowd.
cn: 将军在黎明时集结了他的部队。
她鼓足勇气面对挑战。
志愿者的年度集会吸引了大批人群。

en: The scientist studied the genetic code of the mutant fly.
Mutant plants often exhibit unusual colors.
The film features mutants with supernatural abilities.
cn: 科学家研究了变异果蝇的基因序列。
突变植物常呈现异常颜色。
这部电影以拥有超能力的变种人为主角。

definitions.definition: 使残废；使严重伤残；使残缺不全；使支离破碎

en: The explosion mutilated his hand beyond recognition.
Censors mutilated the text, removing entire chapters.
It is a crime to mutiliate or deface currency.
cn: 爆炸使他的手严重伤残，无法辨认。
审查人员肢解了文本，删除了整章整章的内容。
损毁或污损货币是一种犯罪行为。

definitions.definition: 给（动物）戴口套；压制言论

en: The dog wore a leather muzzle to prevent biting.
The soldier carefully cleaned the muzzle of his rifle.
The government tried to muzzle the press during the crisis.
cn: 这只狗戴着皮制口套以防咬人。
士兵仔细擦拭了步枪的枪口。
危机期间，政府试图压制新闻自由。

en: The sky was filled with a myriad of twinkling stars.
She faced myriad challenges while starting her business.
The artist used a myriad of colors to create the vibrant painting.
cn: 夜空中闪烁着无数繁星。
创业时，她面临着无数挑战。
艺术家用多种多样的色彩创作了这幅生动的画作。

en: The old monk was known as a mystic who could see the future.
She felt a mystic connection to the ancient forest.
His poetry is full of mystic symbols.
cn: 这位老僧人以能预见未来的神秘主义者身份闻名。
她感受到与这片古老森林之间有一种神秘的联结。
他的诗歌充满玄妙的象征。

definitions.definition: 神话学（研究神话的学科）
神话体系（某一文化或宗教中的神话总称）

en: Greek mythology is full of stories about gods and heroes.
She specialized in comparative mythology at university.
The book explores the mythology of ancient Egypt.
cn: 希腊神话充满了关于神与英雄的故事。
她在大学专攻比较神话学。
这本书探讨了古埃及的神话体系。

en: The police nabbed the thief before he could escape.
She managed to nab the best seat in the theater.
Fans rushed to nab autographs after the concert.
cn: 警方在小偷逃跑前将其抓获。
她抢到了剧院里最好的座位。
演唱会结束后，粉丝们争先恐后索要签名。

en: She always nags me about cleaning my room.
The noise from the construction site nagged at him all day.
Don't be such a nag—let the kids have some fun.
cn: 她总是唠叨要我打扫房间。
建筑工地的噪音整天烦扰着他。
别这么唠叨，让孩子们玩会儿吧。

en: My nephew is my namesake; we both share the name "William".
The city is the namesake of a famous explorer who discovered it.
She gifted me a book by her favorite author, my literary namesake.
cn: 我的侄子与我同名，我们都叫“威廉”。
这座城市以发现它的著名探险家命名。
她送了我一本她最爱的作家写的书，那位作家与我同名。

en: The cat licked its nape after the meal.
He felt a chill run down his nape.
Sunburn on the nape is common during summer.
cn: 猫吃完饭后舔了舔自己的后颈。
他感到一阵寒意顺着后颈袭来。
夏季时颈背晒伤很常见。

definitions.definition: （大写首字母）那喀索斯（希腊神话中因自恋水中倒影而憔悴致死的美少年，死后化为水仙花）

en: The narcissus blooms in early spring, often when there is still snow on the ground.
cn: 水仙花在早春开花，那时地上常常还有积雪。

en: The doctor examined her nasal passage for any obstructions.
French has several distinctive nasal sounds.
He spoke with a nasal tone due to his cold.
cn: 医生检查了她的鼻腔是否有阻塞。
法语有几种独特的鼻音。
他因感冒说话带有鼻音。

en: The captain wore a traditional nautical uniform.
Nautical charts are essential for safe navigation.
She decorated her room with a nautical theme, using anchors and ropes.
cn: 船长穿着一套传统的航海制服。
航海图对安全航行至关重要。
她用锚和绳索等元素以航海主题装饰房间。

en: The baby's navel healed completely after two weeks.
Ancient Greeks believed Delphi was the navel of the world.
She gently cleaned around her newborn's navel with cotton.
cn: 婴儿的肚脐两周后完全愈合。
古希腊人认为德尔斐是世界的中心。
她用棉花轻轻擦拭新生儿的肚脐周围。

definitions.definition: 纳粹主义（20世纪德国的极权主义意识形态，以种族主义、反犹主义和扩张主义为核心）

en: Nazism was condemned internationally for its atrocities during World War II.
The rise of Nazism in the 1930s dramatically altered European history.
Scholars analyze Nazism as a warning against totalitarian ideologies.
cn: 纳粹主义因二战期间的暴行受到国际社会谴责。
20世纪30年代纳粹主义的兴起彻底改变了欧洲历史。
学者将纳粹主义作为极权意识形态的警示案例进行研究。

definitions.definition: 模糊不清的，难以理解的

en: The boundaries between these two categories are often nebulous.
cn: 这两类之间的界限常常很模糊。

en: The sudden storm necessitated a change in our travel plans.
Rapid population growth necessitates better urban planning.
His injury necessitated immediate medical attention.
cn: 突如其来的暴风雨迫使我们的旅行计划作出调整。
人口的快速增长需要更完善的城市规划。
他的伤势需要立即就医。

definitions.definition: 花蜜（植物分泌的甜味液体）
神饮（希腊神话中众神的饮品）
甘露（比喻极美味的饮料）

en: Bees collect nectar from flowers to make honey.
In Greek myths, nectar was the drink of the gods.
This tropical juice is pure nectar!
cn: 蜜蜂从花朵中采集花蜜以酿造蜂蜜。
希腊神话中，神饮是众神的饮品。
这款热带果汁简直是甘露！

en: The evidence was sufficient to negate his earlier statement.
Adding sugar will negate the health benefits of this drink.
She chose to negate the contract after discovering hidden clauses.
cn: 证据足以否定他先前的陈述。
加糖会抵消这种饮品的健康益处。
发现隐藏条款后，她决定废除合同。

en: The court ruled the doctor was negligent in failing to diagnose the condition.
His negligent attitude towards safety protocols caused the accident.
She lost her job due to negligent handling of confidential documents.
cn: 法院裁定该医生未能诊断出病情，存在过失。
他对安全规程的疏忽态度导致了事故。
她因粗心处理机密文件而丢了工作。

definitions.definition: 微不足道的；可忽略不计的

en: The difference in performance was negligible.
She considered the risk negligible and proceeded.
Only a negligible amount of data was lost.
cn: 性能差异微不足道。
她认为风险可忽略不计，于是继续行动。
仅丢失了极少量的数据。

definitions.definition: （票据、证券等）可转让的，可流通的

en: The terms of the contract are fully negotiable.
cn: 合同的条款完全可以协商。

definitions.definition: 新古典主义的（尤指艺术、建筑、经济学等领域）

en: The building's neoclassical facade features grand columns and a triangular pediment.
Neoclassical economists emphasize the efficiency of market equilibrium.
She composed a piece of music with a distinct neoclassical style.
cn: 这座建筑的新古典主义立面以宏伟的柱子和三角形山花为特色。
新古典主义经济学家强调市场均衡的效率。
她创作了一首具有鲜明新古典主义风格的音乐作品。

definitions.definition: 氖（一种惰性气体元素，符号 Ne）
霓虹灯（因含氖气发光而得名）

en: Neon is used in advertising signs for its bright glow.
The city streets were vibrant with neon lights at night.
Helium and neon are both noble gases.
cn: 氖因其明亮的辉光被用于广告灯牌。
夜晚的城市街道因霓虹灯而充满活力。
氦和氖都是惰性气体。

en: The kitten nestled against its mother for warmth.
She nestled the vase carefully among the books.
The village nestles in a valley surrounded by mountains.
cn: 小猫依偎在母猫身边取暖。
她将花瓶小心地安放在书堆之间。
村庄舒适地坐落在群山环绕的谷地中。

This drug targets neural activity to reduce pain.
AI models attempt to mimic neural networks in humans.
cn: 大脑中的神经通路极为复杂。
该药物通过作用于神经活动来减轻疼痛。
人工智能模型试图模拟人类的神经网络。

Alzheimer's disease causes severe neurological damage.
Her research focuses on neurological disorders in children.
cn: 患者接受了一系列神经学检查。
阿尔茨海默病会导致严重的神经损伤。
她的研究专注于儿童神经发育障碍。

definitions.definition: 神经官能症，神经症（一种轻性心理障碍，特征为焦虑、强迫行为或忧郁等，但未丧失现实感）

The therapist specialized in treating patients with obsessive-compulsive neurosis.
In modern psychology, neurosis is distinguished from psychosis by the patient's intact reality testing.
cn: 他的慢性焦虑被诊断为一种神经官能症。
这位治疗师专长于治疗强迫性神经症患者。
在现代心理学中，神经症与精神病的区别在于患者现实检验能力是否完整。

The character is portrayed as a neurotic artist who constantly doubts her work.
Chronic stress can lead to neurotic behaviors if left unmanaged.
cn: 他对清洁的神经过敏使他每10分钟就要洗一次手。
这个角色被描绘成一个不断自我怀疑的神经质艺术家。
长期压力若不加以控制，可能导致神经症行为。

definitions.definition: 使中立化；抵消，中和（化学或政治语境）

Baking soda can neutralise acidic solutions.
Her diplomatic skills helped neutralise the conflict.
cn: 该条约旨在使争议边境地区中立化。
小苏打能中和酸性溶液。
她的外交技巧帮助化解了冲突。

cn: 在电视出现之前，人们去电影院看最新的新闻影片。

这段新闻影片胶片捕捉到了欧洲胜利日那天欢欣鼓舞的人群。

The bird used its nib to crack open the seed.
Dip the nib into the inkwell before you start writing.
cn: 我的钢笔笔尖弯了，需要更换。
那只鸟用它的喙啄开了种子。

The machine is designed nicely for easy use.
He explained the rules nicely without any confusion.
cn: 她友好地向客人们微笑。
这台机器设计精巧，便于使用。
他清晰地解释了规则，毫无含糊之处。

Each species occupies a unique niche in the rainforest ecosystem.
Their company found a profitable niche in organic pet food.
cn: 雕像被安放在教堂墙壁凿出的壁龛中。
每个物种在雨林生态系统中占据独特的生态位。
他们的公司在有机宠物食品领域找到了盈利利基。

The study focused on how nicotine affects brain function.
Many smokers struggle to quit due to nicotine dependence.

Modern activists emphasize eradicating such language from public discourse.
cn: “nigger”一词被普遍认定为种族侮辱用语。
历史文献表明该词如何被武器化以剥夺黑人人性。

She drew nigh to the fire to warm her hands.
He came nigh to winning the race.
cn: 项目结束在即。
她靠近火堆暖手。
他差点就赢了比赛。

Her nimble mind solved the puzzle in seconds.
Cats are nimble creatures, able to leap great distances.
cn: 这位敏捷的体操运动员在平衡木上完美落地。
她思维敏锐，几秒内就解开了谜题。
猫是灵活的动物，能跳跃很远的距离。

en: She nipped the dead leaves off the plant.
The cold wind nipped at our faces.
He took a nip of whiskey to warm himself.
cn: 她掐掉了植物上的枯叶。
寒风刺骨，刮得我们脸生疼。
他抿了一小口威士忌暖身子。

en: The baby refused to drink from the silicone nipple.
A metal nipple connects the two pipes.
Her fingers brushed against the cold nipple of the bottle.
cn: 婴儿拒绝用硅胶奶嘴喝奶。
一个金属接头连接了两根管道。
她的手指碰到了冰凉的瓶口突起。

definitions.definition: 涅槃，超脱苦难、欲望和轮回的终极境界（佛教、印度教）
极乐世界，无忧无虑的理想状态或地方（引申义）

After weeks of vacation by the lake, she felt she had achieved a state of nirvana.
The musician described the experience of composing as a form of creative nirvana.
cn: 在佛教中，涅槃代表了灵修实践的终极目标。
在湖边度过了几周的假期后，她感觉自己仿佛达到了极乐境界。
这位音乐家将创作经历描述为一种创造性的涅槃。

definitions.definition: 硝酸盐（一种无机化合物）

Farmers often nitrate soil to boost crop growth.
The lab detected nitrates in the asteroid sample.
cn: 饮用水中过量的硝酸盐可能危害婴儿健康。
农民常通过土壤硝化促进作物生长。
实验室在小行星样本中检测到硝酸盐。

definitions.definition: 节点（网络、植物或解剖结构中的连接点）
【数学】结点（曲线交点或函数零点）

Maple leaves typically have five nodes where veins intersect.
The equation has a double node at the origin.
cn: 网络工程师定位到系统中的一个故障节点。
枫叶通常有五个叶脉交汇的结点。

Digital nomads work remotely while traveling the world.
Nomads have a deep understanding of desert survival.
cn: 蒙古游牧民族根据季节迁移他们的蒙古包。

游牧者对沙漠生存有着深刻理解。

Digital nomads work remotely while traveling the world.
Nomadic tribes adapt quickly to changing environments.
cn: 蒙古族拥有悠久的游牧生活传统。
数字游民边旅行边远程工作。

cn: 她担任名义上的主席，但没有实权。
该公司仅收取象征性服务费。

All party nominees must pass a background check.

所有政党候选人均需通过背景审查。

definitions.definition: 漠不关心的；冷淡的；若无其事的

cn: 她对赢得这个 prestigious 奖项表现出惊人的漠然。

The evidence is weak; nonetheless, it suggests a possible connection.
cn: 天气很糟糕，但我们依然玩得很开心。
她筋疲力尽，但仍按时完成了项目。

乐队连续演奏了三小时的流行金曲。

definitions.definition: 北欧的；斯堪的纳维亚的（与挪威、瑞典、丹麦等国家相关）
北欧人；北欧特征（如体型或文化）

en: Nordic countries are known for their high quality of life and social welfare systems.
She has classic Nordic features: fair skin and blonde hair.
The furniture design follows a minimalist Nordic aesthetic.
cn: 北欧国家以高生活质量和社会福利体系闻名。
她有典型的北欧人特征：白皙皮肤和金发。

definitions.definition: 对过去的怀念（尤指对美好时光的感伤追忆）

cn: 这张老照片让她充满对童年的怀念。
怀旧情绪会让我们甚至美化过去的艰难岁月。

He played a nostalgic tune on the piano.
The vintage shop sells items that evoke a nostalgic atmosphere.
cn: 这张老照片让她怀念起童年。
他在钢琴上弹奏了一首怀旧的曲子。
这家复古商店售卖能唤起怀旧氛围的物品。

en: The contract was signed in the presence of a notary public.
You will need to have the document certified by a notary.
The notary verified our identities before stamping the papers.
cn: 合同是在一位公证人的见证下签署的。
你需要让公证人认证这份文件。
公证人在文件上盖章前核实了我们的身份。

definitions.definition: 符号系统；标记法（如数学、音乐中的符号）

en: Musical notation allows composers to communicate complex melodies precisely.
The scientist used a special notation to record the chemical reaction.
Ancient Babylonian clay tablets contain the earliest known mathematical notations.
cn: 音乐符号系统让作曲家能精确传达复杂旋律。
科学家用特殊标记法记录化学反应。
古巴比伦泥板上有已知最早的数学符号记录。

en: The school sent a notification about the upcoming parent-teacher meeting.
Turn off app notifications to avoid distractions while working.
A pop-up notification alerted her to the new email.
cn: 学校发送了关于即将召开的家长会通知。
关闭应用通知功能，避免工作时分心。
一条弹窗通知提醒她收到了新邮件。

definitions.definition: （因负面行为）广为人知的状态

en: The scandal brought him instant notoriety.
She avoided social media to escape notoriety.
The town gained notoriety for its corrupt officials.
cn: 这桩丑闻让他一夜成名（恶名）。
她远离社交媒体以躲避恶名。
该镇因官员腐败而臭名昭著。

en: Notwithstanding the heavy rain, the event proceeded as planned.
He insisted on his opinion, notwithstanding all objections.
The law remains valid, notwithstanding its age.
cn: 尽管大雨倾盆，活动仍按计划进行。
他不顾所有反对意见，坚持己见。
尽管年代久远，该法律依然有效。

en: The score was three to nought.
All his efforts came to nought.
In some contexts, nought is used interchangeably with zero.
cn: 比分是三比零。
他所有的努力都化为乌有。
在某些语境中，nought 和 zero 可以互换使用。

en: The novelty of working from home soon wore off.
She bought some Christmas novelties to decorate the tree.
Scientific discoveries often begin with a sense of novelty.
cn: 居家办公的新鲜感很快消失了。
她买了一些圣诞小饰品装饰树。
科学发现常始于新奇感。

en: She's a complete novice at coding, but she's eager to learn.
The monastery accepts novices every spring.
As a novice driver, he avoided busy highways.
cn: 她对编程完全陌生，但学习热情很高。
修道院每年春季接收见习修士。
作为新手司机，他避开了繁忙的高速公路。

definitions.definition: （颜色、音调、意义等的）细微差别

en: The pianist mastered the nuances of the composer's style.
Her essay nuances the argument with historical context.
The fabric changes color with subtle nuances under sunlight.
cn: 钢琴家把握了作曲家风格的微妙之处。
她的论文通过历史背景精细区分了论点。
这块布料在阳光下呈现出细微的色调变化。

definitions.definition: 核心，中心（如原子核、细胞核）
起点，基础（抽象概念的核心部分）

en: The nucleus of an atom contains protons and neutrons.
This idea formed the nucleus of their new theory.
The cell nucleus controls genetic activity.
cn: 原子核由质子和中子组成。
这一观点构成了他们新理论的基础。
细胞核控制遗传活动。

en: The artist painted a nude figure against a dark background.
In some cultures, being nude in public is considered taboo.
The statue depicts a nude athlete holding a laurel wreath.
cn: 艺术家在深色背景上绘制了一幅裸体人像。
在某些文化中，公开裸露被视为禁忌。
这座雕像刻画了一名手持月桂花环的裸体运动员。

definitions.definition: 轻推；用肘轻碰（以引起注意）
轻推；轻微的推动或提醒

en: She nudged me to remind me of the meeting.
The government uses tax incentives as a nudge toward renewable energy.
Give the door a nudge if it sticks.
cn: 她轻轻推了我一下，提醒我开会。
政府利用税收激励作为推动可再生能源的手段。
如果门卡住了，轻轻推一下。

en: The painting depicts nudity with artistic subtlety.
Public nudity is prohibited in most cities.
The documentary explores cultural attitudes toward nudity.
cn: 这幅画以艺术的微妙手法描绘了裸体。
大多数城市禁止公共场所裸露身体。
这部纪录片探讨了不同文化对裸体的态度。

en: Her fingers were numb from the cold.
The shock of the news numbed him.
He rubbed his numb leg to restore circulation.
cn: 她的手指因寒冷而麻木。
消息的冲击使他麻木。
他揉搓麻木的腿以恢复血液循环。

en: Parents should nurture their children's creativity.
The school is dedicated to the nurture of young talents.
Good soil helps nurture healthy plants.
cn: 父母应培养孩子的创造力。
这所学校致力于培育年轻人才。
肥沃的土壤有助于培育健康的植物。

en: Plants absorb nutrients from the soil.
This drink is rich in essential nutrients.
Nutrient deficiency can cause health problems.
cn: 植物从土壤中吸收养分。
这种饮料富含必需营养素。
营养缺乏会导致健康问题。

definitions.definition: /vi. （用鼻子）轻推、轻触（表示亲昵或寻找）

en: The puppy nuzzled against my hand for attention.
She nuzzled her face into his shoulder, sighing contentedly.
Cows nuzzle the grass to find the tenderest shoots.
cn: 小狗用鼻子轻推我的手，想引起注意。
她把脸埋进他的肩膀，满足地叹了口气。
牛用鼻子轻触草叶，寻找最嫩的草芽。

definitions.definition: 宁芙（希腊神话中的自然精灵）
（昆虫学）若虫（未成熟的昆虫形态）

en: The artist painted a nymph dancing by the moonlit stream.
The cicada nymph lives underground for years before emerging.
Ancient Greeks believed every grove had its own nymph.
cn: 画家描绘了一位在月光溪边起舞的宁芙。
蝉的若虫会在地下生活多年才破土而出。
古希腊人认为每片树林都有专属的宁芙。

definitions.definition: 绿洲（沙漠中的肥沃地带）

en: The travelers rejoiced when they found an oasis in the desert.
Her kindness was an oasis of calm in his chaotic life.
The café became a popular oasis for artists in the city.
cn: 旅行者们发现沙漠中的绿洲时欣喜若狂。
她的善意是他混乱生活中的一片宁静绿洲。
这家咖啡馆成了城市里艺术家们钟爱的避风港。

definitions.definition: 肥胖的（指体重严重超标的病理状态）

en: Obesity is a major risk factor for heart disease.
The doctor warned him about becoming obese due to sedentary habits.
Obese patients often face social stigma.
cn: 肥胖是心脏病的主要风险因素。
医生警告他久坐习惯可能导致肥胖。
肥胖患者常面临社会歧视。

en: Childhood obesity has become a serious public health issue.
Genetic factors may contribute to obesity.
The doctor advised exercise to reduce obesity-related risks.
cn: 儿童肥胖已成为严重的公共卫生问题。
遗传因素可能导致肥胖。
医生建议通过运动降低肥胖相关风险。

definitions.definition: 讣告（记录逝者生平的公告）

en: The newspaper published an obituary for the renowned scientist.
She wrote a heartfelt obituary to honor her grandfather.
Obituaries often include details about the deceased's family and achievements.
cn: 报纸为这位著名科学家刊登了讣告。
她写了一篇深情的讣告以纪念祖父。
讣告通常包含逝者的家庭背景和成就细节。

definitions.definition: 义务的；必须的；强制性的

en: Wearing a helmet is obligatory for cyclists in this city.
The course includes obligatory attendance at three seminars.
His obligatory apology lacked sincerity.
cn: 在这座城市，骑自行车必须戴头盔。
该课程要求必须参加三次研讨会。
他敷衍了事的道歉毫无诚意。

definitions.definition: 彻底毁灭；抹去（痕迹或记忆）
（医学）使（器官或组织）消失或失效

en: The tsunami obliterated entire coastal villages.
Time had obliterated the ancient inscriptions on the stone.
The laser treatment obliterated the abnormal blood vessels.
cn: 海啸彻底摧毁了沿海的村庄。
时间磨灭了石头上的古老铭文。
激光治疗消除了异常的血管。

definitions.definition: 遗忘；湮没；被遗忘的状态

en: The ancient civilization fell into oblivion after centuries of neglect.
He drank himself into oblivion to escape the pain.
Many great artists were lost to oblivion until their works were rediscovered.
cn: 这座古文明因长期被忽视而湮没在历史中。
他借酒消愁，直至不省人事。
许多伟大艺术家曾被遗忘，直至作品重见天日。

en: The plaintive sound of the oboe introduced the melody.
She has been practicing the oboe for five years.
The oboe plays the tuning note for the orchestra.
cn: 双簧管哀怨的声音引出了旋律。
她练习双簧管已有五年时间。
双簧管为管弦乐队演奏定调音。

definitions.definition: 令人反感的，骇人听闻的（引申义）

en: The court banned the book for containing obscene material.
His obscene wealth contrasts sharply with the poverty around him.
The graffiti was deemed obscene and promptly removed.
cn: 法院因该书含有淫秽内容而将其禁封。
他骇人的财富与周围的贫困形成鲜明对比。
涂鸦被判定为低俗内容并迅速清除。

definitions.definition: 淫秽，下流（指语言、行为或材料）

en: The film was banned for its obscenity.
His speech was full of obscenities.
Laws regulate the publication of obscenity.
cn: 这部电影因淫秽内容被禁。
他的演讲充斥着脏话。
法律对淫秽出版物的传播进行规范。

en: The poet lived in obscurity until his work was rediscovered.
The obscurity of the ancient text puzzled scholars.
Fog rolled in, wrapping the town in obscurity.
cn: 这位诗人默默无闻，直到他的作品被重新发现。
古代文本的晦涩难懂让学者们困惑不已。
雾气弥漫，将小镇笼罩在朦胧中。

definitions.definition: 仪式，庆典（尤指宗教性质）

en: The company strictly enforces observance of safety protocols.
Ramadan is a time of spiritual observance for Muslims.
The ancient festival is still celebrated with traditional observances.
cn: 该公司严格执行安全规程的遵守。
斋月是穆斯林进行宗教修持的时期。
这一古老节日仍以传统仪式庆祝。

definitions.definition: 观察力敏锐的；注意细节的

en: She was observant enough to notice the subtle change in his expression.
Observant Muslims fast during Ramadan.
The detective’s observant eye caught a clue others had missed.
cn: 她观察力敏锐，注意到了他表情的微妙变化。
虔诚的穆斯林在斋月期间禁食。
侦探敏锐的目光捕捉到了他人遗漏的线索。

definitions.definition: 使着迷；使困扰（指思想或情感上的强烈占据）
沉迷（常与介词 with/about 连用）

en: The fear of failure obsessed him throughout his career.
She became obsessed with collecting vintage postcards.
His mind was obsessed by the idea of revenge.
cn: 对失败的恐惧贯穿了他的整个职业生涯。
她迷上了收集复古明信片。
复仇的念头占据了他的脑海。

en: His obsessive attention to detail made him a brilliant scientist.
She developed an obsessive interest in ancient history.
The film portrays the dark side of obsessive love.
cn: 他对细节的强迫性关注使他成为杰出的科学家。
她对古代历史产生了近乎痴迷的兴趣。
这部电影描绘了强迫型爱情的阴暗面。

en: Floppy disks are now obsolete in modern computing.
The new law will obsolete many outdated regulations.
His skills became obsolete after the industry shifted to automation.
cn: 软盘在现代计算中已被淘汰。
新法律将使许多过时的法规失效。
行业转向自动化后，他的技能过时了。

definitions.definition: 西方的，西方国家的；西方文化的

en: The museum has a magnificent collection of oriental and occidental art.
From an occidental perspective, the customs may seem unusual.
He studied the differences between oriental and occidental philosophies.
cn: 该博物馆拥有辉煌的东方和西方艺术藏品。
从西方人的视角来看，这些习俗可能显得不同寻常。
他研究了东方哲学与西方哲学之间的差异。

en: The hotel's occupancy rate reached 90% during the holiday season.
Proof of occupancy is required to apply for a resident permit.
The new law regulates the maximum occupancy of public venues.
cn: 假日期间酒店入住率达90%。
申请居住证需提供居住证明。
新法规对公共场所的最大容纳人数作出规定。

definitions.definition: 海洋学，一门研究海洋及其现象的学科

en: She decided to major in oceanography to study marine ecosystems.
Advances in technology have revolutionized the field of oceanography.
The research vessel is dedicated to deep-sea oceanography.
cn: 她决定主修海洋学，以研究海洋生态系统。
技术进步彻底改变了海洋学领域。
这艘研究船专门用于深海海洋学考察。

definitions.definition: 章鱼（一种海洋软体动物，有八条触手）
引申为“多面手”或“多功能组织”（比喻用法）

en: The octopus camouflaged itself against the coral reef.
Scientists study the octopus for its remarkable intelligence.
The company operates like an octopus, with branches in multiple industries.
cn: 章鱼在珊瑚礁中伪装自己。
科学家因章鱼的高智商而研究它。
这家公司像章鱼一样触手遍布多个行业。

definitions.definition: 差异，不平等（如力量、条件等）

en: The odds of winning the lottery are extremely low.
Despite the odds, she succeeded in her career.
The bookmaker offered 3-to-1 odds on the underdog.
cn: 彩票中奖的概率极低。
尽管形势不利，她仍在事业上取得了成功。
庄家为劣势方开出了3比1的赔率。

definitions.definition: 颂诗，颂歌（一种抒情诗体裁，通常歌颂人或事物）

en: Keats wrote his famous "Ode to a Grecian Urn" in 1819.
The choir performed a modern ode to nature at the festival.
Her speech was like an ode to the power of education.
cn: 济慈于1819年创作了著名的《希腊古瓮颂》。
合唱团在音乐节上演唱了一首献给自然的现代颂歌。
她的演讲宛如一曲对教育力量的赞歌。

definitions.definition: 气味（尤指强烈或特殊的气味，可指香味或臭味）

en: The odour of fresh bread filled the bakery.
A strange odour came from the abandoned house.
The chemical leaves a persistent odour on fabrics.
cn: 新鲜面包的香气弥漫着面包店。
废弃的房屋里传来一股怪味。
这种化学品会在织物上留下持久气味。

en: His remarks were deeply offensive to the entire community.
The army launched a major offensive at dawn.
She found the joke highly offensive.
cn: 他的言论严重冒犯了整个社区。
军队在黎明时发动了大规模进攻。
她觉得这个笑话极其无礼。

definitions.definition: 临时的；即席的；随便的；草率的

en: She gave an offhand answer without looking up from her book.
I don’t know offhand, but I can check for you.
His offhand manner sometimes made him seem uninterested.
cn: 她头也不抬地从书中给出了一个随口而出的回答。
我一时说不上来，但可以帮你查一下。
他随意的态度有时会让他显得不感兴趣。

definitions.definition: 药膏；软膏（用于涂抹皮肤的外用制剂）

en: She applied the ointment to the burn to soothe the pain.
This herbal ointment helps reduce skin inflammation.
The doctor prescribed an antibiotic ointment for the wound.
cn: 她在烧伤处涂抹药膏以缓解疼痛。
这种草药软膏有助于减轻皮肤炎症。
医生为伤口开了一种抗生素药膏。

definitions.definition: 希腊字母表的最后一个字母（Ω, ω）
（一系列中）最后一个；最终；终结

en: Alpha and omega are the first and last letters of the Greek alphabet.
The death of the character marked the omega of the story.
This project is the omega of all my efforts this year.
cn: 阿尔法和欧米伽是希腊字母表的第一个和最后一个字母。
这个角色的死亡标志着故事的终结。
这个项目是我今年所有努力的最终成果。

definitions.definition: 煎蛋饼，鸡蛋卷（一种由打散的鸡蛋煎制而成的菜肴，常加入奶酪、蔬菜或肉类等馅料）

en: She made a delicious cheese and herb omelette for breakfast.
A well-made omelette should be light and fluffy, not rubbery.
He ordered a Spanish omelette with potatoes and onions at the café.
cn: 她早餐做了一份美味的奶酪香草煎蛋饼。
一份做得好的煎蛋饼应该轻盈松软，而不是像橡胶一样硬。
他在咖啡馆点了一份西班牙土豆洋葱蛋饼。

definitions.definition: 不祥的，预兆的（尤指坏事）

en: The dark clouds looked ominous before the storm.
His silence was ominous, suggesting bad news.
The sudden drop in stock prices gave investors an ominous feeling.
cn: 暴风雨前的乌云显得很不祥。
他的沉默预示着坏消息，令人不安。
股价突然下跌给投资者一种不祥的预感。

en: The novel features an omniscient narrator who reveals every character's thoughts.
No human can truly be omniscient, no matter how intelligent they are.
In mythology, gods are often portrayed as omniscient beings.
cn: 这部小说采用全知视角的叙述者，揭示所有角色的内心活动。
无论多么聪明，人类都无法真正全知。
神话中，神常被描绘为无所不知的存在。

en: The driver slowed down for the oncoming traffic.
She felt uneasy about the oncoming storm.
The oncoming of winter brings shorter days.
cn: 司机为迎面而来的车辆减速。
她对即将到来的风暴感到不安。
冬季的来临使白昼变短。

en: The investigation is still ongoing.
We appreciate your ongoing support.
The project faces ongoing challenges.
cn: 调查仍在进行中。
我们感谢您持续的支持。
该项目面临持续的挑战。

definitions.definition: 拟声法，象声词（指模仿自然声音构词的语言现象）
拟声词（指模仿声音的词语本身）

en: The word "buzz" is an example of onomatopoeia.
Comic books often use onomatopoeia like "pow" and "boom" to make the action more vivid.
The poet employed onomatopoeia to mimic the sound of rain falling on the leaves.
cn: “嗡嗡声（buzz）”这个词是拟声词的一个例子。
漫画书经常使用“啪（pow）”和“砰（boom）”这样的拟声词来让动作场面更加生动。
诗人运用拟声法来模仿雨点落在树叶上的声音。

definitions.definition: （尤指不愉快事件的）开始，发作

en: The onset of winter brought heavy snowfall.
Early diagnosis can delay the onset of symptoms.
The troops prepared for the sudden onset of the enemy.
cn: 冬季伊始，大雪纷飞。
早期诊断可延缓症状发作。
军队为敌人的突然进攻做准备。

en: The castle fell after a fierce onslaught by the enemy.
The company faced an onslaught of complaints after the product recall.
Spring brings an onslaught of pollen allergies.
cn: 城堡在敌人的猛攻后沦陷。
产品召回后，公司遭到大量投诉。
春天花粉过敏问题集中爆发。

en: The mud oozed between her toes as she walked through the swamp.
Maple syrup oozed slowly from the tree trunk.
His voice oozed confidence during the presentation.
cn: 沼泽中的泥浆从她的脚趾间缓缓渗出。
枫糖浆从树干中缓慢渗出。
他的声音在演讲中流露出自信。

definitions.definition: 蛋白石，一种非晶质的宝石，以其独特的彩虹般变彩效应而闻名。

en: The fire opal displayed a brilliant play of colors in the sunlight.
Her ring was set with a magnificent Australian opal.
The mineralogist explained how the unique internal structure of an opal causes its iridescence.
cn: 火蛋白石在阳光下展现出绚丽的色彩变幻。
她的戒指上镶嵌着一颗华丽的澳大利亚蛋白石。
矿物学家解释了蛋白石独特的内部结构是如何导致其产生虹彩现象的。

en: The windows were made of opaque glass to ensure privacy.
His explanation was deliberately opaque, leaving us more confused.
The chemical solution turned opaque after mixing.
cn: 窗户采用不透明玻璃以保证隐私。
他的解释故意含糊其辞，让我们更加困惑。
混合后化学溶液变得浑浊不透明。

definitions.definition: 操作的；运作的（与系统、机器或组织的实际功能相关）
可使用的；可运行的（指设备或系统处于可用状态）

en: The new system is now fully operational.
Operational costs have been reduced by 20%.
The airport resumed operational services after the storm.
cn: 新系统现已全面投入运行。
运营成本降低了20%。
暴风雨过后，机场恢复了运营服务。

en: The new policy became operative last month.
She is a skilled operative in the manufacturing plant.
The spy worked as an undercover operative.
cn: 新政策已于上月生效。
她是制造厂里一名熟练的操作工。
这名间谍以卧底特工的身份工作。

en: She decided to opt for the vegetarian menu.
Employees can opt out of the company pension scheme.
Many students opt to study abroad for better opportunities.
cn: 她选择了素食菜单。
员工可以选择退出公司的养老金计划。
许多学生选择留学以获取更好的机会。

en: The temperature for yeast fermentation is at its optimum around 30°C.
This algorithm finds the optimum solution with minimal resources.
Plants grow poorly when conditions deviate from the optimum.
cn: 酵母发酵的最适温度约为30摄氏度。
该算法能以最少资源找到最优解。
当环境偏离最适条件时，植物生长不良。

en: The opulent palace was adorned with gold and marble.
Her opulent lifestyle included private jets and designer clothes.
The novel describes the opulent feasts of the royal court.
cn: 这座豪华宫殿装饰着黄金和大理石。
她奢侈的生活方式包括私人飞机和名牌服装。
小说描绘了皇室宫廷的奢华盛宴。

definitions.definition: （尤指音乐或文学领域的）作品，尤指编号作品（如贝多芬的《第九交响曲》Op. 125）

en: Beethoven's Opus 131 is a string quartet in C-sharp minor.
The composer left his final opus unfinished.
This novel is considered her magnum opus.
cn: 贝多芬的《作品131号》是一首升C小调弦乐四重奏。
这位作曲家未完成他的最后一部作品。
这部小说被视为她的代表作。

definitions.definition: 神谕（古希腊等宗教中神传达的预言或指示）
（技术领域）权威数据库或系统（如 Oracle 数据库）

en: The priestess at Delphi was the most famous oracle in ancient Greece.
He is regarded as the oracle of modern economic theory.
Oracle Corporation provides database solutions to global enterprises.
cn: 德尔斐的女祭司是古希腊最著名的神谕传达者。
他被视为现代经济理论的权威智者。
甲骨文公司为全球企业提供数据库解决方案。

en: Cicero was renowned as the greatest orator of ancient Rome.
The politician’s skill as an orator won him widespread support.
She trained herself to become an effective orator in court.
cn: 西塞罗被誉为古罗马最伟大的演说家。
这位政治家作为演说家的技巧为他赢得了广泛支持。
她训练自己成为法庭上一位有力的辩手。

en: The satellite was launched into a geostationary orbital.
She studied the orbital patterns of electrons in atoms.
The orbital road around the city reduces traffic congestion.
cn: 卫星被发射到地球静止轨道。
她研究了原子中电子的轨道模式。
城市的环形公路缓解了交通拥堵。

definitions.definition: 精心安排；协调（复杂活动或事件）
为管弦乐队谱写或改编音乐

en: She orchestrated the entire campaign with military precision.
The composer orchestrated the piano piece for a full symphony.
He was accused of orchestrating the political scandal behind the scenes.
cn: 她以军事般的精准策划了整个活动。
作曲家将这首钢琴曲改编成交响乐版本。
他被指控在幕后策划了这起政治丑闻。

en: The orchid blooms in the greenhouse every spring.
She wore a dress in a delicate shade of orchid.
Orchids are highly prized for their exotic beauty.
cn: 每年春天，温室里的兰花都会盛开。
她穿了一条淡紫色的连衣裙。
兰花因其异域之美而备受珍视。

en: The bishop will ordain five new priests next Sunday.
The law ordains that all citizens must pay taxes.
Fate seemed to ordain their meeting again after decades.
cn: 主教将于下周日为五位新牧师授职。
法律规定所有公民必须纳税。
命运似乎注定他们在数十年后重逢。

en: "First" and "third" are ordinal numbers.
The ordinal sequence of the events is crucial to understanding the story.
In many languages, ordinal adjectives agree in gender and number with the noun they modify.
cn: “第一”和“第三”是序数词。
事件的先后顺序对于理解故事至关重要。
在许多语言中，序数形容词与其修饰的名词在性和数上保持一致。

definitions.definition: 法令，条例（由政府或权威机构颁布的正式规定）
传统习俗（尤指宗教仪式中的固定程序）

en: The city passed an ordinance prohibiting loud noises after 10 PM.
The royal ordinance established new trade regulations in 1602.
According to church ordinance, the ceremony must begin at dawn.
cn: 该市通过了一项法令，禁止晚上10点后的噪音。
1602年的皇家法令制定了新的贸易条例。
根据教会传统，仪式必须在黎明时分开始。

definitions.definition: 性高潮；极度兴奋的状态

en: The novel describes her orgasm in vivid poetic language.
Climbers often experience an orgasm of joy upon reaching the summit.
Some medications may delay orgasm in men.
cn: 这部小说用生动的诗性语言描述了她的性高潮。
登山者在登顶时常会体验到一种极致的喜悦。
某些药物可能会延迟男性的性高潮。

definitions.definition: （古代宗教仪式中的）狂欢祭礼

en: The nobles were accused of indulging in drunken orgies.
Ancient Greek orgies were often linked to fertility rites.
The party turned into a chaotic orgy of noise and dancing.
cn: 贵族们被指控沉溺于纵酒狂欢。
古希腊的狂欢祭礼常与生育仪式相关。
