派对演变成一场喧闹狂舞的混乱聚会。

definitions.definition: 适应；培训（对新环境或工作的引导）

en: The map helps with orientation in unfamiliar cities.
New employees undergo a week of orientation.
The orientation of the building maximizes sunlight.
cn: 地图有助于在陌生城市中确定方向。
新员工接受为期一周的入职培训。
建筑物的朝向设计最大化利用了阳光。

en: The cathedral's ornate ceiling was covered in gold leaf.
Her writing style is too ornate for a scientific report.
The antique clock had an ornate design with intricate carvings.
cn: 大教堂华丽的穹顶铺满了金箔。
她的写作风格对科学报告来说过于辞藻堆砌。
这座古董钟有着繁复的雕刻设计。

en: The church strictly adheres to the principles of orthodoxy.
His scientific theories challenged the orthodoxy of his time.
In some cultures, questioning orthodoxy is considered taboo.
cn: 该教会严格遵循正统教义原则。
他的科学理论挑战了当时的正统观念。
在某些文化中，质疑正统观念被视为禁忌。

definitions.definition: 摆动，振荡（物理或抽象意义上的周期性运动）

en: The pendulum's oscillation gradually slowed due to friction.
Her constant oscillation between job offers frustrated the recruiters.
Economic policies often face oscillations between growth and stability.
cn: 钟摆的摆动因摩擦力逐渐减缓。
她在多个工作机会间的犹豫不决让招聘方感到沮丧。
经济政策常在增长与稳定之间摇摆。

definitions.definition: 表面上，貌似（但实际可能并非如此）

en: He was ostensibly friendly, but his tone hinted at resentment.
cn: 他表面上很友好，但语气里透着不满。

definitions.definition: 炫耀的，夸耀的，卖弄的（指以夸张的方式吸引注意）

en: She arrived at the party in an ostentatious gown covered in sequins.
His ostentatious display of wealth made many of his guests uncomfortable.
The mansion's ostentatious decor was meant to impress visitors.
cn: 她穿着一件镶满亮片的华丽礼服来到了派对。
他炫耀财富的行为让许多客人感到不适。
这座豪宅浮夸的装饰是为了给访客留下深刻印象。

en: The rebels ousted the dictator from power.
New evidence may oust the current theory.
Shareholders voted to oust the CEO.
cn: 叛军将独裁者赶下台。
新证据可能推翻现有理论。
股东投票罢免了首席执行官。

en: After the scandal, he became an outcast in his community.
The novel tells the story of an outcast who finds redemption.
She felt like an outcast at the party, ignored by everyone.
cn: 丑闻后，他在社区里成了被排斥的人。
这部小说讲述了一个流浪者寻求救赎的故事。
她在派对上感到被遗弃，无人理睬。

definitions.definition: 大声喊叫（古义或文学用法）

en: The new policy sparked public outcry.
She gave an outcry of pain when she fell.
Social media amplified the outcry against injustice.
cn: 新政策引发了公众的强烈抗议。
她摔倒时发出了一声痛苦的喊叫。
社交媒体放大了对不公现象的抗议声浪。

en: She bought a new outfit for the job interview.
The team was outfitted with the latest technology.
His hiking outfit included a waterproof jacket and sturdy boots.
cn: 她为求职面试买了一套新衣服。
团队配备了最新技术设备。
他的徒步装备包括防水夹克和结实的靴子。

en: Her outgoing personality makes her popular at social events.
The outgoing president will hand over power next week.
The company recorded higher outgoings than income last quarter.
cn: 她外向的性格使她在社交活动中很受欢迎。
即将离任的总统将于下周移交权力。
该公司上一季度的支出高于收入（古义例句）。

definitions.definition: 因长大而不再需要（某物）

en: Children often outgrow their clothes within a year.
She outgrew her fear of public speaking after joining the debate team.
The startup outgrew its office space and moved to a larger building.
cn: 孩子们常在一年内就长得穿不下原来的衣服。
加入辩论队后，她逐渐克服了对公开演讲的恐惧。
这家初创公司规模扩大，原办公场所已容纳不下，于是搬到了更大的办公楼。

definitions.definition: 怪异的；异国风情的；不合常规的

en: His outlandish outfit turned heads at the party.
The story was filled with outlandish creatures from another world.
She dismissed his proposal as outlandish and impractical.
cn: 他那怪异的装扮在派对上引人注目。
这个故事充满了来自另一个世界的奇异生物。
她认为他的提议荒诞不切实际，不予理会。

en: The initial outlay for the project was higher than expected.
They had to outlay a significant sum to upgrade the equipment.
The outlay of time and effort paid off in the end.
cn: 该项目的初始支出比预期更高。
他们不得不花费一大笔钱来升级设备。
时间和精力的投入最终得到了回报。

en: The defenders were outnumbered three to one.
In some regions, immigrants outnumber native residents.
Positive reviews outnumber negative ones on the platform.
cn: 防守方以1:3的数量劣势被压倒。
某些地区的移民数量已超过本地居民。
该平台上的好评数量多于差评。

en: The soldiers established an outpost on the hill to monitor enemy movements.
This research station is the northernmost outpost of civilization.
The trading outpost grew into a bustling town over decades.
cn: 士兵们在山上设立前哨站以监视敌军动向。
这个研究站是人类文明最北端的边陲据点。
几十年间，这个贸易前哨站发展成了繁华的城镇。

en: The NGO's outreach program provides education to remote villages.
Her kindness outreaches cultural barriers.
The telescope's outreach exceeds 10 light-years.
cn: 该非政府组织的外展项目为偏远村庄提供教育。
她的善意超越了文化隔阂。
这台望远镜的观测范围超过10光年。

en: He won the match with an outright victory.
She rejected the proposal outright.
The government banned the substance outright.
cn: 他以绝对优势赢得比赛。
她当即拒绝了提议。
政府彻底禁止了该物质。

en: She is known for her outspoken criticism of social injustice.
The CEO’s outspoken remarks shocked the media.
Being outspoken can sometimes lead to misunderstandings.
cn: 她以对社会不公的直言批评而闻名。
这位CEO坦率的言论震惊了媒体。
直言不讳有时可能导致误解。

definitions.definition: （重要性、价值或影响）超过；比…更重要

en: The benefits of exercise far outweigh the risks.
Environmental concerns should outweigh economic interests.
Her happiness outweighed all other considerations.
cn: 锻炼的益处远大于风险。
环境问题应优先于经济利益。
她的幸福比其他任何考虑都重要。

definitions.definition: （古罗马）小凯旋式（低于正式凯旋的荣誉仪式）

en: The performer received a standing ovation for her breathtaking solo.
In ancient Rome, an ovation was granted for victories without bloodshed.
His speech ended with thunderous ovations from the audience.
cn: 这位表演者因惊艳的独奏获得了全场起立鼓掌。
在古罗马，不流血的胜利会被授予小凯旋式。
他的演讲以观众雷鸣般的掌声结束。

definitions.definition: 向舷外；从船上落（或抛）入水中

en: The sailor accidentally fell overboard during the storm.
She went overboard with the decorations, spending thousands on the party.
Throwing valuable supplies overboard saved the sinking ship.
cn: 水手在暴风雨中不慎落水。
她在装饰上过于铺张，为派对花费了数千元。
抛掉贵重物资使下沉的船只得以挽救。

en: She was overly cautious about the risks.
The teacher criticized him for being overly dependent on others.
His overly optimistic attitude ignored the challenges.
cn: 她对风险过于谨慎。
老师批评他过度依赖他人。
他过分乐观的态度忽视了挑战。

definitions.definition: （以更高权威）推翻，否决；覆盖（系统设置）

en: The court can override the governor's veto.
Press ALT+R to override the default settings.
The safety system has an automatic override.
cn: 法院可以推翻州长的否决。
按ALT+R键覆盖默认设置。
安全系统配有自动覆盖功能。

definitions.definition: 使黯然失色；遮蔽（光线或重要性）

en: The tall building overshadows the small park nearby.
Her achievements overshadowed those of her colleagues.
Dark clouds overshadowed the sunny morning.
cn: 高大的建筑遮蔽了附近的小公园。
她的成就让同事们相形见绌。
乌云笼罩了晴朗的早晨。

en: The committee provides oversight of government spending.
The error was caused by an oversight in the final check.
Technological tools enhance financial oversight.
cn: 委员会负责监督政府开支。
这一错误是由于最终检查时的疏忽造成的。
技术工具强化了财务监管能力。

en: Politicians often overstate their achievements to gain public support.
The advertisement overstated the product's effectiveness.
Don't overstate the risks; we need a balanced view.
cn: 政客常夸大成就以获取公众支持。
这则广告夸大了产品的功效。
别夸大风险，我们需要客观评估。

en: His overt criticism of the policy surprised everyone.
The company made an overt effort to improve working conditions.
She showed overt hostility towards the new rules.
cn: 他对政策的公开批评让所有人感到意外。
该公司公开努力改善工作条件。
她对新规定表现出明显的敌意。

definitions.definition: （正式行动或关系的）开端，提议

en: The opera began with a dramatic overture.
He made an overture of peace to the rival faction.
The symphony's overture subtly introduces all major themes.
cn: 歌剧以一段激昂的序曲开场。
他向敌对派系提出了和平倡议。
交响乐的序曲巧妙铺垫了所有主题。

en: The report provides an overview of recent climate trends.
She overviewed the project before the meeting.
The book's first chapter offers a historical overview.
cn: 这份报告概述了近期气候趋势。
她在会议前纵览了项目内容。
该书第一章提供了历史概览。

en: The ovum is released from the ovary during ovulation.
A sperm cell must fertilize the ovum for conception to occur.
The size of a human ovum is about 0.1 millimeters in diameter.
cn: 卵子在排卵期间从卵巢中释放出来。
精子细胞必须使卵子受精才能受孕。
人类卵子的直径大约为0.1毫米。

en: Iron will oxidize and form rust when exposed to moisture and air.
The goal of metabolism is to oxidize nutrients to produce energy for the body.
Special coatings are applied to the metal surfaces to prevent them from oxidizing.
cn: 铁暴露在潮湿空气时会氧化并形成铁锈。
新陈代谢的目的是氧化营养物质以产生身体所需的能量。
金属表面经过特殊涂层处理以防止其氧化。

en: The government sent troops to pacify the riot.
She tried to pacify her angry boss with a sincere apology.
Soft music can help pacify a restless baby.
cn: 政府派出军队平息骚乱。
她试图用真诚的道歉安抚愤怒的上司。
轻柔的音乐能帮助安抚躁动的婴儿。

definitions.definition: 稻田；稻谷（尤指未脱壳的稻米）
（非正式）爱尔兰人或爱尔兰裔的昵称

en: The farmers are planting rice in the paddy fields.
Paddy is a staple food in many Asian countries.
cn: 农民们正在稻田里插秧。
稻米是许多亚洲国家的主食。

en: He secured the gate with a heavy padlock.
Remember to padlock the storage unit before you leave.
The old padlock was rusty but still functional.
cn: 他用一把沉重的挂锁锁住了大门。
离开前记得用挂锁锁上储藏室的门。
那把旧挂锁虽然生锈了，但依然能用。

definitions.definition: 异教徒（非基督教、犹太教或伊斯兰教信徒）；非宗教人士

en: The missionaries tried to convert the local pagans to Christianity.
Some pagan rituals were incorporated into early Christian holidays.
He enjoys studying ancient pagan mythology.
cn: 传教士试图让当地异教徒改信基督教。
一些异教仪式被融入早期的基督教节日中。
他热衷于研究古代异教神话。

definitions.definition: 盛大的游行或表演（常含历史主题）

en: The historical pageant featured knights and royalty.
She won the title of Miss Universe in the pageant.
The town's annual pageant celebrates its founding.
cn: 这场历史盛典以骑士和王室成员为主题。
她在选美比赛中赢得环球小姐称号。
小镇的年度庆典纪念其建镇历史。

definitions.definition: 极其仔细的；一丝不苟的

en: She did a painstaking job of restoring the ancient manuscript.
The research required years of painstaking effort.
His painstaking attention to detail made the project flawless.
cn: 她一丝不苟地修复了这份古老的手稿。
这项研究需要多年殚精竭虑的努力。
他对细节的极致追求使项目完美无瑕。

en: He's been my pal since kindergarten.
Want to grab a coffee, pal?
The dog was his only pal during the lonely journey.
cn: 他是从幼儿园就认识的老友。
伙计，喝杯咖啡吗？
那条狗是他孤独旅途中唯一的伙伴。

en: The soup was barely palatable due to excessive salt.
The compromise made the deal more palatable to both parties.
Her criticism was phrased in a palatable manner.
cn: 汤因盐过多而难以下咽。
妥协使交易对双方都更易接受。
她的批评以委婉的方式表达。

en: The sound /ʃ/ in "ship" is a palatal consonant.
The palatal shelf is crucial in the development of the roof of the mouth.
Some languages have a series of palatalized or palatal consonants.
cn: “ship”中的 /ʃ/ 音是一个腭辅音。
腭架在口腔上颚的发育过程中至关重要。
一些语言有一系列腭化或腭辅音。

en: The spicy food burned his palate.
She has a refined palate for classical music.
The wine’s complexity delighted his palate.
cn: 辛辣食物灼伤了他的上颚。
她对古典音乐有高雅的鉴赏力。
这款酒的层次感愉悦了他的味蕾。

definitions.definition: 调色板（画家用于混合颜料的平板）
（某画家或时期的）独特用色风格

en: She carefully mixed the oils on her wooden palette.
Monet's palette evolved from dark tones to vibrant pastels.
The game's color palette creates a nostalgic 8-bit aesthetic.
cn: 她仔细地在木制调色板上混合油彩。
莫奈的用色风格从暗色调逐渐变为明亮的浅色系。
游戏的配色方案营造出怀旧的8比特风格。

definitions.definition: 可触摸的；明显的，易察觉的

en: The tension in the room was palpable after the argument.
A palpable sense of relief swept through the crowd.
The doctor noted a palpable mass during the examination.
cn: 争论过后，房间里的紧张气氛显而易见。
人群中弥漫着一种明显的解脱感。
医生在检查时发现了一个可触摸到的肿块。

definitions.definition: 溺爱，纵容（过度满足需求）
精心照料（尤指通过奢侈方式）

en: She pampers her dog with gourmet treats.
The spa offers treatments to pamper tired muscles.
Parents should avoid pampering children too much.
cn: 她用高级零食溺爱她的狗。
这家水疗中心提供舒缓疲劳肌肉的护理。
父母应避免过度纵容孩子。

definitions.definition: 万能药；解决一切问题的方案

en: The new policy was hailed as a panacea for economic woes.
Technology is not a panacea for all social problems.
Ancient alchemists sought a panacea to cure all diseases.
cn: 这项新政策被誉为解决经济困境的万能良方。
技术并非解决所有社会问题的灵丹妙药。
古代炼金术士曾寻找能治愈百病的万能药。

definitions.definition: 薄煎饼（一种由面粉、鸡蛋和牛奶制成的圆形扁平糕点，通常搭配糖浆或水果食用）

en: She flipped the pancake skillfully in the air.
Maple syrup is a classic topping for pancakes.
We made banana pancakes for breakfast.
cn: 她熟练地将薄煎饼抛向空中翻面。
枫糖浆是薄煎饼的经典配料。
我们早餐做了香蕉薄煎饼。

definitions.definition: 一阵剧痛（尤指生理或情感上的）
突然的强烈感受（如悔恨、渴望等）

en: She felt a sharp pang of guilt when she saw his disappointed face.
The pang of hunger made it hard to focus on the lecture.
A sudden pang of nostalgia hit him when he heard the old song.
cn: 当她看到他失望的表情时，一阵强烈的内疚感袭来。
饥饿的阵痛让人难以集中精力听讲。
听到那首老歌时，他突然感到一阵怀旧之情。

en: The hotel offers panoramic views of the ocean.
She took a panoramic photo of the city skyline.
The documentary provides a panoramic look at ancient civilizations.
cn: 酒店提供一览无余的海景。
她拍摄了一张城市天际线的全景照片。
这部纪录片全景式地展现了古代文明。

en: The dog panted heavily after running in the park.
She panted out the news, too excited to speak clearly.
His breath came in quick pants as he reached the mountaintop.
cn: 狗狗在公园奔跑后剧烈喘息。
她气喘吁吁地说出消息，激动得语无伦次。
到达山顶时，他的呼吸变得短促急促。

definitions.definition: 黑豹（尤指美洲豹或亚洲豹的黑色变种）
泛指大型猫科动物（如美洲狮等，非正式用法）

en: The panther moved silently through the jungle.
In some cultures, the panther symbolizes courage and protection.
The comic book hero Black Panther comes from the fictional nation of Wakanda.
cn: 黑豹悄无声息地穿过丛林。
在某些文化中，黑豹象征勇气与守护。
漫画英雄黑豹来自虚构的瓦坎达王国。

en: The actor communicated his despair through pantomime.
We took the children to see a Christmas pantomime.
She pantomimed lifting a heavy box to show she needed help.
cn: 这位演员通过哑剧动作来表达他的绝望。
我们带孩子们去看了一场圣诞童话剧。
她比划着抬起一个重箱子的动作，以表示她需要帮助。

definitions.definition: 同等；标准；平价（如高尔夫中的标准杆）

en: His performance was on par with the industry standards.
She finished the course three strokes under par.
The currency is trading at par with the dollar.
cn: 他的表现与行业标准相当。
她以低于标准杆三杆的成绩完成比赛。
该货币与美元汇率持平。

definitions.definition: 寓言（通过简短故事传达道德或宗教教训）

en: Jesus often taught in parables to convey spiritual truths.
The fable serves as a parable about the dangers of greed.
Her life story reads like a modern parable of resilience.
cn: 耶稣常用寓言传达属灵真理。
这个寓言是对贪婪危害的讽喻。
她的人生故事宛如一部关于韧性的现代寓言。

definitions.definition: 范式；典范（指某领域内被广泛接受的模式或标准）
词形变化表（语言学中指单词的屈折形式集合）

en: The Ptolemaic system was the dominant paradigm in astronomy for centuries.
Latin verbs are learned through their paradigms.
Her research challenges the current economic paradigm.
cn: 托勒密体系是天文学中数个世纪的主导范式。
拉丁语动词通过词形变化表学习。
她的研究挑战了现有的经济学范式。

definitions.definition: 自相矛盾的；似非而是的

en: His paradoxical statement left the audience both confused and intrigued.
It's paradoxical that standing still can sometimes be the fastest way to move forward.
The artist's work is a paradoxical blend of chaos and harmony.
cn: 他自相矛盾的陈述让听众既困惑又着迷。
静止不动有时反而是前进的最快方式，这看似矛盾却合理。
这位艺术家的作品是混乱与和谐的矛盾统一体。

definitions.definition: 石蜡，一种从石油或页岩中提取的白色或无色蜡状物质，用于制作蜡烛、密封剂、化妆品等。

en: The candles were made from high-quality paraffin wax.
In some regions, paraffin is still used as a fuel for heating and lighting.
The artist used a paraffin barrier to create a resist effect in the batik process.
cn: 这些蜡烛是由优质石蜡制成的。
在一些地区，煤油仍被用作取暖和照明的燃料。
这位艺术家在蜡染过程中使用了石蜡作为防染剂来创造效果。

definitions.definition: 瘫痪；麻痹（身体或功能丧失活动能力）

en: The stroke left him with partial paralysis of the right side.
The city's transportation system was in complete paralysis after the snowstorm.
Fear can induce a temporary paralysis of rational thought.
cn: 中风导致他右侧身体部分瘫痪。
暴风雪后，该市的交通系统完全瘫痪。
恐惧可能导致理性思维的短暂停滞。

en: The accident left him with paralytic weakness in his legs.
She specializes in caring for elderly paralytic patients.
The toxin causes paralytic symptoms within hours of exposure.
cn: 事故导致他的双腿瘫痪性无力。
她专门护理老年瘫痪患者。
这种毒素会在接触后几小时内引起麻痹症状。

en: The model requires three input parameters to function.
We need to work within the parameters of the budget.
Cultural norms set invisible parameters for behavior.
cn: 该模型需要三个输入参数才能运行。
我们必须在预算范围内工作。
文化规范为行为设定了无形的界限。

en: The paramilitary group was trained in guerrilla tactics.
She wore a paramilitary uniform during the exercise.
Critics accused the government of supporting paramilitary activities.
cn: 准军事组织接受过游击战术训练。
演习期间她穿着准军事制服。
批评者指责政府支持准军事活动。

en: Safety is of paramount importance in this experiment.
The paramount leader addressed the nation.
This issue remains a paramount concern for policymakers.
cn: 本次实验中，安全至关重要。
最高领导人向全国发表讲话。
这一问题仍是决策者的首要关切。

definitions.definition: 偏执狂；妄想症（精神疾病）
多疑，过度猜疑（非临床用法）

en: His paranoia made him distrust even his closest friends.
The film depicts a hacker’s descent into paranoia.
Clinical paranoia often requires professional intervention.
cn: 他的多疑使他连最亲密的朋友也不信任。
这部电影描绘了一名黑客逐渐陷入偏执的过程。
临床上的妄想症通常需要专业干预。

en: He became paranoid about being followed.
The film portrays a paranoid hacker obsessed with conspiracy theories.
Her paranoid delusions made it hard to maintain friendships.
cn: 他变得疑神疑鬼，总担心被人跟踪。
这部电影描绘了一个沉迷阴谋论的偏执黑客。
她的偏执妄想使维系友谊变得困难。

definitions.definition: 依赖他人生活的人，食客

en: The tapeworm is a parasite that lives in the intestines of its host.
He was seen as a parasite, living off his family’s wealth without working.
Some plants act as parasites, stealing nutrients from nearby roots.
cn: 绦虫是一种寄生在宿主肠道内的寄生虫。
他被视为寄生虫，不工作却靠家族财富生活。
某些植物是寄生植物，从邻近植物的根系窃取养分。

definitions.definition: 削去（水果、蔬菜等的皮）；修剪（指甲、边缘等）

en: She carefully pared the apple with a knife.
The company pared down its workforce to cut costs.
He pared his nails before the interview.
cn: 她用小刀仔细地削苹果皮。
公司裁员以缩减开支。
面试前他修剪了指甲。

definitions.definition: 出身；父母的身份；家系；门第

en: He was a man of humble parentage, but he achieved great success through his own efforts.
The novel explores the themes of identity and parentage.
Her noble parentage was evident in her manners and education.
cn: 他出身卑微，但通过自己的努力取得了巨大成功。
这部小说探讨了身份和出身主题。
她高贵的出身在她的举止和教育中显而易见。

definitions.definition: 插入的；作为附带说明的；括号内的

en: The author made a parenthetical remark about the weather.
This is just a parenthetical note in the larger report.
She added a few parenthetical clauses to clarify her argument.
cn: 作者插入了一句关于天气的评论。
这只是长篇报告中的一个附带说明。
她添加了几个插入性从句来澄清她的论点。

definitions.definition: 滑稽模仿（尤指文学或艺术作品的夸张仿作）

en: The film is a brilliant parody of classic horror movies.
She parodied the politician's speech with exaggerated gestures.
His latest novel reads like a parody of his own earlier work.
cn: 这部电影是对经典恐怖片的精彩恶搞。
她用夸张的动作模仿了那位政治家的演讲。
他的新小说读起来像是对自己早期作品的戏仿。

en: He was released on parole after serving five years.
The soldier forgot the daily parole and was detained.
The judge decided to parole the offender under strict supervision.
cn: 他在服刑五年后获得假释。
士兵忘记了当日口令而被拘留。
法官决定在严格监管下假释该罪犯。

definitions.definition: & vi. 挡开，避开（武器或攻击）

en: The fencer parried the thrust with ease.
She skillfully parried the interviewer's awkward question.
His reply was a neat parry to the criticism.
cn: 击剑手轻松地格开了这一刺。
她巧妙地回避了面试官那个尴尬的问题。
他的回答是对那项批评的巧妙挡开。

definitions.definition: 欧芹（一种香草，常用于烹饪调味）

en: Fresh parsley adds a bright flavor to salads.
She garnished the dish with chopped parsley.
Parsley is rich in vitamins A and C.
cn: 新鲜欧芹为沙拉增添清爽风味。
她用切碎的欧芹装饰了这道菜。
欧芹富含维生素A和C。

definitions.definition: 教区牧师，尤指英国国教的教区长

en: The parson gave a sermon on kindness every Sunday.
The old parsonage was the residence of the parson for over a century.
He was not just a preacher but a respected parson deeply involved in community affairs.
cn: 这位教区牧师每个星期日都会布道关于仁慈的主题。
那座古老的牧师住宅曾是一个多世纪以来教区牧师的住所。
他不仅仅是一名传教士，更是一位深入参与社区事务、受人尊敬的教区牧师。

definitions.definition: 分享，分担（尤指食物或感受）

en: She refused to partake in the heated debate.
Would you like to partake of this chocolate cake?
The ritual invites all to partake in its sacred energy.
cn: 她拒绝参与这场激烈的辩论。
你想尝尝这块巧克力蛋糕吗？
这一仪式邀请所有人感受其神圣能量。

en: The judge was accused of partiality towards the wealthy defendant.
Her partiality for chocolate made her dessert choice predictable.
Partiality in hiring practices can damage a company's reputation.
cn: 法官被指控偏袒富有的被告。
她对巧克力的偏爱让她的甜点选择毫无悬念。
招聘中的偏袒行为会损害公司声誉。

en: The politician’s partisan speech alienated independent voters.
She refused to take a partisan stance on the controversial issue.
During the war, partisans fought behind enemy lines.
cn: 这位政客的党派演说疏远了独立选民。
她拒绝在这一争议问题上采取偏袒立场。
战争期间，游击队员在敌后作战。

definitions.definition: 意大利面食（如通心粉、面条等）

en: She cooked pasta with homemade tomato sauce.
This restaurant serves fresh pasta daily.
Whole wheat pasta is a healthier choice.
cn: 她煮了意大利面配自制番茄酱。
这家餐厅每日供应新鲜意大利面。
全麦意大利面是更健康的选择。

en: She drew a landscape with soft pastels.
The room was painted in pastel shades of pink and blue.
His pastel sketches captured the light beautifully.
cn: 她用柔和的粉彩画了一幅风景。
房间涂成了粉蓝相间的柔和色调。
他的粉彩素描完美捕捉了光线。

definitions.definition: 牧人的；田园的；乡村生活的

en: The painting depicts a pastoral scene with sheep grazing under oak trees.
His poetry often reflects a nostalgic longing for pastoral simplicity.
The pastor delivered a sermon on the pastoral duties of care and guidance.
cn: 这幅画描绘了羊群在橡树下吃草的田园景象。
他的诗歌常流露出对田园纯朴生活的怀念。
牧师以牧养与引导的职责为主题布道。

definitions.definition: 分布不均的；零散的；不完整的
质量不一的；参差不齐的

en: The fog was patchy, making driving conditions dangerous in some areas.
His knowledge of the subject is rather patchy.
The review praised the lead actor but was patchy in its assessment of the supporting cast.
cn: 雾气分布不均，导致某些地区的驾驶条件变得危险。
他对这个学科的知识相当零散。
这篇评论称赞了主演，但对配角阵容的评价则好坏不一。

definitions.definition: 病理学（研究疾病的科学分支）

en: She specialized in pathology to understand the root causes of cancers.
The doctor noted a pathology of excessive aggression in the patient's behavior.
Ancient pathology relied on visible symptoms rather than microscopic analysis.
cn: 她专攻病理学以探究癌症的根源。
医生指出患者行为中存在过度攻击性的病态表现。
古代病理学依赖可见症状而非显微镜分析。

definitions.definition: 病理学的；与疾病相关的

en: The doctor noted the pathologic changes in the tissue sample.
Her fear of germs became pathologic, severely impacting her daily life.
A pathologic examination is crucial for an accurate diagnosis.
cn: 医生注意到了组织样本中的病理学变化。
她对细菌的恐惧变得病态，严重影响了她的日常生活。
病理学检查对于准确诊断至关重要。

definitions.definition: 露台；天井（房屋外侧铺砌的露天平台）

en: We had dinner on the patio under the stars.
The house features a spacious patio with a fountain.
She grows herbs in pots on the patio.
cn: 我们在星空下的露台上用餐。
这栋房子配有一个带喷泉的宽敞天井。
她在露台的盆栽里种植香草。

en: The patriarch of the family made all major decisions.
The Orthodox patriarch delivered a speech on unity.
In ancient tribes, the patriarch's word was law.
cn: 家族族长负责所有重大决定。
东正教主教发表了关于团结的演讲。
在古代部落中，族长的命令即为法律。

en: Many ancient societies were deeply patriarchal.
She criticized the patriarchal norms in traditional cultures.
The company’s leadership remains predominantly patriarchal.
cn: 许多古代社会是高度父权制的。
她批判了传统文化中的父权规范。
该公司的领导层仍以男性为主导。

en: The museum relies on the patronage of wealthy donors.
Political patronage often leads to corruption.
Your patronage of our store is greatly appreciated.
cn: 这家博物馆依赖富裕捐赠者的资助。
政治任命权常导致腐败。
我们非常感激您光顾本店。

definitions.definition: 以高人一等的态度对待；表现出屈尊俯就

en: She hated when he patronised her with unsolicited advice.
The café relies on locals who regularly patronise it.
Wealthy families often patronised artists during the Renaissance.
cn: 她讨厌他以高高在上的姿态给出不必要的建议。
这家咖啡馆依赖常来光顾的本地顾客。
文艺复兴时期，富有的家族常资助艺术家。

definitions.definition: 急促的轻拍声；行话；顺口溜
发出轻快的拍打声；喋喋不休

en: The rain began to patter against the window.
He delivered the sales pitch in a rapid patter.
Her feet pattered down the hallway.
cn: 雨水开始轻拍窗户。
他用一连串行话快速推销。
她的脚步声哒哒地穿过走廊。

definitions.definition: （国际象棋中的）兵，卒；抵押品；人质

en: He had to pawn his watch to pay the rent.
The pawn is the weakest piece in chess.
She felt like a pawn in their political game.
cn: 他不得不典当手表来付房租。
兵是国际象棋中最弱的棋子。
她感觉自己像他们政治游戏中的一枚棋子。

en: The lottery winner received a lump-sum payout of $5 million.
The insurance company delayed the payout due to incomplete documentation.
Investors expect quarterly payouts from the dividend fund.
cn: 彩票赢家一次性获得了500万美元的支付款项。
保险公司因文件不全延迟了赔付。
投资者期待从股息基金获得季度分红。

definitions.definition: 工资单（记录员工薪资的清单）
工资总额（企业支付的薪资总和）

en: The accountant updates the payroll every Friday.
Our company's payroll has increased by 20% this year.
Errors in the payroll caused delays in salary payments.
cn: 会计每周五更新工资单。
今年我公司的工资总额增长了20%。
工资单错误导致薪资发放延迟。

definitions.definition: 泥炭（部分碳化的植物物质，用作燃料或土壤改良剂）

en: The villagers used dried peat as fuel for heating.
Peat bogs are important carbon sinks.
This soil mix contains peat to retain moisture.
cn: 村民用干燥的泥炭作为取暖燃料。
泥炭沼泽是重要的碳汇。
这种土壤混合物含有泥炭以保持水分。

en: Her pedagogic approach emphasizes student-centered learning.
The conference focused on innovative pedagogic strategies for online education.
His writings are not only theoretical but also rich in pedagogic insights.
cn: 她的教学法强调以学生为中心的学习。
这次会议聚焦于在线教育的创新教学策略。
他的著作不仅具有理论性，还富含教学法方面的深刻见解。

definitions.definition: 迂腐的，学究式的，过分拘泥于细节或形式规则的

en: His pedantic attention to minor errors made the editing process tedious.
She dismissed his argument as pedantic quibbling over semantics.
The professor's pedantic lecture style failed to engage the students.
cn: 他对小错误的迂腐关注使编辑过程变得乏味。
她认为他的论点是对语义的迂腐狡辩，不予理会。
这位教授学究式的讲课风格未能吸引学生。

definitions.definition: 基座；底座（用于支撑雕像、柱子等物体的基础结构）
（比喻）崇高地位；受人尊敬的位置

en: The statue of liberty stands on a massive granite pedestal.
She put her mentor on a pedestal, ignoring his flaws.
The vase fell off its pedestal and shattered.
cn: 自由女神像矗立在一座巨大的花岗岩基座上。
她将导师奉若神明，无视他的缺点。
花瓶从底座上掉落，摔得粉碎。

definitions.definition: 血统；家谱（尤指动物或名门世系的记录）

en: The dog's pedigree traces back to a champion bloodline.
Her academic pedigree includes degrees from Harvard and Oxford.
The manuscript has a dubious pedigree, with no clear author.
cn: 这只狗的血统可追溯至冠军犬系。
她的学术背景包括哈佛和牛津的学位。
这份手稿来源可疑，作者不明。

en: She peeked through the curtains to see who was outside.
Take a peek at the birthday cake before the party starts.
The sun peeked out from behind the clouds.
cn: 她透过窗帘偷看外面是谁。
在派对开始前偷偷看一眼生日蛋糕。
太阳从云层后微微露脸。

definitions.definition: 鹈鹕，一种大型水鸟，以其巨大的喉囊著称

en: A pelican uses its large bill and expandable throat pouch to catch fish.
We watched a flock of pelicans gliding gracefully over the waves.
The brown pelican is a common sight along the coastlines of the Americas.
cn: 鹈鹕用它的大嘴和可扩张的喉囊来捕捉鱼类。
我们看着一群鹈鹕优雅地滑过海浪。
褐鹈鹕是美洲海岸线上一道常见的风景。

definitions.definition: （体育比赛中）判罚；使处于不利地位

en: The referee will penalize any player who violates the rules.
Heavy taxes penalize small businesses disproportionately.
The new policy penalizes late submissions by reducing grades.
cn: 裁判将处罚任何违反规则的球员。
重税对小企业造成了不成比例的惩罚。
新政策通过扣分来处罚迟交作业的行为。

en: She wore a silver pendant shaped like a crescent moon.
The chandelier is a beautiful crystal pendant from the ceiling.
The pendant leaves of the willow tree swayed in the breeze.
cn: 她戴着一枚新月形的银质吊坠。
这盏枝形吊灯是从天花板垂下的精美水晶悬饰。
柳树下垂的枝条在微风中摇曳。

en: The decision is still pending.
Pending further investigation, the project is on hold.
She received a promotion pending approval from HR.
cn: 决定仍未作出。
在进一步调查期间，项目暂停。
她获得了晋升，但需待人力资源部批准。

en: The penis is a male reproductive organ.
Some animals have a baculum in their penis.
The study focused on the developmental biology of the penis.
cn: 阴茎是男性生殖器官。
某些动物的阴茎内有阴茎骨。
该研究聚焦于阴茎的发育生物学。

definitions.definition: 领取养老金者，退休人员
（英国）剑桥大学自费生；（史）皇家侍从

en: My grandfather is a pensioner who receives his state pension every month.
The supermarket offers discounts to pensioners on weekdays.
In the 16th century, a pensioner was an attendant at the English royal court.
cn: 我的祖父是一名养老金领取者，每月领取国家发放的养老金。
这家超市在工作日为退休人员提供折扣。
在16世纪，pensioner 指的是英国皇家宫廷的一名侍从。

definitions.definition: 现代五项全能运动（包括击剑、游泳、马术、射击和跑步）
古代五项全能运动（包括铁饼、标枪、跳远、赛跑和摔跤）

en: She trained for years to compete in the modern pentathlon at the Olympics.
cn: 她为参加奥运现代五项比赛训练了多年。

en: The billionaire owns a penthouse with a panoramic view of the city.
The old theater had a small penthouse for storing props.
Penthouses are often symbols of status in urban areas.
cn: 这位亿万富翁拥有一套能俯瞰城市全景的顶层公寓。
老剧院的顶部有一个存放道具的小阁楼。
顶层公寓常被视为都市地位的象征。

definitions.definition: 胡椒薄荷（一种薄荷属植物，常用于调味或药用）
薄荷味（尤指糖果、口香糖等的味道）

en: The tea is infused with fresh peppermint leaves.
She prefers peppermint-flavored toothpaste.
The candy left a cool peppermint aftertaste.
cn: 这款茶用新鲜胡椒薄荷叶冲泡。
她更喜欢薄荷味的牙膏。
糖果留下了清凉的薄荷余味。

en: The sound was barely perceptible over the noise of the wind.
There has been a perceptible change in her attitude recently.
The drug’s effects are perceptible within 30 minutes.
cn: 风声几乎掩盖了那微弱可闻的声响。
最近她的态度发生了明显可察的变化。
药效在30分钟内即可感知。

definitions.definition: 感知，觉察（通过感官获得信息的过程）
理解，看法（对事物的个人解读或观点）

en: Her perception of colors changed after the accident.
Cultural background influences our perception of beauty.
The study examines infants' perception of facial expressions.
cn: 事故后，她对颜色的感知发生了变化。
文化背景影响我们对美的理解。
该研究探讨婴儿对面部表情的觉察能力。

definitions.definition: 感知的（与感官或认知相关）

en: She gave a perceptive analysis of the novel’s themes.
His perceptive eyes noticed the subtle change in her expression.
The documentary offers a perceptive look into urban life.
cn: 她对小说的主题进行了敏锐的分析。
他敏锐的双眼察觉到了她表情的微妙变化。
这部纪录片对城市生活提出了富有洞察力的观察。

en: The percussion section of the orchestra includes drums and cymbals.
Doctors use percussion to examine the condition of lungs.
The percussion of raindrops on the roof kept me awake.
cn: 管弦乐队的打击乐部分包括鼓和钹。
医生通过叩诊检查肺部状况。
雨点敲打屋顶的声音让我无法入睡。

definitions.definition: 敷衍的，马虎的（指做事缺乏热情或认真）

en: He gave a perfunctory nod and continued scrolling on his phone.
The waiter’s perfunctory service ruined the dining experience.
Her apology sounded perfunctory, lacking genuine remorse.
cn: 他敷衍地点了点头，继续刷手机。
服务员马虎的服务毁了用餐体验。
她的道歉听起来很敷衍，毫无诚意。

en: The mountain path was narrow and perilous.
Their perilous journey across the desert lasted three weeks.
Investing all your money in one stock is a perilous decision.
cn: 这条山路狭窄而危险。
他们穿越沙漠的冒险之旅持续了三周。
将所有资金投入一支股票是冒险的决定。

en: The perimeter of the rectangle is 30 meters.
Guards patrolled the prison perimeter.
The virus affected areas within a 5-kilometer perimeter.
cn: 这个长方形的周长是30米。
警卫在监狱外围巡逻。
病毒影响了方圆5公里范围内的区域。

en: The professor discussed the periodic motion of planets in the solar system.
Sodium is a reactive metal in the periodic table.
She receives periodic updates from her research team.
cn: 教授讨论了太阳系中行星的周期性运动。
钠是周期表中一种活泼的金属元素。
她定期收到研究团队的进度更新。

en: The factory is located in the peripheral area of the city.
She focused on the core issues, ignoring peripheral details.
The printer is a common peripheral device for computers.
cn: 工厂位于城市的外围区域。
她专注于核心问题，忽略了次要细节。
打印机是常见的外围计算机设备。

en: The factory was built on the periphery of the city.
These issues are peripheral to the main discussion.
The artist focused on details at the periphery of the painting.
cn: 工厂建在城市边缘。
这些问题属于主要讨论的边缘内容。
艺术家着重处理了画作外围的细节。

definitions.definition: 使消亡；使腐烂（罕见用法）

en: Without water, plants will perish quickly.
Ancient civilizations perished due to climate change.
The old documents perished in the fire.
cn: 没有水，植物会迅速枯死。
古代文明因气候变化而消亡。
那些古老文件在大火中焚毁。

definitions.definition: 伪证（法律术语，指在法庭上故意作虚假陈述）

en: The witness was charged with perjury after lying under oath.
Committing perjury can result in severe legal consequences.
His testimony was dismissed due to evidence of perjury.
cn: 证人在宣誓后作伪证，被提起指控。
作伪证可能导致严重的法律后果。
他的证词因伪证证据而被驳回。

definitions.definition: 振作；竖起（尤指耳朵或头部）

en: She perks up whenever coffee is mentioned.
Free gym membership is a popular job perk.
The dog’s ears perked at the sound of the doorbell.
cn: 一提到咖啡，她就精神起来。
免费健身房会员是常见的工作福利。
狗的耳朵随着门铃声竖了起来。

en: The smell of fresh bread permeated the entire bakery.
Sunlight permeates through the curtains in the morning.
His ideas gradually permeated into mainstream culture.
cn: 新鲜面包的香气弥漫了整个面包店。
晨光透过窗帘渗入房间。
他的思想逐渐渗透到主流文化中。

en: It is not permissible to smoke in this area.
The error margin was within permissible limits.
Are these chemicals permissible for use in food production?
cn: 此区域禁止吸烟。
误差范围在允许限度内。
这些化学品允许用于食品生产吗？

en: The chemical has a pernicious effect on marine life.
Social media can spread pernicious rumors rapidly.
His pernicious influence corrupted the entire organization.
cn: 这种化学物质对海洋生物有致命影响。
社交媒体会迅速传播有害谣言。
他的毒害性影响腐蚀了整个组织。

en: The gang perpetrated a series of robberies in the city.
He was shocked to discover his colleague had perpetrated fraud.
The law aims to punish those who perpetrate violence.
cn: 该团伙在城里犯下了一系列抢劫案。
他震惊地发现同事实施了欺诈。
该法律旨在惩罚实施暴力者。

en: The police are still searching for the perpetrator of the robbery.
The documentary exposed the perpetrator’s motives in detail.
Society must address the root causes that create perpetrators of violence.
cn: 警方仍在搜寻抢劫案的罪犯。
这部纪录片详细揭露了作案者的动机。
社会必须解决催生暴力犯罪者的根源问题。

en: The museum works to perpetuate the legacy of ancient artists.
Social media can perpetuate misinformation rapidly.
Rituals help perpetuate cultural identity across generations.
cn: 博物馆致力于使古代艺术家的精神永存。
社交媒体会加速错误信息的长期传播。
仪式有助于代代延续文化认同。

en: Numerous personages from the political world attended the state funeral.
The novel is famed for its vivid and complex personages.
He was a personage of considerable influence in the cultural circles of his time.
cn: 许多政界要人出席了国葬。
这部小说以其生动而复杂的人物角色闻名。
他是他那个时代文化圈里相当有影响力的人物。

definitions.definition: 拟人化；将抽象概念赋予人格或人性特征

en: The poet personified death as a shadowy figure.
She personifies elegance in every gesture.
Ancient myths often personify natural forces like wind and thunder.
cn: 诗人将死亡拟人化为一个黑影。
她的一举一动都是优雅的化身。
古代神话常将风、雷等自然力量拟人化。

en: These documents pertain to the legal case.
The rules pertain to all employees equally.
His remarks did not pertain to the main topic.
cn: 这些文件与法律案件相关。
这些规则平等适用于所有员工。
他的发言与主题无关。

en: His remarks were pertinent to the discussion.
The lawyer asked only pertinent questions.
Include pertinent details in your report.
cn: 他的发言与讨论内容密切相关。
律师只提了切中要害的问题。
报告中需包含相关细节。

definitions.definition: 扰乱，使混乱（尤指物理系统）

en: The unexpected news did not seem to perturb her in the slightest.
cn: 这个意外的消息似乎一点也没有让她感到不安。

definitions.definition: 弥漫，渗透（指气味、思想等遍布整个空间或群体）

en: The scent of lavender pervaded the room.
A sense of optimism pervades her latest novel.
Corruption had pervaded all levels of the government.
cn: 薰衣草的香气弥漫了整个房间。
她的最新小说中洋溢着乐观情绪。
腐败已渗透至政府的各个层级。

definitions.definition: 使反常；滥用；误导；使堕落

en: He was accused of trying to pervert the course of justice.
cn: 他被指控企图妨碍司法公正。

en: Stop pestering me with questions!
The kids kept pestering their parents for ice cream.
Telemarketers pestered him daily.
cn: 别再用问题烦我了！
孩子们缠着父母要冰淇淋。
电话推销员每天骚扰他。

en: Farmers use pesticides to protect crops from insects.
Excessive pesticide use can harm the environment.
This pesticide is designed to target specific pests.
cn: 农民使用杀虫剂保护作物免受虫害。
过度使用农药会危害环境。
这种杀虫剂专门针对特定害虫。

en: The ghostly figure was merely a phantom of her imagination.
The radar detected a phantom aircraft that disappeared moments later.
His promises turned out to be phantom hopes.
cn: 那个幽灵般的身影只是她想象中的幻影。
雷达探测到一架幽灵飞机，片刻后便消失了。
他的承诺最终化为虚幻的希望。

en: The pharmaceutical industry is highly regulated.
She works in pharmaceutical research.
These pharmaceuticals must be stored at low temperatures.
cn: 制药行业受到严格监管。
她从事药物研究工作。
这些药品必须低温保存。

definitions.definition: 雉鸡，野鸡（一种长尾猎鸟，原产亚洲，现广泛引入其他地区）

en: The pheasant fluttered its iridescent feathers and disappeared into the undergrowth.
Roasted pheasant was considered a delicacy in medieval banquets.
Conservationists are working to protect the native habitat of the ring-necked pheasant.
cn: 雉鸡抖动着彩虹般的羽毛，消失在灌木丛中。
烤野鸡在中世纪宴会上被视为珍馐。
环保人士正致力于保护环颈雉的原生栖息地。

definitions.definition: 非凡的，惊人的（指事物或现象超出寻常）
现象的，与现象相关的（哲学或科学语境）

en: The athlete's performance was truly phenomenal.
Quantum physics deals with phenomenal reality beyond human intuition.
Her memory for details is phenomenal, almost like a superpower.
cn: 这位运动员的表现堪称非凡。
量子物理学研究超越人类直觉的现象实在。
她对细节的记忆力惊人，近乎超能力。

en: His philanthropic efforts funded schools in underprivileged areas.
The billionaire pledged half his wealth to philanthropic causes.
She received an award for her philanthropic work in healthcare.
cn: 他的慈善事业为贫困地区资助了多所学校。
这位亿万富翁承诺将半数财富投入慈善事业。
她因在医疗领域的慈善工作而获奖。

definitions.definition: 音系学，对语言或语言系统中语音模式和功能的研究
某个特定语言的语音系统

en: English phonology examines the sound system of the English language.
She is writing her thesis on the phonology of an endangered dialect.
Understanding phonology is essential for mastering the pronunciation of a new language.
cn: 英语音系学研究英语语言的语音系统。
她正在撰写一篇关于一种濒危方言音系学的论文。
理解音系学对于掌握一门新语言的发音至关重要。

en: The phosphorous glow of the algae illuminated the path along the shore.
Farmers need to apply phosphorous fertilizer to promote root growth in crops.
The scientist studied the phosphorous compounds present in the soil sample.
cn: 藻类的磷光照亮了沿岸的小路。
农民需要施用磷肥以促进作物的根系生长。
这位科学家研究了土壤样本中存在的含磷化合物。

en: White phosphorus glows in the dark.
The ancient Greeks called Venus "Phosphorus" when it appeared at dawn.
Phosphorus is essential for plant growth.
cn: 白磷在黑暗中会发光。
古希腊人在黎明看到金星时称其为“Phosphorus”。
磷是植物生长必需的元素。

definitions.definition: 物理疗法，一种通过按摩、锻炼、热疗等物理手段而非药物或手术来治疗疾病、损伤或残疾的医疗专业。

en: After her knee surgery, she underwent physiotherapy to regain full range of motion.
Physiotherapy can be highly effective in managing chronic back pain.
The physiotherapy clinic offers specialized treatments for athletes.
cn: 在她的膝盖手术后，她接受了物理治疗以恢复完整的活动范围。
物理疗法对于治疗慢性背痛可能非常有效。
这家物理治疗诊所为运动员提供专业治疗。

definitions.definition: 体格；体形（尤指肌肉发达程度或整体身体结构）

en: His athletic physique impressed the scouts.
Yoga helps to maintain a balanced physique.
The actor transformed his physique for the role.
cn: 他运动员般的体格给球探留下了深刻印象。
瑜伽有助于保持匀称的体形。
这位演员为角色彻底改变了体型。

definitions.definition: 用尖桩围住；派纠察队包围

en: The soldiers surrounded the camp with wooden pickets.
Protesters formed a picket line outside the factory.
She was assigned to picket duty at the entrance.
cn: 士兵们用木桩围住了营地。
抗议者在工厂外组成纠察线。
她被派往入口处担任警戒哨。

en: She made spicy pickles with cucumbers from her garden.
The fish needs to pickle overnight in vinegar and herbs.
He got himself into a real pickle by forgetting the passport.
cn: 她用自家种的黄瓜做了辣腌菜。
鱼需要在醋和香草中腌制过夜。
他忘了带护照，让自己陷入了大麻烦。

definitions.definition: 皮钦语，混杂语；一种由不同语言群体为便于沟通而发展出的简化混合语言，语法和词汇均有限。

en: They used a pidgin to communicate with the local tribes.
cn: 他们使用一种混杂语与当地部落交流。

en: The ship docked at the pier to unload its cargo.
Waves crashed against the concrete pier during the storm.
The bridge's central pier was reinforced to withstand earthquakes.
cn: 船只停靠在码头卸货。
暴风雨中，海浪猛烈拍打着混凝土突堤。
桥梁的中央桥墩经过加固以抵御地震。

definitions.definition: 虔诚（对宗教或道德的深刻敬意与忠诚）
孝道（对父母或传统的尊敬与服从）

en: Her piety was evident in her daily prayers and acts of charity.
Filial piety is a cornerstone of many Asian cultures.
The monk's life was marked by humility and deep piety.
cn: 她的虔诚体现在每日的祷告和慈善行为中。
孝道是许多亚洲文化的基石。
这位僧侣的一生以谦卑和深厚的虔诚为标志。

definitions.definition: 肮脏杂乱的住所（或房间）

en: The farmer went to clean the pigsty early in the morning.
Your room is a complete pigsty; you need to tidy it up immediately.
The novel describes the slums as a pigsty of poverty and despair.
cn: 农夫一大清早就去打扫猪圈了。
你的房间简直是个猪窝，你得马上收拾一下。
这部小说将贫民窟描绘成一个充满贫困与绝望的肮脏之地。

en: The soldier carried a pike into battle.
We caught a large pike in the lake.
The hikers reached the summit of Pike's Peak.
cn: 士兵手持长矛投入战斗。
我们在湖里钓到一条大梭鱼。
徒步者登上了派克峰的顶峰。

en: She pinched her brother’s arm playfully.
Add a pinch of salt to the soup.
He got pinched for shoplifting.
cn: 她开玩笑地捏了弟弟的手臂。
往汤里加一小撮盐。
他因入店行窃被抓。

en: The scientist pinpointed the exact gene responsible for the mutation.
A pinpoint of light appeared in the dark tunnel.
The report provides pinpoint analysis of market trends.
cn: 科学家精确定位了导致突变的特定基因。
黑暗的隧道中出现了一个针尖大小的光点。
这份报告对市场趋势进行了极其精准的分析。

definitions.definition: 海盗行为；非法复制或盗版

en: The navy was deployed to combat piracy in the Gulf of Aden.
Software piracy remains a major issue for tech companies.
His book was a victim of literary piracy, appearing online without permission.
cn: 海军被派往亚丁湾打击海盗行为。
软件盗版仍是科技公司面临的主要问题。
他的书遭遇了文学盗版，未经许可就被发布在网上。

en: He went behind the tree to piss.
The drunk man pissed on the sidewalk.
"I don't give a piss!" he shouted angrily.
cn: 他走到树后小便。
醉汉在人行道上撒尿。
“我他妈才不在乎！”他愤怒地喊道。

definitions.definition: 活塞（机械装置中在汽缸内往复运动的部件）

en: The engine's piston moves up and down to convert fuel into motion.
A damaged piston can cause severe engine failure.
The mechanic replaced the worn-out piston rings.
cn: 发动机的活塞上下运动，将燃料转化为动力。
损坏的活塞可能导致发动机严重故障。
机械师更换了磨损的活塞环。

en: The pitcher threw a perfect game.
She poured lemonade from the glass pitcher.
Ancient pitchers were often made of clay.
cn: 投手完成了一场完美比赛。
她从玻璃水壶中倒出柠檬水。
古代水壶多由黏土制成。

definitions.definition: 陷阱；隐藏的危险或困难

en: The report highlights the potential pitfalls of investing in unstable markets.
Lack of communication is a common pitfall in team projects.
The trail looks easy, but hidden pitfalls await inexperienced hikers.
cn: 报告强调了投资不稳定市场的潜在风险。
缺乏沟通是团队项目中常见的隐患。
这条小径看似简单，但暗藏对经验不足徒步者的危险。

definitions.definition: 以枢轴为中心旋转；调整策略

en: The door swings smoothly on its pivot.
She pivoted to face the new challenge.
The company pivoted its focus to renewable energy.
cn: 门在枢轴上平稳转动。
她转身应对新的挑战。
公司将重心转向可再生能源。

definitions.definition: 枢轴的，可旋转的（机械术语）

en: The invention of the printing press was pivotal in spreading knowledge.
The dancer balanced on one foot, using her toe as a pivotal point.
His testimony proved pivotal to the jury's decision.
cn: 印刷术的发明对知识传播至关重要。
舞者单脚站立，以脚尖为支点保持平衡。
他的证词对陪审团的裁决起了关键作用。

definitions.definition: 格子花纹（尤指苏格兰传统织物）
格子呢（制成的衣物或围巾）

en: She wore a red plaid skirt for the school concert.
The traditional Scottish kilt is made of tartan plaid.
His shirt had a subtle blue and gray plaid pattern.
cn: 她在学校音乐会上穿了一条红色格子裙。
传统苏格兰短裙由格子呢制成。
他的衬衫带有低调的蓝灰格子花纹。

definitions.definition: 原告（法律术语，指向法院提起诉讼的一方）

en: The plaintiff submitted new evidence to the court.
The jury ruled in favor of the plaintiff.
The plaintiff's lawyer emphasized the defendant's negligence.
cn: 原告向法庭提交了新证据。
陪审团作出了有利于原告的裁决。
原告律师强调了被告的过失行为。

en: The telescope is designed to study planetary atmospheres.
His ideas had a planetary impact on the scientific community.
The rover collected data on planetary geology.
cn: 这台望远镜用于研究行星大气层。
他的观点对科学界产生了巨大影响。
探测车收集了行星地质学的数据。

definitions.definition: 在…上铺木板；<非正式>用力放下

en: The bridge was made of sturdy planks.
The party’s main plank is education reform.
He planked the box onto the table with a thud.
cn: 这座桥由结实的木板搭建而成。
该政党的核心纲领是教育改革。
他砰的一声把箱子重重放在桌上。

definitions.definition: 匾牌；铭牌（刻有文字或图案的金属或石板）
牙菌斑（牙齿表面的细菌沉积物）
（医学）斑块（如动脉粥样硬化斑块）

en: A bronze plaque marks the site of the historic battle.
Brushing your teeth regularly helps prevent plaque buildup.
The doctor found arterial plaques during the examination.
cn: 一块铜匾标明了这场历史性战役的发生地。
定期刷牙有助于防止牙菌斑堆积。
医生在检查中发现了动脉斑块。

definitions.definition: 等离子体（物理学中电离气体的第四态）
血浆（血液中的液态成分）

en: The sun's core consists of extremely hot plasma.
Donated plasma is crucial for treating trauma patients.
Scientists use plasma cutting technology for precision metalwork.
cn: 太阳核心由极高温的等离子体组成。
捐赠的血浆对治疗创伤患者至关重要。
科学家利用等离子切割技术进行精密金属加工。

en: The workers plastered the walls smoothly.
She applied a plaster to the small cut.
His hair was plastered to his forehead by the rain.
cn: 工人将墙面抹得平整光滑。
她给伤口贴了一张创可贴。
雨水把他的头发紧贴在额头上。

en: The platoon advanced through the dense forest under heavy fire.
A platoon of volunteers cleaned up the beach after the storm.
His leadership transformed the disorganized group into a disciplined platoon.
cn: 这支排冒着猛烈炮火穿越茂密森林。
一队志愿者在风暴后清理了海滩。
他的领导将散乱的队伍转变为纪律严明的排。

en: The team advanced to the playoffs after a thrilling victory.
The tennis tournament will have a playoff to break the tie.
His goal in the playoff secured the championship.
cn: 球队在激动人心的胜利后晋级季后赛。
网球锦标赛将通过加赛打破平局。
他在加赛中的进球锁定了冠军。

en: He made a desperate plea for help.
The defendant entered a plea of not guilty.
Her tearful plea touched everyone's heart.
cn: 他绝望地恳求帮助。
被告提出无罪抗辩。
她含泪的请求打动了每个人的心。

en: She pleaded with him to stay.
The lawyer will plead the case in court tomorrow.
He pleaded ignorance when asked about the missing files.
cn: 她恳求他留下来。
律师将于明日出庭为此案辩护。
被问及丢失的文件时，他以不知情为由辩解。

en: The skirt has a deep pleat at the back for ease of movement.
She learned how to pleat the fabric to create a tailored look.
The uniform's sharp pleats were a mark of discipline.
cn: 这条裙子后部有一个深褶，便于活动。
她学会了如何给布料打褶以打造一种剪裁得体的外观。
制服上笔挺的褶痕是纪律的标志。

en: He was appointed as plenipotentiary to negotiate the peace treaty.
The ambassador carried plenipotentiary powers to sign the agreement on behalf of her government.
Only a plenipotentiary representative can make binding commitments for the state.
cn: 他被任命为全权代表去谈判和平条约。
这位大使拥有全权，代表她的政府签署协议。
只有全权代表才能为国家做出具有约束力的承诺。

en: The refugees' plight moved the international community.
In medieval times, knights would plight their loyalty to the king.
Climate change has worsened the plight of polar bears.
cn: 难民的困境触动了国际社会。
中世纪时，骑士会向国王宣誓效忠。
气候变化加剧了北极熊的生存危机。

definitions.definition: 用铅锤测量；探究，彻底查明

en: The wall was checked with a plumb to ensure it was straight.
Scientists are plumbing the depths of the ocean to study marine life.
Her analysis was plumb accurate.
cn: 用铅锤检查墙面是否垂直。
科学家正在深入探究海洋以研究生物。
她的分析完全准确。

en: Stock prices plummeted after the economic report.
The climber used a plummet to check the cliff's verticality.
The bird folded its wings and plummeted toward the water.
cn: 经济报告发布后股价暴跌。
攀登者用铅锤测量悬崖的垂直度。
鸟儿收起翅膀，笔直坠向水面。

definitions.definition: 活塞；柱塞；潜水者；（非正式）盲目投机者

en: The plumber used a plunger to unclog the toilet.
As a fearless plunger, he often dove into the ocean from great heights.
The plunger in the syringe must be pushed down slowly to administer the vaccine.
cn: 水管工用搋子疏通了马桶。
作为一名无畏的潜水者，他经常从很高的地方跳入海洋。
注射器中的活塞必须缓慢推下以注射疫苗。

en: The sofa was covered in soft red plush.
She enjoyed the plush comforts of the five-star hotel.
The toy rabbit had shiny plush fur.
cn: 沙发铺着柔软的红丝绒。
她享受着五星级酒店的奢华舒适。
玩具兔子的毛绒闪闪发亮。

definitions.definition: 钚（一种放射性化学元素，符号 Pu，原子序数94）

en: Plutonium is used as fuel in some nuclear reactors.
The half-life of plutonium-239 is 24,100 years.
Handling plutonium requires extreme precautions due to its radioactivity.
cn: 钚被用作某些核反应堆的燃料。
由于钚的放射性，操作时需要极度谨慎。

definitions.definition: 侵入他人地盘（如偷猎或挖人才）

en: He was arrested for poaching deer in the protected forest.
She prefers to poach eggs rather than fry them.
Tech companies often poach talent from competitors.
cn: 他因在保护区内偷猎鹿而被捕。
她更喜欢水煮蛋而非煎蛋。
科技公司常从竞争对手那里挖人才。

definitions.definition: 麻点；痘痕；（物体表面的）凹坑，凹痕
使布满麻点；使留下凹痕

en: His face was badly pockmarked after surviving the illness.
The ancient wall was pockmarked with bullet holes from past battles.
The moon's surface is pockmarked with craters from meteorite impacts.
cn: 他病愈后脸上留下了严重的麻子。
这面古老的墙壁上布满了过往战斗留下的弹孔。
月球表面布满了陨石撞击形成的坑洞。

definitions.definition: 令人痛苦的；尖锐的（情感或感官上）
深刻的；切中要害的（比喻意义）

en: The poignant aroma of the spices made her eyes water.
His speech ended with a poignant reminder of wartime sacrifices.
The photograph captured a poignant moment of farewell.
cn: 辛辣的香料气味呛得她流泪。
他的演讲以对战争牺牲的深刻提醒作结。
这张照片定格了离别的揪心瞬间。

definitions.definition: 极性（物理或化学中的正负两极对立）
（观点、性格等的）对立，截然相反

en: The polarity of a magnet determines its attraction or repulsion.
There is a growing polarity between the two political parties.
Water molecules have inherent polarity due to their uneven charge distribution.
cn: 磁铁的极性决定其吸引或排斥。
两党间的对立日益加剧。
水分子因电荷分布不均而具有固有极性。

en: His essay was a fierce polemic against government policies.
She avoided polemic discussions to maintain a neutral stance.
The book combines scholarly analysis with lively polemic.
cn: 他的文章是对政府政策的猛烈抨击。
她避免争论性讨论以保持中立立场。
这本书将学术分析与生动的论辩相结合。

definitions.definition: 脊髓灰质炎（俗称小儿麻痹症）

en: The polio vaccine has nearly eradicated the disease in most countries.
She wore leg braces as a child after contracting polio.
Global efforts to eliminate polio continue today.
cn: 脊髓灰质炎疫苗已在大多数国家几乎消灭了这种疾病。
她小时候感染脊髓灰质炎后戴过腿部支架。
全球根除脊髓灰质炎的努力至今仍在继续。

definitions.definition: 花粉（植物雄性生殖细胞）

en: Bees collect pollen from flowers to make honey.
Pollen allergies are common in spring.
The microscope revealed the intricate structure of the pollen grain.
cn: 蜜蜂从花朵采集花粉以酿造蜂蜜。
花粉过敏在春季很常见。
显微镜下可见花粉颗粒的复杂结构。

definitions.definition: 民意调查专家； pollster 指专门从事民意调查或数据分析的专业人士。

en: The pollster predicted the election outcome with surprising accuracy.
Pollsters use statistical methods to analyze public opinion trends.
Critics questioned the pollster's methodology in selecting survey samples.
cn: 这位民意调查专家以惊人的准确度预测了选举结果。
民意调查专家运用统计方法分析舆论趋势。
批评者质疑该调查专家选取样本的方法论。

definitions.definition: 聚酯（一种合成纤维或塑料）

en: This jacket is made of 100% recycled polyester.
Polyester fabrics are known for their durability and wrinkle resistance.
The chemical plant specializes in producing polyester resins.
cn: 这件夹克由100%再生聚酯制成。
聚酯织物以耐用和抗皱著称。
该化工厂专门生产聚酯树脂。

en: His pompous speech bored the audience.
The mayor arrived in a pompous procession.
She dismissed his pompous claims as nonsense.
cn: 他浮夸的演讲让听众感到无聊。
市长以一场盛大的游行队伍到场。
她对他自命不凡的言论嗤之以鼻。

definitions.definition: 杨树（一种落叶乔木，树干高大，叶子呈三角形）

en: The wind rustled through the leaves of the poplar.
Poplars are often planted along roadsides for shade.
Her painting captured the golden hues of autumn poplars.
cn: 微风拂过杨树叶，沙沙作响。
杨树常被种在路边以提供荫凉。
她的画作捕捉了秋天杨树的金黄色调。

definitions.definition: 罂粟花（象征纪念，尤指一战阵亡士兵）

en: The field was dotted with red poppies.
She wore a poppy on Remembrance Day.
Opium is derived from the poppy plant.
cn: 田野里点缀着红色的罂粟花。
阵亡将士纪念日那天，她佩戴了一朵罂粟花。
鸦片是从罂粟植物中提取的。

en: Tokyo is one of the most populous cities in the world.
The Nile Delta has been populous since ancient times.
Despite its small area, the island is surprisingly populous.
cn: 东京是世界上人口最稠密的城市之一。
尼罗河三角洲自古人口密集。
尽管面积小，这座岛屿的人口密度却出奇地高。

definitions.definition: 仔细阅读；沉思（常与 over 连用）

en: Sweat exits the body through pores in the skin.
She pored over the ancient manuscript for clues.
Plant leaves have tiny pores for gas exchange.
cn: 汗液通过皮肤上的毛孔排出体外。
她仔细研读古老的手稿以寻找线索。
植物叶片有用于气体交换的微小气孔。

definitions.definition: 作品集（展示艺术、设计等作品的合集）
投资组合（个人或机构的金融资产集合）
文件夹（用于存放文件的便携夹）

en: She presented her design portfolio to the interview panel.
Diversifying your investment portfolio reduces risk.
The lawyer carried a leather portfolio full of legal documents.
cn: 她向面试小组展示了她的设计作品集。
分散投资组合能降低风险。
律师拿着一个装满法律文件的皮质文件夹。

en: The poet received posthumous fame for his unpublished works.
The award was given posthumously to the fallen soldier.
She edited her father’s posthumous manuscripts with great care.
cn: 这位诗人因未发表的作品在死后获得声誉。
该奖项被追授给这位阵亡士兵。
她精心编辑了父亲的遗稿。

definitions.definition: （信件或书籍的）附言，补充说明

en: She added a postscript to her letter with an update about her trip.
The book's postscript reveals the author's reflections years later.
PostScript files ensure high-quality printing of complex documents.
cn: 她在信末附言中补充了旅行的最新消息。
书的附言揭示了作者多年后的思考。
PostScript文件确保复杂文档的高质量打印。

en: Einstein postulated that the speed of light is constant.
This theory rests on two key postulates.
The lawyer postulated the defendant's innocence.
cn: 爱因斯坦假设光速是恒定的。
该理论基于两个关键假设。
律师主张被告无罪。

en: She has perfect posture when playing the piano.
The politician postured as a champion of the poor.
Good posture helps prevent back pain.
cn: 她弹钢琴时姿势非常标准。
这位政客摆出一副穷人捍卫者的姿态。
良好的姿势有助于预防背痛。

definitions.definition: 力量，效力（尤指药物、化学物质或人的能力）

en: The potency of this vaccine has been proven in clinical trials.
His speech lacked emotional potency to move the audience.
The herbal remedy retains its potency for up to two years.
cn: 这种疫苗的效力已在临床试验中得到验证。
他的演讲缺乏打动听众的情感力量。
这种草药的有效期可长达两年。

en: The potent storm caused widespread damage.
This medicine is highly potent against infections.
His potent arguments convinced the committee.
cn: 这场强风暴造成了大规模破坏。
这种药物对感染非常有效。
他有力的论点说服了委员会。

definitions.definition: 百乐餐（每人自带菜肴共享的聚餐）
碰运气的事；现成的饭菜

en: We're having a potluck dinner this weekend; could you bring a salad?
I hadn't planned anything for dinner, so we just took potluck with what was in the fridge.
The community center organizes a monthly potluck to encourage neighbors to mingle.
cn: 本周末我们将举行一场百乐餐，你能带一份沙拉来吗？
我没计划晚餐吃什么，所以我们就碰运气，吃了冰箱里现成的东西。
社区中心每月组织一次百乐餐，以鼓励邻居们相互交流。

definitions.definition: 小袋；荷包；育儿袋（如袋鼠的）

en: She kept her coins in a leather pouch.
Kangaroos carry their young in a pouch.
The hiker pouched some trail mix for energy.
cn: 她把硬币装在一个皮质小袋里。
袋鼠用育儿袋携带幼崽。
徒步者装了些干果混合物在袋中以补充能量。

en: The cat pounced on the mouse with lightning speed.
Investors pounced when the stock price hit a record low.
Her quick pounce saved the glass from falling off the table.
cn: 猫以闪电般的速度扑向老鼠。
股价跌至历史低点时，投资者迅速出手。
她迅速一抓，防止了玻璃杯从桌上掉落。

en: The design prioritizes practicality over aesthetics.
His idea lacked practicality under current constraints.
The practicality of renewable energy is now widely accepted.
cn: 设计优先考虑实用性而非美观性。
在当前限制下，他的想法缺乏可行性。
可再生能源的实用性现已广受认可。

en: She took a pragmatic approach to solving the budget crisis.
Pragmatic leaders prioritize results over ideological debates.
His philosophy blends pragmatic realism with ethical principles.
cn: 她以务实的方式解决了预算危机。
务实的领导者将结果置于意识形态争论之上。
他的哲学将实用现实主义与道德原则相结合。

definitions.definition: 不稳定的；危险的（指因缺乏支撑或保障而可能随时失败或倒塌的状态）
依赖他人意愿的；不确定的（指地位、权利等）

en: The ladder stood at a precarious angle, threatening to fall at any moment.
Many freelancers live in a precarious financial situation.
His position in the company was precarious after the scandal.
cn: 梯子以危险的角度倾斜着，随时可能倒塌。
许多自由职业者处于不稳定的财务状况中。
丑闻发生后，他在公司的地位岌岌可危。

definitions.definition: （城市的）分区，辖区（尤指警察或选举的管辖区域）

en: The police station covers three electoral precincts.
Smoking is prohibited within the hospital precinct.
The historic precinct of the city is well-preserved.
cn: 这座警察局负责三个选举辖区。
医院范围内禁止吸烟。
该城市的历史街区保存完好。

definitions.definition: 1. 使突然发生；加速（尤指不好的事件）

en: The scandal precipitated the collapse of the government.
Adding salt will precipitate the dissolved proteins.
His precipitate decision led to massive losses.
cn: 这场丑闻加速了政府的垮台。
加入盐会使溶解的蛋白质沉淀。
他仓促的决定导致了巨大损失。

definitions.definition: 仓促的，鲁莽的（形容行为）

en: The hikers avoided the precipitous cliff edge.
His precipitous decision led to unexpected consequences.
The village was nestled between precipitous mountains.
cn: 徒步者避开了陡峭的悬崖边缘。
他仓促的决定导致了意想不到的后果。
村庄坐落在陡峭的群山之间。

en: The heavy rain precluded us from holding the outdoor ceremony.
His prior commitment precluded any chance of attending the meeting.
Strict regulations preclude the use of unapproved materials.
cn: 大雨使我们无法举行户外仪式。
他先前的承诺使他完全无法参加会议。
严格的规定排除了使用未经批准材料的可能性。

definitions.definition: 掠夺的，捕食性的（指动物）
剥削的，恃强凌弱的（指人或行为）

en: The hawk is a predatory bird with keen eyesight.
The company was accused of predatory pricing to eliminate competitors.
Some loan apps engage in predatory lending targeting vulnerable groups.
cn: 鹰是一种视力敏锐的捕食性鸟类。
该公司被指控通过掠夺性定价打压竞争对手。
部分借贷软件从事针对弱势群体的掠夺性放贷。

en: The company faced a financial predicament after the market crash.
In logic, a predicament refers to a fundamental category of existence.
She found herself in a ridiculous predicament when her dress tore at the party.
cn: 公司在市场崩盘后陷入财务困境。
在逻辑学中，“predicament”指存在的基本范畴。
当她的裙子在派对上撕裂时，她陷入了可笑的窘境。

en: The company gives preferential treatment to its long-term employees.
She has a preferential option for organic food.
Preferential tariffs are applied to developing countries.
cn: 该公司对长期员工给予优待。
她偏爱有机食品。
发展中国家享有优惠关税。

en: The project failed due to premature decisions.
Premature babies often need special medical care.
His premature retirement surprised everyone.
cn: 该项目因仓促决策而失败。
早产儿通常需要特殊医疗护理。
他的提前退休让所有人感到意外。

en: Customers pay a premium for organic products.
This hotel offers premium services to its guests.
The stock is trading at a 10% premium to its market value.
cn: 消费者为有机产品支付额外费用。
这家酒店为客人提供优质服务。
该股票以高于市场价10%的溢价交易。

en: She had a sudden premonition that the plane would crash.
The dark clouds were a premonition of the coming storm.
His dream turned out to be a premonition of his father’s illness.
cn: 她突然预感到飞机会坠毁。
乌云是暴风雨来临的前兆。
他的梦后来成了父亲生病的前兆。

en: Prenatal vitamins are essential for fetal development.
She attended prenatal yoga classes regularly.
Doctors monitor prenatal health through ultrasound scans.
cn: 孕期维生素对胎儿发育至关重要。
她定期参加产前瑜伽课程。
医生通过超声波检查监测产前健康状况。

definitions.definition: 全神贯注的；心事重重的
被抢先占用的（如时间、空间）

en: She was too preoccupied with work to notice the time.
The parking space was already preoccupied by a delivery truck.
His preoccupied expression suggested he was worrying about something.
cn: 她工作太投入，没注意到时间。
停车位已被一辆送货卡车占用。
他心事重重的表情表明他在担忧某事。

en: A high school diploma is a prerequisite for college admission.
The course has no prerequisite knowledge requirements.
Trust is a prerequisite for effective teamwork.
cn: 高中文凭是大学入学的先决条件。
这门课程没有前置知识要求。
信任是高效团队合作的前提。

en: She works as a teacher in a local preschool.
Preschool education focuses on play-based learning.
Many parents enroll their children in preschool programs.
cn: 她在当地一所幼儿园担任教师。
学前教育以游戏化学习为核心。
许多家长让孩子参加学前班课程。

definitions.definition: 主席团；常务委员会；执行委员会

en: The presidium of the assembly convened an emergency meeting.
He was elected as a member of the presidium for the upcoming conference.
The decision was ultimately made by the party's presidium.
cn: 大会主席团召开了一次紧急会议。
他当选为即将举行的会议的主席团成员。
该决定最终由党的常务委员会作出。

en: The team faced pressing deadlines to finish the project.
Vinyl records are made by the pressing of heated plastic.
She ignored the pressing issue until it became a crisis.
cn: 团队面临紧迫的截止日期来完成项目。
黑胶唱片通过加热塑料压制而成。
她忽视了这一紧迫问题，直到它演变成危机。

definitions.definition: 假定；推测（基于有限证据）

en: We must presume innocence until guilt is proven.
I presume you’ve already read the report?
He presumed to give advice without being asked.
cn: 在证明有罪之前，我们必须假定无罪。
我猜你已经读过报告了吧？
他未经请求就擅自提建议。

definitions.definition: 假定，推测（基于不充分证据的结论）
冒昧，放肆（过度自信的行为）

en: His presumption that she would agree angered everyone.
It’s sheer presumption to speak for others without consent.
The theory rests on the presumption of human rationality.
cn: 他擅自假定她会同意，这激怒了所有人。
未经允许代表他人发言纯属放肆。
这一理论基于人类理性的假设。

en: All arguments presuppose a shared definition of terms.
The theory presupposes that humans act rationally.
You can't presuppose their consent without asking.
cn: 所有论点都以对术语的共同定义为前提。
该理论假设人类会理性行事。
你不能未经询问就假定他们同意。

en: His pretentious speech about art confused everyone.
The restaurant served tiny portions with pretentious names.
She avoided pretentious people who only cared about status.
cn: 他对艺术矫揉造作的演讲让所有人困惑。
这家餐厅用浮夸的菜名供应分量极小的食物。
她避开那些只在乎地位、自命不凡的人。

en: The belief that hard work leads to success is prevalent in many cultures.
Smartphones have become prevalent tools for communication.
During the pandemic, mask-wearing was prevalent worldwide.
cn: 努力工作能带来成功的信念在许多文化中普遍存在。
智能手机已成为占主导地位的通讯工具。
疫情期间，戴口罩的做法在全球范围内盛行。

definitions.definition: 棱镜（光学器件，可将光分解为光谱）
棱柱（几何图形，两端为全等平行多边形）

en: The sunlight passing through the prism created a rainbow on the wall.
A hexagonal prism has eight faces in total.
Her analysis acted like a prism, breaking down the problem into clear components.
cn: 阳光穿过棱镜，在墙上投出一道彩虹。
六角棱柱共有八个面。
她的分析像棱镜一样，将问题分解为清晰的组成部分。

en: The lake remains pristine despite nearby development.
She wore a pristine white dress for the ceremony.
Scientists found pristine samples of ice dating back thousands of years.
cn: 尽管周边开发，湖泊仍保持原始状态。
她穿着一尘不染的白裙出席典礼。
科学家发现了可追溯至数千年前的原始冰层样本。

en: She turned pro at the age of 16.
The debater argued pro the new policy.
As a pro, he always delivers high-quality work.
cn: 她在16岁时成为职业选手。
辩手支持这项新政策。
作为专业人士，他总是交付高质量的工作。

en: The new employee is on a three-month probation.
The judge sentenced him to two years' probation.
During probation, her performance will be closely monitored.
cn: 这位新员工有三个月的试用期。
法官判处他两年缓刑。
在试用期内，她的表现将受到密切评估。

en: The lack of data makes the conclusion highly problematic.
His behavior in the meeting was problematic for team morale.
The ethical implications of this technology remain problematic.
cn: 数据缺失使得结论非常不可靠。
他在会议中的行为对团队士气产生了负面影响。
这项技术的伦理影响仍存在争议。

en: The judge emphasized the importance of procedural fairness in the trial.
This game uses procedural generation to create unique maps.
The report outlined the procedural steps for handling emergencies.
cn: 法官强调了审判中程序公平的重要性。
这款游戏通过程序化生成来创建独特的地图。
报告概述了处理紧急情况的程序步骤。

definitions.definition: （尤指非法或不道德地）促成，谋取

en: The company procured a rare mineral for the experiment.
He was accused of procuring confidential documents illegally.
Her connections helped procure tickets to the sold-out concert.
cn: 该公司为实验采购了一种稀有矿物。
他被指控非法获取机密文件。
她的人脉帮她弄到了售罄音乐会的门票。

en: She prodded the snail with a stick to see if it was alive.
The teacher's words prodded him to start studying seriously.
He gave the cattle a gentle prod to move them forward.
cn: 她用树枝戳了戳蜗牛，看看是否还活着。
老师的话督促他开始认真学习。
他轻轻戳了戳牛群，让它们向前走。

en: The prodigal son returned home after years of wasteful living.
She has a prodigal talent for storytelling, captivating everyone with her words.
The company's prodigal spending on unnecessary luxuries led to its bankruptcy.
cn: 浪子在多年挥霍生活后回到了家。
她拥有丰富的讲故事天赋，用语言迷住了所有人。
公司在不必要的奢侈品上挥霍无度，导致了破产。

definitions.definition: 天才；奇才（尤指年轻且才华非凡的人）

en: Mozart was a child prodigy who composed music at the age of five.
The technological breakthrough was hailed as a prodigy of modern engineering.
Ancient Romans often interpreted eclipses as prodigies signaling divine displeasure.
cn: 莫扎特是五岁便能作曲的天才儿童。
这一技术突破被誉为现代工程学的奇迹。
古罗马人常将日食视为预示神怒的异象。

definitions.definition: 公开宣称；声称（尤指信仰或情感）
教授（学科，古义或正式用法）

en: She professed her love for classical music.
He professed to be an expert, but his advice was flawed.
In medieval times, monks professed vows of poverty.
cn: 她公开表达了对古典音乐的热爱。
他自称专家，但其建议漏洞百出。
中世纪时，僧侣公开立誓守贫。

en: During the war, he was reviled as a profiteer who sold scarce goods at exorbitant prices.
Some companies are accused of profiteering from the current energy crisis.
The new regulations aim to prevent profiteering in the pharmaceutical industry.
cn: 战争期间，他被斥为哄抬稀缺商品价格的奸商。
一些公司被指责从当前的能源危机中牟取暴利。
新法规旨在防止制药行业的暴利行为。

definitions.definition: （心理）投射（将自身情感归因于他人）

en: The map uses a Mercator projection to represent the Earth.
Her criticism of others is often a projection of her own insecurities.
The company's sales projection for next year is optimistic.
cn: 这张地图使用墨卡托投影法表现地球。
她对别人的批评常是自身不安的投射。
公司对明年销售额的预测很乐观。

definitions.definition: 增殖；扩散；激增（尤指细胞、生物或数量的快速增长）

en: The proliferation of smartphones has changed global communication.
Scientists observed rapid cell proliferation in the lab experiment.
Controlling nuclear proliferation remains a critical international issue.
cn: 智能手机的普及彻底改变了全球通信方式。
科学家在实验中观察到细胞的快速增殖。
控制核扩散仍是国际社会的重要议题。

definitions.definition: 丰富的；大量存在的（指作品或成果）

en: Mozart was a prolific composer, writing over 600 works in his short life.
The rabbit is known for being a prolific breeder.
The region is prolific in producing talented artists.
cn: 莫扎特是一位多产的作曲家，在短暂一生中创作了600多部作品。
兔子以繁殖能力强而闻名。
该地区盛产才华横溢的艺术家。

definitions.definition: 序言，开场白（戏剧、文学作品的开篇部分）
序幕，开端（事件的起始阶段）

en: The prologue of the novel sets the scene for the historical conflict.
His early struggles were merely a prologue to his later success.
The chorus delivered the prologue in classical Greek style.
cn: 小说序言为历史冲突设定了背景。
他早期的奋斗只是后来成功的序幕。
合唱团以古典希腊风格演绎了开场白。

en: The prominence of the mountain made it a landmark for sailors.
She achieved prominence as a scientist in her early thirties.
The issue has gained prominence in recent political debates.
cn: 这座山的突出轮廓使其成为水手的航标。
她在三十岁出头时就成为了一位杰出的科学家。
该问题在近期的政治辩论中变得尤为重要。

en: She is prone to headaches in humid weather.
The patient lay prone during the examination.
Young drivers are more prone to accidents.
cn: 她在潮湿天气容易头痛。
检查时患者呈俯卧位。
年轻司机更容易出事故。

definitions.definition: 传播（思想、知识等）；繁殖（植物或生物）

en: Farmers propagate new plants by cuttings.
The internet helps propagate ideas rapidly.
Misinformation can propagate through social media.
cn: 农民通过扦插繁殖新植株。
互联网帮助快速传播思想。
错误信息可能通过社交媒体蔓延。

en: The engine uses burning gases to propel the rocket forward.
She was propelled to fame by her groundbreaking research.
Wind can propel a sailboat across the water effortlessly.
cn: 发动机利用燃烧气体推动火箭前进。
她的突破性研究使她一举成名。
风能轻松推动帆船穿越水面。

en: The ancient prophecy foretold the rise of a great leader.
Her gift of prophecy was both a blessing and a curse.
The book explores the blurred line between prophecy and coincidence.
cn: 古老的预言预示了一位伟大领袖的崛起。
她的预言天赋既是祝福也是诅咒。
这本书探讨了预言与巧合之间的模糊界限。

en: The ancient priestess would prophesy the fate of warriors before battle.
Some claim that dreams can prophesy future events.
His writings seem to prophesy the technological revolution.
cn: 古代女祭司会在战前预言战士的命运。
有人认为梦境能预示未来事件。
他的著作似乎预言了技术革命。

en: She is a strong proponent of renewable energy.
The bill’s proponent argued for its environmental benefits.
As a proponent of free education, he organized public lectures.
cn: 她是可再生能源的坚定支持者。
该法案的提出者强调了其对环境的益处。
作为免费教育的倡导者，他组织了公开讲座。

definitions.definition: 向…提出建议（尤指不当要求）

en: The committee rejected his proposition to cut funding.
In logic, a proposition must be either true or false.
He was propositioned by a stranger at the bar.
cn: 委员会否决了他削减资金的提议。
在逻辑学中，命题必须非真即假。
他在酒吧被陌生人提出了不当要求。

definitions.definition: 潜在的（尤指可能成为客户或成员的人）

en: The company is evaluating prospective employees this week.
Prospective changes in the law may affect small businesses.
She attended a seminar for prospective homebuyers.
cn: 公司本周正在评估潜在雇员。
法律的预期变化可能影响小型企业。
她参加了面向潜在购房者的研讨会。

definitions.definition: 前列腺（男性生殖系统中的腺体）

en: The prostate gland secretes fluid that nourishes sperm.
Regular check-ups can help detect prostate cancer early.
Enlarged prostate may cause urinary difficulties in older men.
cn: 前列腺分泌滋养精子的液体。
定期检查有助于早期发现前列腺癌。
前列腺增大会导致老年男性排尿困难。

definitions.definition: （某活动或事业的）主要倡导者

en: The protagonist of the novel struggles with moral dilemmas.
She was a leading protagonist in the environmental movement.
The film’s protagonist transforms from a timid student to a confident leader.
cn: 这部小说的主角在道德困境中挣扎。
她是环保运动的主要倡导者。
电影的主角从胆怯的学生蜕变为自信的领导者。

definitions.definition: 协议（正式文件或国际条约）

en: The diplomats signed the protocol to formalize the agreement.
Royal events require strict adherence to protocol.
HTTP is a common protocol for web communication.
cn: 外交官签署协议草案以正式达成协定。
皇室活动需严格遵守礼仪规范。
HTTP是网络通信的常用协议。

definitions.definition: 原型（原始模型或初代版本）

en: The engineer built a prototype to test the new design.
This robot is the prototype for future household assistants.
Her innovative approach became a prototype for social reforms.
cn: 工程师制作了原型来测试新设计。
这款机器人是未来家用助手的原型。
她的创新方法成为社会改革的范例。

definitions.definition: 延长的，拖延的（尤指时间上超出预期或必要范围）

en: The negotiations became a protracted battle over minor details.
His illness led to a protracted absence from work.
The film’s protracted ending disappointed many viewers.
cn: 谈判因琐碎细节演变成一场持久战。
他的疾病导致他长期无法工作。
电影冗长的结尾让许多观众失望。

en: The nail protruded from the wooden board, posing a danger.
Her ribs protruded under the thin fabric.
The telescope allows the lens to protrude for zooming.
cn: 钉子从木板上凸出，构成危险。
她的肋骨在薄布料下明显凸起。
这款望远镜的镜头可伸出变焦。

definitions.definition: 有远见的；未雨绸缪的；节俭的

en: Provident individuals often save a portion of their income for retirement.
Her provident management of resources helped the company survive the economic crisis.
It was provident of you to bring an umbrella with this forecast.
cn: 有远见的人通常会为退休储蓄一部分收入。
她对资源的节俭管理帮助公司度过了经济危机。
你看天气预报带了伞，真是有先见之明。

definitions.definition: 有条件限制的（如法律文件）

en: The government issued a provisional license for the new drug.
These rules are provisional and may change after discussion.
She accepted the offer with provisional approval.
cn: 政府为这种新药颁发了临时许可证。
这些规定是暂行的，讨论后可能修改。
她有条件地接受了这个提议。

definitions.definition: 卓越的技能或能力（尤指战斗或竞争中）

en: His prowess in debate earned him national fame.
The warrior was celebrated for his prowess with a sword.
Her academic prowess secured her a scholarship at Harvard.
cn: 他在辩论中的卓越表现使他闻名全国。
这位战士因剑术高超而备受赞誉。
她的学术才能为她赢得了哈佛大学的奖学金。

definitions.definition: 接近，邻近（指空间或时间上的靠近）

en: The proximity of the school to the park makes it convenient for children to play after class.
Cultural proximity often facilitates better understanding between neighboring countries.
The sensor detects the proximity of objects within a 5-meter range.
cn: 学校靠近公园，方便孩子们课后玩耍。
文化上的邻近性常促进邻国间更好的理解。
该传感器能检测5米范围内物体的接近。

definitions.definition: 谨慎的，明智的（尤指为避免风险或后果而采取的行动）

en: It would be prudent to save some money for emergencies.
She made a prudent decision after consulting experts.
Prudent investors diversify their portfolios.
cn: 为紧急情况存些钱是明智之举。
咨询专家后，她做出了谨慎的决定。
谨慎的投资者会分散投资组合。

en: He adopted a pseudo intellectual style to impress others.
The product was marketed with pseudo scientific claims.
Her pseudo enthusiasm was obvious to everyone in the room.
cn: 他采用了一种伪知识分子的风格来给别人留下深刻印象。
该产品用伪科学的主张进行营销。
她虚伪的热情对房间里的每个人来说都很明显。

definitions.definition: 精神病医生；精神病学家

en: The psychiatrist prescribed medication to help manage her anxiety.
He decided to consult a psychiatrist after experiencing prolonged insomnia.
Modern psychiatrists often combine therapy with pharmacological treatments.
cn: 这位精神病医生开了药以帮助控制她的焦虑。
在长期失眠后，他决定咨询一位精神病医生。
现代精神病学家常将心理疗法与药物治疗结合使用。

definitions.definition: 精神变态者；精神病患者（非正式用法，含贬义）
精神病的；疯狂的（非正式用法）

en: The movie villain is a classic psycho who enjoys manipulating others.
She called him a psycho after he yelled at a stranger for no reason.
The term "psycho" is often misused in casual conversations.
cn: 这部电影的反派是个典型的心理变态，以操纵他人为乐。
他无故对陌生人大吼后，她骂他是疯子。
“精神病”一词在日常对话中常被滥用。

en: The psychoanalyst listened attentively to the patient’s free associations.
Freud was the first psychoanalyst to explore the significance of dreams.
She trained for years to become a qualified psychoanalyst.
cn: 精神分析学家专注倾听患者的自由联想。
弗洛伊德是首位探索梦境意义的精神分析学家。
她经过多年训练成为一名合格的精神分析学家。

definitions.definition: 心理治疗师（从事心理治疗的专业人士）

en: The psychotherapist helped her overcome childhood trauma.
He trained for years to become a licensed psychotherapist.
Psychotherapists often use cognitive-behavioral techniques.
cn: 这位心理治疗师帮助她克服了童年创伤。
他经过多年训练成为持证心理治疗师。
心理治疗师常采用认知行为疗法。

definitions.definition: 心理治疗（通过心理学方法治疗精神或情绪障碍）

en: She decided to try psychotherapy to address her anxiety.
Cognitive-behavioral psychotherapy is effective for depression.
The clinic specializes in psychotherapy for trauma survivors.
cn: 她决定尝试心理治疗来解决焦虑问题。
认知行为心理治疗对抑郁症有效。
这家诊所专长为创伤幸存者提供心理治疗。

definitions.definition: 青春期（人类或动物性成熟的生理阶段）

en: The onset of puberty varies between individuals.
Hormonal changes during puberty affect both body and mind.
Some species reach puberty within a few months of birth.
cn: 青春期的开始时间因人而异。
青春期的荷尔蒙变化影响身心。
某些物种出生后几个月便进入青春期。

definitions.definition: 套头衫（一种无需扣子、直接从头上套穿的衣服）

en: She wore a cozy wool pullover on the hike.
This pullover is easy to take off because it's stretchy.
He bought a new pullover for the winter season.
cn: 她在徒步时穿了一件舒适的羊毛套头衫。
这件套头衫很有弹性，所以很容易脱下来。
他为冬季买了一件新的套头衫。

definitions.definition: （教堂的）讲道坛；神职人员的职位；公开演讲的场合

en: The priest stood at the pulpit, delivering his sermon.
Her powerful speech from the pulpit moved the congregation.
The issue was debated in the pulpit and the press.
cn: 牧师站在讲道坛上布道。
她在讲坛上的有力演讲打动了会众。
这一议题在宗教场合和媒体上均引发争论。

definitions.definition: 双关语（利用同音异义或一词多义制造幽默效果的语言形式）

en: "The baker joked about his job being a piece of cake."
"Time flies like an arrow; fruit flies like a banana."
"She used a pun about bicycles because she was two-tired."
cn: 面包师开玩笑说他的工作是小菜一碟。（“a piece of cake”字面指蛋糕，隐喻指轻松的事）
光阴似箭；果蝇爱香蕉。（利用“flies”和“like”的双重含义）
她用了关于自行车的双关语，因为她“太累了”。（“two-tired”谐音“too tired”）

definitions.definition: （气味或味道）刺激性的，辛辣的

en: The pungent smell of garlic filled the kitchen.
Her pungent remarks left the audience in silence.
The cheese has a pungent flavor that not everyone enjoys.
cn: 厨房里弥漫着大蒜的刺鼻气味。
她犀利的评论让听众陷入沉默。
这种奶酪味道浓烈，并非人人都喜欢。

en: The court imposed punitive fines to deter future violations.
Critics argue that the policy is overly punitive toward low-income families.
Punitive measures alone cannot solve systemic corruption.
cn: 法院处以惩罚性罚款以杜绝未来违规行为。
批评者认为该政策对低收入家庭过于严苛。
仅靠惩罚性措施无法解决系统性腐败。

en: The decoration is purely functional, with no artistic intent.
She agreed purely out of kindness.
This theory is purely speculative at this stage.
cn: 装饰纯粹是功能性的，毫无艺术意图。
她完全是出于善意才同意的。
该理论现阶段仅为推测。

en: The dictator ordered a purge of dissidents.
Drinking herbal tea helps purge toxins from the body.
After the scandal, the company underwent a leadership purge.
cn: 独裁者下令清除异见人士。
饮用草本茶有助于排出体内毒素。
丑闻后，公司进行了管理层清洗。

en: The document purports to be an official statement.
The purport of his speech was unclear.
She purports to know the truth, but offers no evidence.
cn: 该文件声称是一份官方声明。
他演讲的主旨不明。
她自称知道真相，却未提供证据。

definitions.definition: 蟒蛇（一种大型无毒蛇类）
Python（希腊神话中的巨蛇，或指编程语言Python）

en: The zookeeper fed a rabbit to the python.
Python is widely used in data science.
Apollo defeated Python in Greek mythology.
cn: 动物园管理员用兔子喂蟒蛇。
Python编程语言被广泛应用于数据科学。
希腊神话中阿波罗杀死了巨蛇Python。

definitions.definition: 鸭子叫声；庸医，江湖骗子

en: The ducks started to quack when they saw the bread.
He was exposed as a quack who sold fake medicines.
Don't be fooled by his quack remedies; they have no scientific basis.
cn: 鸭子们看到面包后开始嘎嘎叫起来。
他被揭露为一个售卖假药的江湖骗子。
不要被他那些骗人的疗法愚弄了，它们根本没有科学依据。

definitions.definition: 四边形；四合院（尤指学院或大学中围起来的方形院落）

en: The students gathered in the college quadrangle for the ceremony.
A square is a regular quadrangle with four equal sides and four right angles.
The museum is built around a beautiful quadrangle garden.
cn: 学生们聚集在学院的四方院里举行仪式。
正方形是一种规则的四边形，有四条等边和四个直角。
博物馆围绕着一个美丽的四合院式花园而建。

definitions.definition: 象限（数学或天文学中的四分之一圆形或平面区域）
象限仪（测量角度的仪器）

en: The city is located in the northeast quadrant of the state.
Sailors used a quadrant to navigate by the stars.
Each quadrant of the circle represents a different phase.
cn: 这座城市位于该州的东北象限。
水手曾用象限仪通过星辰导航。
圆的每个象限代表一个不同阶段。

en: The quadratic function graphs as a parabola.
Solving quadratic equations requires finding the roots.
The relationship is modeled by a quadratic polynomial.
cn: 二次函数的图像是一条抛物线。
解二次方程需要求根。
该关系通过一个二次多项式建模。

en: A square is a regular quadrilateral with four equal sides and four right angles.
The architect designed a quadrilateral courtyard at the center of the building.
We studied the properties of various quadrilaterals in geometry class.
cn: 正方形是一种规则的四边形，有四条等边和四个直角。
建筑师在建筑中心设计了一个四边形庭院。
我们在几何课上学习了各种四边形的性质。

definitions.definition: 四倍的；由四部分组成的

en: The company aims to quadruple its profits by 2030.
A quadruple bypass surgery is more complex than a double.
Her investment quadrupled in value over five years.
cn: 该公司计划到2030年将利润翻两番。
心脏四重搭桥手术比双重搭桥更复杂。
她的投资在五年内增值了三倍。

en: The soldiers did not quail in the face of danger.
We spotted a quail nesting in the bushes.
His mocking tone made her quail inwardly.
cn: 士兵们在危险面前没有退缩。
我们发现一只鹌鹑在灌木丛中筑巢。
他嘲讽的语气让她内心胆怯。

definitions.definition: 古雅的，奇特的（尤指因古老或罕见而迷人）

en: The village had a quaint charm with its cobblestone streets.
She wore a quaint hat from the 1920s.
His quaint manners reminded me of a bygone era.
cn: 这座村庄的鹅卵石街道有一种古雅的魅力。
她戴着一顶20世纪20年代的别致帽子。
他古怪的举止让我想起过去的年代。

definitions.definition: 贵格会教徒（基督教教派"公谊会"成员）

en: The Quaker refused to swear an oath in court.
Colonial records described Quakers as wearing plain clothing.
The old man was a quaker of palsy, his hands never still.
cn: 贵格会教徒拒绝在法庭上宣誓。
殖民时期文献记载贵格会教徒衣着朴素。
那位老人因帕金森症双手颤抖不止。（古义用法）

en: She won the regional qualifier for the tennis championship.
In grammar, an adjective can act as a qualifier to a noun.
Only the top three teams will be qualifiers for the finals.
cn: 她赢得了网球锦标赛的地区资格赛。
在语法中，形容词可以充当名词的修饰语。
只有前三名的队伍能获得决赛资格。

definitions.definition: 不安，疑虑（尤指道德或良心上的）

en: She had no qualms about reporting the fraud to the authorities.
A sudden qualm of nausea made him pause during the speech.
His qualms over the decision kept him awake at night.
cn: 她毫不犹豫地向当局举报了欺诈行为。
一阵突如其来的恶心让他在演讲中途停了下来。
他对这个决定的疑虑让他夜不能寐。

definitions.definition: （语言学）量词，限定词（如 some, many, all）

en: In logic, the universal quantifier (∀) denotes "for all".
Words like "some" and "many" are examples of quantifiers in natural language.
The researcher used a statistical quantifier to measure the uncertainty in the data.
cn: 在逻辑学中，全称量符（∀）表示“对于所有”。
像“一些”和“许多”这样的词是自然语言中量词的例子。
研究人员使用一个统计量词来度量数据中的不确定性。

definitions.definition: 量子（物理学中最小不可分割的单位）
数量；总量（古义或特定语境）

en: The theory explains how energy is absorbed in discrete quanta.
Ancient philosophers debated the quantum of happiness one can achieve.
Quantum computing leverages superposition to solve complex problems.
cn: 该理论解释了能量如何以离散的量子形式被吸收。
古代哲学家曾探讨人能获得的幸福总量。
量子计算利用叠加态解决复杂问题。

en: The travelers were placed in quarantine for two weeks.
Dogs entering the country must undergo quarantine.
The government lifted the city's quarantine measures.
cn: 旅客被隔离了两周。
入境的犬只需接受检疫。
政府解除了该市的隔离措施。

en: The string quartet performed Mozart's masterpiece.
A quartet of volunteers cleaned the beach.
This wine is part of a limited-edition quartet.
cn: 弦乐四重奏乐团演奏了莫扎特的杰作。
四人志愿者小组清理了海滩。
这款酒是限量版四瓶套装中的一支。

definitions.definition: 石英（一种坚硬、透明的矿物，化学成分为二氧化硅）

en: The watch uses quartz to keep precise time.
Quartz crystals are often found in granite.
Her necklace was made of polished rose quartz.
cn: 这款手表利用石英来保持精确时间。
石英晶体常见于花岗岩中。
她的项链由抛光的粉晶制成。

en: The court quashed the conviction due to new evidence.
The government moved swiftly to quash the rebellion.
She tried to quash her feelings of guilt.
cn: 法院因新证据撤销了定罪。
政府迅速行动镇压了叛乱。
她试图压抑内心的愧疚感。

definitions.definition:
（声音）颤抖，震颤
• n. 颤音；八分音符

en: Her voice began to quaver as she spoke about the emotional experience.
The singer added a subtle quaver to the final note for dramatic effect.
In musical notation, a quaver is equivalent to an eighth note.
cn: 谈及那段情感经历时，她的声音开始颤抖。
歌手在最后一个音符上加入了细微的颤音以增强戏剧效果。
在乐谱中，quaver 相当于一个八分音符。

en: The government deployed troops to quell the uprising.
Her gentle words quelled his anxiety.
New evidence may quell doubts about the theory.
cn: 政府部署军队镇压起义。
她温柔的话语消除了他的焦虑。
新证据可能平息对该理论的质疑。

definitions.definition: 熄灭（火、光等）；解渴；抑制（欲望等）

en: The firefighters worked tirelessly to quench the raging wildfire.
She drank a glass of water to quench her thirst after the long run.
His enthusiasm for the project was quenched by constant setbacks.
cn: 消防员奋力扑灭肆虐的山火。
长跑后，她喝了一杯水解渴。
接连的挫折浇灭了他对项目的热情。

en: The tired child became increasingly querulous as bedtime approached.
cn: 随着就寝时间临近，这个疲惫的孩子变得越来越爱闹脾气。

definitions.definition: 吹毛求疵的反对意见；狡辩；遁词
吹毛求疵；狡辩；为小事争吵

en: He dismissed my objection as a mere quibble.
There's no point in quibbling over such minor details.
Their entire argument was based on a legal quibble.
cn: 他将我的反对意见斥为纯粹的狡辩。
为如此细微的细节争论毫无意义。
他们的整个论点都基于一个法律上的遁词。

en: She gave a quick reply to the question.
Be quick, or we'll miss the train!
His quick thinking saved the child from danger.
cn: 她迅速回答了问题。
快点，否则我们要错过火车了！
他的敏捷思维让孩子脱离了危险。

definitions.definition: 流沙（一种湿沙混合物，能吞噬重物）
危险而复杂的处境；陷阱

en: The adventurer was trapped in quicksand but rescued by his team.
The legal dispute became a quicksand of paperwork and delays.
Do not panic if you step into quicksand; lean back to distribute your weight.
cn: 这位探险家陷入了流沙，但被他的团队救了出来。
这场法律纠纷变成了文书工作和拖延的泥潭。
如果你踩进流沙，不要惊慌；向后仰以分散你的体重。

definitions.definition: 精华；典范；第五元素（古代哲学中构成天体的元素）

en: She is the quintessence of professionalism.
The perfume is the quintessence of floral fragrances.
The ancient philosophers believed the stars were made of quintessence.
cn: 她是专业精神的典范。
这款香水是花香调香氛的精华。
古代哲学家认为星辰由第五元素构成。

definitions.definition: 五重奏（乐团）；五重唱（组合）
由五个部分组成的一组事物

en: The jazz quintet performed an improvisational piece at the festival.
She collected a quintet of rare porcelain vases from the Ming dynasty.
The novel is structured as a quintet of interconnected stories.
cn: 这支爵士五重奏在音乐节上表演了一首即兴作品。
她收集了一组五只明代稀有瓷瓶。
这部小说由五个相互关联的故事组成。

en: She responded with a clever quip that made everyone laugh.
His speech was full of witty quips and sharp observations.
Don’t just quip—give a serious answer.
cn: 她回了一句机智的俏皮话，逗得大家哈哈大笑。
他的演讲充满诙谐妙语和犀利见解。
别光说俏皮话，给个认真答复。

en: His habit of collecting bottle caps is just one of his many quirks.
By a quirk of fate, they met again after 20 years.
She quirked an eyebrow at his unexpected answer.
cn: 他收集瓶盖的习惯只是他众多怪癖之一。
命运的巧合让他们在20年后重逢。
听到他出乎意料的回答，她挑了挑眉毛。

definitions.definition: 轻易放弃者；半途而废的人

en: Don't be a quitter; see the project through to the end.
He was labeled a quitter after he dropped out of the race.
A quitter never wins, and a winner never quits.
cn: 不要当个半途而废的人，要把项目坚持到底。
他在退出比赛后被贴上了放弃者的标签。
放弃者永远不会成功，而成功者永不放弃。

en: The archer drew an arrow from his quiver.
Her voice began to quiver with emotion.
The leaves quiver in the breeze.
cn: 弓箭手从箭袋中抽出一支箭。
她的声音因情绪激动而开始颤抖。
树叶在微风中轻轻颤动。

definitions.definition: 不切实际的；空想的；理想主义的（常指慷慨或浪漫到不现实的程度）

en: His quixotic attempt to build a free energy machine consumed all his savings but yielded no practical results.
She has a quixotic vision of world peace that ignores complex political realities.
Despite the quixotic nature of his campaign, he managed to inspire a great number of volunteers.
cn: 他试图建造一台免费能源机器的不切实际的尝试耗尽了他所有积蓄，却没有产生任何实际成果。
她对世界和平有着一种忽略复杂政治现实的、不切实际的幻想。
尽管他的竞选活动很不切实际，但他还是成功激励了大量的志愿者。

en: She gave me a quizzical look when I told her the surprising news.
His quizzical smile suggested he knew more than he was letting on.
The professor's quizzical expression encouraged the students to think deeper about the problem.
cn: 当我告诉她这个令人惊讶的消息时，她向我投来了疑惑的目光。
他揶揄的微笑表明他知道的比他透露的要多。
教授探询的表情鼓励学生们更深入地思考这个问题。

definitions.definition: 商（数学中除法运算的结果）

en: The quotient of 20 divided by 5 is 4.
Her high adversity quotient helped her overcome challenges.
The study measured the happiness quotient of different cities.
cn: 20除以5的商是4。
她的高逆商（逆境商数）帮助她克服了困难。
该研究测量了不同城市的幸福指数。

definitions.definition: 拉比（犹太教宗教领袖或学者）

en: The rabbi explained the Torah portion with great insight.
She consulted the rabbi about the traditional wedding customs.
As a young rabbi, he focused on community outreach.
cn: 拉比以深刻的见解阐释了《托拉》章节。
她向拉比咨询了传统婚礼习俗。
作为一名年轻的拉比，他专注于社区服务。

definitions.definition: 狂热的；极端的（如狂热支持者）

en: The rabid dog was immediately isolated by veterinarians.
