He enjoyed the concert vicariously by watching a recording since he couldn't attend.
cn: 她通过朋友的旅行故事设身处地地体验了冒险的刺激。
父母常常通过子女的成就获得替代性的满足。
由于无法亲临现场，他通过观看录像间接享受了音乐会。

en: There are several good schools in the vicinity.
The noise alarmed everyone in the vicinity.
His theories are in the vicinity of modern physics.
cn: 附近有几所好学校。
噪音惊动了附近的每个人。
他的理论接近现代物理学范畴。

en: The scam artists often target elderly people to victimize them financially.
Bullying can victimize children and leave lasting psychological scars.
The new law aims to protect immigrants from being victimized by employers.
cn: 诈骗犯常以老年人为目标，从经济上迫害他们。
霸凌会使儿童受害，并留下持久的心理创伤。
新法律旨在保护移民免受雇主的欺压。

en: The two teams vie for the championship every year.
Startups often vie with giants for market share.
She refused to vie for his attention.
cn: 两支队伍每年争夺冠军。
初创企业常与巨头争夺市场份额。
她拒绝为吸引他的注意而竞争。

definitions.definition: 守夜，熬夜（尤指为祈祷或守护）

en: She kept a vigil by her father's bedside throughout the night.
The monks observed a vigil before the feast day.
Protesters held a candlelight vigil for peace.
cn: 她整夜守在父亲床边。
修士们在节日前夕举行了守夜礼。
抗议者们为和平举行了烛光守夜活动。

definitions.definition: 1. （书籍或章节的）装饰性小插图；2. 简短而生动的描述（如人物、场景）；3. （摄影）渐晕效果（边缘渐暗的图片风格）

en: The novel opens with a vignette of rural life in 19th-century France.
She added a floral vignette to the manuscript’s title page.
The photographer used vignetting to draw focus to the subject’s face.
cn: 小说以一段19世纪法国乡村生活的生动描写开篇。
她在手稿标题页添加了花卉装饰小插图。
摄影师运用渐晕效果将视觉焦点集中在人物面部。

definitions.definition: 极坏的；卑鄙的；令人厌恶的

en: The dictator committed vile acts against his own people.
The room was filled with a vile odor of rotten eggs.
She was shocked by the vile language in the anonymous letter.
cn: 这位独裁者对人民犯下了卑鄙的罪行。
房间里弥漫着腐臭的鸡蛋味。
匿名信中粗鄙的语言令她震惊。

definitions.definition: 邪恶的；恶毒的；罪大恶极的

en: The dictator was known for his villainous acts against his own people.
She gave a villainous laugh as she revealed her evil plan.
The story is about a hero trying to stop the villainous schemes of a mad scientist.
cn: 这位独裁者以其对本国人民犯下的邪恶行径而闻名。
当她揭露自己的邪恶计划时，发出了恶毒的笑声。
这个故事讲述了一位英雄试图阻止一位疯狂科学家的罪恶阴谋。

definitions.definition: 维护（权利、观点等）；证明…正确

en: The new evidence vindicated him after years of false accusations.
Her success vindicated her unconventional approach.
The court's ruling vindicated the rights of minority groups.
cn: 新证据还了他清白，洗刷了多年的冤屈。
她的成功证明了她非传统方法的正确性。
法院的裁决维护了少数群体的权利。

en: His vindictive behavior ruined their friendship.
She gave him a vindictive smile after winning the argument.
The dictator was known for his vindictive punishments.
cn: 他的报复行为毁掉了他们的友谊。
赢得争论后，她对他露出报复性的微笑。
这位独裁者以报复性的惩罚手段闻名。

en: She plays the viola in the city orchestra.
The garden was filled with colorful violas in the spring.
The deep, rich sound of the viola complements the string section.
cn: 她在市交响乐团拉中提琴。
春天，花园里开满了色彩斑斓的堇菜花。
中提琴深沉饱满的声音为弦乐声部增添了色彩。

en: The video went viral on social media within hours.
Scientists are studying the viral genome to develop a vaccine.
Her tweet had a viral impact, sparking global discussions.
cn: 这段视频几小时内在社交媒体上疯传。
科学家正在研究病毒基因组以开发疫苗。
她的推文产生病毒式效应，引发全球讨论。

en: His virile appearance commanded respect in the traditional community.
The actor’s virile voice suited the heroic role perfectly.
Ancient Sparta valued virile qualities in both men and women.
cn: 他阳刚的外表在这个传统社群中赢得了尊敬。
这位演员浑厚的嗓音与英雄角色完美契合。
古斯巴达崇尚男女皆需具备刚健品格。

en: She was known as a virtuous leader who always put others first.
In medieval times, virtuous herbs were believed to cure illnesses.
His virtuous actions inspired many to volunteer.
cn: 她是一位以他人为先的品德高尚的领导者。
中世纪时，人们认为有功效的草药能治愈疾病。
他的善举激励了许多人参与志愿活动。

en: The virulent strain of flu spread rapidly across the continent.
Her virulent criticism left him deeply shaken.
The politician’s virulent rhetoric fueled social divisions.
cn: 这种高致病性流感病毒在洲际间快速传播。
她恶毒的批评让他深受打击。
该政客充满敌意的言论加剧了社会分裂。

definitions.definition: 面容，外貌（尤指表情或气质）

en: Her visage betrayed no emotion as she delivered the news.
The artist captured the weary visage of the old sailor perfectly.
A grim visage stared back at him from the mirror.
cn: 她宣布消息时，面容未泄露一丝情绪。
画家完美捕捉了老水手疲惫的面容。
镜中一张阴郁的脸回望着他。

en: The impact of the crash damaged his internal viscera.
Surgeons must handle the viscera with extreme care during operations.
The poem describes feelings that come from the viscera, raw and unfiltered.
cn: 碰撞的冲击力损伤了他的内脏。
外科医生在手术过程中必须极其小心地处理内脏器官。
这首诗描述了源自内心深处最原始、未加过滤的情感。

definitions.definition: 子爵（英国贵族头衔，位于伯爵之下、男爵之上）

en: The viscount inherited his title and estates from his father.
She was married to a viscount and thus became a viscountess.
The viscount attended the royal ceremony alongside other nobles.
cn: 子爵从其父亲那里继承了头衔与地产。
她嫁给了一位子爵，因此成为了子爵夫人。
子爵与其他贵族一同出席了皇家典礼。

definitions.definition: 正式访问（尤指官方或宗教性质的）

en: The bishop's annual visitation ensured parish compliance with church doctrines.
Hospital visitation hours are strictly enforced for patient recovery.
Some claim the ghostly visitation was a message from the afterlife.
cn: 主教的年度巡视确保了教区对教义的遵守。
医院探视时间严格规定以利于患者康复。
有人称那次幽灵显现是来自彼岸的讯息。

definitions.definition: 远景，展望；（尤指从高处看到的）景色

en: The hotel room offers a stunning vista of the ocean.
The book opens up new vistas for understanding human behavior.
From the hilltop, we enjoyed a panoramic vista of the valley below.
cn: 酒店房间可欣赏到壮观的海景。
这本书为理解人类行为开辟了新的视角。
从山顶望去，我们饱览了下方的山谷全景。

en: The software helps users visualize complex data in 3D graphs.
She closed her eyes to visualize the perfect sunset.
Athletes often visualize success before competitions.
cn: 该软件帮助用户以三维图表形式可视化复杂数据。
她闭上眼睛想象完美的日落景象。
运动员常在赛前通过想象预演成功场景。

definitions.definition: 赋予生命力；使充满活力；激励

en: The new policy aims to vitalize the local economy by attracting innovative industries.
Fresh paint and natural light can vitalize any dull room.
Her passionate speech vitalized the team to push through the final phase of the project.
cn: 新政策旨在通过吸引创新产业来激发地方经济活力。
新鲜的油漆和自然光能让任何沉闷的房间焕发生机。
她充满激情的演讲激励团队推进项目的最后阶段。

definitions.definition: （举止或气质的）活泼，快活，开朗

en: Her vivacity and optimism made her the life of the party.
The old musician played the melody with remarkable vivacity.
The film captures the vivacity of city life in the 1920s.
cn: 她的活泼与乐观使她成为了派对的焦点。
这位老音乐家以惊人的活力演奏了那段旋律。
这部电影捕捉了20世纪20年代城市生活的勃勃生机。

definitions.definition: 歌手（尤指流行或爵士乐的主唱）

en: She is the lead vocalist of the band.
The jazz vocalist improvised brilliantly during the performance.
Many vocalists train for years to perfect their technique.
cn: 她是乐队的主唱。
这位爵士歌手在演出中即兴发挥得极为出色。
许多歌手经过多年训练以精进技巧。

en: The vocalization of consonants is a key feature in many languages.
Researchers studied the vocalizations of whales to understand their communication patterns.
Proper vocalization is essential for singers to maintain healthy voices.
cn: 辅音的浊化是许多语言的关键特征。
研究人员研究鲸鱼的叫声以理解它们的交流模式。
正确的发声方法对歌手保持嗓音健康至关重要。

en: She expressed her disagreement vocally during the meeting.
Although shy, he contributed to the discussion vocally.
The protesters made their demands known vocally.
cn: 她在会议上大声地表达了她的不同意见。
尽管害羞，他还是通过口头发言为讨论做出了贡献。
抗议者们高声地表明了他们的要求。

definitions.definition: 伏特加（一种无色透明的烈酒，原产于俄罗斯和东欧）

en: He ordered a shot of vodka with ice.
Traditional vodka is made from grains or potatoes.
The cocktail mixes vodka with fresh lime juice.
cn: 他点了一杯加冰的伏特加。
传统伏特加以谷物或马铃薯酿造。
这款鸡尾酒混合了伏特加和新鲜青柠汁。

en: This hairstyle was in vogue in the 1990s.
Minimalist design is the current vogue.
The phrase gained vogue on social media.
cn: 这种发型在20世纪90年代曾风靡一时。
极简主义设计是当下的潮流。
这个短语在社交媒体上流行起来。

en: The contract was declared void due to fraud.
She stared into the void of the night sky.
The machine voids all air from the chamber.
cn: 因欺诈行为，该合同被宣告无效。
她凝视着夜空的虚无。
这台机器将腔室内的空气全部抽空。

definitions.definition: 易变的；不稳定的（情绪或局势）

en: Ether is a highly volatile liquid that evaporates quickly.
The stock market remained volatile due to political uncertainty.
Her volatile temper made it difficult to predict her reactions.
cn: 乙醚是一种极易挥发的液体，会迅速蒸发。
由于政治不确定性，股市持续波动。
她喜怒无常的脾气让人难以预测她的反应。

definitions.definition: （情绪或情况的）易变性，反复无常

en: The volatility of the stock market makes investors nervous.
Her emotional volatility surprised everyone at the meeting.
High volatility in cryptocurrency prices requires careful risk management.
cn: 股市的波动性让投资者感到紧张。
她情绪的反复无常让与会者都很惊讶。
加密货币价格的高波动性需要谨慎的风险管理。

definitions.definition: 意志的；凭意志的；自愿的

en: Her decision to leave was entirely volitional, not influenced by external pressure.
The study focuses on volitional control of movement in patients with motor disorders.
A volitional act requires conscious intention and purpose.
cn: 她离开的决定完全是自愿的，并未受到外部压力的影响。
这项研究侧重于运动障碍患者运动的意志控制。
一个意志行为需要清醒的意图和目标。

en: She was so voluble that it was difficult to get a word in edgeways.
The voluble vines twisted around the ancient oak tree.
His voluble explanation convinced everyone in the room.
cn: 她口若悬河，让别人很难插上话。
缠绕的藤蔓盘绕在那棵古老的橡树上。
他滔滔不绝的解释说服了房间里的每一个人。

definitions.definition: （文字或言语）冗长的，长篇大论的

en: She wore a voluminous skirt that billowed in the wind.
The author is known for his voluminous writings on medieval history.
The cloud appeared voluminous against the sunset sky.
cn: 她穿着一条宽大的裙子，在风中飘扬。
这位作者以关于中世纪历史的浩繁著作闻名。
云朵在夕阳映照下显得格外庞大。

en: The boat was sucked into the vortex and disappeared.
Her mind was caught in a vortex of conflicting emotions.
Scientists studied the vortex formation in the lab.
cn: 小船被卷入漩涡后消失了。
她的思绪陷入矛盾情感的漩涡中。
科学家在实验室中研究涡流的形成。

en: She was shocked by the vulgarity of his jokes at the formal dinner.
The film was criticized for its unnecessary vulgarity and crude humor.
He mistook her directness for vulgarity, failing to see her honest intent.
cn: 她在正式晚宴上被他粗俗的笑话震惊了。
这部电影因其不必要的粗俗内容和低级的幽默而受到批评。
他将她的直率误认为粗鄙，没有看出她真诚的意图。

definitions.definition: 比喻贪婪或剥削他人的人

en: The vulture circled overhead, searching for carrion.
He was accused of being a vulture, profiting from others' misfortunes.
Vultures play a crucial role in the ecosystem by cleaning up dead animals.
cn: 秃鹫在头顶盘旋，寻找腐肉。
他被指责像秃鹫一样，靠他人不幸牟利。
秃鹫通过清理动物尸体，在生态系统中扮演关键角色。

definitions.definition: （鸭子、肥胖者等）摇摇摆摆地走

en: The ducks waddled across the muddy path.
He waddled into the room, out of breath from climbing the stairs.
Her toddler’s waddle always makes everyone smile.
cn: 鸭子们摇摇摆摆地走过泥泞的小路。
他蹒跚着走进房间，爬楼梯累得气喘吁吁。
她学步孩子摇摇晃晃的步伐总让人发笑。

definitions.definition: 费力通过（液体或障碍物）

en: The hikers waded across the shallow river.
She waded through piles of paperwork.
Ducks wade in the marsh to find food.
cn: 徒步者们蹚过浅河。
她费力处理成堆的文件。
鸭子在沼泽中涉水觅食。

definitions.definition: 圣饼（宗教仪式用无酵薄饼）

en: She sandwiched ice cream between two chocolate wafers.
The priest placed the wafer on the communicant's tongue.
Silicon wafers are essential for microchip production.
cn: 她把冰淇淋夹在两片巧克力威化饼中间。
牧师将圣饼放在领圣餐者的舌头上。
硅晶圆是微芯片生产的关键材料。

definitions.definition: 爱说笑的人；摇摆的动作

en: The dog's tail began to wag excitedly when it saw its owner.
He's known as the office wag, always making everyone laugh.
The branches wagged violently in the storm.
cn: 狗狗看到主人时，尾巴兴奋地摇了起来。
他是办公室里的活宝，总逗得大家发笑。
树枝在暴风雨中剧烈摇晃。

en: The wind wailed through the abandoned house.
She wailed in grief when she heard the tragic news.
The baby’s constant wailing kept the neighbors awake.
cn: 寒风在废弃房屋中呼啸如泣。
听到噩耗时，她悲痛地痛哭起来。
婴儿持续的啼哭让邻居们无法入睡。

en: He wore a tailored waistcoat under his suit jacket.
The waistcoat added a touch of formality to his attire.
In the 18th century, waistcoats were often elaborately embroidered.
cn: 他在西装外套下穿了一件定制马甲。
这件马甲为他的着装增添了一抹正式感。
在18世纪，马甲通常带有精美的刺绣。

definitions.definition: 放弃（权利、要求等）；免除（义务、规则等）

en: The company agreed to waive the late fee as a goodwill gesture.
She waived her right to legal counsel during the interrogation.
The university may waive the application fee for low-income students.
cn: 该公司同意免除滞纳金以示善意。
她在审讯中放弃了聘请律师的权利。
大学可能为低收入学生免除申请费。

definitions.definition: （在泥、水等中）打滚；沉溺（于某种情绪）
打滚的地方；沉溺的状态

en: The pigs wallow in the mud to cool off.
He wallowed in self-pity after losing the job.
The marsh is a favorite wallow for wild boars.
cn: 猪在泥浆里打滚降温。
失业后，他沉溺于自怜中。
这片沼泽是野猪最爱的打滚地。

en: The wizard waved his wand and cast a spell.
She used a metal wand to curl her hair.
The conductor’s wand moved gracefully through the air.
cn: 巫师挥动魔杖，施了一道咒语。
她用一根金属卷发棒卷头发。
指挥棒在空中优雅地舞动。

en: The moon wanes after the full moon.
His influence began to wane after the scandal.
The company’s profits are in a wane this quarter.
cn: 满月之后，月亮逐渐亏缺。
丑闻过后，他的影响力开始减弱。
该公司本季度利润呈下降趋势。

definitions.definition: 恣意的；放纵的（尤指道德上无约束）
无端的；无理由的（如暴力、破坏）

en: The dictator was accused of wanton violence against civilians.
Her wanton disregard for rules shocked the conservative community.
cn: 独裁者被指控对平民实施无端暴力。
她对规则的肆意漠视震惊了保守的社区。

en: The merchant displayed his wares on a wooden stall.
These handmade wares are popular among tourists.
The market is known for its exotic wares from Africa.
cn: 商贩将货物陈列在木摊上。
这些手工制品深受游客喜爱。
该市场以贩售非洲异域商品闻名。

en: The damp wood began to warp over time.
The artist used heat to warp the plastic into unusual shapes.
In weaving, the warp threads run lengthwise on the loom.
cn: 潮湿的木材随时间推移开始弯曲。
艺术家用加热法将塑料扭曲成奇特形状。
织布时，经线在织机上纵向排列。

definitions.definition: 保修；保证（法律或商业中承诺产品或服务质量的书面文件）
正当理由（古义，现代较少用）

en: The laptop comes with a two-year warranty.
The manufacturer refused to honor the warranty due to water damage.
In medieval law, warranty protected buyers from defective goods.
cn: 这台笔记本电脑附带两年保修。
制造商以进水为由拒绝履行保修。
中世纪法律中，担保条款保护买家免受瑕疵商品损害。

definitions.definition: 谨慎的，小心的（对潜在危险或问题保持警觉）

en: She gave a wary smile to the stranger.
Investors are wary of putting money into unstable markets.
The cat moved forward, wary of every sound.
cn: 她对陌生人露出谨慎的微笑。
投资者对将资金投入不稳定市场持谨慎态度。
猫小心翼翼地前进，警惕着每一个声响。

definitions.definition: （纸张中的）水印；（数字媒体中的）隐形标记

en: The company's logo was embedded as a digital watermark in the photograph.
High-quality stationery often has a distinctive watermark.
You need to watermark your artwork to protect it from unauthorized use.
cn: 这家公司的标志作为数字水印被嵌入到照片中。
优质的文具通常带有独特的水印。
你需要为你的艺术作品添加水印，以防止未经授权的使用。

en: The soup was too watery and lacked flavor.
She painted the sky with watery blue strokes.
His eyes grew watery as he listened to the story.
cn: 汤太稀了，没什么味道。
她用淡蓝色的笔触描绘天空。
听着这个故事，他的眼睛湿润了。

en: The candle flame wavered in the breeze.
She didn't waver in her decision despite the pressure.
His voice wavered as he spoke about the accident.
cn: 烛火在微风中摇曳。
尽管面临压力，她的决定毫不动摇。
他谈起事故时声音颤抖。

en: The wayward child refused to follow any instructions.
A wayward breeze scattered the papers across the room.
His wayward behavior worried his parents.
cn: 这个任性的孩子拒绝听从任何指示。
一阵无常的微风把文件吹得满屋都是。
他反复无常的行为让父母忧心忡忡。

definitions.definition: 使断奶；使戒除（习惯或依赖）

en: The mother decided to wean her baby at twelve months.
cn: 这位母亲决定在孩子12个月时断奶。

definitions.definition: 楔子；楔形物；导致分裂的事物

en: He used a wooden wedge to keep the door open.
The new policy drove a wedge between the two communities.
She wedged her foot in the crack to stop the box from sliding.
cn: 他用木楔卡住门，让它保持敞开。
新政策在两个社群间制造了分裂。
她把脚挤进缝隙，防止箱子滑动。

en: The box was too weighty for the child to lift.
She made a weighty contribution to the scientific community.
His words carried a weighty significance during the meeting.
cn: 这个箱子太重了，孩子提不起来。
她对科学界做出了重大贡献。
他的发言在会议中具有举足轻重的意义。

en: The old house had a weird atmosphere.
She always wears weird clothes to stand out.
It's weird how cats always land on their feet.
cn: 这座老房子有种诡异的气氛。
她总穿奇装异服来引人注目。
猫总能四脚着地，这很不可思议。

en: He whacked the ball out of the park.
Give it a whack if you think you can fix it.
Everyone deserves a fair whack of the profits.
cn: 他一棍把球打出了球场。
要是你觉得能修好，就试试看。
每个人都应分得公平的一份利润。

definitions.definition: 一阵（气味或风）；轻微的气息

en: A whiff of fresh bread wafted from the bakery.
He whiffed the air to catch the scent of the flowers.
The batter took a swing but only got a whiff of the ball.
cn: 一阵新鲜面包的香气从面包店飘来。
他轻嗅空气，想捕捉花香。
击球手挥棒却只擦到球的一点边。

en: The artist's whimsical paintings feature flying elephants and upside-down castles.
Her whimsical sense of humor always surprises us.
The garden was decorated with whimsical sculptures of mythical creatures.
cn: 这位艺术家异想天开的画作中，大象飞翔，城堡倒悬。
她反复无常的幽默感总让我们措手不及。
花园里点缀着神话生物的奇幻雕塑。

definitions.definition: 旋风；急促而混乱的活动

en: The tornado formed a terrifying whirlwind of debris.
Her life became a whirlwind of meetings and travel.
They embarked on a whirlwind romance.
cn: 龙卷风形成了可怕的碎片旋风。
她的生活变成了会议与旅行的忙乱漩涡。
他们展开了一段闪电般的恋情。

definitions.definition: 快速移动；搅拌（蛋、奶油等）

en: She used a wire whisk to beat the eggs.
The cat's tail whisked through the air.
He whisked the documents into his briefcase.
cn: 她用金属打蛋器搅拌鸡蛋。
猫尾巴在空中快速甩动。
他把文件迅速塞进公文包。

en: She used bleach to whiten the yellowed shirts.
The dentist offers a treatment to whiten teeth.
The old walls will whiten again after the rain.
cn: 她用漂白剂使发黄的衬衫变白。
牙医提供一种美白牙齿的治疗。
雨过后，这些旧墙会再次变白。

definitions.definition: 白色涂料；粉饰；掩盖真相
粉刷；粉饰；掩盖（错误或失败）

en: The fence needs a fresh coat of whitewash before the summer.
The official report was a whitewash of the corruption scandal.
They tried to whitewash their failures by blaming external factors.
cn: 夏季前栅栏需要重新粉刷一遍。
这份官方报告是对腐败丑闻的粉饰。
他们试图通过归咎于外部因素来掩盖自己的失败。

definitions.definition: 嗖嗖声；快速移动的人或物

en: The arrow whizzed past my ear.
She's a whizz at solving math problems.
The motorbike whizzed down the empty highway.
cn: 箭嗖的一声从我耳边飞过。
她是解数学题的能手。
摩托车在空旷的公路上疾驰而下。

definitions.definition: 发出高声喊叫；喘息声（如百日咳的咳嗽声）

en: The children let out a whoop of joy when they saw the ice cream truck.
Whooping cough is named for the characteristic "whoop" sound after coughing fits.
An owl whooped in the dark forest, sending chills down her spine.
cn: 孩子们看到冰淇淋车时发出了一声欢呼。
百日咳得名于咳嗽发作后的典型“喘息”声。
猫头鹰在漆黑的森林里鸣叫，让她脊背发凉。

en: The witch cast a wicked spell on the village.
That skateboard trick was wicked!
In old tales, the wicked are often punished in the end.
cn: 女巫对村庄施了邪恶的咒语。
那个滑板技巧太厉害了！
古老故事中，恶人终将受罚。

en: The chair is made of woven wicker.
She carried a wicker basket full of flowers.
Wicker furniture is popular for outdoor use.
cn: 这把椅子由编织柳条制成。
她提着一个装满鲜花的柳条篮。
柳条家具常用于户外。

definitions.definition: 挥舞（武器或工具）；掌握（权力或影响力）

en: He learned to wield a sword at the age of twelve.
A good leader must wield authority wisely.
She wields great influence in the fashion industry.
cn: 他在十二岁时学会了舞剑。
优秀的领导者必须明智地运用权力。
她在时尚界拥有巨大影响力。

definitions.definition: 扭动，摆动（身体或某部分）

en: The puppy wiggled its tail excitedly when it saw its owner.
She managed to wiggle out of the tight jacket.
The loose tooth wiggled every time he touched it.
cn: 小狗看到主人时兴奋地摇尾巴。
她扭动着脱下了那件紧身夹克。
他的松动的牙齿每次一碰就晃动。

en: The flowers wilted under the scorching sun.
Her confidence wilted after the harsh criticism.
Water the plants, or they will wilt by noon.
cn: 花朵在烈日下枯萎了。
严厉的批评让她的信心萎靡不振。
给植物浇水，否则它们中午前就会蔫掉。

en: The wily fox escaped the hunters by doubling back on its tracks.
She outwitted her opponents with a wily strategy.
His wily smile suggested he knew more than he admitted.
cn: 狡猾的狐狸折返脚印逃脱了猎人的追捕。
她用诡计多端的策略智胜了对手。
他狡黠的笑容暗示他知道的比承认的更多。

en: She winced when the doctor touched her bruised arm.
His joke made the audience wince in secondhand embarrassment.
A slight wince crossed his face as he admitted the mistake.
cn: 医生碰到她淤青的手臂时，她疼得缩了一下。
他的笑话让观众因替人尴尬而皱眉退缩。
承认错误时，他脸上闪过一丝窘迫的表情。

definitions.definition: 意外之财；被风吹落的果实

en: The inheritance was a windfall that changed his life.
After the storm, we gathered windfall apples from the orchard.
The tax refund felt like a windfall for the struggling family.
cn: 这笔遗产改变了他的人生，纯属意外之财。
风暴过后，我们从果园捡拾被风吹落的苹果。
退税对这个拮据的家庭来说犹如雪中送炭。

definitions.definition: 一小束（头发、草等）；一缕（烟、雾）；纤细的东西

en: A wisp of smoke curled from the chimney.
She brushed away a wisp of hair from her face.
The old man carried a wisp of straw to light the fire.
cn: 一缕轻烟从烟囱袅袅升起。
她拂开脸上的一绺头发。
老人拿着一小束稻草来引火。

definitions.definition: 经受住；抵抗；承受（压力、攻击等）

en: The bridge was designed to withstand earthquakes.
She could hardly withstand the temptation of chocolate.
Their friendship withstood years of separation.
cn: 这座桥的设计能抵御地震。
她几乎无法抵抗巧克力的诱惑。
他们的友谊经受住了多年的分离。

en: The old wizard cast a spell to protect the village.
She's a wizard at solving complex math problems.
This new software is absolutely wizard!
cn: 老巫师施法保护了村庄。
她是解决复杂数学问题的奇才。
这款新软件简直太棒了！

en: The table wobbles because one leg is shorter than the others.
Her voice wobbled with emotion during the speech.
The government’s policy on this issue has begun to wobble.
cn: 桌子因一条腿较短而摇晃。
她演讲时声音因情绪激动而颤抖。
政府在这一问题上的政策开始动摇。

en: She uttered a cry of woe when she heard the tragic news.
The city was filled with woe after the earthquake.
"Woe unto you!" the prophet declared.
cn: 听到噩耗时，她发出了一声悲叹。
地震后，整座城市沉浸在悲痛中。
先知宣告：“你们有祸了！”

en: The entire nation was in woeful mourning after the tragic event.
She gave a woeful account of her failed expedition.
The team's woeful performance disappointed all their fans.
cn: 那次悲剧事件后，举国上下都沉浸在悲痛的哀悼中。
她悲伤地叙述了自己失败的远征经历。
球队糟糕的表现让所有粉丝都感到失望。

definitions.definition: 具有女性特质的；女人般的；温柔的

en: She displayed a womanly grace and compassion that impressed everyone.
Her womanly intuition told her that something was wrong.
The dress emphasized her womanly figure.
cn: 她展现出一种女性的优雅和同情心，给所有人留下了深刻印象。
她的女性直觉告诉她有些事情不对劲。
这条裙子凸显了她女性化的身材。

definitions.definition: 追求（爱情或支持）；向…求爱
努力争取（某事物，如成功或好感）

en: He tried to woo her with flowers and poetry.
The company is wooing investors with promising returns.
Politicians often woo voters before elections.
cn: 他用鲜花和诗歌追求她。
该公司以诱人的回报努力吸引投资者。
政客常在选举前争取选民支持。

en: The wording of the contract needs to be more precise.
She criticized the ambiguous wording in the advertisement.
Pay attention to the wording when drafting official documents.
cn: 这份合同的措辞需要更严谨。
她批评了广告中模棱两可的用词。
起草官方文件时需注意措辞。

en: She carefully removed the shiny wrapper from the chocolate bar.
This API acts as a wrapper for the complex database operations.
He tossed the candy wrapper into the recycling bin.
cn: 她小心地剥开巧克力棒闪亮的包装纸。
该API充当复杂数据库操作的封装层。
他把糖纸扔进了回收箱。

definitions.definition: 愤怒，暴怒（尤指强烈的、带有报复性的愤怒）

en: The king's wrath fell upon those who betrayed him.
Her eyes burned with silent wrath.
In mythology, the gods often unleashed their wrath on mortals.
cn: 国王的怒火降临在那些背叛他的人身上。
她的双眼燃烧着无声的愤怒。
神话中，众神常对凡人降下天罚。

en: They wreathed flowers into garlands for the festival.
Smoke wreathed slowly from the chimney.
Her face was wreathed in smiles when she heard the good news.
cn: 他们为节日将鲜花编成花环。
烟雾从烟囱中缓缓缭绕升起。
听到这个好消息，她脸上绽放出灿烂的笑容。

definitions.definition: （车辆、飞机等的）残骸；破坏后的残余物

en: The wreckage of the plane was scattered over a wide area.
Emotional wreckage after the divorce took years to heal.
Archaeologists studied the wreckage of an ancient Roman ship.
cn: 飞机的残骸散落在一片广阔的区域。
离婚后的情感创伤花了多年才愈合。
考古学家研究了一艘古罗马船只的残骸。

en: He used a wrench to tighten the bolt.
The fall wrenched her ankle painfully.
Her sudden departure wrenched my heart.
cn: 他用扳手拧紧了螺栓。
这一跤扭伤了她的脚踝，疼得厉害。
她的突然离开让我心如刀绞。

en: He tried to wrest the knife from the attacker's hand.
Politicians often wrest facts to fit their narratives.
The rebellion aimed to wrest control from the monarchy.
cn: 他试图从袭击者手中夺下刀子。
政客常歪曲事实以迎合其说辞。
这场叛乱旨在从君主手中夺取控制权。

definitions.definition: 扭动，蠕动（如身体或小物体）

en: The fish wriggled out of my hands and back into the river.
She managed to wriggle through the narrow gap in the fence.
Stop wriggling in your seat during the meeting!
cn: 鱼从我手中扭动着挣脱，跳回了河里。
她成功扭动着钻过了栅栏的狭窄缝隙。
开会时别在座位上扭来扭去！

definitions.definition: 拧，绞（挤出液体或使变形）

en: She wrung the wet towel to remove excess water.
The dictator wrung confessions from his prisoners.
His hands were wrung with anxiety during the speech.
cn: 她拧干湿毛巾以去除多余水分。
独裁者逼迫囚犯认罪。
演讲时他焦虑地绞着双手。

en: The injured snake writhed in the grass.
She writhed with embarrassment when her mistake was announced.
The vines writhed around the old fence, pulling it downward.
cn: 受伤的蛇在草丛中扭动。
当她的错误被公之于众时，她因尴尬而局促不安。
藤蔓缠绕着旧篱笆，将其拽得倾斜。

definitions.definition: 扭曲的；歪斜的（指面部表情或物体形状）
讽刺的；冷嘲的（指幽默或言辞）

en: She gave a wry smile when she heard the ironic compliment.
His wry sense of humor often catches people off guard.
The tree grew in a wry angle after years of wind erosion.
cn: 她听到那句讽刺的恭维时，露出一个苦笑。
他冷嘲式的幽默常让人措手不及。
多年风吹后，这棵树长得歪斜扭曲。

definitions.definition: 对外国人或陌生人的恐惧或厌恶

en: His xenophobia made him reluctant to interact with international colleagues.
The government launched a campaign to combat xenophobia and promote inclusivity.
Xenophobia often stems from ignorance and lack of exposure to other cultures.
cn: 他的排外心理使他不愿与国际同事交流。
政府发起一项运动，以对抗仇外心理并促进包容性。
仇外情绪常源于无知和缺乏对其他文化的了解。

en: The bar was full of yahoos shouting and breaking glasses.
He called the protesters a bunch of yahoos who didn't understand the issue.
Yahoo! was one of the pioneers of the early internet era.
cn: 酒吧里全是些大喊大叫、摔杯子的粗野之徒。
他称抗议者是一群不懂问题的野蛮人。
雅虎是早期互联网时代的先驱之一。

en: She yanked the cord to start the lawnmower.
The dog yanked the leash out of his hand.
Give it a quick yank to open the stuck drawer.
cn: 她猛拉绳索启动了割草机。
狗突然拽走了他手中的牵绳。
用力一拉就能打开卡住的抽屉。

definitions.definition: 仆人，侍者（古语或历史用法）
得力助手，忠诚可靠的人

en: In medieval England, a yeoman was a free man who owned and cultivated his own land.
The Yeomen of the Guard are ceremonial guardians of the Tower of London.
He was a yeoman in the service of the king, known for his loyalty and hard work.
cn: 在中世纪的英格兰，自耕农是指拥有并耕种自己土地的自由人。
伦敦塔的仪仗卫士是塔楼的仪式护卫。
他是国王身边的一位忠实侍从，以其忠诚和勤奋著称。

definitions.definition: 瑜伽（一种身心修炼体系，结合体式、呼吸与冥想）

en: She practices yoga every morning to improve her flexibility.
Yoga is not just physical exercise; it’s a way to achieve mental peace.
The ancient texts describe yoga as a union of body, mind, and spirit.
cn: 她每天早晨练习瑜伽以增强柔韧性。
瑜伽不仅是身体锻炼，更是获得内心平静的途径。
古代典籍将瑜伽描述为身体、心灵与精神的合一。

definitions.definition: （非正式）令人愉悦的，讨人喜欢的

en: The chocolate cake is so yummy!
She wore a yummy pink dress to the party.
"Yummy!" the little girl giggled while eating ice cream.
cn: 这块巧克力蛋糕太美味了！
她穿了一条讨人喜欢的粉色裙子去派对。
“好吃！”小女孩一边吃冰淇淋一边笑道。

definitions.definition: 雅皮士（指年轻、富裕、受过高等教育的都市专业人士，常追求物质享受与社会地位）

en: The downtown area is full of yuppies sipping artisanal coffee.
He traded his bohemian lifestyle for a yuppie’s designer suits.
Critics argue that yuppies prioritize materialism over social issues.
cn: 市中心满是喝着精品咖啡的雅皮士。
他放弃了波西米亚式生活，换上了雅皮士的名牌西装。
批评者认为雅皮士将物质主义置于社会问题之上。

definitions.definition: 小丑；滑稽的模仿者；笨拙的搞笑者

en: He was known for his zany sense of humor that always made everyone laugh.
The comedian's zany antics on stage captivated the entire audience.
She has a collection of zany hats that she wears to parties.
cn: 他以总能逗笑所有人的古怪幽默感而闻名。
这位喜剧演员在舞台上滑稽的古怪动作吸引住了全场观众。
她有一系列在派对上戴的滑稽帽子。

definitions.definition: 狂热者（尤指宗教或政治领域的极端拥护者）
（历史）奋锐党成员（犹太教激进派别）

en: He was a religious zealot who refused to tolerate any opposing views.
The political zealot disrupted the meeting with aggressive protests.
Historical records describe the Zealots as fierce defenders of Jewish traditions.
cn: 他曾是拒绝容忍任何反对意见的宗教狂热者。
那名政治狂热分子以激烈抗议扰乱了会议。
历史记载将奋锐党描述为犹太传统的激烈捍卫者。

definitions.definition: 天顶（天体在观测者正上方的最高点）

en: The sun reaches its zenith at noon in the tropics.
Her career was at its zenith when she won the Nobel Prize.
Ancient navigators used stars near the zenith to calibrate their compasses.
cn: 热带地区正午时分太阳升至天顶。
当她获得诺贝尔奖时，事业达到了巅峰。
古代航海者利用接近天顶的恒星校准罗盘。

en: She added lemon zest to the cake for extra flavor.
His zest for life is contagious.
The team played with zest and won the match.
cn: 她在蛋糕中加入柠檬皮以增添风味。
他对生活的热情极具感染力。
球队充满干劲地比赛并赢得了胜利。

en: The camera can zoom in to capture distant details.
A plane zoomed overhead, leaving a trail of white smoke.
The kids zoomed around the playground on their scooters.
cn: 相机可以变焦拍摄远处的细节。
一架飞机呼啸而过，留下一道白烟。
孩子们踩着滑板车在操场上飞驰。

en: The Zulu warriors displayed remarkable bravery in the battle.
She is studying Zulu to better understand South African literature.
The museum has a collection of traditional Zulu artifacts.
cn: 祖鲁战士在战斗中展现了非凡的勇气。
她正在学习祖鲁语以更深入理解南非文学。
该博物馆收藏了一批祖鲁传统手工艺品。
